However, information relevant to the present is not necessarily useful for future generation, while seemingly less relevant history may become important later. Our key insight is that historical information should be selected according to its relevance to future information needs. Capturing these needs does not require generating the full future; instead, a compact representation of what becomes important next is sufficient to guide historical selection. Building on this insight, we propose FrameMorrow, a prospective frame selector that predicts a small set of prospective tokens representing future information needs and uses them to identify relevant information from history. FrameMorrow selects explicit historical frames rather than model-specific internal states, enabling plug-and-play integration across diverse generators, including closed-source models, with little additional inference cost. We evaluate FrameMorrow across five benchmarks and 11 generative models spanning long-video generation, interactive generation, and action-conditioned world models. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent improvements in long-range consistency, visual quality, and action alignment across diverse generation settings.

</details>


### [57] [Decoupling Spherical Reasoning from Dense Prediction for 360 Depth Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38856)
*Zhijie Shen,Chunyu Lin,Shuai Zheng,Feng Li,Runmin Cong,Huihui Bai,Yao Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Fibonacci球面图（FSG）与球面上下文调制（SCC）模块，将全景深度估计的上下文建模从ERP空间解耦到近似均匀的球面空间，在降低畸变影响与计算开销的同时提升稠密预测精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 等距柱状投影（ERP）广泛用于全景深度估计，但其随纬度变化的空间畸变导致几何一致的特征建模困难，尤其在关系建模中高纬度拉伸区域被过度表示。

Method: 提出Fibonacci球面图（FSG）作为中间推理空间，将ERP特征提升到球面上近似均匀分布的Fibonacci节点，通过互补的球面邻域捕获局部与长程依赖；节点数量紧凑，避免在全ERP分辨率上构图的开销。进一步提出球面上下文调制（SCC）模块，用增强的球面表示自适应调制稠密ERP特征，使球面上下文引导像素对齐的深度预测。

Result: 在三个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，所提方法在深度精度上持续优于现有方法。

Conclusion: 通过将上下文建模解耦到原生球面空间、并保留ERP稠密预测的优势，该方法在几何一致性与计算效率之间取得更好平衡，验证了球面中间推理空间在全景深度估计中的有效性。

Abstract: The equirectangular projection (ERP) is widely used for panoramic depth estimation, but its spatially varying distortion makes geometry-consistent feature modeling challenging. We revisit panoramic depth estimation by decoupling contextual modeling in native spherical space from dense ERP prediction. To this end, we propose a Fibonacci Spherical Graph (FSG) as an intermediate reasoning space to lift ERP features onto quasi-uniform Fibonacci nodes on the sphere and capture local and long-range dependencies through complementary spherical neighborhoods. The resulting spherical discretization distributes graph nodes approximately uniformly over the spherical surface, reducing the over-representation of highly stretched regions during relational modeling. Operating on a compact set of Fibonacci nodes also avoids the computational burden of constructing and processing a graph at full ERP resolution. To bridge spherical reasoning and dense prediction, we propose a Spherical Context Conditioning (SCC) module that adaptively modulates dense ERP features with the enhanced spherical representation, allowing spherical context to guide pixel-aligned depth prediction. Extensive experiments on three benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed method consistently achieves superior depth accuracy over existing approaches.

</details>


### [58] [AdaOcc: Adaptive 3D Occupancy Prediction for Embodied Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38864)
*Jinglong Wang,Yunjie Wang,Zhiyang Zhang,Jiawei He,Ye Yuan,Bo Qiu,Jing Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出AdaOcc，一种面向具身场景的基于点的自适应3D语义占用预测方法，支持异构传感器输入与可调计算预算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 具身任务需要准确、灵活、语义丰富的3D场景表示。3D语义占用能建模整体3D空间，但现有占用预测方法难以适应变化的计算预算、传感器配置和观测视角等实际部署需求。

Method: AdaOcc采用自适应几何引导的双分支编码器，支持不同视图数量的RGB图像（含估计深度）或LiDAR扫描；用稀疏语义点表示占用区域，并通过渐进式查询学习策略训练；计算预算可通过查询点数量和解码器层数灵活调整；此外提出一种新的包含损失（containment loss），约束预测点位于有效占用区域内，以实现高保真几何建模。

Result: 大量实验表明，该方法在Occ-ScanNet上达到新的SOTA，相比此前方法有显著性能提升；作为自适应3D感知模块在真实具身系统中展现出很强的实用性。

Conclusion: AdaOcc通过基于点的自适应设计兼顾了灵活性、计算可调性与几何保真度，验证了其在具身3D感知中的有效性和部署潜力。

Abstract: Embodied tasks demand accurate, flexible, and semantically rich 3D scene representations. 3D semantic occupancy is well suited to this requirement, as it can model holistic 3D spaces by encoding geometric occupancy along with semantic categories. However, existing occupancy prediction methods struggle to meet practical deployment requirements, such as adapting to varying computing budgets, sensor setups, and observation views. In this paper, we propose a point-based Adaptive 3D Occupancy Prediction method, called AdaOcc, tailored for embodied scenarios. To accommodate heterogeneous sensor inputs, AdaOcc uses an adaptive geometry-guided dual-branch encoder that can support RGB images in various numbers of views with (estimated) depth maps or LiDAR scans. AdaOcc represents occupied regions via sparse semantic points trained with a progressive query learning strategy, allowing the prediction computational budget to be flexibly adjusted through query point numbers and decoder layers. To facilitate high-fidelity geometric modeling for lightweight point-based occupancy learning, we further propose a novel containment loss that regularizes predicted points to reside within valid occupied regions. Extensive experiments show that our method achieves a new state-of-the-art on Occ-ScanNet with considerable performance improvements over previous methods. Moreover, our framework demonstrates strong practical applicability as an adaptive 3D perception module in real-world embodied systems.

</details>


### [59] [MEMO: Multi-Level Entity-Aware Memory for Streaming Video Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38900)
*Yinying Li,Yuqian Fu,Yulin Dai,Jingyu Gong,Tianwen Qian,Xiaoling Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MEMO框架，通过多层级、实体感知的结构化记忆对无界视频流建模，以轻量全局/实体表征作为检索索引、单独保留高分辨率视觉内容按需调用，无需训练即可插拔至现有多模态大模型，在StreamingBench和OVO-Bench上取得SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流式视频理解需在极长时间跨度上处理无界视觉流并保留丰富视觉语义，记忆建模是核心难点。现有方法主要着力于扩大记忆容量（压缩为固定尺寸表征或扩展至GPU外存储），但多依赖全局或粗粒度表征，不可避免地丢失细粒度视觉信息。

Method: 提出MEMO框架，进行多层级感知以联合捕获全局语义、实体动态与空间结构，将视频流切分为语义连贯的块（chunk）。每块组织为结构化记忆：轻量的全局与实体级表征作为检索索引，对应的高分辨率视觉内容单独保留以供按需访问。推理时基于查询在结构化记忆上做查询特定检索，选择性召回相关视觉证据供下游推理。该框架免训练、可插拔。

Result: 在StreamingBench与OVO-Bench上大量实验表明，MEMO持续提升多个基座模型表现并达到最先进性能。

Conclusion: 流式视频记忆应显式编码结构化、语义有意义的表征，尤其是实体层级；MEMO验证了实体感知结构化记忆在流式视频理解中的有效性。

Abstract: Streaming video understanding requires models to process unbounded visual streams while preserving rich visual semantics across vast temporal horizons, posing a fundamental challenge for memory modeling. Existing approaches primarily focus on increasing memory capacity, either by compressing historical information into fixed-size representations or by extending storage beyond GPU memory. However, these methods largely rely on global or coarse-grained representations, inevitably losing fine-grained visual information. In this work, we argue that streaming video memory should explicitly encode structured and semantically meaningful representations, particularly at the entity level. To this end, we propose MEMO, a novel framework that models streaming video through multi-level, entity-aware structured memory. MEMO performs multi-level perception to jointly capture global semantics, entity dynamics, and spatial structures, partitioning streaming video into semantically coherent chunks. Each chunk is organized into a structured memory, where lightweight global and entity-level representations serve as retrieval indices, while the corresponding high-resolution visual content is retained separately for on-demand access. At inference time, MEMO performs query-specific retrieval over the structured memory and selectively recalls relevant visual evidence for downstream reasoning. Notably, MEMO is training-free and plug-and-play with existing multimodal large language models. Extensive experiments on StreamingBench and OVO-Bench demonstrate that MEMO consistently improves multiple base models and achieves state-of-the-art performance.

</details>


### [60] [FLOW: Feature-Level Optimal Warping for Generalized Remote Physiological Measurement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38913)
*Bo Zhao,Junzhe Cao,Dan Guo,Dongmin Huang,Wenjin Wang,Tao Tan,Yue Sun,Zitong YU*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FLOW是一个基于最优传输的域泛化rPPG框架，通过时间精炼模块与原型跨时间最优传输模块实现域不变对齐，在四个基准上取得SOTA跨域性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 远程光电容积描记（rPPG）支持非接触式生理测量，但易受光照、运动、传感器等因素引起的域偏移影响，现有方法跨域泛化能力不足。

Method: 提出FLOW（Feature-Level Optimal Warping）框架：1）时序精炼模块（TRM）稳定时间动态；2）基于原型的跨时序最优传输模块（PCOT）借助可学习原型实现域不变对齐；3）采用软跨时序对应建模，灵活对齐时序特征以保留生理信号固有节律；4）模块轻量化，可无缝嵌入现有端到端rPPG架构，无需额外预处理；5）引入两个正则项分别约束源域一致性与身份保持；理论上推导了条件最优传输下的泛化界。

Result: 在四个rPPG基准数据集上，FLOW以轻量设计和强生理保真度实现了最先进的跨域性能。

Conclusion: FLOW验证了最优传输驱动的特征级对齐在rPPG域泛化中的有效性，兼顾轻量化、跨域性能与生理信号保真度。

Abstract: Remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) enables non-contact physiological measurement but remains vulnerable to domain shifts from illumination, motion, and sensors. We propose \textbf{FLOW (Feature-Level Optimal Warping)}, an \emph{optimal transport--driven} framework for domain-generalized rPPG. FLOW integrates a \textbf{Temporal Refinement Module (TRM)} to stabilize temporal dynamics and a \textbf{Prototype-based Cross-Temporal Optimal Transport (PCOT)} module to achieve domain-invariant alignment via learnable prototypes.Beyond feature alignment, FLOW employs soft cross-temporal correspondence modeling that aligns temporal features in a flexible manner, allowing the model to respect and preserve the intrinsic rhythmic patterns of physiological signals. Moreover, the lightweight design of our modules allows seamless integration into existing end-to-end rPPG architectures without additional preprocessing. Two regularization terms further enforce source consistency and identity preservation. Theoretically, we derive a generalization bound under conditional optimal transport. Extensive experiments across four rPPG benchmarks show that FLOW achieves state-of-the-art cross-domain performance with lightweight design and strong physiological fidelity.

</details>


### [61] [From Image Interpretation to Clinical Reasoning: Upstream Physician-Context-Aware Multimodal Learning with Causal Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38924)
*Jialu Pi,Yanan Ma,Weijie Chen,Owen Crystal,Shubham Trivedi,Stephen Xie,Anna Silverman,Matthew Stib,Chadi Ayoub,Reza Arsanjani,Imon Banerjee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出因果强化学习框架，融合胸片与临床病史进行机会性MACE预测，在多队列上优于单模态与SOTA医学视觉语言模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MACE是全球主要死因，利用常规采集数据进行机会性筛查可规模化识别高危个体。胸片含潜在心血管生物标志物，临床病史提供互补信息，但现有医学视觉语言模型主要面向影像解读，而非预后推理。

Method: 面向多模态临床推理的因果强化学习框架，整合胸片与医生撰写的临床病史。包含三部分：(1) 角色解耦的双LLM架构，将推理与风险预测分离；(2) 双动作因果强化学习策略，用于证据选择与推理优化；(3) 因果token剪枝，学习紧凑的多模态表示。

Result: 在内部队列、急诊队列和外部MIMIC数据集上评估，AUROC分别为0.720、0.760、0.845，持续优于单模态基线和SOTA医学视觉语言模型；推理质量显著提升，GREEN分数与专家偏好更高，同时在不同人群中保持稳健的预测性能。

Conclusion: 该框架验证了因果强化学习驱动的多模态推理在机会性MACE预测中的有效性，兼顾预测性能与可解释推理质量。

Abstract: Major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE) remain the leading cause of mortality worldwide. Opportunistic screening using routinely acquired clinical data offers a scalable approach for identifying high-risk individuals before acute events occur. Although chest X-rays (CXRs) capture latent cardiovascular biomarkers and clinical histories provide complementary patient context, existing medical vision-language models are primarily optimized for radiology interpretation rather than prognostic reasoning. We propose a causal reinforcement learning framework for multimodal clinical reasoning that integrates CXRs and physician-authored clinical histories for opportunistic MACE prediction. The framework introduces (1) a role-decoupled dual-LLM architecture that separates reasoning from risk prediction, (2) a dual-action causal reinforcement learning policy for evidence selection and reasoning optimization, and (3) causal token pruning to learn compact multimodal representations. Evaluated on an internal cohort, an emergency department cohort, and the external MIMIC dataset, the proposed framework consistently outperformed unimodal baselines and state-of-the-art medical vision-language models, achieving AUROCs of 0.720, 0.760, and 0.845, respectively. It also substantially improved reasoning quality, achieving higher GREEN scores and higher expert preference while maintaining robust predictive performance across diverse patient populations.

</details>


### [62] [On the Relaxation of Conditional Independence Assumption for Image Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38930)
*Zixun Wang,Ben Dai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文将RankSEG中的条件独立假设替换为空间局部依赖结构，并结合倒数矩近似与不动点优化，将复杂度降至O(d log d)，在低对比度和小目标分割场景中显著优于argmax与CIA-based RankSEG。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RankSEG在推理阶段直接优化Dice/IoU，但因依赖条件独立假设（CIA）而忽略标签相关性，导致在模糊、低对比度场景下性能下降；而完整建模标签依赖需O(d^3)时间复杂度，计算不可行。

Method: 用空间局部依赖（SLD）结构替代CIA以捕捉局部标签相关性，保持依赖模型可处理；再用倒数矩近似结合新型不动点优化策略消除穷举搜索，实现O(d log d)复杂度。

Result: 在多个分割基准上持续优于传统argmax和基于CIA的RankSEG；在低对比度或小目标场景中提升显著，标签依赖提供了与图像信息互补的有效信号。代码已开源。

Conclusion: 通过引入可 tractable 的局部依赖建模与高效优化，克服了RankSEG的CIA限制和计算瓶颈，实现了实用复杂度下的性能提升，验证了标签依赖对分割任务的价值。

Abstract: In semantic segmentation, a recent line of RankSEG methods directly optimizes Dice/IoU scores at inference time, improving alignment with evaluation metrics without modifying model training. Despite its theoretical and empirical success, RankSEG relies on the restrictive Conditional Independence Assumption (CIA), which ignores crucial label correlations and therefore degrades performance in ambiguous or low-contrast scenarios. However, accounting for full label dependence is computationally prohibitive, requiring $\mathcal{O}(d^3)$ time. To address this, we replace the CIA with a Spatially Localized Dependence (SLD) structure that captures local label correlations while keeping the dependence model tractable. We further overcome the remaining computational bottleneck via a Reciprocal Moment Approximation coupled with a novel fixed-point optimization strategy that eliminates exhaustive search. The proposed algorithm achieves a highly practical $\mathcal{O}(d \log d)$ complexity and consistently outperforms conventional argmax and CIA-based RankSEG across diverse segmentation benchmarks. Improvements are significant in low-contrast or small-object scenarios, where label dependence offers valuable signals complementary to image information for accurate segmentation. The code of experiments is available at https://github.com/ZixunWang/RankSEG-DEP.

</details>


### [63] [Beyond Spatial-Domain Supervision: A Relation Constrained Space for Multi-Modal Image Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38968)
*Zeyu Wang,Mingyu Ge,Haiyu Song,Haoran Duan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出关系约束监督范式（RCS-Fusion），将多模态图像融合的监督从空间域迁移到学习到的关系空间，利用冻结的DINO与CLIP特征经可学习适配器推断共享性、主导性、协调半径三个关系参数并构造对应损失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态图像融合缺乏真实融合图像（ground-truth），现有监督普遍以空间域源图像或其梯度变体作为代理真值，导致监督机制与MMIF目标本身错位，引发像素级折中或模态偏置问题。

Method: 将融合监督从空间域移到学习到的关系空间；以冻结预训练表征模型（DINO、CLIP）作为信息提供者，设计可学习特征适配器将异质特征对齐到统一监督空间；适配器推断共享性（sharedness）、主导性（dominance）与协调半径（coordination radius）三个关系参数，并据此定义三个与MMIF目标对应的损失；针对适配器设计自监督对比排序目标，并通过交替优化与融合网络耦合。

Result: 大量实验表明，所提监督空间在融合网络采用不同主流主干时均能带来显著性能增益，验证了其与MMIF目标更好对齐的有效性。代码已开源：github.com/GMY628/RCS-Fusion。

Conclusion: 该工作提供了一种与MMIF目标更对齐的监督范式，摆脱对空间域代理真值的依赖，且对融合主干具有良好通用性与可移植性。

Abstract: Multi-modal image fusion (MMIF) aims to form a single image by integrating shared information, preserving complementary cues, and coordinating cross-modal conflicts across modalities. However, due to the absence of ground-truth fused images, existing MMIF supervision commonly uses spatial-domain sources or gradient variants as surrogate ground truth, making the supervision mechanism inherently misaligned with the goal of MMIF and causing pixel-level compromise or modality bias. To address this, we propose a relation-constrained supervision paradigm that moves fusion supervision from the spatial domain to a learned relation space. Rather than relying solely on direct source approximation, we further leverage frozen pretrained representation models as information providers and design a learnable feature adapter to align heterogeneous DINO and CLIP features into a unified supervision space. The adapter infers three relation parameters, namely sharedness, dominance, and coordination radius, which define three losses corresponding to the MMIF's goal. To make this space reliable, we devise a self-supervised contrastive ranking objective tailored to the adapter and couple it with the fusion network through alternating optimization. Extensive experiments show that the proposed supervision space yields significant gains regardless of which mainstream backbone the fusion network adopts, offering a supervision paradigm better aligned with the goal of MMIF. Code: github.com/GMY628/RCS-Fusion.

</details>


### [64] [PARK: Accurate Block Retrieval for Sparse Attention in Video Diffusion Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38978)
*Yun Dai,Jiarui Wen,Huiping Zhuang,Cen Chen,Ziqian Zeng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PARK是一种免训练稀疏注意力方法，通过修正查询块与键块检索中的两类不匹配，实现更准确的块检索，在保持视频生成质量的同时加速推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散Transformer（DiTs）已成为视频生成的主流架构，但全注意力的二次复杂度限制了其效率。稀疏注意力通过检索重要块并仅在块内计算注意力来降低成本，然而不准确的检索会导致生成质量下降或产生不必要的计算。现有方法使用查询块和键块的平均表示进行块检索，存在两类不匹配问题。

Method: 作者识别出两类检索不匹配：(i) 查询侧聚合不匹配：在Softmax之前对查询求平均，无法保留各个查询的注意力偏好；(ii) 键侧聚类度量不匹配：在原键空间中使用欧氏距离聚类，可能将当前查询下QK分数差异较大的键分到一组，导致其平均表示无法准确反映当前查询对各键的评分。为此提出PARK：保留每个原始查询，独立地在键块上归一化其注意力，再在查询块内对这些分布求平均；同时利用当前查询信息在聚类前对键进行变换，使获得相似QK分数的键聚在一起。此外使用融合GPU内核降低块检索开销。

Result: 在HunyuanVideo和Wan上的实验表明，PARK提升了块检索准确率，在加速推理的同时保持了生成质量，在对比的稀疏注意力方法中取得了最佳的质量-效率权衡。

Conclusion: PARK作为一种免训练的稀疏注意力方法，通过修正查询侧聚合与键侧聚类度量的不匹配，显著提高了视频生成中块检索的准确性，实现了质量与效率的良好平衡。

Abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have become a dominant architecture for video generation, but their efficiency is limited by the quadratic complexity of full attention. Sparse attention reduces this cost by retrieving important blocks and computing attention only within them, but inaccurate retrieval can either degrade generation quality or yield unnecessary computation. We identify two retrieval mismatches in methods that retrieve blocks using the averaged representations of query and key blocks: (i) query-side aggregation mismatch, where averaging queries before Softmax fails to preserve their individual attention preferences, and (ii) key-side clustering metric mismatch, where standard Euclidean clustering in the original key space can group keys with dissimilar QK scores under the current query, so their average representation may not accurately represent how the current query scores individual keys. These mismatches can lead to inaccurate block retrieval. To address these mismatches, we propose PARK, a training-free sparse attention method for accurate block retrieval. PARK retains every original query, independently normalizes its attention over key blocks, and then averages these distributions within each query block. It also uses information from the current queries to transform keys before clustering, so that keys receiving similar QK scores are grouped together. A fused GPU kernel further reduces the overhead of block retrieval. Experiments on HunyuanVideo and Wan demonstrate that PARK improves block retrieval accuracy and preserves generation quality while accelerating inference, achieving the best quality-efficiency trade-off among the compared sparse attention methods.

</details>


### [65] [Mitigating Object Hallucination in Large Vision-Language Models via False Discovery Controlled Visual Data Splitting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38979)
*Chang Liu,Yu Tian,Rui Xie*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练框架CORAL，利用不确定性感知视觉数据划分与镜像统计量化视觉对比，在图像级以FDR控制虚假物体预测，抑制LVLM多物体幻觉。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）在解码中因视觉不确定性产生多物体幻觉，即生成视觉输入不支持的物体。现有对比信号方法依赖启发式，缺乏对图像级假阳性的原则性控制。

Method: CORAL为免训练框架：采用不确定性感知的视觉数据划分策略建模视觉不确定性；通过成对、对称扰动的视觉输入计算镜像统计量（mirror statistics），量化解码中的视觉对比，据此估计虚假物体预测，并设定数据驱动阈值，控制每张图像期望的虚假发现比例（FDR）。

Result: 在多个基准与多种评价指标上，CORAL持续超越现有最优方法，在保留真实有依据物体的高检出力（high power）的同时抑制幻觉，实现更可靠、稳健的幻觉控制。

Conclusion: CORAL是一种灵活、支持多种LVLM、无需重训练或监督的幻觉缓解框架，通过FDR原则性控制图像级假阳性，为LVLM多物体幻觉提供可靠控制。代码已开源。

Abstract: Multiple object hallucination, where large vision-language models (LVLMs) generate objects not supported by the visual input, is a persistent challenge caused by visual uncertainty during decoding. Existing methods reduce hallucinations using contrastive signals, but they rely on heuristics and lack principled control of false positives at the image level. To address this, we propose False Discovery Rate-COntRol of HALlucination (CORAL), a training-free framework that models visual uncertainty using an uncertainty-aware visual data splitting strategy and leverages mirror statistics to quantify visual contrast during decoding. By computing mirror statistics from paired, symmetrically perturbed visual inputs, CORAL estimates spurious object predictions and sets a data-driven threshold to control the expected fraction of false discoveries per image, suppressing hallucinations while retaining high power for truly grounded objects. The framework is flexible, supports multiple LVLMs, and mitigates hallucinations without retraining or supervision. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks with several evaluation metrics demonstrate that CORAL consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, providing more reliable and robust hallucination control. Code is available at: https://changliu1993-cl.github.io/CORAL/

</details>


### [66] [MeshOctave generates meshes via cascading resolution transitions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38985)
*Junkai Lin,Tianhao Zhao,Hang Long,Huipeng Guo,Jielei Zhang,Youjia Zhang,Jiale Xu,Wenbing Li,Rendong Liang,Jozef Hladký,Matthias Nießner,Yuanming Hu,Wei Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MeshOctave 以二进网格分辨率定义尺度，通过确定性的体素合并与“拆分-重连”逆操作实现并行、逐尺度加一位精度的高效网格生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有艺术家风格、显式拓扑的网格生成依赖自回归模型（逐 token 串行代价过高）或连续流模型（依赖启发式连通性解码器）；次尺度生成范式虽可并行化，但通常通过渐进网格简化构造层级并需顺序反演，导致失去尺度内并行性、生成步数随面数线性增长。

Method: 提出 MeshOctave：用二进空间网格分辨率定义尺度，粗化视为确定性坍塌——合并同体素单元顶点并继承连通性；逆操作为 split-and-rewire，对每个粗面确定实例化哪些八分体子顶点，并用离散结构 token 解析局部连通性。逐面操作无需序列化，每次尺度转换建模为无序集合、增加一位坐标精度，天然支持动态长度网格与自适应分辨率细化；构建尺度条件化的掩码均匀离散扩散模型，从分辨率坍塌层级中学习该操作。

Result: 在几何保真度与拓扑有效性上显著优于强基线，并支持自适应分辨率细化，可自然扩展到网格细分任务。

Conclusion: MeshOctave 通过分辨率坍塌层级与掩码离散扩散，实现了并行、可扩展且拓扑有效的逐尺度网格生成，为艺术家风格网格建模提供了新的高效范式。

Abstract: Generating compact, artist-style meshes with explicit topology typically relies on autoregressive models which incur prohibitive sequential per-token costs, or continuous flow models that depend on heuristic connectivity decoders. Next-scale generation paradigms offer a compelling alternative by enabling parallel intra-scale token prediction and coarse-to-fine refinement from global structure to local topology; yet, existing methods derive hierarchical scales via progressive mesh simplification and invert them sequentially. This eliminates intra-scale parallelism and scales generation steps linearly with face count. In this paper, we propose MeshOctave, which instead defines scale through dyadic spatial grid resolutions, framing coarsening as a deterministic collapse that merges vertices sharing a voxel cell and inherits connectivity. Its inverse operation, split-and-rewire, determines which octant sub-vertices are instantiated for each coarse face and resolves local connectivity using discrete structural tokens. These per-face operations require no serialization, each scale transition is modeled as an unordered set that adds one bit of coordinate precision, naturally supporting dynamic-length meshes and adaptive resolution refinement. We construct a scale-conditioned masked-uniform discrete diffusion model to learn split-and-rewire operation from resolution collapse hierarchies. MeshOctave outperforms strong baselines in geometric fidelity and topological validity by a non-trivial margin, while supporting adaptive resolution refinement and extending naturally to mesh subdivision tasks.

</details>


### [67] [When Integral Meets Decomposition: A Signal-Level Self-Supervised Feature Decompose Paradigm for Multi-Modal Image Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39004)
*Zeyu Wang,Jiayu Wang,Haiyu Song,Haoran Duan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种一维信号级自监督特征分解范式（SIDFusion），将多模态图像融合中缺乏真值监督的二维图像级特征分解重述为积分驱动的1D信号级优化问题，并采用两阶段自监督框架实现融合，在代表性MMIF任务上取得SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态图像融合（MMIF）旨在整合不同模态的互补信息生成高质量融合图像并支撑下游任务。特征分解范式通过将源图像分离为公共特征与模态特有特征而成为重要方法。然而，现有方法缺乏清晰监督：由于不存在分解特征图的真值（GT），通常以多个图像级指标的组合作为损失，这些损失本身不完整且可能相互冲突，因为每个像素耦合了纹理、边缘、轮廓等多种属性。

Method: 提出1D信号级自监督特征分解范式，将原本模糊的2D图像级监督重述为积分驱动的1D信号级优化问题，利用1D信号形式计算积分约束，通过公共信号与原始信号之间的积分面积来优化分解器，使优化更稳定且目标明确。模型采用两阶段自监督学习框架：阶段一设计双预训练任务，分别在信号级进行积分驱动分解、在图像级进行结构保持重建；阶段二融合特有特征并与公共特征结合以重建融合图像。

Result: 在代表性MMIF任务上的实验表明该方法达到最先进（SOTA）性能。代码已开源：github.com/Wangjiayu0512/SIDFusion。

Conclusion: 通过目标层面的重述，将缺乏真值监督的特征分解转化为具有明确优化目标的1D信号级积分约束问题，配合两阶段自监督框架，有效缓解了多指标损失不完整与冲突的问题，实现了稳定优化与优异的融合效果。

Abstract: Multimodal image fusion (MMIF) aims to integrate complementary information from different modalities into a high-quality fused image and support downstream tasks. Recently, feature decomposition has become an important paradigm by separating source images into common and modality-specific unique features. However, existing methods lack clear supervision because ground-truth (GT) decomposition feature maps are unavailable. They usually combine multiple image-level metrics as losses, which are inherently incomplete and may conflict since each pixel couples attributes such as texture, edge, and contour. To address this, we propose a 1D signal-level self-supervised feature decomposition paradigm. Our core insight is to reformulate feature decomposition from unclear 2D image-level supervision into an integral-driven 1D signal-level optimization problem. This objective-level reformulation uses the 1D signal form to compute the integral constraint. The decomposer is optimized by the integral area between common and original signals, enabling more stable optimization with a clear optimization objective. Our model follows a two-stage SSL framework. Stage I designs dual pretext tasks for integral-driven decomposition at the signal level and structure-preserving reconstruction at the image level. Stage II fuses unique features and combines them with common features to reconstruct the fused image. Experiments on representative MMIF tasks show state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance. Code: github.com/Wangjiayu0512/SIDFusion.

</details>


### [68] [Frame Differential On-Policy Self-Distillation for Video Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39021)
*Haiying He,Xin Zheng,Shaoli Hu,Shijun Xiao,Xuanhe Liu,Bing Li,Harry Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 FD-OPSD，通过稀疏与密集帧视图下同一响应的 token 级偏好差分进行在线自蒸馏，将密集帧证据迁移到稀疏帧策略，不增加推理成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频推理 RL 训练中帧预算固定且两难：帧数多则自回归 rollout 昂贵，帧数少则易漏掉时间局部事件与细粒度视觉细节。需要一个在不增加推理开销的前提下利用密集帧证据的方案。

Method: Frame Differential On-Policy Self-Distillation：对同一采样响应，分别计算策略在稀疏视图与密集视图下的 token 级偏好（分布/似然），以二者差分作为蒸馏信号，无需外部教师模型、也无需密集自回归 rollout；训练保持稀疏帧 rollout，推理流程不变。

Result: 在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 与 Qwen3-VL-4B 上，于 16/32/64 帧评测设置下，六个视频推理基准的平均性能均优于对应的 GRPO、T-GRPO、Video-KTR 最强基线。

Conclusion: 密集视觉证据可在训练阶段通过 token 级自蒸馏被选择性迁移至稀疏帧策略，同时保留稀疏帧 rollout 与不变的推理代价。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has substantially improved the reasoning ability of multimodal language models through verifiable rewards and increasingly fine-grainedvisual or temporal credit assignment. In video reasoning, however, current RL methods typically train with a fixed sparse frame budget: increasing the number of frames makes autoregressive rollouts expensive, while too few frames may miss temporally localized events and fine-grained visual details. We present \textbf{Frame Differential On-Policy Self-Distillation (FD-OPSD)}, which transfers the useful evidence of dense frame observations to a sparse frame policy during RL training. FD-OPSD compares the policy's token level preferences for the same sampled response under sparse and dense views, and distills the resulting frame differential signal without an external teacher or dense autoregressive rollout. The method preserves sparse-frame rollouts and leaves inference unchanged. Across Qwen2.5-VL-7B and Qwen3-VL-4B on six video reasoning benchmarks, FD-OPSD yields higher overall average performance than the strongest corresponding GRPO, T-GRPO, or Video-KTR baselines across the 16, 32, and 64 frame evaluation settings. These results show that dense visual evidence can be transferred selectively during training through token level self-distillation while retaining sparse frame rollouts and unchanged inference.

</details>


### [69] [Persistent Watermarking of Text-to-Image Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39024)
*Dixi Yao,Kaiwen Chen,Tahseen Rabbani,Tian Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种对比式水印目标，显式促使加水印模型在触发输入上与原始模型行为不同，从而在多种下游修改和擦除攻击下实现更强的触发数据持久性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: T2I模型训练成本高昂，需要可靠版权保护机制；但攻击者可能未经授权获取并复用预训练模型，通过API提供经下游适配或恶意擦除（输入提示预处理、模型微调、输出后处理）的修改版本。核心挑战是在这些改动下保持触发数据持久性，同时不损害模型正常生成能力。

Method: 提出一种对比式（contrastive-style）水印目标函数，其中包含一个显式项，鼓励加水印模型在触发输入上的行为与原始模型产生差异。

Result: 在多种下游修改和蓄意削弱水印的尝试下，触发数据持久性显著强于先前方法，检测率更高，通常接近100% TPR@FPR<10^{-4}。

Conclusion: 对比式水印目标通过显式放大触发输入上的模型行为差异，有效提升水印鲁棒性，为T2I模型版权保护提供了实用方案。

Abstract: Text-to-image (T2I) generation is gaining increasing popularity with the general public, motivating the development of reliable mechanisms for copyrighting such models given their expensive training costs. An adversary may obtain and reuse a pretrained T2I model without authorization, and then serve a modified version through an API service. Such modifications may arise from ordinary downstream adaptation or deliberate attempts to erase ownership, including input-prompt preprocessing, model fine-tuning, and output post-processing. From the model owner's perspective, a key challenge is therefore to embed trigger data that remain persistent under such changes while preserving the model's normal image-generation capabilities. In this work, we propose a contrastive-style watermarking objective with a term that explicitly encourages the watermarked model to behave differently from the original model on trigger inputs. Experiments show substantially stronger trigger-data persistence than prior methods across a wide range of downstream modifications and deliberate attempts to weaken the watermark, resulting in higher detection rates, often approaching 100% TPR@FPR<$10^{-4}$.

</details>


### [70] [TED:Text-Axis Evidence Decomposition for Prompted Anomaly Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39033)
*JinYoung Kim,Geonho Kim,GiJeong Park,Geonu Lee,YoungJoon Yoo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出TED（Text-Axis Evidence Decomposition）后处理评分方法，通过对比缺陷补丁与"被误判为异常的"正常补丁的文本轴证据支持，提升CLIP类异常检测器的像素级定位可靠性，无需目标域训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CLIP并非为细粒度缺陷定位设计，基于CLIP的异常检测器常通过prompt或轻量模块增强缺陷敏感性。但作者发现：更高的敏感性并不保证局部证据可靠——在域偏移下，适配后的CLIP-AD会对真实缺陷和视觉复杂的正常区域同时给出高异常分。问题根源不是缺陷信息缺失，而是局部评分规则将缺陷证据与"难样本正常"证据解码为相同的异常证据。

Method: TED是一种后处理评分方法，对每个模糊响应判断其更受源域缺陷补丁支持，还是更受被误判为异常的源域正常补丁支持；在宿主模型的正常-异常文本响应下比较这两种支持度。方法不改动骨干网络与prompt，无需目标域训练：既可作为原始VLM骨干的无训练评分，也可作为适配CLIP-AD宿主的源域校准残差修正。

Result: 在冻结VLM骨干上，TED相比原始prompt相似度显著提升像素级定位；在适配宿主上，在多数像素级设定中优于P-AUROC、P-PRO、P-AP。在更强的难负样本竞争下增益最大，平均定位增益从低竞争场景的+5.0升至中/高竞争场景的约+10.9。

Conclusion: 结果表明，可恢复的缺陷证据已存在于预训练多模态表征中，但实现可靠定位需要相对于难正常竞争者的解码方式。代码将发布于TED GitHub仓库。

Abstract: CLIP is a powerful vision-language model, but it was not designed for fine-grained defect localization; CLIP-based anomaly detectors therefore adapt it with prompts or lightweight modules to increase defect sensitivity. We show that stronger sensitivity does not necessarily make local evidence reliable: under domain shift, adapted CLIP-AD models often assign high anomaly scores to both true defects and visually complex normal regions. The issue is not simply missing defect information, but a local scoring rule that decodes defect and hard-normal evidence, having the same anomaly evidence. We propose TED (Text-Axis Evidence Decomposition), a post-hoc scoring method that asks whether each ambiguous response is better supported by source defect patches or by source normal patches mistaken as anomalous. TED compares these supports under the host's normal-versus-anomaly text response, leaves the backbone and prompts unchanged, and requires no target-domain training. It works as a train-free score for raw VLM backbones or as a source-calibrated residual correction for adapted CLIP-AD hosts. Across frozen VLM backbones, TED substantially improves pixel-level localization over raw prompt similarity; across adapted hosts, it improves most pixel-level settings over P-AUROC, P-PRO, and P-AP. Gains are largest under stronger hard-FP competition, with mean localization gain increasing from +5.0 in low-competition regimes to about +10.9 in mid/high-competition regimes. These results suggest that recoverable defect evidence can already exist in pretrained multimodal representations, but reliable localization requires decoding it against hard-normal competitors. Code will be released at TED GitHub repository.

</details>


### [71] [BadAction: Backdoor Attacks on Interactive Video Generation via Action-Guided Triggers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39047)
*Zhihang Wu,Zhongqi Wang,Jie Zhang,Fengming Gu,Shiguang Shan,Xilin Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文首次系统研究交互式视频生成（IVG）模型的后门攻击，提出BadAction：以动作引导的触发器植入预设运动模式并关联静态目标视频，触发后模型生成冻结帧且不再响应用户动作。动作触发器平均攻击成功率91.0%，多模态触发器80.4%，并可绕过现有后门检测方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交互式视频生成模型在用户动作引导下已能生成可控视觉内容，但其安全漏洞（尤其是交互性相关的后门风险）尚未被探索。作者旨在揭示IVG交互环节中的新攻击面。

Method: 提出BadAction攻击：在中毒样本的动作序列中植入预定义运动模式作为触发器，并将其与静态目标视频关联；触发时使后门模型输出冻结的未来帧、不再响应后续用户动作，同时对良性动作序列保持正常行为。此外探索更隐蔽的多模态触发器变体，联合污染动作、文本与图像输入。

Result: 动作触发器平均攻击成功率91.0%，多模态触发器为80.4%；大量防御评估表明BadAction可成功绕过现有后门检测方法，暴露了交互式视频生成流程中的关键安全缺口。

Conclusion: IVG模型的交互性可被后门攻击利用，形成"动作触发—响应冻结"的新型威胁；现有多数防御手段对此失效，需针对IVG交互管线设计专门的检测与防护机制。

Abstract: Interactive video generation (IVG) models have achieved remarkable progress in producing controllable visual content guided by user-defined actions, yet their security vulnerabilities remain largely unexplored. In this paper, we present the first systematic study of backdoor attacks against the interactivity of IVG models. Based on this attack surface, we propose BadAction, which leverages action-guided triggers to achieve the attack. Specifically, BadAction implants predefined motion patterns into the action sequences of backdoor samples and associates them with a static target video. Once triggered, the backdoored model generates frozen future frames that no longer respond to subsequent user actions, while preserving normal behavior on benign action sequences. In addition, we explore a stealthier attack in which multimodal triggers jointly poison action, text, and image inputs. Experiments show that BadAction achieves average attack success rates of 91.0% with action-only triggers and 80.4% with multimodal triggers. Moreover, extensive defense evaluations show that BadAction successfully bypasses existing backdoor detection methods, revealing a critical security gap in the interactive video generation pipeline. Project page: https://wsad55.github.io/badaction01/.

</details>


### [72] [TSMD: Temporal-Stream Modality Dropout for Robust Video Highlight Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39051)
*Bo-Yuan Cheng,Kuan-Yu Chen,Po-Han Huang,Jeng-Lin Li,Jian-Jiun Ding*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出TSMD方法应对多模态视频精彩片段检测中的模态缺失问题，结合结构化缺失模拟与复合损失函数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态视频精彩片段检测器默认视觉、音频、文本流始终可用，但实际中常出现局部帧缺失或整条流中断，且MSE损失与评估指标及精彩片段的峰值特性不匹配。

Method: 定义两种鲁棒性挑战：时间缺失（各模态帧独立缺失）与流级缺失（某模态整段视频不可用）。提出TSMD，将结构化缺失模拟与联合目标（逐点MSE、逐视频Pearson相关、面向峰值的RankNet损失）结合，含时间、流级、混合三种变体。

Result: 在MoSu和Mr.HiSum数据集上，50%独立时间移除下TSMD-Temporal的mAP@15分别比TripleSumm提升7.06和3.41个点；完全流移除下TSMD-Stream表现最佳；TSMD-Mix保留互补优势，在各条件下排名第一或第二。

Conclusion: 结构化缺失模拟与多目标损失能有效提升多模态视频精彩片段检测在时间与流级缺失下的鲁棒性。

Abstract: Existing multimodal video highlight detectors typically assume that visual, audio, and textual streams are continuously available. In practice, however, inputs may suffer from localized frame missingness or complete-stream outage. We formulate this robustness challenge along two dimensions: temporal missingness, where frames are missing independently in each modality, and stream-level missingness, where one modality is unavailable throughout a video. Moreover, we find that the mean squared error (MSE) loss is misaligned with both the evaluation metrics and the peak-driven nature of highlights. Therefore, we propose Temporal-Stream Modality Dropout (TSMD), which combines structured missingness simulation with a joint objective comprising pointwise MSE, per-video Pearson correlation, and peak-oriented RankNet loss terms. TSMD has three variants: temporal, stream-level, and mixed dropout. On the MoSu and Mr. HiSum datasets, TSMD-Temporal improves mAP@15 by 7.06 and 3.41 points over TripleSumm under 50% independent temporal removal, whereas TSMD-Stream performs the best under complete-stream removal. TSMD-Mix retains most of these complementary benefits and ranks the best or the second-best across the evaluated temporal and stream-level conditions.

</details>


### [73] [Agentic Tool-Augmented Reasoning for Explainable Image Forgery Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39066)
*Zhiya Tan,Jing Huang,Changtao Miao,Lin Tan,Xin Zhang,Weiwei Feng,Jianshu Li,Joey Tianyi Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出ATAR框架，通过22种取证工具与多轮推理实现图像伪造的自主检测、定位与可解释证言，在零样本IMDL基准上平均图像级F1达78.5%，超越最强MLLM基线11.8个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统图像伪造检测仅输出二值分数或像素掩码，缺乏可解释证据；近期基于多模态大语言模型的方法先给出既定分类结果再生成事后解释，并非从证据出发进行推理。作者受人类司法鉴定专家取证工作流启发，希望构建从证据推理出发的自主取证范式。

Method: 提出Agentic Tool-Augmented Reasoning (ATAR)框架，集成覆盖七个互补领域的22种专用取证工具，通过多轮推理自主完成检测、定位与解释。核心包括：双流取证推理范式——高层语义异常路径放大可疑区域做细粒度检查，低层伪造伪影路径调用取证工具提取客观证据；取证课程学习——在通用经验SFT阶段以自动化师生指导流水线合成多轮工具使用推理轨迹，在取证场景RL阶段用工具先验课程引导早期工具探索并逐步将控制权转移给智能体，同时以结构化证据奖励提供细粒度过程级监督。

Result: 在IMDL、Deepfake检测、DMDL与AIGC检测任务上实验。在六个零样本IMDL基准上平均图像级F1达78.5%，超过最强MLLM基线11.8个百分点；在其他任务上与专用检测器保持竞争力，同时生成更忠实、更有依据的解释。

Conclusion: ATAR以工具增强的智能体推理替代事后解释式检测，实现证据驱动的可解释图像取证，在零样本伪造定位与多任务泛化上表现优异，兼顾检测性能与解释忠实度。

Abstract: Conventional image forgery detection methods produce binary scores or pixel-level masks without interpretable evidence, while recent multimodal large language model (MLLM)-based approaches generate post-hoc explanations of predetermined classification results rather than reasoning from evidence. Inspired by the forensic workflow of human judicial experts, we propose Agentic Tool-Augmented Reasoning (ATAR), a framework integrating 22 specialized forensic tools across seven complementary domains to autonomously detect, localize, and explain image forgeries through multi-turn reasoning. A Dual-Stream Forensic Reasoning paradigm combines a high-level semantic anomaly path, which magnifies suspicious regions for fine-grained inspection, with a low-level forgery artifact path, which invokes forensic tools to extract objective evidence. We further introduce Forensics Curriculum Learning: during General Experience SFT, an automated teacher-student mentoring pipeline synthesizes multi-turn tool-usage reasoning trajectories; during Forensic Scene RL, a Tool Prior Curriculum guides early tool exploration and progressively transfers control to the agent, while a Structured Evidence Reward provides fine-grained process-level supervision. Experiments across IMDL, Deepfake detection, DMDL, and AIGC detection show that ATAR achieves 78.5% average image-level F1 on six zero-shot IMDL benchmarks, surpassing the strongest MLLM baseline by 11.8 percentage points, and remains competitive with specialized detectors on other tasks while producing substantially more faithful and grounded explanations.

</details>


### [74] [MRI Super-Resolution with RCDM/WaveMix and Task-Aware Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39083)
*Kavitha Viswanathan,Harsh Choudhary,Amit Sethi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 低场(1.5 T)脑MRI增强应针对具体下游模型并配合可靠标签进行验证：提出一种非配对、物理引导的轻量级增强器，发现增强对分割器的影响因模型和标签质量而异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超分辨与质量增强通常仅用图像保真度指标评估，但其真正目的是改善下游分析。本文旨在探究增强是否真的能提升组织分割效果，以及这种提升对哪类分割器有效。

Method: 提出一种非配对、物理引导的训练流程，用于轻量级（≤2.5 M参数）循环卷积增强器，包含三个组件：六模块随机1.5 T退化算子、在不变动解剖结构的前提下添加扫描仪特定纹理的残差对抗网络，以及带有反恒等惩罚、排除复制解（copy solution）的循环一致性目标。随后在相同被试的原始或增强1.5 T图像上，使用相同标签和受试者级划分，从头训练U-Net、Swin-UNet和小波token混合分割器，覆盖三种增强器变体与两个数据集。

Result: 在ABIDE（41名留出被试，FreeSurfer标签）上，增强显著提升小波分割器（平均Dice +0.014，Wilcoxon p=3.5×10⁻⁵；CSF +0.018，灰质 +0.013），显著降低U-Net性能（−0.008，p=5.1×10⁻⁴），对Swin-UNet无影响。在IXI（标签来自FSL-FAST）上，增强使全部九种配对组合的Dice下降，且几乎全部由CSF导致；作者将其归因于标签中空间上不合理的CSF体素，这些体素惩罚了更平滑的预测。

Conclusion: 低场MRI增强的效果高度依赖于下游模型和标签可靠性，因此应在具体下游模型和可靠标签条件下分别验证，而不能仅凭图像保真度指标判断。

Abstract: Super-resolution and quality enhancement of 1.5\,T brain MRI are normally validated with image-fidelity metrics, although their purpose is to improve downstream analysis. We study whether enhancement improves tissue segmentation, and for which segmenters. We propose an unpaired, physics-guided training pipeline for a lightweight ($\le$2.5\,M parameter) recurrent convolutional enhancer: a six-module stochastic 1.5\,T degradation operator, a residual adversarial network that adds scanner-specific texture without moving anatomy, and a cycle-consistent objective with an anti-identity penalty that rules out the copy solution. We then train U-Net, Swin-UNet and wavelet token-mixing segmenters \citep{jeevan2023wavemix} from scratch on either raw or enhanced 1.5\,T images of the same subjects, using identical labels and subject-level splits, for three enhancer variants and two datasets. On ABIDE (41 held-out subjects, FreeSurfer labels) enhancement significantly improves the wavelet segmenter (mean Dice $+0.014$, Wilcoxon $p=3.5\times10^{-5}$; CSF $+0.018$, grey matter $+0.013$), significantly degrades the U-Net ($-0.008$, $p=5.1\times10^{-4}$) and leaves Swin-UNet unchanged. On IXI, whose labels come from FSL-FAST, enhancement lowers Dice for all nine pairings, almost entirely through CSF; we trace this to spatially implausible CSF voxels in the labels that penalise smoother predictions. Enhancement of low-field MRI should therefore be validated per downstream model and against reliable labels.

</details>


### [75] [UGOD: Uncertainty-Guided Opacity and Dropout for Sparse-View 3D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39089)
*Zhihao Guo,Peng Wang,Zidong Chen,Xiangyu Kong,Yan Lyu,Guanyu Gao,Chenghao Qian,Ziyang Wang,Xinqi Fan,Liangxiu Han*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出UGOD不确定性引导框架，为每个高斯估计视角相关不确定性并调节其渲染贡献，在稀疏视角新视角合成上提升质量并得到更紧凑表示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏视角3D高斯泼溅因观测有限，许多高斯基元约束不足却仍通过alpha混合累积贡献，容易过拟合；缺少不确定性估计时渲染器无法区分不可靠与约束良好的基元，错误贡献会污染新视角合成。

Method: UGOD为每个高斯估计视角相关的不确定性分数：以高斯属性和视角方向为条件的轻量不确定性头预测该分数，并驱动可微不透明度调制机制，在合成前衰减高不确定性基元。训练时使用分离梯度的软丢弃分支，施加不确定性控制的连续保留掩码，抑制模型依赖约束不足的高斯以减少过拟合；分离不确定性分数可防止该随机正则化的梯度偏置或致其崩溃。

Result: 在Mip-NeRF 360与LLFF数据集上，UGOD提升了稀疏视角新视角合成质量，同时产生比对比方法更紧凑的高斯表示。

Conclusion: 高斯不确定性可为稀疏视角重建提供一种有效的渲染时控制手段。

Abstract: Sparse-view 3D Gaussian Splatting is prone to overfitting because limited observations leave many Gaussian primitives weakly constrained, yet their contributions are still accumulated through alpha blending. Without uncertainty estimation, the renderer cannot distinguish unreliable primitives from well-constrained ones, allowing their erroneous contributions to corrupt novel-view synthesis. We introduce UGOD, an uncertainty-guided framework that estimates a view-dependent uncertainty score for each Gaussian and uses it to regulate its rendering contribution. A lightweight uncertainty head conditioned on Gaussian attributes and viewing direction predicts this score, which then drives a differentiable opacity-modulation mechanism that attenuates high-uncertainty primitives before compositing. During training, a detached soft-dropout branch applies an uncertainty-controlled continuous keep mask to discourage the model from relying on poorly constrained Gaussians and thereby reduce overfitting. Crucially, detaching the uncertainty score prevents gradients from this stochastic regulariser from biasing or collapsing the uncertainty prediction. Experiments on Mip-NeRF~360 and LLFF show that UGOD improves sparse-view novel-view synthesis while producing more compact Gaussian representations than the compared methods. These results demonstrate that Gaussian uncertainty provides an effective rendering-time control for sparse-view reconstruction.

</details>


### [76] [DeCoPrune: Efficient KV-Cache Pruning for Autoregressive Video Diffusion via Denoising Consistency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39096)
*Zeqi Xiao,Qingle Liu,Kaiwen Zhang,Yifan Zhou,Zihan Ding,Xingang Pan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练缓存压缩方法 DeCoPrune，利用去噪一致性信号保留高差异 token，实现长程信息保留与推理加速，并发布 CMBench 评测基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归视频扩散支持流式生成与交互控制，但 KV 缓存随生成历史线性增长。现有压缩策略采用固定窗口丢弃历史，或依赖局部注意力与相似度信号选择 token，均未直接衡量某个 chunk 相对已保留上下文是否携带增量信息。因此需要一种能直接度量信息增量、且无需训练的缓存压缩方法。

Method: 将缓存压缩建模为去噪一致性问题。核心观察：中间干净预测与最终去噪值之间差异较大的 token，其视觉证据更难由已保留上下文预测。DeCoPrune 以此为模型内在信号，在长期缓存中保留高差异 token、剪除低差异 token，全程无需训练。同时提出 head-specialized 变体，按注意力头进行差异化保留。为衡量信息保留能力，构建 CMBench 基准，包含 58 段约一分钟的生成或真实世界上下文片段，以及 116 个 Reappear/Revisit 续写任务，要求模型回忆早期事件或物体。

Result: 在 LingBot World v2 上，DeCoPrune 取得 DINO 分数 0.6701（0–1 尺度），累计历史 KV token 数减少 85.43%，续写生成相对 FullKV 加速 4.14 倍。head-specialized 变体在 86.19% 剪枝率下达到 0.6783，接近 FullKV 的 0.6803，并在相近预算下超过所评估的压缩基线。

Conclusion: 去噪一致性可作为有效的长程信息保留信号，在显著降低自回归推理成本的同时维持生成质量，为免训练视频扩散缓存压缩提供了新思路。项目主页 https://decoprune.github.io，代码 https://github.com/DeCoPrune/CMBench，基准 https://huggingface.co/datasets/Aoraku/CMBench。

Abstract: Autoregressive video diffusion supports streaming generation and interactive control, but its KV cache grows with the generated history. Existing compression strategies discard history using fixed windows or select tokens through local attention and similarity signals, without directly measuring whether a chunk contributes information beyond the retained context. We introduce DeCoPrune, a training-free method that treats cache compression as a denoising-consistency problem. We find that tokens with larger discrepancies between intermediate clean predictions and final denoised values tend to carry visual evidence less predictable from the retained context. DeCoPrune uses this model-intrinsic signal to retain high-discrepancy tokens in the long-term cache while pruning low-discrepancy tokens. To evaluate information retention, we introduce CMBench, comprising 58 approximately one-minute generated or real-world context episodes and 116 Reappear or Revisit continuation tasks requiring recall of earlier events or objects. Experiments with LingBot World v2 show that DeCoPrune achieves a DINO score of 0.6701 on a 0-1 scale, with an 85.43% reduction in cumulative historical KV token counts and a 4.14-fold continuation-generation speedup over FullKV. Its head-specialized variant reaches 0.6783 at an 86.19% pruning ratio, approaching FullKV's 0.6803 score and exceeding the evaluated compression baselines at similar budgets. These results indicate that denoising consistency can support long-range information retention while reducing autoregressive inference cost. Our project homepage is https://decoprune.github.io. The code is available at https://github.com/DeCoPrune/CMBench, and the benchmark at https://huggingface.co/datasets/Aoraku/CMBench.

</details>


### [77] [CamAgent: An LLM-Agent Framework for Multi-Species Camera-Trap Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39112)
*Yutong Deng,Qi Song,Xi Guo,Tianming Wang,Lei Bao,Jianping Ge*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CamAgent：基于LLM的自主智能体框架，将红外相机数据分析流程整合为统一生态系统，支持自然语言驱动的端到端时空生态分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 红外相机积累了大量多维野生动物监测数据，但原始媒体档案转化为生态学洞察的过程高度碎片化：研究者需费力拼接各类分析工具与脚本，编程门槛高，端到端时空分析难以实现。

Method: 提出CamAgent，一个自主LLM智能体框架。它能解析自然语言的生态学分析意图，进行计算路由调度，并执行多类专用工具：计算机视觉感知（如SpeciesNet）、兼容CamtrapDP的数据管理、检测校正的占据模型、时间活动分析以及物种共现网络；在自动化多阶段分析流水线的同时保留数据质量控制与分析规范。

Result: CamAgent自动化了多阶段分析流程，并维持必要的数据质量与分析惯例，显著降低了保护工作者的手工编程负担。

Conclusion: CamAgent为红外相机生态学建立了一种透明、可扩展且完全集成的分析范式，项目地址为 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/artifact72c6f4。

Abstract: Camera traps accumulated vast, multidimensional data for wildlife monitoring, yet translating raw media archives into meaningful ecological insights remains highly fragmented. Current research workflows require laboriously stitching together disparate analysis tools and scripts, creating steep programming hurdles and complicating end-to-end spatiotemporal analyses. To overcome this fragmentation, we present CamAgent, an autonomous Large Language Model (LLM) agent framework that integrates camera-trap analytical workflows into a unified intelligent ecosystem. CamAgent interprets natural-language ecological intent, schedules computational routing, and executes specialized tools spanning computer-vision perception (e.g., SpeciesNet), CamtrapDP-compatible data management, detection-corrected occupancy modeling, temporal activity analysis, and species co-occurrence networks. The framework automates multi-stage analytical pipelines while maintaining essential data-quality controls and analytical conventions. Consequently, CamAgent significantly reduces manual programming overhead for conservationists, establishing a transparent, scalable, and fully integrated paradigm for camera-trap ecology. Our project is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/artifact72c6f4.

</details>


### [78] [Beyond Local Linearity: Scale-Resolved Geometry of Learned Image Encoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39115)
*Jakub Szymkowiak,Wojtek Pałubicki,Kamil Adamczewski*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种尺度分辨的统计量，通过比较编码器实际特征位移与其局部线性预测随扰动幅度增大的偏离，发现多样图像编码器中普遍存在"隆起"（bump）剖面，并将其确立为表征受学习塑造的特征签名。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有几何分析多为局部性的，仅能描述无穷小扰动，无法刻画表征对有限输入变化的响应，因而难以完整表征其敏感性、不变性与鲁棒性。

Method: 引入尺度分辨统计量：随扰动幅度增加，比较编码器测得的特征位移与其局部线性预测之间的偏差；在多种图像编码器上考察不同训练阶段、标签与输入条件下的表现。

Result: 在多种图像编码器中发现特征性的"平台—上升—峰值—衰减"剖面（bump）；该现象在初始化时不出现，标准训练早期即涌现，在随机标签或随机噪声输入下不形成，且其形状随训练分布与鲁棒性目标而变化。

Conclusion: 偏离局部几何可作为表征如何被学习塑造的签名，为理解编码器的敏感性、不变性与鲁棒性提供了非局部的尺度分辨视角。

Abstract: Understanding how learned representations respond to finite input changes is important for characterizing their sensitivity, invariances, and robustness. Yet existing geometric analyses are predominantly local and describe only infinitesimal perturbations. We introduce a scale-resolved statistic that compares an encoder's measured feature displacement with its local linear prediction as the perturbation magnitude increases. Across diverse image encoders, we discover a characteristic plateau-rise-peak-decay profile, which we call the bump. The bump is absent at initialization, emerges early during standard training, and does not form under randomized labels or random-noise inputs. Its shape also varies with the training distribution and robustness objective. These results establish departures from local geometry as a signature of how encoder representations are shaped by learning.

</details>


### [79] [GRC-Pose: Generation-Reconstruction Correspondence for Prior-Free 6D Object Pose Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39116)
*Shiyang Liu,Weiquan Lin,Luping Xiao,Jiadong Tang,Yi Yang,Yu Gao,Xingyu Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出GRC-Pose，将无先验6D物体位姿跟踪表述为"生成-重建对应"问题，结合几何基础模型的物体中心与场景中心线索，实现SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无先验6D位姿跟踪需从单目RGB视频恢复未见物体的轨迹，且不依赖CAD模型、已定位参考图或位姿标注。几何基础模型提供了互补的物体中心与场景中心线索，但二者存在表征不一致：SAM3D CAD以任意物体局部表面参数化索引，而重建证据则表达在序列特定的世界坐标系中且表面覆盖不完整，因此难以直接利用这种互补性。

Method: 将跟踪建模为生成-重建对应问题，提出基于对应的框架GRC-Pose，融合学习式对应预测与鲁棒位姿估计。具体包含：GeoCorr-Matcher为每个位姿候选估计加权物体-场景对应及逐匹配不确定性；FGH-Solver通过多个鲁棒几何估计器与序列级后验推断整合这些匹配；并设计后验门控记忆，在遮挡与视点变化中仅保留有内点支持的观测。

Result: 在使用SAM3D CAD时，GRC-Pose在HOT3D上取得SOTA的平均召回率（Average Recall）与运动保持度（motion retention），后者较现有方法提升58%；在YCBInEOAT、LINEMOD等经典基准上仍具高度竞争力。

Conclusion: 通过生成-重建对应的表述与不确定性加权的鲁棒求解、后验门控记忆机制，GRC-Pose有效弥合了物体中心与场景中心线索的表征差异，在无先验6D位姿跟踪任务上取得领先性能并保持良好泛化性。

Abstract: Prior-free 6D object pose tracking seeks to recover the trajectory of an unseen object from a single RGB video without object-specific CAD models, posed reference images, or pose annotations. Geometric foundation models provide complementary object-centric and scene-centric cues, yet SAM3D CAD is indexed by an arbitrary object-local surface parameterization, whereas reconstructed evidence is expressed in a sequence-specific world frame with partial surface coverage. To exploit this complementarity, we formulate tracking as generation-reconstruction correspondence and introduce GRC-Pose, a correspondence-based framework that combines learned correspondence prediction with robust pose estimation. Concretely, GeoCorr-Matcher estimates weighted object-scene correspondences and per-match uncertainty for each pose candidate. FGH-Solver integrates these matches through multiple robust geometric estimators and sequence-level posterior inference, while a posterior-gated memory retains only inlier-supported observations through occlusion and viewpoint change. Extensive evaluation shows that with SAM3D CAD, GRC-Pose achieves state-of-the-art Average Recall and motion retention on HOT3D, improving the latter by 58% over prior art. On classical benchmarks including YCBInEOAT and LINEMOD, it remains highly competitive.

</details>


### [80] [Is Better Teacher Supervision Enough? Unlocking Student-side Learning in Multimodal On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39120)
*Siyuan Liu,Kanghui Tian,Yue Duan,Yutao He,Shangdong Yang,Jian Zhang,Yinghuan Shi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出S-OPD多模态同策略蒸馏框架，通过强化学生感知学习（教师校准策略对比+策略一致性两个目标）解决学生感知不足瓶颈，无需额外标注/参数/推理开销，八个基准上性能稳定提升（LogicVista最高+4.25）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态同策略蒸馏（OPD）方法主要聚焦于增强教师侧指导（如丰富教师输入、优化教师反馈），但作者发现学生侧感知能力有限是另一关键瓶颈。通过提供oracle视觉事实，无论教师强弱，OPD训练的学生性能仍能显著提升，说明学生感知不足制约了蒸馏效果。

Method: 提出S-OPD框架，显式强化学生感知学习，包含两个目标：(1) Teacher-calibrated Policy Contrast：在原始图像与掩码图像下，利用基于教师的token级门控分离学生策略，增强推理时对视觉证据的依赖；(2) Policy Agreement：对齐原始图像与噪声扰动图像下的学生策略，提升对视觉噪声的感知鲁棒性。该方法可无缝接入现有OPD框架，无需额外数据标注、模型参数或推理操作。

Result: 在八个基准上跨学生规模与蒸馏范式的广泛实验显示一致性能提升，LogicVista上最高提升4.25分；与现有教师侧监督方法结合可获进一步提升。

Conclusion: 学生感知受限是多模态同策略蒸馏的关键瓶颈。S-OPD通过教师校准策略对比与策略一致性两个目标强化学生感知，作为即插即用方法无需额外开销即可稳定提升性能，并可与其他教师侧监督方法协同增效。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) improves reasoning by providing token-level supervision from a teacher on a student's own trajectories. Existing methods primarily focus on enhancing this teacher-side guidance (e.g., by enriching teacher inputs and refining teacher feedback), yet we find that limited student perception is another critical bottleneck in multimodal OPD. By providing oracle visual facts, the performance of OPD-trained students can still be substantially improved for both weak and strong teachers. To address this bottleneck, we propose S-OPD, a simple multimodal on-policy distillation framework that explicitly strengthens student perceptual learning through two objectives. Specifically, Teacher-calibrated Policy Contrast separates student policies under original and masked images with teacher-based token-level gating, strengthening the student's reliance on visual evidence during reasoning. Policy Agreement aligns student policies under original and noise-perturbed images, further improving perceptual robustness to visual noise. Notably, our method can be seamlessly plugged into existing OPD frameworks, requiring no additional data annotations, model parameters or inference operations. Extensive experiments on eight benchmarks across student scales and distillation paradigms demonstrate consistent performance improvements, with gains of up to 4.25 points on LogicVista. When combined with existing teacher-side supervision methods, our method can yield further gains. Code is available at https://github.com/Sirilaw/S-OPD.

</details>


### [81] [How to Reduce Localization Ambiguity? Geometry-Semantic Constrained BEV Representation Learning for Satellite-Ground Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39127)
*Junming Feng,Panwang Xia,Qiong Wu,Xudong Lu,Zeyu Jiao,Kun Lv,Zherong Wu,Yi Wan,Peifeng Ma,Li-Ta Hsu,Zhi Zheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出GeoSem-BEV，通过径向深度、垂直高度与共享显式语义三重监督约束BEV特征学习，缓解几何歧义与描述子匹配歧义，显著提升卫星-地面定位精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有BEV类卫星-地面定位方法存在两类歧义：一是深度约束不足，导致同一地面特征被映射到视线方向上不同距离处，造成BEV特征放置的几何歧义；二是不同位置外观相似引起描述子匹配歧义，且现有描述子学习缺乏显式语义监督来区分这些位置。

Method: GeoSem-BEV，一种几何-语义约束的BEV表示学习方法。采用径向深度监督约束距离分配，垂直高度监督约束高度聚合，并引入共享显式语义监督，促使跨视角语义预测一致，从而区分语义相似的不同位置。上述约束共同改善特征放置与描述子判别性，可增强现有SOTA BEV定位模型。

Result: 在VIGOR未知朝向设定下，跨区域与同区域平均朝向误差分别降低37.2%和38.1%；在DReSS-D上分别降低10.8%和15.6%；在KITTI-CVL上，10度朝向噪声下同区域平均朝向误差降低26.8%。

Conclusion: 通过几何与语义的显式监督约束，可有效提升BEV空间中特征放置的准确性与描述子的判别性，进而增强卫星-地面定位模型的鲁棒性和精度。

Abstract: Satellite-ground localization estimates the planar position and yaw orientation of a ground camera within a geo-referenced satellite image. Most recent methods map ground and satellite features into a shared bird's-eye-view (BEV) space and establish spatial correspondences. However, insufficient depth constraints can assign one ground feature to different distances along a viewing direction, creating geometric ambiguity in BEV feature placement. Similar appearances at different locations can also create descriptor matching ambiguity, while existing descriptor learning lacks explicit semantic supervision to distinguish them. We propose GeoSem-BEV, a geometry-semantic constrained BEV representation learning method. Radial depth supervision constrains distance assignment, and vertical height supervision constrains height aggregation. Shared explicit semantic supervision promotes consistent semantic predictions across views and helps distinguish locations with similar semantics. These constraints improve feature placement and descriptor discriminability, enhancing state-of-the-art BEV localization models. On VIGOR with unknown orientation, GeoSem-BEV reduces mean orientation error by 37.2% and 38.1% in the cross-area and same-area settings, respectively. The corresponding errors are reduced by 10.8% and 15.6% on DReSS-D. On KITTI-CVL, it reduces same-area mean orientation error by 26.8% under 10 degree orientation noise.

</details>


### [82] [GeoGAT: Bidirectional Temporal Sampling Meets Hierarchical Graph Attention for Global Video Geo-localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39128)
*Junchao Cui,Xuanzi Ma,Wenqi Shi,Hangyu Li,Biru Zhu,Chong Fu,Xiangyang Luo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出GeoGAT，通过双向时间采样与图注意力网络（GAT）融合互补时空特征，并利用地理层级图进行结构感知消息传递与双约束剪枝，消除跨层级预测冲突，实现全球视频地理定位四层级SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有全球视频地理定位方法多采用单向均匀采样处理视频帧，并为每个地理层级（城市/州省/国家/大洲）独立训练分类器，导致关键地理线索丢失以及层级间预测冲突，尤其在复杂多镜头剪辑视频上表现不佳。

Method: GeoGAT整合双向时间采样与图注意力网络（GATs）：提取前向与偏移反转帧序列构建互补时空特征；将融合特征输入预定义地理层级图，由GAT执行结构感知消息传递；并通过双约束机制进行预测剪枝以消除跨层级冲突。同时构建GeoGAT10k基准数据集，含来自全球166个城市的9,720段多镜头剪辑视频。

Result: 在CityGuessr68k与GeoGAT10k上，GeoGAT完全消除层级冲突，并在四个地理层级上均达到SOTA。在CityGuessr68k上，分类与检索协议下城市层级较最强基线提升2.6个百分点；在更具挑战性的GeoGAT10k多镜头剪辑视频上，准确率提升超过24个百分点。

Conclusion: GeoGAT通过双向采样与图注意力建模有效解决单向采样信息丢失与层级预测冲突问题，验证了其在复杂真实场景下的强泛化能力，为全球视频地理定位提供了新范式。

Abstract: Global video geo-localization aims to infer the geographic location of a video worldwide, evaluating performance across four geographic hierarchies: city, state/province, country, and continent. Existing methods typically employ one-way uniform sampling to process video frames and train independent classifiers for each hierarchy, which leads to the loss of key geographic cues and prediction conflicts between hierarchies, especially for complex multi-shot edited videos. To address these limitations, we propose GeoGAT, which integrates bidirectional temporal sampling with graph attention networks (GATs). Specifically, GeoGAT extracts forward and offset-reversed frame sequences to construct complementary spatiotemporal features. These fused features are then fed into a predefined geographical hierarchy graph, where GATs perform structure-aware message passing, while a dual-constraint mechanism prunes predictions to eliminate cross-hierarchy conflicts. We construct GeoGAT10k, comprising 9,720 multi-shot edited videos from 166 cities worldwide, specifically to benchmark generalization ability on complex video structures. Experimental results on CityGuessr68k and GeoGAT10k demonstrate that GeoGAT eliminates hierarchical conflicts entirely and achieves state-of-the-art performance across all four geographic hierarchies. On CityGuessr68k, GeoGAT outperforms the strongest baseline, evaluated under both classification and retrieval protocols, by 2.6 percentage points at the city level. On the more challenging GeoGAT10k with multi-shot edited videos, the accuracy improvement exceeds 24 percentage points, validating strong generalization to complex real-world scenarios.

</details>


### [83] [Perceptual Color Difference Modeling Using Machine Learning and Human Similarity Judgments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39130)
*Elnara Kadyrgali,Muragul Muratbekova,Adilet Yerkin,Nuray Toganas,Ayan Igali,Malika Ziyada,Aruzhan Burambekova,Jamaladdin Hasanov,Pakizar Shamoi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本研究基于2000对颜色的七人四点序数相似性判断数据，比较RGB、HSI与COLIBRI模糊语言特征在五种回归算法下的色差估计性能，发现颜色表示比回归算法更关键，LightGBM结合表示取得最佳R²=0.703。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有色差度量（如CIEDE2000）虽试图逼近人类感知，但仍与感知判断存在不一致，因此作者希望以直接的人类评估数据驱动方式估计色差，提升感知一致性。

Method: 收集2000对系统生成颜色对的相似性判断，每对由七名观察者按四点序数尺度评分；以此训练回归模型，比较RGB通道差、HSI差与COLIBRI模糊语言类别等不同颜色表示，并测试五种回归算法。

Result: 颜色模型的选择对预测性能影响大于回归算法的选择；仅用COLIBRI特征时线性回归R²=0.595，优于RGB（0.479）与HSI（0.493）；LightGBM使用组合表示达到最佳R²=0.703。

Conclusion: 人类感知色差在数值颜色坐标之外辅以分级感知类别时能被更好捕捉，表明数据驱动模型在感知对齐的色差估计方面具有潜力。

Abstract: Accurate assessment of color differences is essential for applications ranging from digital design to quality control. While existing color difference metrics, such as CIEDE2000, aim to approximate human perception, they may still exhibit inconsistencies with perceptual judgments. In this study, we investigate a data-driven approach to color-difference estimation based directly on human evaluations. We collect similarity judgments for 2,000 systematically generated color pairs, each rated by seven observers using a four-point ordinal scale. These judgments are then used to train regression models using different color representations, including RGB channel differences, HSI differences, and COLIBRI fuzzy linguistic categories. Experiments with five regression algorithms show that the choice of color model has a greater influence on prediction performance than the choice of regression algorithm. Using COLIBRI features alone, linear regression achieves an R2 of 0.595, outperforming RGB and HSI representations, which achieve R2 values of 0.479 and 0.493, respectively. The best performance is obtained by LightGBM using the combined representation, reaching an R2 of 0.703. The results indicate that human perceptual color differences are better captured when numerical color coordinates are complemented by graded perceptual categories, highlighting the potential of data-driven models for perceptually aligned color-difference estimation.

</details>


### [84] [Uncertainty-Aware Consistency Distillation for Few-Step Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39132)
*Lingyu Liu,Yaxiong Wang,Li Zhu,Zhedong Zheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出不确定性感知一致性蒸馏（UACD），用局部无参数不确定性估计对时空一致性监督重加权，配合特征空间对抗训练与语义对齐，实现高质量少步视频生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 少步视频生成通常通过一致性蒸馏将多步教师压缩为少步学生，但教师给出的监督信号可靠性并不均等；在时序变化剧烈的区域（如移动的树叶阴影、流水）内容更难学习。作者观察到监督可靠性取决于内容的局部难度而非语义复杂度：变化小的区域端点预测一致，变化大的区域差异大并与最大感知误差重合。

Method: 提出 UACD：在时空区域上用局部、无参数的不确定性估计对一致性监督重加权。构造两条独立扰动的教师引导一致性路径，其学生端点预测形成共识目标；学生直接预测与该目标的差异作为不确定性代理。通过指数权重放宽高不确定性区域的一致性惩罚，其余区域保留完整惩罚。为在激进步数压缩下保持感知质量，整合特征空间对抗训练与语义对齐，并对 50 步 Wan 模型做参数高效 LoRA 适配。

Result: 在 VBench 2.0 上实现 SOTA 的 4 步生成，平均分 0.556，并在用户研究中优于对比方法。

Conclusion: 监督可靠性应依据内容局部难度而非语义复杂度来分配一致性监督权重；基于不确定性重加权的一致性蒸馏结合对抗训练与语义对齐，可在极少采样步数下取得领先的视频生成质量。

Abstract: We study few-step video generation, i.e., distilling a multi-step video generator, which typically requires tens of sampling steps, incurring substantial latency and compute, into a few-step student. Consistency distillation is a common recipe, in which a multi-step teacher provides the consistency targets for a few-step student. However, these teacher-guided targets are not equally trustworthy, and the content is harder to learn where it varies rapidly over time, e.g., moving foliage shadows or flowing water. We observe that supervision reliability follows the local difficulty of the content rather than semantic complexity: regions that change little yield consistent endpoint predictions, whereas regions with large temporal variation produce larger discrepancies that coincide with the largest perceptual errors. Motivated by this observation, we propose Uncertainty-Aware Consistency Distillation (UACD), which reweights consistency supervision at each spatiotemporal region using a local, parameter-free uncertainty estimate. Specifically, we construct two independently perturbed teacher-guided consistency paths, whose student endpoint predictions provide a consensus target; the discrepancy between the student's direct prediction and this target is the uncertainty proxy. We then relax the consistency penalty on high-uncertainty regions through an exponential weight, while keeping the full penalty elsewhere, since the student cannot be expected to match targets that are hard to learn. To preserve perceptual quality under aggressive step reduction, we integrate feature-space adversarial training with semantic alignment. With parameter-efficient LoRA adaptation of the 50-step Wan model, our method achieves state-of-the-art 4-step generation on VBench 2.0 (0.556 mean score) and is preferred over competing methods in a user study.

</details>


### [85] [Feature-Aware Token Attack for Compression-Triggered Stealthy Failures in Large Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39134)
*Shilinlu Yan,Bowen Chen,Yuechen Zhang,Zhenhong Zhou,Li Sun,Sen Su*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出FATA攻击：在保持全token推理正确的前提下，使视觉token压缩路径出现错误。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉token压缩虽能提升大型视觉语言模型效率，但会引入全token评测无法发现的脆弱性。作者关注"压缩后出错、全token仍正确"的对抗样本，而构造此类样本的难点在于：扰动token重要性往往同时破坏全token推理所需的视觉内容。

Method: 提出Feature-Aware Token Attack(FATA)，在固定的干净图像显著token集合上，将注意力抑制与基于余弦相似度的特征保持相结合。在LLaVA-1.5-7B主设定下，仅使用视觉编码器梯度，不接触部署的压缩器、token预算或下游任务。

Result: 在四个视觉依赖任务子集与四种压缩器、受控重建协议下，FATA达到SR=96.3%的全token准确率保持率与CBR=22.1%的条件致盲率，优于CAA的89.8%和15.7%。消融实验支持两个目标各自作用；在5%假阳率下，FATA在三种检测器中检测率最低。

Conclusion: 结果表明应对全token与压缩推理两条路径联合评估对抗鲁棒性。

Abstract: Visual-token compression improves the efficiency of large vision-language models, but can expose failures that full-token evaluation misses. We study adversarial images that preserve full-token correctness yet induce errors after compression, even when both inference paths succeed on the clean image. Creating such failures is challenging because perturbing token importance can also damage the visual content needed for full-token inference. We propose Feature-Aware Token Attack (FATA), which couples attention suppression with cosine-based feature preservation on a fixed set of salient clean-image tokens. In the primary LLaVA-1.5-7B setting, FATA uses only vision-encoder gradients, without access to the deployed compressor, token budget, or downstream task. Across four visually dependent task subsets and four compressors under a controlled reconstruction protocol, FATA achieves SR = 96.3% full-token accuracy retention and CBR = 22.1% conditional blinding, compared with 89.8% and 15.7% for CAA. Ablations support the role of both objectives in balancing compressed-path failure against full-token preservation. FATA also has the lowest measured detection rate among four attacks across three evaluated detectors at a 5% false-positive rate. These findings motivate assessing adversarial robustness jointly across full-token and compressed inference.

</details>


### [86] [Asking the World: Generalist Physical Reasoning through Agentic World Modeling and Probing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39135)
*Shenxiang Zeng,Chen Yang,Peiyao Chen,Guohui Zhang,Jiansheng Fan,Chen Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出"Asking the World"（ATW）通用智能体，通过自适应地构建并探询可执行物理世界，结合PolyWorl引擎与CEM系统辨识，在CLEVRER、ContPhy及真实场景上显著超越基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从视频进行物理推理需推断直接观测之外的潜在物理属性与动力学。直接VLM推理在复杂物理任务上不可靠，缺乏显式建模与验证；而预设工具流水线依赖任务与领域特定先验，限制了对不同材料、动力学和推理任务的泛化能力。

Method: ATW通过两个自适应阶段构建并探询任务相关的可执行世界：World Modeling（从视频校准世界）与World Probing（对世界进行查询、模拟与干预以获取与问题相关的证据），两阶段操作均非预设，而是依场景与问题自适应决定。为此开发PolyWorld Engine——基于Warp的轻量级、高度可编程多物理模拟器，支持刚体、软体、布料、绳索、流体及其耦合交互；并在World Modeling中使用基于CEM的系统辨识恢复任务相关动力学。所得世界成为问题导向物理实验的主动工作空间，而非预定的下游工具。

Result: 以Gemini-3-Flash为基座VLM，ATW在CLEVRER上达到80.82%整体逐题准确率，较直接Gemini-3-Flash提升46.50分、GPT-5.5提升13.58分、PhysMind提升8.27分；在ContPhy上达70.56%，超Gemini-3-Flash 28.10分、GPT-5.5 3.53分；在三个真实场景中达71.67%，超GPT-5.5 28.33分。

Conclusion: 结果表明，智能体式世界建模与探询是一种有效且以执行为基础的通用物理推理方法。

Abstract: Physical reasoning from video requires inferring latent physical properties and dynamics beyond direct observation. Direct VLM inference remains unreliable on complex physical tasks without explicit modeling and validation, while predefined tool pipelines rely on task- and domain-specific priors that limit generalization across materials, dynamics, and reasoning tasks. We introduce Asking the World (ATW), a generalist agent that constructs and interrogates task-relevant executable worlds through two adaptive stages: World Modeling calibrates a world from video, while World Probing queries, simulates, and intervenes on it to obtain question-relevant evidence. Rather than prescribing the operations in either stage, ATW determines how to model and probe according to the scene and question. We develop PolyWorld Engine, a lightweight and highly programmable Warp-based multiphysics simulator for constructing and probing worlds with rigid bodies, soft bodies, cloth, ropes, fluids, and their coupled interactions. CEM-based system identification recovers task-relevant dynamics during World Modeling. The resulting world becomes an active workspace for question-directed physical experiments rather than a predetermined downstream tool. We evaluate ATW on CLEVRER, ContPhy, and three real-world scenarios. Using Gemini-3-Flash as its base VLM, ATW achieves 80.82% overall per-question accuracy on CLEVRER, improving direct Gemini-3-Flash by 46.50 points, GPT-5.5 by 13.58 points, and PhysMind by 8.27 points. On ContPhy, it reaches 70.56% overall accuracy, surpassing Gemini-3-Flash by 28.10 points and GPT-5.5 by 3.53 points. Across the three real-world scenarios, ATW achieves 71.67% accuracy, 28.33 points above GPT-5.5. These results establish agentic world modeling and probing as an effective, execution-grounded approach to generalist physical reasoning.

</details>


### [87] [When Can Text Replace Vision? Structural Bottlenecks in Diagram Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39142)
*Yunbei Zhang,Janet Wang,Jihun Hamm,Chandan K Reddy*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出诊断协议，用于区分「文本化后答错」是源自结构表示缺失信息，还是求解器未能利用已有信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 结构化文本能否替代视觉进行图表推理尚不明确；文本化后的错误可能来自表示信息缺失，也可能来自求解器未使用已存在的信息，需加以区分。

Method: 采用同一求解器模型与生成设置，比较三种输入：原始图像、视觉语言模型提取的问题盲结构、由图表源派生的金标准结构；并设计有效性触发恢复测试、问题相关保真度度量与匹配边干预。

Result: 在240个公开FlowGen图表的保留集上，金标准结构准确率87%，而直接视觉与学习文本均低于30%；仅重试无效提取几乎不改变准确率；公开学习文本相对金标准的差距随结构难度增加而翻倍；问题相关拓扑比全图拓扑更能预测正确性；单条答案相关边编辑使原答案准确率接近零，匹配无关编辑基本不影响；供给结构比视觉更省求解token，但学习获取在单次使用中失去该优势。

Conclusion: 聚合比较包含源派生关系标签且编码不同，未能单独隔离提取误差；应依据所获文本保留的答案相关证据及求解器使用该表示的能力来评估获取式文本。

Abstract: Can structured text replace vision for diagram reasoning? A wrong answer after textualization can arise because the representation omits information the question needs, or because the solver fails to use information that is present. We introduce a diagnostic protocol to distinguish these explanations. Using the same solver model and generation settings, we compare three input conditions: the original image, question-blind structure extracted by a vision-language model, or gold structure derived from the diagram source. Validity-triggered recovery tests truncation and schema failure, question-relevant fidelity measures preservation of answer-critical structure, and matched edge interventions test the effect of error location. On a reserved holdout of 240 public FlowGen diagrams, evaluated under a frozen protocol, gold structure reaches 87% accuracy while direct vision and learned text both remain below 30%. The aggregate comparison includes source-derived relation labels that may not be printed in the image and uses different learned and gold graph encodings, so it does not isolate extraction error alone. Retrying only invalid extractions makes nearly every public representation schema-valid yet leaves accuracy essentially unchanged. The public learned-text deficit relative to gold more than doubles with structural difficulty. Question-relevant topology predicts correctness better than whole-graph topology. In an exposed intervention study, a single answer-relevant edge edit reduces the primary solver's original-answer accuracy to near zero, while matched irrelevant edits largely preserve it. Supplied structure requires fewer solving tokens than vision, but learned acquisition removes this advantage at single use. These comparisons motivate evaluating acquired text by the answer-relevant evidence it preserves and by the solver's ability to use that representation.

</details>


### [88] [MindWorldBench: Evaluating Mental-State-to-Behavior Reasoning in Image-to-Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39147)
*Ruiqi Li,Xuanyi Liu,Sijia Li,Haofeng Wang,Yuxin Liu,Feng Xie,Songchao Tan,Shiqi Wang,Hanwei Zhu,Yizong Wang,Chuanmin Jia,Siwei Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MindWorldBench基准，评估视频生成模型在心理状态条件下的行为推理能力，发现模型普遍存在"全知偏见"失败模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图像到视频模型虽在视觉真实感与物理合理性上表现优异，但无法对心理状态（信念、欲望、感知）进行推理。人类行为由心理状态驱动，需要在显式指令之外进行推理，而这一能力尚未被探索。

Method: 将任务形式化为"心理状态到行为推理"，即模型需在仅有世界状态与隐变量、无显式动作提示的条件下生成动作。构建MindWorldBench，采用零动作提示（Zero-Action Prompting）与反事实设计，包含744个提示以隔离心理状态的因果效应；并设计自动化评估流程，衡量视频质量、常识合理性与心理状态一致性。

Result: 对11个模型的评估显示，尽管具备视觉保真度和物理推理能力，模型仍无法使行为与潜在心理状态对齐。识别出"全知偏见"（Omniscient Bias）失败模式：模型倾向于依据客观世界状态而非人物主观信念生成行为。

Conclusion: 结果揭示了视觉生成与认知推理之间的脱节，表明视频生成系统需要引入显式的心理状态建模。

Abstract: Current image-to-video models achieve visual realism and physical plausibility, but reasoning about mental states remains unexplored. Actions are driven by belief, desire, and perception, requiring inference beyond explicit instructions. We introduce MindWorldBench to evaluate mental-state-conditioned video generation. We formalize this as mental-state-to-behavior reasoning, where models generate actions from a world state and latent variables without explicit action prompts. MindWorldBench utilizes Zero-Action Prompting and a counterfactual design with 744 prompts to isolate the causal effects of mental states. An automated pipeline evaluates video quality, commonsense plausibility, and mental-state consistency. Evaluations of 11 models show that despite visual fidelity and physical reasoning, models fail to align behaviors with latent mental states. We identify a failure mode, termed Omniscient Bias, where models default to the objective world state rather than human's subjective belief. These results demonstrate a disconnect between visual generation and cognitive reasoning, suggesting a need for explicit mental-state modeling in video generation systems. Project website: https://richard2049-lee.github.io/MindWorldBench/

</details>


### [89] [OP-CAD: On-Policy Clean-Audio Distillation for Robust Audio-Visual Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39150)
*Xingming Shui,Dapeng Chen,Bowei Liu,Jingqi Tian,Minfu Li,Kun Yi,Jiapeng Hong,Yansong Tang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出OP-CAD（On-Policy Clean-Audio Distillation），一种基于课程学习的特权自蒸馏框架，用于提升全模态大模型在噪声环境下的音视频问答鲁棒性，通过选择性token级监督实现从轻度到重度噪声的渐进训练，并在所有评测噪声条件下超越对比方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实环境中部署的全模态大模型会遭遇外部噪声，干扰其对多模态输入尤其是音视频内容的理解。核心挑战在于既要抵御声学干扰，又要保留有用的音频证据。现有on-policy蒸馏虽提供密集教师反馈，但其统一的token权重并未显式优先关注受声学干扰影响的位置。

Method: OP-CAD采用课程式特权自蒸馏：训练从轻度到重度环境噪声与竞争语音逐步推进，每阶段进行选择性token级监督。学生模型基于受损音视频输入生成回答，冻结教师模型使用干净音频与已验证答案监督相同回答前缀。为分配监督权重，OP-CAD在不泄露答案的前提下比较教师模型在干净、受损、纯视觉三种上下文中的预测，通过匹配比较度量对音频移除与损坏的敏感度；采用有界加权规则突出任一种信号识别出的位置，同时在全响应中保持监督。

Result: OP-CAD在所有评测噪声条件下均优于对比方法。配对分析进一步表明，在强干扰下干净正确答案的保持率提升，且未观察到总体干净准确率的下降。

Conclusion: 将干净教师监督导向声学敏感的预测位置，对实现鲁棒的音视频推理具有重要价值。

Abstract: Omni-modal large language models deployed in real-world environments encounter external noise that can interfere with their perception and understanding of multimodal inputs. We study their robustness in audio-visual understanding, focusing on question answering under environmental noise and competing speech. The challenge is to resist acoustic interference while preserving useful audio evidence. On-policy distillation provides dense teacher feedback on student-generated responses, but uniform token weighting does not explicitly prioritize positions affected by acoustic interference. We introduce OP-CAD (On-Policy Clean-Audio Distillation), a curriculum-based privileged self-distillation framework for robust audio-visual understanding. Training progresses from mild to severe environmental noise and competing speech, with selective token-level supervision at each stage. The student generates responses from corrupted audio-visual input, while a frozen teacher uses clean audio and the verified answer to supervise the same response prefixes. To allocate this supervision, OP-CAD compares teacher predictions under clean, corrupted, and visual-only contexts without revealing the answer. These matched comparisons measure sensitivity to audio removal and corruption; a bounded weighting rule emphasizes positions identified by either signal while retaining supervision throughout the response. OP-CAD outperforms the compared methods across all evaluated noise conditions. Paired analyses further show improved preservation of clean-correct answers under strong interference, with no observed aggregate clean-accuracy penalty. These results demonstrate the value of directing clean-teacher supervision toward acoustically sensitive predictions for robust audio-visual reasoning.

</details>


### [90] [TripleFlow: Training-Free Video Object Removal by Bridging Residual Editing and Native Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39157)
*Songhe Wang,Lifu Wei,Shuolin Xu,Charles A. Kamhoua,David Miller*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TripleFlow：一种免训练的视频物体移除框架，通过源流、残差流与合成流的紧耦合，在每步将合成背景回注编辑轨迹，实现无缝且时空一致的移除效果，在五个基准上达到新SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频物体移除的难点在于移除提示只指定"擦除什么"而不指定"生成什么"，模型必须完全依据上下文推断并重建被遮挡的特定背景。现有免训练方法将编辑机制主要作为局部擦除器，无法主动合成缺失的背景细节，并常残留重影伪影。

Method: 提出 TripleFlow 免训练框架，将擦除与生成紧密耦合，全程协调源流（source flow）、残差流（residual flow）与合成流（synthesis flow）。复用单一目标预测：残差流负责隔离并抑制物体，合成流独立重建被遮挡背景。关键机制是在每一步将新合成的背景回注编辑轨迹，形成持续反馈回路，使生成结构主动引导移除过程。

Result: 在五个具有挑战性的基准上进行了广泛评估，TripleFlow 在重建保真度与时间一致性两方面均显著优于现有基线，确立了新的 state-of-the-art。

Conclusion: 通过擦除与生成的紧耦合及逐步背景回注的反馈机制，TripleFlow 在不需训练的情况下实现了与未编辑场景时空一致的无缝视频物体移除，验证了"生成引导移除"范式的有效性。

Abstract: Video object removal presents a uniquely difficult editing challenge. Because a removal prompt specifies only what to erase rather than what to generate, the model must infer and reconstruct a highly specific occluded background entirely from the surrounding context.
