TL;DR: 本文提出"Steering Fields"，将传统的全局固定引导向量推广为在生成轨迹每一步自适应估计的引导方向，用于流模型（flow models）的文本到图像生成控制，在安全引导基准上取得SOTA，并可用于无需反演的结构保持图像编辑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有引导范式（steering paradigm）是在选定激活上叠加一个全局固定的引导向量。该向量与样本无关且沿整条轨迹均匀施加，无法适应生成过程的动态状态变化，常导致不必要的全局性改变。因此需要一种能随生成状态自适应调整的引导方法。

Method: 提出Steering Fields，作为引导向量的推广：在生成过程的每一步对引导方向进行自适应重新估计，作用于流模型的噪声状态（noisy states）。该方法提供引导强度与内容保持之间的连续权衡，并具有可组合性（compositionality），可同时诱导和抑制概念。方法不使用显式空间掩码或物体先验。

Result: 在安全引导基准上取得新的SOTA；轨迹自适应估计天然保留局部结构，效果类似于图像编辑。作为结构保持的图像编辑技术，达到SOTA的语义保真度（CLIP、VQAScore），且保持模型无关（model-agnostic）与免反演（inversion-free）。

Conclusion: Steering Fields通过逐步自适应估计引导方向，克服了固定引导向量的局限，在安全性控制与图像编辑两方面均表现优异，为流模型的生成控制提供了一个通用、免反演的框架。

Abstract: As state-of-the-art text-to-image flow models achieve near-photorealistic quality, controlling their outputs, e.g., suppressing harmful content while promoting benign alternatives, has become a central challenge. The current steering paradigm consists of adding a global steering vector to selected activations. While functional, a fixed and example-agnostic vector applied uniformly along the entire trajectory cannot adapt to the changing state of the generation and often causes unintended global changes. We introduce Steering Fields, a generalization of steering vectors that adaptively re-estimates the steering direction at each step of the generative process. Steering Fields operate on the noisy states of flow models, expose a continuous trade-off between steering strength and content preservation, and are compositional, enabling the simultaneous induction and inhibition of concepts, setting a new state of the art on safety steering benchmarks. Despite using no explicit spatial masks or object priors, the trajectory-adaptive estimation naturally preserves local structure, in a manner reminiscent of image editing. In fact, Steering Fields can serve as a structure-preserving image-editing technique that achieves state-of-the-art semantic fidelity (CLIP, VQAScore), while remaining model-agnostic and inversion-free.

</details>


### [125] [A Generalizable and Explainable Framework for Synthetic Video Detection Using First-Digit Gradient Statistics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39585)
*Sidharth Shanu,Gautam Kumar,Tej Singh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出基于Sobel梯度一阶数字定律的AI视频检测方法，无需生成器或场景先验，在多个数据集上可训练分类，但零样本检测失效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI视频生成场景日益多样，CNN检测器虽有效但缺乏可解释性，取证类检测器则常依赖预设场景或过于复杂而难以给出有意义的洞察，因此需要一种不依赖生成器与场景特征的可解释检测方法。

Method: 对Sobel梯度值应用首位数字定律（Benford定律）提取特征，用线性判别分析（LDA）可视化判别信号，并用多层感知机（MLP）进行分类。方法不使用生成器或场景特定特征，模型也不知悉容器格式、编解码器、码率或压缩伪影。

Result: 模型在GenBuster-200K、GenBusterBench、GenVA、FaceForensics++ C23与CelebDF上完成训练与测试；结果显示特征集虽携带判别信号，零样本检测仍然失败。

Conclusion: Sobel梯度的一阶数字统计可作为通用、可解释的AI视频检测信号，但该信号在跨域零样本场景下不足以支撑检测，表明判别信号的存在并不等同于可泛化检测能力。

Abstract: AI video generators have not only become harder to detect but are used to generate a diverse set of scenarios from landscapes to street views to animal videos. This creates a problem where CNN-based detectors are effective but offer no insight into their inner workings, while forensics-based detectors are often pretrained for a set scenario or become too complex to derive meaningful insights. We present a novel approach to AI video detection using Sobel gradient values analysed with the first-digit law. Using linear discriminant analysis, we visualise the discriminatory signal, while a multi-layer perceptron is used for classification. The detection method has no generator- or scenespecific features, and the model has no knowledge of container formats, codec, bitrate, or compression artefacts. The model is trained and tested on GenBuster-200K, GenBusterBench, GenVA, FaceForensics++ C23, and CelebDF. We also show how zero-shot detection fails even though the feature set carries a discriminatory signal.

</details>


### [126] [KilometerVision: A New Frontier for Large-Scale Spatial Intelligence in VLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39588)
*Aravindh Mahendran,Michael King,Matthew Koichi Grimes,Antoine Yang,Tyler Zhu,Joseph Heyward,Tengda Han,Shiry Ginosar,Chen Sun,Dima Damen,Simon Osindero,Noah Snavely,Simon Lynen,João Carreira,Viorica Pătrăucean*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出首个基于真实视频、覆盖至1公里范围的地理布局理解基准，按人类空间认知层级（地标锚定、路线连接、全局心理地图）评测VLM，发现其依赖2D视觉识别与文本匹配，缺乏真正的路径积分与几何勘测知识。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推动视觉语言模型（VLM）在大规模空间智能上的前沿，弥补现有评测缺乏真实视频、长距离（至1公里）地理布局理解的问题；并借鉴认知科学关于人类空间意识层级结构的理论，为模型空间能力提供更贴近人类认知的评测框架。

Method: 构建首个探测真实世界视频中地理布局理解的大规模基准，场景跨度可达1公里；依据认知科学，将评测划分为三个层级阶段：通过地标进行锚定（anchoring）、通过路线连接地标（connecting）、以及整合为全局心理地图（integrating）；对现有VLM在基准上进行大规模实验分析。

Result: 实验揭示当前AI模型处理空间信息存在根本性分歧：VLM几乎完全依赖2D视觉识别与文本匹配来回避复杂的空间推理，而非使用真正的路径积分或形成几何勘测知识（survey knowledge）。

Conclusion: 当前VLM在长距离真实视频地理布局理解上缺乏真正的人类式空间认知机制，其能力主要来自视觉识别与文本匹配的捷径；该基准公开可用，为后续研究提供评测平台。

Abstract: We push the frontier of large-scale spatial intelligence in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and introduce the first benchmark that probes geographical layout understanding from real-world videos, spanning up to 1km distances. Inspired by the cognitive science literature, we evaluate models against the hierarchical stages of human spatial awareness: anchoring via landmarks, connecting them through routes, and integrating these into global mental maps. Extensive experiments reveal a fundamental divergence in how current AI models process spatial information. Instead of utilising true path integration or forming geometric survey knowledge, we find that VLMs rely almost entirely on 2D visual recognition and text-matching to bypass complex spatial reasoning. The benchmark is publicly available at https://perception-test-challenge.github.io/kilometervision.html.

</details>


### [127] [SPOON: Towards Coherent Compositional 3D Scene Generation from Uncalibrated Multi-view Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39590)
*Guibiao Liao,Mochu Xiang,Heng Li,Ken Deng,Zijie Wang,Guanbin Li,Ping Tan,Shenghua Gao,Yizhou Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SPOON框架，将多视角组合式3D场景生成重述为场景级、几何接地的位姿推理问题，通过Guide-Route-Reconcile范式协调物体位姿与相机配置，在两个数据集上取得一致的放置与构图改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从视觉观测恢复完整3D物体形状及其空间布局时，核心挑战在于将生成的高质量物体资产组织成全局一致的场景，同时保持与多视角观测一致。现有方法要么将场景布局与物体生成纠缠，要么独立地从各视角估计空间放置，导致跨视角位姿假设存在歧义与不一致，产生混乱的"物体-相机大杂烩"。

Method: SPOON将多视角组合式3D生成重新表述为场景级、几何接地的位姿推理，而非独立处理各视角的物体位姿假设。它利用重建得到的多视角几何，通过Guide-Route-Reconcile范式对位姿假设进行协调，逐步将物体位姿与相机配置组织为一致的场景级空间布局。

Result: 在ARSG-110K与MIDI-3D-Front上的大量实验表明，在不同输入视角数量下，物体放置与场景构图均获得一致提升。在ARSG-110K上，相比强基线，SPOON将场景级与物体级Chamfer距离分别降低12.7%和17.7%。

Conclusion: 将多视角组合式3D生成建模为场景级几何接地的位姿推理，并通过Guide-Route-Reconcile协调跨视角假设，可有效缓解位姿歧义与跨视角不一致，从而提升场景布局的全局一致性与生成质量。

Abstract: Compositional 3D scene generation aims to recover complete 3D object shapes and their spatial arrangement from visual observations. Recent image-conditioned 3D generators provide strong priors for producing high-quality object geometry, making the generation of complex scenes increasingly practical. A central challenge is therefore to spatially organize these generated assets into a globally coherent scene while remaining consistent with multi-view observations. Existing approaches either entangle scene layout with object generation or separately estimate spatial placement from view-specific observations, where pose hypotheses may remain ambiguous and inconsistent across views, often resulting in an incoherent object-camera soup. We introduce SPOON, a framework that reformulates multi-view compositional 3D generation as scene-level, geometry-grounded pose reasoning. Rather than treating view-specific object pose hypotheses independently, SPOON coordinates them using reconstruction-derived multi-view geometry through a Guide-Route-Reconcile paradigm. This progressively organizes object poses and camera configurations into a coherent scene-level spatial arrangement. Extensive experiments on ARSG-110K and MIDI-3D-Front demonstrate consistent improvements in object placement and scene composition across varying numbers of input views. On ARSG-110K, SPOON reduces scene-level and object-level Chamfer distances by 12.7% and 17.7%, respectively, compared with a strong baseline.

</details>


### [128] [Structural Limits of the Information-Theoretic Uncertainty Decomposition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39591)
*Jakob Lønborg Christensen,Christian F. Baumgartner,Morten Rieger Hannemose,Anders Bjorholm Dahl,Vedrana Andersen Dahl*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文从函数层面分析标准信息论不确定性分解框架，发现AU与EU的可行域受类数与蒙特卡洛样本数N的结构性限制（AU ≤ log(2)/N），该不可行区域可解释认知坍缩，并指出低AU区间AU与EU耦合、不应视为独立量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实践中的不确定性估计存在两个关键问题：AU与EU高度相关的纠缠，以及EU幅度随模型容量增大而收缩的认知坍缩。作者希望从理论层面解释这些现象的成因。

Method: 在函数层面对标准信息论分解框架进行分析，刻画假定的AU、EU取值范围中在有限设定下不可行的部分，并推导该不可行区域随类别数与蒙特卡洛样本数N的缩放规律。

Result: 不可行区域由AU ≤ log(2)/N界定；其边界解释了认知坍缩：当模型置信度高时，该结构性限制保证AU > EU；增大集成规模可通过缩小不可行区域缓解认知坍缩；当AU ≤ log(2)/N时AU与EU耦合。

Conclusion: 应谨慎对待低AU区间中AU与EU的独立假设，因为此时二者耦合；增大集成规模有助于缓解认知坍缩。研究揭示了标准分解框架的结构性局限。

Abstract: Uncertainty estimation in machine learning typically decomposes uncertainty into aleatoric uncertainty (AU) and epistemic uncertainty (EU) using the standard information-theoretic framework. However, in practice, two critical issues arise: entanglement (AU and EU are highly correlated) and epistemic collapse (EU magnitude shrinks with increasing model capacity). We analyze this framework on a functional level and discover that significant portions of the assumed AU, EU range are infeasible in finite settings, and cannot be attained with any class probabilities. We characterize how this infeasible region scales with the number of classes and Monte Carlo samples $N$ (e.g., from ensembles with $N$ members), revealing it is bounded by $\text{AU} \leq \log(2)/N$. Crucially, the infeasible region's boundary helps explain epistemic collapse: when model confidence is high, $\text{AU} > \text{EU}$ is guaranteed by this fundamental structural limitation. Our findings show that increasing ensemble size mitigates epistemic collapse by reducing the infeasible area. Lastly, we caution against interpreting AU and EU as independent quantities in low AU regimes, since we show they are coupled when $\text{AU} \leq \log(2)/N$.

</details>


### [129] [GroundAnything: Reconciling Parallel Decoding with Precise Visual Grounding at Flash Speed](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39600)
*Qize Yu,Lianrui Fan,Bowen Ping,Xini Ding,Zetian Song,Junbo Niu,Kaixuan Wang,Tianxing Chen,Yue Chen,Minghua He,Yuran Wang,Jie Huang,Haojun Zhang,Min Chen,Hao Li,Wenxuan Song,Ruihai Wu,Xianming Liu,Shilong Liu,Shuchang Zhou,Ping Luo,Shiyu Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 4B 参数的 grounding 基础模型 GroundAnything，将 grounding 视为视觉证据提取，采用分块去噪扩散实现并行解码，在 30 个基准上达到同规模 SOTA，并提供自推测解码加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归 grounding 模型将空间预测序列化，带来顺序延迟，并将输出 token 强加因果顺序。但物体、位置与空间关系的依赖关系并不蕴含固有的从左到右生成顺序，因此需要一种可并行生成并联合精炼的建模范式。

Method: 将 grounding 重新表述为视觉证据提取，采用双向扩散建模，通过分块去噪（blockwise denoising）在快速并行解码与精确定位之间取得平衡。训练流程包括：基于公开数据集与专用数据引擎的 grounding 预训练、带联合 AR 与扩散目标的直接 AR-to-diffusion 转换、监督微调以及基于 GRPO 的强化学习后训练。另引入熵引导解码与可选自推测解码模式。

Result: 在 30 个 grounding 基准上，自回归变体 GroundAnything-VLM 在同规模模型中取得新 SOTA，总体 72.42%，与 GPT-6 Astra（71.35%）保持竞争力；熵引导解码下 GroundAnything 平均 61.75%，超过同规模此前 SOTA（快速 MTP 的 LocateAnything，53.32%）。自推测模式相较 AR 对应模型实现 4.51× 加速，COCO F1mIoU 仅下降 0.74 个百分点，渐进式推理优化可将并行解码转化为实际加速。

Conclusion: 并行扩散解码可有效替代序列化 AR 生成，兼顾速度与定位精度，支持延迟敏感的真实世界视觉 grounding 系统。同时保留 AR 变体作为强基线，验证了联合 AR 与扩散目标的训练设计。

Abstract: Autoregressive (AR) grounding models serialize spatial predictions, introducing sequential latency and imposing a causal order on output tokens. We view grounding as visual evidence extraction: objects, locations, and spatial relations are jointly constrained by the image and query, yet their dependencies do not imply an intrinsic left-to-right generation order. This distinction makes bidirectional diffusion a natural fit, allowing spatial hypotheses to emerge in parallel and be jointly refined through iterative denoising. We introduce GroundAnything, a 4B-parameter grounding foundation model that reconciles fast parallel decoding with precise localization through blockwise denoising. Training combines grounding pretraining from public datasets and dedicated data engines, direct AR-to-diffusion conversion with joint AR and diffusion objectives, supervised fine-tuning, and GRPO-based reinforcement post-training. Across 30 grounding benchmarks, our autoregressive variant, GroundAnything-VLM, establishes a new overall state of the art among similarly sized models at 72.42%, remaining competitive with GPT-6 Astra (71.35%). With entropy-guided decoding, GroundAnything also surpasses the prior state of the art at this scale, averaging 61.75% versus 53.32% for the fast MTP-based LocateAnything model. We further explore decoding strategies, showing that an optional self-speculative mode achieves a $4.51\times$ speedup over the AR counterpart with a 0.74 percentage-point drop in COCO F1mIoU. Infrastructure experiments show that progressive inference optimizations translate parallel decoding into practical speedups. These support efficient visual grounding in latency-sensitive real-world systems.

</details>


### [130] [GroundingPI: A Grounding Foundation Model towards Physical Intelligence with Visual Primitives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39601)
*Qize Yu,Lianrui Fan,Boyu Chen,Jiaqi Liang,Xini Ding,Yue Chen,Zetian Song,Yuran Wang,Yi Zou,Kaixuan Wang,Tianxing Chen,Wenxuan Song,Bohan Zhou,Mingleyang Li,Siqiao Huang,Yuqi Ye,Caigao Jiang,Wei Wei,Ruihai Wu,Hang Zhang,Yixiao Ge,Shuchang Zhou,Shilong Liu,Xianming Liu,Ping Luo,Shiyu Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 GroundingPI，一个 4B 规模的 grounding 基础模型，将点和框以量化坐标形式统一到共享词表中生成，并通过多模态与空间预训练、监督微调及 GRPO 强化学习训练。在 34 个基准、44 个基线上达到平均 73.68% 的 SOTA，并作为视觉骨干提升机器人操作与自动驾驶性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 精准 grounding（确定目标是什么、在哪里，需在杂乱场景与微小目标下有效，且满足闭环控制的实时性）对物理智能至关重要。然而现有 VLA 与世界动作模型（WAMs）沿用通用视觉-语言与视频生成骨干，其感知在此类场景中仍表现不佳，缺乏面向感知的专用预训练。

Method: GroundingPI 为 4B grounding 基础模型，将点与框表示为共享词表中的量化坐标进行生成。训练流程包含三阶段：多模态与空间预训练、监督微调、基于 GRPO 的强化学习，监督信号来自公开数据集与专用数据引擎。作者在 11 类感知能力上系统分析预训练规模与数据配比。

Result: 在 34 个 grounding 基准、44 个基线上取得 SOTA，平均 73.68%，超过更大的 GPT-6 Astra（71.54%）。作为下游视觉骨干：RoboTwin 2.0 上在全部四个 OOD 设置中优于所评估的所有主流骨干，最高相对最强骨干提升 24.8%；RoboCasa-GR1 上仅用 50% 演示即超过使用 75% 的基线；nuScenes 上开环 L2 误差平均 0.296 m。下游性能随预训练规模扩大而提升；密集 grounding 对机器人与自动驾驶均有显著收益，OCR 有潜力成为感知学习的催化剂。

Conclusion: 结果支持将 grounding 作为感知基础，并表明面向感知的专用预训练是通向物理智能基础模型的有前景方向；同时揭示了预训练规模、数据配比与具体感知能力之间的系统性关系。

Abstract: Precise grounding matters. It specifies which object is the target and where that object is, even in clutter and for tiny objects, and it has to be fast enough for closed-loop control. Yet vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action models (WAMs) take perception from general-purpose vision-language and video-generation backbones, which still fail in these settings. We introduce GroundingPI, a 4B grounding foundation model that generates points and boxes as quantized coordinates in a shared vocabulary. Training combines multimodal and spatial pretraining, supervised fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning with GRPO, using supervision from public datasets and dedicated data engines. Against 44 baselines across 34 grounding benchmarks spanning 11 perceptual capabilities, GroundingPI establishes a new state of the art, averaging 73.68%, above the larger GPT-6 Astra (71.54%). As a downstream visual backbone, GroundingPI improves performance on robotic manipulation and autonomous driving. On RoboTwin 2.0, it outperforms every mainstream backbone we evaluate in all four out-of-distribution settings, by up to 24.8% relative to the strongest backbone. On RoboCasa-GR1, GroundingPI trained with 50% of the demonstrations outperforms those baselines trained with 75%. On nuScenes, used as the visual backbone, GroundingPI attains an average open-loop L2 error of 0.296 m. We systematically analyze GroundingPI's pretraining in scale and data composition. Downstream autonomous driving and robotic manipulation improve as the pretraining is scaled. Analyzing the data recipe across these 11 perceptual capabilities shows dense grounding's substantial benefits for both, and OCR's potential as a catalyst for perceptual learning. These results support grounding as a perceptual foundation, and dedicated perceptual pretraining as a promising direction for foundation models of physical intelligence.

</details>


### [131] [FOMO: Forget the Concept, Don't Miss Out on the Scene in Selective Video Unlearning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39605)
*Łukasz Rudnik,Agnieszka Polowczyk,Alicja Polowczyk,Przemysław Spurek*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FOMO是首个基于训练的选择性视频概念遗忘方法，将原场景保持作为优先目标，可统一处理不安全内容、物体与运动概念的遗忘，并在概念移除与场景保持间取得最佳权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式视频模型依赖大规模网络数据训练，不可避免接触不良内容，概念遗忘成为必要缓解手段。但现有方法主要针对静态视觉概念（物体、身份、不安全外观），忽视运动遗忘；且很少关注保留周围场景，导致概念移除时可能意外改变背景、构图或整体视频动态。作者主张有效遗忘应只改变目标内容，尽量减少对剩余场景的不必要改动。

Method: 提出FOMO，首个基于训练的选择性视频遗忘方法。将遗忘形式化为两个互补目标："改什么"与"保什么"：定位概念相关表征并加以修改；保持机制无需辅助数据即可维持非目标场景信息。除擦除不良概念外，还将生成显式重定向至指定的安全替代概念。进一步将该框架扩展至运动遗忘，此时概念由时序行为而非固定空间区域定义。

Result: 在不安全内容、物体和运动概念上均实现有效遗忘，并在概念移除与场景保持之间取得最佳权衡。

Conclusion: FOMO将场景保持作为优先目标，通过"改变"与"保持"双目标及安全重定向机制，实现选择性视频概念遗忘，并成功扩展到运动遗忘，验证了兼顾概念移除与场景保持的可行性与优越性。

Abstract: The rapid advancement of generative video models has enabled the synthesis of increasingly realistic and temporally coherent videos, while also raising concerns about the generation of harmful content. The reliance on large-scale web datasets during training inevitably exposes these models to undesirable material, making concept unlearning an essential mitigation. Existing methods mainly target static visual concepts, such as objects, identities, or unsafe appearance, largely overlooking motion unlearning. Furthermore, these approaches often pay little attention to preserving the surrounding scene. As a result, successful concept removal may unintentionally alter the background, composition, or overall video dynamics. We argue that effective unlearning should ideally change only what is targeted, while minimizing unnecessary changes to the remaining scene. In this work, we introduce FOMO, to the best of our knowledge the first training-based selective video unlearning method that directly treats preservation of the original scene as a priority. We formulate unlearning around two complementary objectives: what to change and what to preserve. Our method localizes concept-related representations and modifies them, while the preservation mechanism maintains non-target scene information without requiring auxiliary data. Beyond simply erasing unwanted concepts, FOMO explicitly redirects the generation toward a specified safe alternative. We further extend this formulation to motion unlearning, where the concept is defined by temporal behavior rather than a fixed spatial region. Our solution achieves effective unlearning across unsafe content, object, and motion concepts, while achieving the best trade-off between concept removal and scene preservation.
  Code: https://github.com/gmum/FOMO
  Project Page https://gmum.github.io/FOMO

</details>


### [132] [ShieldCLIP: Selective Safety Alignment for Harmful Content Mitigation in Multimodal Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39688)
*Tobia Poppi,Silvia Cappelletti,Samuele Poppi,Marcella Cornia,Lorenzo Baraldi,Diego Garcia-Olano,Rita Cucchiara*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 ShieldCLIP 框架，按各模态的安全状态而非样本来源进行多模态编码器的安全对齐，并发布 ViSUv2 数据集，在保持原嵌入空间效用的同时显著降低有害输出。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CLIP 等基于网络规模数据训练的多模态编码器嵌入了有害关联，需要安全对齐加以抑制，同时又不能无谓改变良性表征。由于伦理与现实约束无法大规模采集真实不安全内容，现有数据集将安全真实样本与生成样本配对，却把所有生成样本一律标为不安全，即使其中某一模态本身是安全的，导致对齐目标过于粗糙、损害安全内容。

Method: 提出 ShieldCLIP：首个以各模态观测到的安全状态（而非样本来源）为条件的安全对齐框架。配套发布 ViSUv2，包含 195k 四元组、覆盖 578 个概念与 28 个类别，并具备独立的分模态安全标签。基于这些标签，ShieldCLIP 定义了超越对级监督的四路条件目标：安全内容被锚定；不安全模态被重定向到其安全对应物；混合对仅更新不安全分支；当两个模态均不安全时施加一致性约束。

Result: 在跨模态检索、基于 Stable Diffusion v1.4 与 SDXL 的文生图、以及基于 LLaVA 的图生文三类任务上评估，ShieldCLIP 相较此前的安全对齐编码器与强缓解基线，持续降低有害输出，同时保持原嵌入空间的效用。消融实验进一步表明，分模态监督与选择性对齐目标均对性能提升有贡献。

Conclusion: 以分模态安全状态为条件的选择性对齐可在不牺牲嵌入空间效用的情况下有效抑制多模态编码器的有害关联；源代码、训练模型及受控访问的 ViSUv2 将公开于 https://aimagelab.github.io/ShieldCLIP/。

Abstract: Multimodal encoders such as CLIP underlie many downstream systems, but their web-scale training data embed harmful associations that safety alignment must suppress without unnecessarily changing benign representations. Because ethical and practical constraints prevent collecting real unsafe content at scale, existing datasets pair safe real samples with generated counterparts, but label every generated sample unsafe, even when one modality is individually safe. To address this, we introduce ShieldCLIP, the first framework to condition safety alignment on the observed safety state of each modality rather than the origin of a sample, preserving safe content while redirecting only what is unsafe. We also introduce ViSUv2, a 195k-quadruplet dataset with independent per-modality safety labels across 578 concepts and 28 categories. Using these labels, ShieldCLIP defines a four-way conditional objective beyond pair-level supervision: safe content is anchored, unsafe modalities are redirected to their safe counterparts, mixed pairs update only the unsafe branch, and coherence is enforced when both are unsafe. We evaluate ShieldCLIP on cross-modal retrieval, text-to-image generation with Stable Diffusion v1.4 and SDXL, and image-to-text generation with LLaVA. Across these settings, ShieldCLIP consistently reduces harmful outputs over prior safety-aligned encoders and strong mitigation baselines, while preserving the utility of the original embedding space. Extensive ablation studies further show that both modality-specific supervision and the selective alignment objective contribute to these gains. Source code, trained models, and ViSUv2 (under a controlled-access protocol) will be made publicly available at https://aimagelab.github.io/ShieldCLIP/.

</details>


### [133] [Semantic Watermarking for Malicious Image Manipulation Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39623)
*Yoonseo Kim,Seungwoo Baek,Junyoung Park*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 CLIP-VAE 语义水印框架，将水印重构为可恢复的语义参考而非不透明标识符，结合通道感知训练提升鲁棒性，并支持篡改方向检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高保真生成编辑模型可向普通图像注入暴力或性内容且保持视觉合理性，对公共话语与弱势群体造成实际影响，亟需鲁棒的语义水印来应对此类篡改。

Method: 采用基于 β-VAE 的二进制水印（CLIP-VAE），并在训练中注入随机比特翻转噪声，实现显式的通道感知训练，使解码器在噪声水印信道下学习优雅退化；下游轻量模块 SDA-Net 利用恢复的语义嵌入判断图像是否被篡改及其语义漂移方向。

Result: 在与 SimHash、ITQ、HashNet 及其 robust-MLP 变体的 5 路对比中，CLIP-VAE 在真实 InstructPix2Pix 比特错误率条件下对原始 CLIP 嵌入取得最高重建余弦相似度，并独有地支持漂移方向检测。

Conclusion: CLIP-VAE 可作为现有内容审核流程的取证补充，实现语义级篡改检测与方向性溯源。

Abstract: The proliferation of high-fidelity generative editing models has made it possible to inject violent or sexual content into otherwise ordinary images while preserving visual plausibility, with concrete consequences for public discourse and vulnerable populations. We propose a robust semantic watermarking framework that reframes the watermark as a recoverable semantic reference rather than an opaque identifier. Our framework combines a $β$-VAE-based binary watermark (CLIP-VAE) with explicit channel-aware training---random bit-flip noise is injected during training so that the decoder learns graceful degradation under the noisy watermarking channel. As a downstream application, a lightweight module SDA-Net uses the recovered semantic embedding to expose not only whether but in which semantic direction an image has been altered. In a 5-way comparison against representative binary hashing baselines (SimHash, ITQ, HashNet, and their robust-MLP variants), CLIP-VAE achieves the highest reconstruction cosine similarity to the original CLIP embedding under realistic InstructPix2Pix bit-error rates, and uniquely supports direction-of-drift detection---a forensic complement to existing content-moderation pipelines.

</details>


### [134] [ExpandDiff: Dynamic Range Expanding Diffusion for Single-Image HDR Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39624)
*Mehmet Emre andıran,Zhuoqian Yang,Liying Lu,Mathieu Salzmann,Sabine Süsstrunk*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 ExpandDiff，一种条件扩散管线，可联合重建单张 LDR 图像中被裁剪的阴影与高光，在 SI-HDR 基准上显著提升 HDR 重建精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单图 HDR 重建需在保留 LDR 可见内容的同时推断缺失细节。由于传感器动态范围与曝光差异，LDR 图像在阴影和高光处损失的信息量各不相同，现有方法难以同时兼顾两个方向的裁剪恢复。

Method: 提出 Dynamic Clipping Synthesis（DCS），在从 HDR 目标构造训练输入时随机采样阴影与高光的裁剪百分位；采用由空间自适应归一化引导的像素空间扩散模型，通过有界输出头预测感知编码的 HDR，并在单次采样轨迹中同时重建两个裁剪方向。

Result: 在 SI-HDR 基准上，ExpandDiff 各变体相比最强对比方法在 PU21-PSNR 上提升 3.43 dB，在双侧裁剪情形下提升 7.34 dB。

Conclusion: ExpandDiff 通过 DCS 与条件扩散架构有效应对 LDR 中阴影/高光信息损失不一致的问题，实现单次采样内双向裁剪重建，取得领先的 HDR 重建精度。

Abstract: Single-image HDR reconstruction requires inferring missing detail while preserving the visible content of an LDR image. Differences in sensor dynamic range and exposure cause LDR images to lose varying amounts of information in shadows and highlights. We present ExpandDiff, a conditional diffusion pipeline that jointly reconstructs clipped shadows and highlights. To account for this variation, we introduce Dynamic Clipping Synthesis (DCS), which randomly samples shadow and highlight clipping percentiles when constructing training inputs from HDR targets. A pixel-space diffusion model guided by spatially-adaptive normalization then predicts perceptually encoded HDR through a bounded output head, reconstructing both clipping directions in one sampling trajectory. On the SI-HDR benchmark, ExpandDiff variants improve HDR reconstruction accuracy by 3.43 dB in PU21-PSNR over the strongest evaluated competing method, and by 7.34 dB under two-sided clipping. The code and supplementary material are available at https://memreandiran.github.io/expanddiff/.

</details>


### [135] [D-Scope: Decomposing and Steering Diffusion Transformers with Sparse Autoencoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39625)
*Xinyue Xu,Jiahao Zhang,Lijie Hu,Peter Hase,Hao Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出 D-Scope 框架，通过共享视觉证据将扩散 Transformer（DiT）中稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征的"可解释性"与其对生成过程的可控性连接起来。研究系统评估了跨两个模型家族、五个层级的 150 个 SAE，并构建含 100 个目标概念的基准，发现高重建保真度可能伴随低字典利用率和有限的视觉证据覆盖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作利用 SAE 揭示了 DiT 中的视觉结构，但仅对特征进行解释并不能说明该特征能否用于控制生成过程，二者之间存在鸿沟。论文的动机是建立一个可检验、可审查的框架，把"特征解释"与"生成控制"统一到共享的视觉证据上，从而评估稀疏 DiT 特征是否真正具有因果性的生成控制能力。

Method: D-Scope 聚合高激活图像块的 SigLIP~2 嵌入形成视觉质心；在共享图像-文本嵌入空间中，将目标文本描述与视觉质心匹配，从而无需逐特征文本标注即可检索单个特征。对应的图像块作为证据用于审查每次选择；同时通过空间掩码干预，在固定生成条件下以不同强度测试对应的解码器方向。研究覆盖两个模型家族、五个层级的 150 个 SAE，并引入含 100 个目标概念、每个概念十种上下文的基准，涵盖欠指定与显式冲突条件。

Result: 实证结果显示，高重建保真度可与低字典利用率及有限的视觉证据覆盖并存。在逐案例最优强度扫描选择下，相较于直接检索，对比式检索在所测试的引导配置中取得更大的区域 SigLIP~2 平均增益，但并未一致改善区域外保持效果。

Conclusion: D-Scope 提供了一个可审查的框架，通过稀疏 DiT 特征的视觉证据及其解码器方向对生成的影响来评估这些特征，揭示了"解释性"与"可控性"并非等价，并为后续评估 SAE 特征的实际生成控制价值提供了方法论基础。

Abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) reveal visual structure in diffusion transformers (DiTs), but interpreting a feature does not establish whether it can be used to control generation. We introduce D-Scope (Diffusion Scope), a framework that connects feature interpretation to generation control through shared visual evidence. D-Scope aggregates SigLIP~2 embeddings of highly activating image patches into visual centroids. Matching target text descriptions against these visual centroids in the shared image-text embedding space then enables retrieval of individual features without per-feature text annotations. The underlying patches provide evidence for inspecting each selection, while spatially masked interventions test the corresponding decoder direction at varying strengths under fixed generation conditions. We characterize 150 SAEs across two model families and five layers, and introduce a benchmark of 100 target concepts with ten contexts each spanning under-specified and explicit-conflict conditions. Our empirical results show that high reconstruction fidelity can coexist with low dictionary utilization and limited visual-evidence coverage. Under per-case best-of-sweep strength selection, contrastive retrieval yields larger mean regional SigLIP~2 gains than direct retrieval across the tested steering configurations, without consistently improving outside-region preservation. D-Scope provides an inspectable framework for evaluating sparse DiT features through their visual evidence and the effects of their decoder directions on generation. The demo is available at https://jiahaozhang-public.github.io/d-scope/.

</details>


### [136] [Introduction to Computer Vision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39627)
*Stan Birchfield*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 一本以代码为先的计算机视觉教材，涵盖经典2D、经典3D与深度学习，共44个短章节，所有算法用Python/NumPy或PyTorch实现并与OpenCV/PyTorch库函数数值比对验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为希望既理解计算机视觉算法数学原理、又掌握其Python实现的学生与从业者提供一本自包含的参考书，并借助AI辅助将大量在线课程笔记与代码凝练为简明的数学阐述且保持结果可复现。

Method: 全书分三部分、44个短章节，从第一性原理构建主题：2D部分涉及图像算术与形态学、卷积、金字塔与频域滤波、特征检测、光流与立体视觉；3D部分涉及投影几何、相机标定与运动恢复结构；深度学习部分从单神经元到卷积网络、反向传播、经典架构、迁移学习、目标检测、语义与实例分割，并以混合精度、并行训练等工程议题收尾。每个技术均以Python与NumPy或PyTorch直接实现，并与对应OpenCV或PyTorch库函数进行数值校验。

Result: 读者不仅能看到数学推导，还能观察其在真实与合成数据上的具体行为；书中结果经过验证且可复现。

Conclusion: 该书可作为理解计算机视觉算法及其Python实现的自包含参考书，适合学生与从业者使用。

Abstract: This book presents a code-first introduction to computer vision, spanning classical 2D image processing, classical 3D vision, and deep learning. Organized as 44 short chapters across three parts, the book builds each topic from first principles: image arithmetic and morphology; convolution, pyramids, and frequency-domain filtering; feature detection, optical flow, and stereo; projective geometry, camera calibration, and structure from motion; and the full arc of modern deep learning, from a single neuron through convolutional networks, backpropagation, classic architectures, transfer learning, object detection, and semantic and instance segmentation, concluding with engineering considerations like mixed-precision and parallel training. Every technique is implemented directly in Python and NumPy or PyTorch and checked numerically against the corresponding OpenCV or PyTorch library function, so readers see not just the mathematics but its concrete behavior on real and synthetic data. The material was distilled with AI assistance from freely available online course notes, condensing extensive working code into concise mathematical exposition while preserving verified, reproducible results throughout. It is intended as a self-contained reference for students and practitioners who want to understand computer vision algorithms and their Python implementations.

</details>


### [137] [SAGE: Salient Factor Discovery and Generation with Visual Foundation Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39635)
*Shuang Liang,Lejun Liao,Shiyuan Zhang,Max C. Zhang,Xiaolong Luo,Han Wang,Stefano Anzellotti,Yuan Yuan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SAGE在冻结自编码器的高维空间潜空间中直接学习显著与共同因子，并以显著表示条件化DiT，实现高保真重建、无监督子类型发现与可控生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对比分析需从目标数据集（如戴眼镜人脸）中分离出特有的显著因子与两数据集共享的共同内容，且期望显著表示能捕捉每张图像的细节（眼镜形状、颜色、位置），从而在无子类型标签情况下揭示子类型，并引导生成某个未命名或无文本描述的子类型新样本。

Method: 提出SAGE：在冻结的表示自编码器（representation autoencoder）的高维空间潜表示中直接学习显著因子与共同因子，并将扩散Transformer（DiT）条件化于参考图像的已学显著表示上。

Result: 在Digits-ImageNet与FFHQ眼镜数据集上，SAGE兼具高保真重建（rFID低于2）与无监督子类型发现：数字恢复探测准确率0.950，优于基线最高0.281，并揭示眼镜类型、更细的太阳镜风格及误标图像；显著条件生成将Digits-ImageNet子类型准确率从非因子化潜空间的27.7%提升至90.5%，并在两个数据集上提升多样性；在视网膜OCT上，仅用正常/疾病标签即可分离三种疾病。

Conclusion: SAGE表明：在冻结自编码器的高维空间潜空间中直接学习显著/共同因子，并以此显著表示条件化扩散生成器，可在无子类型标签条件下同时取得高保真重建、可解释的子类型发现与可控且多样的生成，并具备跨域（如医学影像）迁移能力。

Abstract: Given a target dataset, such as faces with eyeglasses, and a background dataset, such as faces without, contrastive analysis separates \textit{salient} factors specific to the target from \textit{common} content shared by both. We aim for salient representations that capture target-specific detail in each image, such as the shape, color, and position of the glasses, so that they reveal subtypes without subtype labels and guide the generation of new examples of a discovered subtype, even one with no name or text description. We introduce SAGE, which learns both factors directly in the high-dimensional spatial latent of a frozen representation autoencoder and conditions a diffusion transformer on the learned salient representation of a reference image. On Digits-ImageNet and FFHQ eyeglasses, SAGE combines high-fidelity \textit{reconstruction} (rFID below $2$) with unsupervised \textit{subtype discovery}, recovering the digits better than baselines (probe accuracy $0.950$ vs.\ at most $0.281$) and revealing eyewear types, finer sunglasses styles, and mislabeled images; salient-conditioned \textit{generation} raises Digits-ImageNet subtype accuracy over the unfactorized latent ($90.5\%$ vs.\ $27.7\%$) and diversity on both datasets. On retinal OCT, SAGE's salient space separates three diseases using only normal/disease labels.

</details>


### [138] [FANVIDv2: Evaluating Video Super-Resolution by Face and Licence-Plate Recognition Under Compound Degradation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39649)
*Kavitha Viswanathan,Vrinda Goel,Shlesh Gholap,Devayan Ghosh,Madhav Gupta,Dhruvi Ganatra,Sanket Potdar,Amit Sethi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出FANVIDv2基准，用识别流水线而非PSNR/SSIM来评价视频超分辨率（VSR），覆盖人脸与车牌两类识别任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统VSR多以双三次下采样剪辑上的PSNR和SSIM为评价标准，但在监控场景中VSR的真实目的是让面部和车牌"可识别"，二者目标不一致。

Method: 提供320×180低分辨率（LR）剪辑及高分辨率（HR）参考：48个公众人物（各1张HR库图像）与375个车牌剪辑（覆盖360个不同车牌字符串）。LR由随机复合退化生成（模糊、尺寸抖动、传感器噪声、JPEG压缩、最终下采样），而非仅双三次下采样。提出两个在检测框"内部"评分的指标：FaceRecBox（需定位正确且身份识别正确才给分）、TextRecBox（按定位质量加权的归一化编辑距离评分车牌转录）。基线为2.3M参数VSR模型RCDM及残差图门控变体RCDM-RMGF。

Result: 使用RCDM基线，FaceRecBox由0.6864升至0.7222，匹配人脸的身份准确率由84.35%升至86.93%，TextRecBox由0.3088升至0.3667；RCDM-RMGF在车牌上达0.3801。

Conclusion: 详细描述了退化模型、基线架构与评分器，并公开标注、元数据、下载与退化脚本及评价代码。

Abstract: Video super-resolution (VSR) is normally judged by PSNR and SSIM on clips that were downsampled bicubically, although in surveillance its purpose is to make faces and licence plates \emph{recognisable}. We present FANVIDv2, a benchmark that scores VSR by what a recognition pipeline can do with its output. FANVIDv2 provides $320\times180$ low-resolution (LR) clips with high-resolution (HR) references for 48 public figures (with one HR gallery image each) and 375 licence-plate clips covering 360 distinct plate strings. LR clips are generated with a randomised compound degradation (blur, resize jitter, sensor noise, JPEG compression, final downsampling) rather than bicubic downsampling alone. Two metrics score recognition \emph{inside} detections: FaceRecBox rewards a face only if it is localised and correctly identified, and TextRecBox scores plate transcriptions by normalised edit distance weighted by localisation quality. With a 2.3\,M-parameter VSR baseline (RCDM), FaceRecBox rises from 0.6864 to 0.7222, identity accuracy on matched faces from 84.35\% to 86.93\%, and TextRecBox from 0.3088 to 0.3667; a residual-map gated variant (RCDM-RMGF) reaches 0.3801 on plates. We describe the degradation model, the baseline architectures and the scorers in detail, and release annotations, metadata, download and degradation scripts and evaluation code.

</details>


### [139] [MCD: Causal Distillation of Multimodal In-Context Learning in Large Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39920)
*Yanshu Li,Jiaqian Li,Canran Xiao,Xi Xiao,Tianyang Wang,Yongtai Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出多模态因果蒸馏（MCD）框架，通过迁移教师模型在ICL中"如何使用多模态证据"的因果模式，而非仅对齐输出分布或隐表示，使小模型学生平均提升7.23分，优于普通蒸馏4.68分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LVLM具备强多模态上下文学习（ICL）能力，但模型规模减小时该能力显著退化。现有知识蒸馏方法主要直接对齐输出分布或隐表示，只教会学生"教师预测什么"，而未揭示上下文中哪些证据在因果上支持该预测。因此学生可能模仿教师答案，却仍依赖语言先验、提示结构等虚假线索。

Method: 提出多模态因果蒸馏（MCD）：利用保持结构的token干预来识别并验证因果证据，随后迁移教师在该证据被保留或被移除时的响应方式。该设计将蒸馏与模型在多模态ICL中使用上下文证据的因果模式相连接。

Result: 在三个LVLM系列、七个基准上的实验表明：MCD使学生性能平均提升7.23分，比普通蒸馏高4.68分；进一步分析验证了这些增益的泛化性。

Conclusion: 通过迁移教师利用多模态证据的因果模式，MCD有效缩小不同规模LVLM间的ICL能力差距，且性能提升具有跨模型系列与基准的泛化性。

Abstract: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) exhibit strong multimodal in-context learning (ICL) capabilities, yet this ability degrades substantially as model size decreases. Knowledge distillation offers a natural way to bridge this gap, but existing methods primarily align output distributions or hidden representations directly. Such alignment teaches the student what the teacher predicts without revealing which evidence in the complex context causally supports that prediction. Consequently, a student can imitate the teacher's answer while continuing to rely on language priors, prompt structure, or other spurious cues. To address this limitation, we introduce Multimodal Causal Distillation (MCD), a distillation framework that transfers how a strong teacher uses multimodal evidence during ICL. MCD uses structure-preserving token interventions to identify and verify causal evidence, then transfers how the teacher responds when that evidence is retained or removed. This design connects distillation to the causal patterns by which the model uses contextual evidence during multimodal ICL. Experiments across three LVLM families and seven benchmarks show that MCD improves student performance by 7.23 points on average and outperforms vanilla distillation by 4.68 points, while further analyses confirm the generalizability of these gains.

</details>


### [140] [Diffusable Latents from Structure-Agnostic Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39657)
*Adrien Ramanana Rahary,Nicolas Dufour,Patrick Pérez,David Picard*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 将图像级池化描述子对齐到教师特征，即可替代逐位置稠密蒸馏，在多种潜变量形状与教师模态下保持甚至提升潜扩散的收敛速度与生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准潜扩散蒸馏要求潜变量每个位置与教师共位特征对齐，把潜变量布局绑定到教师布局上，限制了潜空间设计的自由度（如1D token序列、跨模态教师）。作者质疑该约束的必要性。

Method: 对比稠密逐位置蒸馏与图像级池化蒸馏；池化目标分一阶（直接匹配池化描述子）与关系型（仅基于每张图像最近邻关系）两类；在不同潜变量形状（含1D token序列）与不同教师模态（如图像自编码器蒸馏文本编码器）下评估其可扩散性。

Result: 单个池化图像级描述子对齐教师的效果与稠密逐位置蒸馏相当或略优；一阶池化匹配可自然扩展到1D token潜变量与跨模态场景，把文本编码器蒸馏进图像自编码器仍能提升可扩散性；仅用最近邻关系的关系型目标同样带来提升。

Conclusion: 潜空间与教师特征的空间布局对齐并非必要，图像级池化蒸馏是一种结构无关的通用方案，可解耦潜变量设计并支持跨模态蒸馏；代码与博客已开源。

Abstract: Distilling pretrained foundation models into an autoencoder bottleneck improves latent diffusability, enabling diffusion models to converge faster and reach higher sample quality. Standard distillation aligns the latent at each position to a co-located teacher feature, tying the latent layout to the teacher's. We show this constraint is unnecessary: aligning a single pooled image-level descriptor to the teacher's performs as well as or slightly better than dense position-wise distillation. We compare first-order and relational pooled objectives across latent shapes and teacher modalities. First-order matching extends naturally to 1D token-sequence latents and across modalities, where distilling a text encoder into an image autoencoder still improves diffusability; a relational objective based only on each image's nearest neighbours improves it as well. Code and blog post are available at https://github.com/AdrienRR/structure-agnostic-distillation and https://kyutai.org/blog/2026-09-28-structure-agnostic-distillation/.

</details>


### [141] [BAM! Bayesian Anything Model: a foundation model for generative computational imaging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39660)
*Alessio Spagnoletti,Charlesquin Kemajou Mbakam,Jonathan Spence,Andrés Almansa,Marcelo Pereyra*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: BAM 是一个仅 36M 参数的轻量级物理感知基础模型，将 RAM 骨干升级为条件流映射，实现少步数、无需似然近似与引导权重的贝叶斯后验采样，并在多数据集线性逆问题上以 3 步超越专用模型与零样本方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成模型正在变革贝叶斯计算成像，但该领域缺乏物理感知的基础模型。现有做法分为两类：1）将大型基础图像模型作为即插即用先验，配合零样本近似似然引导，但引入显著偏差与计算开销；2）物理感知生成模型虽避免了偏差，却各自绑定于特定数据集、任务和仪器，泛化性差。因此需要一个既物理感知又能稳健泛化到未见数据与任务的基础模型。

Method: 提出 BAM（Bayesian Anything Model），一个用于少步、物理感知后验采样的轻量级基础模型。核心思路是将算子条件化的 Reconstruct Anything Model（RAM，Terris 等）骨干升级为条件流映射（conditional flow map），使仪器物理在推理时指定而非训练时固定。模型仅 36M 参数，在大规模图像语料与前向算子库上联合预训练。单个网络即可在少步内完成后验采样，无需似然近似，也无需调节引导权重。

Result: 在 FFHQ、AFHQ、LSUN、DIV2K 以及 Kohler 相机抖动基准上的线性逆问题中，BAM 仅用 3 步即在样本质量上超越专用模型与领先的零样本方法，且计算成本仅为它们的一小部分。

Conclusion: BAM 为社区提供了生成式计算成像的易用切入点，降低了训练成像模型的经济与环境成本，并为物理感知贝叶斯计算成像的研究开辟了新路径。

Abstract: Generative models are transforming Bayesian computational imaging, yet the field still lacks physics-aware foundation models. Current practice falls into two camps. Large foundation image models are deployed as plug-and-play priors with zero-shot approximate likelihood guidance, which introduces significant bias and computational cost. Physics-aware generative models avoid this bias, but each is tied to a specific dataset, task and instrument. We introduce BAM (Bayesian Anything Model), a lightweight foundation model for few-step, physics-aware posterior sampling that generalises robustly to unseen data and tasks, zero-shot or with minimal finetuning. BAM upgrades the operator-conditioned Reconstruct Anything Model (RAM) backbone (Terris et al.) into a conditional flow map, so instrument physics is specified at inference time rather than fixed during training. BAM has just 36M parameters and is pre-trained jointly on large image corpora and libraries of forward operators. A single network then draws posterior samples in a few steps, with no likelihood approximation and no guidance weights to tune. Across linear inverse problems on FFHQ, AFHQ, LSUN, DIV2K and the Kohler camera-shake benchmark, BAM outperforms in just 3 steps both specialised models and leading zero-shot methods in sample quality, at a fraction of their computational cost. BAM gives the community an accessible entry point to generative computational imaging, lowers the economic and environmental cost of training imaging models, and opens a new path for research on physics-aware Bayesian computational imaging. Official page: https://bayesian-anything-model.github.io/

</details>


### [142] [MemLife: Curating and Reasoning over Long-Term Egocentric Video Memories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40195)
*Guangzhi Xiong,Xinyuan Zhang,Xiao Yang,Hyokun Yun,Kai Zhang,Shiun-Zu Kuo,Hyeonjeong Ha,Xilun Chen,Kai Sun,Lucas Liang,Guangqiang Dong,Ejaz Ahmed,Ahmed A Aly,Anuj Kumar,Raffay Hamid,Aidong Zhang,Xin Luna Dong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出MemLife多模态记忆系统与MemOpt强化学习框架，用于长时程第一视角视频的个性化查询。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程第一视角视频历史可达数百小时、跨越数月甚至数年，对每次查询都重新处理原始视频片段在计算上不可行。现有记忆系统虽将视频压缩为文本表示以实现可扩展性，但存在两类问题：记忆未保留关键证据，或检索器在增长的搜索空间中因检索竞争而无法定位相关条目。

Method: MemLife构建实体锚定的第一视角文本情节（episode），并通过时间索引的智能体式阅读器（agentic reader）进行检索，无需训练也无需在查询时访问视频。此外，作者提出MemOpt——一个强化学习框架，用于优化记忆写入器（memory writer），使其生成忠实、信息丰富且可检索的记忆。

Result: MemLife在四个长时程基准上相较最强的免训练基线提升4.6%–12.0%。MemOpt在不同视频与问题分布上一致地将MemLife提升2.7%–5.0%，且增益可跨写入器与阅读器主干以及不同记忆系统泛化。

Conclusion: MemLife通过实体锚定文本情节与时间索引智能体检索，在免训练条件下有效解决长时程视频记忆的可扩展性与检索竞争问题；MemOpt进一步以强化学习提升记忆质量，且增益具备良好的跨组件与跨分布泛化性。

Abstract: Long-term egocentric video enables personalized AI assistants to reason about daily life. However, as video histories grow to hundreds of hours spanning months or years, reprocessing raw clips for every query becomes computationally prohibitive. Memory systems offer a scalable alternative by compacting videos into text representations, but often fail on practical benchmarks: either the memory does not preserve key evidence, or the retriever fails to locate relevant entries due to retrieval competition in growing search spaces. To address these challenges, we introduce MemLife, a multimodal memory system that constructs entity-grounded, first-person text episodes and retrieves them via a time-indexed agentic reader. Without training or query-time video access, MemLife improves over the strongest training-free baseline by 4.6--12.0% across four long-horizon benchmarks. To further improve memory quality, we propose MemOpt, a reinforcement learning framework that optimizes the memory writer to produce faithful, informative, and retrievable memories. MemOpt consistently improves MemLife by 2.7--5.0% across different video and question distributions, with gains that generalize across writer and reader backbones and memory systems.

</details>


### [143] [Typographic Attack Against VLM-based AI-generated Image Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39662)
*Eunmin Lee,Jungwoo Kim,Jong-Seok Lee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文系统评估了排版攻击（typographic attack）对视觉语言模型（VLM）AI生成图像检测能力的影响，发现推理模式比直接模式更脆弱，攻击效果存在方向不对称性，且模型越大准确率越高但受攻击成功率也越高。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM越来越多地用于AI生成图像检测并提供自然语言解释，但其对图像内文字的解读能力可能使判断暴露于误导性语义线索，需系统评估此类排版攻击风险。

Method: 在面向检测的、开放权重及商业VLM上系统评估排版攻击策略，涵盖"真到假"与"假到真"两个方向；测试推理模式与直接模式；并在图像与文本变换下考察攻击鲁棒性，以及叠加正确类别标签是否有助于纠错。

Result: 推理模式普遍比直接模式更易受攻击；攻击效果存在明显的方向不对称性；更大模型清洁检测准确率更高，但攻击成功率也更高；并通过变换实验与叠加纠错实验刻画鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 排版攻击显著影响VLM的真实性判断，揭示了当前基于VLM的AIGI检测系统的局限性。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used for AI-generated image (AIGI) detection, providing natural-language explanations for authenticity judgments. However, their ability to interpret text within images may also expose these judgments to misleading semantic cues. We systematically evaluate typographic attack strategies across detection-oriented, open-weight, and commercial VLMs, considering both real-to-fake and fake-to-real attacks. Our results show that reasoning modes generally exhibit greater vulnerability than direct modes and that attack effectiveness exhibits pronounced directional asymmetry. Moreover, larger models tend to exhibit higher clean detection accuracy but also higher attack success rates. We further examine attack robustness under image and text transformations and investigate whether overlays indicating the correct class can aid error correction. Together, these analyses characterize how typographic attacks influence authenticity judgments and expose limitations of current VLM-based AIGI detection systems.

</details>


### [144] [MatLoom: Layered Text-to-Material Generation in a Compact Program Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40322)
*Anson Y. Lam,Shuqing Li,Michael R. Lyu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MatLoom：面向文本到材质生成的紧凑分层语言，程序可解释、可编辑，在提示对齐指标与人类盲评中均优于扩散基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 材质生成不应只产出外观图像，还应产出构建该材质的规则；现有方法（如扩散模型）难以显式表达图案、颜色与浮雕之间的依赖，且生成结果缺乏可复用的构造信息。

Method: 提出 MatLoom——一种面向层、紧凑的文本到材质生成语言，配合预训练语言模型使用。程序组合带 alpha 遮罩的图层，共享空间表达式定义覆盖率与 PBR 通道。独立解释器将程序求值为材质贴图，源代码保留命名字段与层参数以便后续编辑。流程无需任务特定微调，采用解析器引导修复与基于预览的批判来迭代设计，并固定候选其余源码、搜索噪声种子。

Result: 在 141 条提示、6 个骨干模型的基准上，最佳配置在全部四项平面布局提示对齐指标上均高于三个扩散基线；初始程序在平均 BLIPScore 上已超过全部基线（无需批判或种子搜索）。跨骨干池化后保留程序中位长度 21 行。30 名参与者、20 条提示的盲测四方比较中，本方法渲染获得 59.2% 的选择，最优基线为 19.3%。

Conclusion: 紧凑的可执行程序能够在生成提示对齐材质的同时，将材质的构建过程作为资产的一部分保留下来。

Abstract: Material generation should produce not only an appearance, but also the rules that construct it. We introduce MatLoom, a compact, layer-oriented language for text-to-material generation with pretrained language models. Each program composes alpha-masked layers whose shared spatial expressions define coverage and physically based rendering (PBR) channels, making dependencies between patterns, color, and relief explicit. A standalone interpreter evaluates the program into material maps, while the source retains named fields and layer parameters for subsequent authoring. Without task-specific fine-tuning, our pipeline uses parser-guided repair and preview-based critique to revise material designs, then searches noise seeds while keeping each candidate's remaining source fixed. On a curated benchmark of 141 prompts evaluated with six backbones, our best-performing configuration achieves higher mean scores than three diffusion baselines on all four flat-layout prompt-alignment metrics. Its initial programs already exceed all three baselines on mean BLIPScore, before critique or seed search. Retained programs have a median length of 21 lines when pooled across backbones. In a blind four-way comparison involving 30 participants and 20 prompts, our renders receive 59.2% of choices, compared with 19.3% for the most-preferred baseline. Compact executable programs thus offer a way to generate prompt-aligned materials while retaining their construction as part of the asset.

</details>


### [145] [MC-PanDA++: Simpler, Stronger, and More Robust Domain-Adaptive Panoptic Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39681)
*Ivan Martinović,Josip Šarić,Yuki M. Asano,Siniša Šegvić*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MC-PanDA++，通过自监督视觉编码器、按类别自适应掩码级损失缩放和单阶段训练，改进掩码Transformer的全景分割无监督域适应，实现更简单、更强、更鲁棒的方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全景分割的无监督域适应（UDA）可借助低成本标注的源域（如合成数据）与无标注目标域来降低标注负担。现有全景UDA方法多基于逐像素分割架构的教师-学生一致性学习，而先进的掩码Transformer（mask transformer）因其对确认偏误的显著脆弱性（错误教师预测在训练中被强化）很少被采用。前期工作MC-PanDA通过细粒度置信度估计缓解该问题，但依赖复杂的多阶段训练和繁琐的超参数调优。

Method: 在MC-PanDA基础上提出MC-PanDA++，引入三项改进：(i) 自监督视觉编码器，提供更强更鲁棒的初始化，进一步减少对人工标注的依赖；(ii) 按类别、自适应、掩码级（mask-wide）的损失缩放，稳定训练并实现跨域单一超参数配置；(iii) 单阶段训练流程，降低整体概念复杂度。

Result: 改进后的方法在全景域适应任务上性能更好、更鲁棒，同时概念上更简洁；代码已开源于 https://github.com/martinovicivan/MC-PanDA。

Conclusion: MC-PanDA++通过自监督初始化、自适应损失缩放和单阶段训练，克服了原方法多阶段复杂性与超参调优的局限，为域适应全景分割提供了更简单、更优、更鲁棒的方案。

Abstract: Unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) reduces the annotation burden in panoptic segmentation by leveraging a cost-effectively labeled source domain (e.g., synthetic) and an unlabeled target domain to bridge the distribution gap. Existing panoptic UDA methods rely on teacher-student consistency learning built upon suboptimal per-pixel segmentation architectures. In contrast, state-of-the-art mask transformers are rarely adopted due to their pronounced vulnerability to confirmation bias in consistency learning, where erroneous teacher predictions are reinforced during training. Our earlier approach, MC-PanDA, mitigates this issue through fine-grained confidence estimation, which suppresses gradients from unreliable masks while sampling informative yet reliable locations for loss computation. However, this method entails a complex multi-stage training and requires careful hyperparameter tuning. This work presents MC-PanDA++, which addresses these limitations by introducing: (i) self-supervised vision encoders that provide a stronger and more robust initialization, further reducing the reliance on human annotations, (ii) per-class, self-adapting mask-wide loss scaling that stabilizes training and enables the usage of a single set of hyperparameters across domains, and (iii) a single-stage training pipeline that decreases overall conceptual complexity. Together, these improvements result in a conceptually simpler, better-performing, and more robust method for domain-adaptive panoptics. Source code: https://github.com/martinovicivan/MC-PanDA

</details>


### [146] [Unapologetically Distributed: A Call for Decentralized Document Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39684)
*Adrià Molina,Oriol Ramos Terrades,Josep Lladós*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出"Unapologetically Distributed"，首次在文档分析领域同时从任务、架构与微调策略三个维度系统评估分布式学习，证明去中心化不仅能保护隐私，还能提升对分布外数据的泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文档分析领域日益重视隐私问题，档案机构、政府机构与本地企业等环境因法律和政策约束而限制自动化应用。现有研究多将联邦学习视为"必要的妥协"，认为其以性能损失换取去中心化与隐私，却忽视了它在提升分布外数据鲁棒性方面的潜力。

Method: 开展首个综合性研究，在文档分析中沿三个关键轴同时评估分布式学习：所处理的任务、所采用的架构以及所应用的微调策略。工作覆盖表格识别、手写识别与词发现等多样任务，并重点分析迁移学习阶段的多种分布式训练方法。

Result: 实验显示，各种分布式训练方法在表格识别、手写识别和词发现等多样任务上均可增强泛化能力，尤其在迁移学习阶段效果显著。

Conclusion: 去中心化并非仅仅是约束，而是提升模型鲁棒性与适应性的重要机遇，对真实世界的文档分析场景具有实际价值。

Abstract: Privacy has become an increasingly important concern in the Document Analysis community, to the extent that in many environments such as archives, governmental institutions, and local businesses, the adoption of automation is restricted by legal and policy constraints. While federated learning has often been regarded as a ``necessary evil'', implying an unavoidable performance trade-off in exchange for decentralization and privacy, many prior works overlook its potential to improve robustness to out-of-distribution data. In this paper, we present Unapologetically Distributed, the first comprehensive study evaluating distributed learning in Document Analysis along three key axes simultaneously: the tasks addressed, the architectures employed, and the fine-tuning strategies applied. Specifically, we demonstrate how various distributed training approaches enhance generalization capabilities across diverse tasks such as Table Recognition, handwriting recognition, and Word Spotting, particularly during transfer learning stages. Our results provide strong evidence that decentralization is not merely a constraint, but a valuable opportunity to improve model robustness and adaptability in real-world Document Analysis scenarios.

</details>


### [147] [When Masking Helps or Hurts Robustness in Compressed CLIP: A Pre-Deployment Diagnostic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39704)
*Muhammad Zawish,Steven Davy*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文发现基于掩码的 token 剪枝对最差组鲁棒性的影响高度不稳定，根源是"虚假反转"现象；提出无需标签的部署前诊断指标 SIM，并设计高效的批处理 GPU 分割例程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文本与注意力引导的 token 剪枝方法普遍假设背景补丁的 CLIP 文本相似度低于真实目标，但该假设在存在虚假相关时可能失效，导致剪枝对最差组鲁棒性时好时坏，亟需在部署前预测其效果并降低掩码本身的开销与风险。

Method: 在 8 个虚假相关基准上系统研究语义掩码；提出 Spurious Inversion Metric (SIM)，一种无标签、部署前的诊断指标，用于预测虚假反转效应；并设计批处理、无同步的 GPU 分割例程以降低运行时开销；最终以 SIM 符号门控部署。

Result: 掩码效果极不稳定：部分数据集最差组准确率相对提升达 82.5%，另一些则下降达 100%。SIM 的符号在全部 8 个数据集上以统计显著性（二项 p=0.035）预测该效应，并在 6 种 CLIP 架构与干净前景/背景划分下保持可靠。GPU 分割将开销从 3.5× 降至 1.75× 基线；SIM 门控在 8 个数据集中的 7 个上匹配或超过强剪枝基线。

Conclusion: 掩码剪枝的收益可预测且可条件化：虚假反转是其不稳定性的机制根源，SIM 提供了可靠的预部署判据，配合高效分割例程可在规避最差失效的同时保留其收益。

Abstract: This paper demonstrate that whether masking-based token pruning helps or hurts worst-group robustness can be predicted before deployment, without labels or fine-tuning. A systematic study of semantic masking across 8 spurious-correlation benchmarks shows its effect on worst-group accuracy is highly unstable: it improves accuracy by up to 82.5\% relative on some datasets and degrades it by up to 100\% on others. We trace this instability to spurious inversion: background patches receive higher CLIP text-similarity than the true object when the spurious attribute is background-separable, inverting the assumption every text- and attention-guided pruning method relies on. We introduce the Spurious Inversion Metric (SIM), a label-free, pre-deployment diagnostic whose sign predicts this effect with statistical significance (binomial $p=0.035$) across all 8 datasets, and remains dependable across 6 CLIP architectures with a clean foreground/background split. Naive masking is itself a major source of risk: it causes the largest average-accuracy loss of any method we evaluate, and its own per-image segmentation step is a significant runtime bottleneck. To address this, we design a batched, synchronization-free GPU segmentation routine that cuts this overhead from 3.5$\times$ to 1.75$\times$ baseline. Gating deployment by SIM's sign recovers masking's benefits while avoiding its worst failures, matching or exceeding a strong pruning baseline on 7 of 8 datasets.

</details>


### [148] [BTC3D: Blended Tile Conditioning for Detail-Enhancing Image-to-3D Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39709)
*Junyu Li,Qiuyu Chen,Pengcheng Wang,Shiqi Yang,Alexandra Gomez-Villa,Joost van de Weijer,Ruilin Li,Kai Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练推理框架BTC3D，通过分块混合条件与动态条件调度缓解图像到3D生成中的细节衰减问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图像到3D扩散方法依赖全局编码条件特征，压缩了空间信息，导致难以复现细粒度细节，出现"细节衰减"现象；而提升质量通常需要重新训练或微调大模型，计算代价高、不适用于复杂3D流程。

Method: 1) 分析图像到3D模型中的图像特征可加性；2) 基于该性质提出混合分块嵌入（blended tile embedding），从切分的图像区域块中提取局部条件信号；3) 设计动态条件调度，在扩散后期低噪声阶段逐步增强分块级条件的权重，以稳定融合全局与局部引导；4) 整个方法仅在推理阶段运行，可无缝嵌入现有图像到3D扩散流程。

Result: 实验表明，该方法在免训练条件下显著提升基础模型的纹理质量与视觉保真度，同时保持全局结构一致性。

Conclusion: BTC3D以推理时免训练方式有效缓解细节衰减，兼顾细粒度细节保留与全局结构一致性，具备良好的即插即用性。

Abstract: Recent diffusion-based pipelines have achieved promising progress in image-to-3D synthesis. However, generating high-fidelity details remains challenging, especially when the input image contains rich details. Existing approaches often rely on globally encoded conditioning features, which compress spatial information and limit the model to reproduce fine-grained details. This common design often leads to a phenomenon we term detail attenuation. Moreover, improving image-to-3D synthesis quality typically requires retraining or fine-tuning large diffusion models, which can be computationally expensive and impractical for complex 3D pipelines. In this work, we present Blended Tile Conditioning for image-to-3D generation (BTC3D), a training-free inference time framework that enhances fine-grained detail preservation in image-to-3D diffusion pipelines. To alleviate detail attenuation, we first examine the image feature additivity in image-to-3D models. Based on this property, we introduce a blended tile embedding that extracts local conditioning signals from split image regional patches, allowing the diffusion model to better preserve fine-grained visual details. To integrate the global and local conditioning guidance stably, we propose a dynamic conditioning schedule that gradually increases the influence of tile-level conditioning during later low-noise stages of diffusion. Our proposed method BTC3D operates entirely at inference time and can be seamlessly integrated into existing image-to-3D diffusion pipelines. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed approach significantly improves texture quality and visual fidelity of the base model while maintaining global structural consistency in a training-free manner.

</details>


### [149] [Let the Carrier Carry the Attack: Preserving the Subject in Adversarial Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39723)
*Linfeng Jiang,Steven McDonagh,Yuhang Chen,Xingyu Zhao,Siddartha Khastgir,Andi Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出"载体(carrier)"概念：在图像中引入次要视觉元素作为辅助区域，在全局分类器引导下承担更多对抗扰动，从而在保持强攻击性和迁移性的同时减轻主体失真。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无限制对抗攻击虽强，但会扭曲图像的主体对象(subject)，破坏主体完整性。作者希望在不大幅削弱攻击强度的前提下，保护主体不受失真。

Method: 引入carrier——一个次要视觉元素，作为辅助空间区域承载对抗更新。在全局归一化的对抗更新中，让carrier吸收更大比例的扰动，从而减少主体承受的修改量，并在全局分类器引导下进行优化。

Result: 三点发现：1) carrier通过吸收更大份额的全局归一化攻击更新来缓解主体失真；2) carrier提升跨模型迁移性，其效果由目标相关特征强度决定，该特征在语义分离与迁移性能间取得平衡；3) 成功的定向攻击在误导分类器的同时，人类感知仍将个性化主体视为主要内容。

Conclusion: 视觉上次要的carrier为对抗性改变提供了辅助空间路径，能够实现强且可迁移的攻击，同时提升主体保持效果。

Abstract: Strong unrestricted adversarial attacks can distort the primary object of an image, hereafter referred to as the subject. To preserve subject integrity without compromising attack magnitude, we introduce the carrier: a secondary visual element that provides an auxiliary region to facilitate the attack under global classifier guidance. We demonstrate three key findings: 1. A carrier mitigates subject distortion by absorbing a larger share of globally normalized attack updates. 2. A carrier improves cross-model transferability, governed by the strength of target-related features that balance semantic separation and transfer performance. 3. Successful targeted attacks retain the personalized subject as the primary content perceived by humans while successfully misleading the classifier. Our results demonstrate that a visually secondary carrier offers an auxiliary spatial pathway for adversarial changes, enabling strong and transferable attacks while improving subject preservation.

</details>


### [150] [FAST: Flow Any Scene Transformer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39748)
*Yongjian Zhang,Longguang Wang,Zhuo Song,Zhiheng Fu,Liang Lin,Yulan Guo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FAST 是一种可扩展的对应匹配模型，通过零参数重连策略复用单视图视觉基础模型的注意力投影，实现跨视图匹配，并在多基准上取得 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言与视觉基础模型的发展主要依赖规模扩展，但规模化在精确对应匹配任务中的作用尚待探索。现有 ViT 匹配器通常需要专门的成对（pair-centric）预训练阶段，成本高且难以随单视图基础模型进步而同步扩展。

Method: 基于两个洞见：(1) 单视图视觉基础模型内部的 query-key 投影蕴含可复用的粗略跨视图匹配先验；(2) 以 cross-attention 形式复用这些预训练投影，可为基于单视图编码器的 ViT 匹配器提供高效初始化。据此构建 FAST：以普通单视图基础模型为骨干，采用零参数重连策略将选定的自注意力层转换为跨注意力层以实现跨视图交互，从而免去专用成对预训练。同时构建 600 万对训练语料，用于通用密集 2D 位移估计。

Result: 在广泛的基准测试中，FAST 达到 state-of-the-art 性能，并且在骨干规模与训练数据量两方面均表现出良好的扩展性。

Conclusion: 表明单视图基础模型的预训练先验可被高效复用于跨视图对应匹配，ViT 匹配器可随单视图基础模型的进步而扩展，无需专门的成对预训练阶段。

Abstract: Scaling has become a primary driver of progress in language and vision foundation models, yet its role in precise correspondence matching remains underexplored. In this work, we present Flow Any Scene Transformer (FAST), a scalable correspondence model driven by two key insights. First, we reveal that the query-key projections inside single-view vision foundation models encode a coarse yet reusable prior for cross-view matching. Second, reusing these pretrained projections in cross-attention form yields a highly effective initialization for a ViT-based matcher built from a single-view encoder. Guided by these insights, we build FAST upon a vanilla single-view foundation model, utilizing a zero-parameter rewiring strategy to convert selected self-attention layers into cross-attention for cross-view interaction. This design allows ViT-based matchers to scale with advances in single-view foundation models, bypassing the need for a dedicated pair-centric pretraining stage. To fully unlock the scaling potential of this formulation, we assemble a 6-million-pair training corpus for general-purpose dense 2D displacement estimation across diverse co-visible image pairs. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FAST achieves state-of-the-art performance across a wide range of benchmarks, while scaling favorably with both backbone size and training data.

</details>


### [151] [Determining Vertical Displacement of Agricultural Areas Using UAV-Photogrammetry and a Heteroscedastic Deep Learning Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39756)
*Wojciech Gruszczyński,Edyta Puniach,Paweł Ćwiąkała,Wojciech Matwij*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种基于U-Net异方差回归的算法，直接从UAV摄影测量点云推断垂直地表位移，在多数测试中略优于传统地面滤波方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统地面滤波依赖点云分类来获取地表高程，植被会干扰高程确定。为减少植被影响并直接量化高程改正的不确定性，需要一种替代传统地面滤波的方法。

Method: 采用U-Net架构进行异方差回归：模型预测高程改正的条件期望值以削弱植被对地表高程的影响，同时估计高程改正方差的对数，从而对每个高程改正值给出不确定性度量。

Result: 用三项指标评估：垂直位移的RMSE、确定位移值节点百分比、异常值百分比；采用TOPSIS方法在四个含至少两个时间间隔的数据集上与多种基于地面滤波的算法比较。多数情况下U-Net方法略有优势。例如某测试数据集：RMSE为6.1 cm，确定沉降节点占80.5%，异常值占0.2%；同案例次优算法SMRF的RMSE为7.7 cm，确定节点占77.3%，异常值占0.3%。

Conclusion: 基于U-Net的异方差回归为UAV点云垂直地表位移确定提供了优于传统地面滤波的替代方案，并能同时给出逐点不确定性，具有实际应用价值。

Abstract: This article introduces an algorithm that uses a U-Net architecture to determine vertical ground surface displacements from unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV)-photogrammetry point clouds, offering an alternative to traditional ground filtering methods. Unlike con-ventional ground filters that rely on point cloud classification, the proposed approach em-ploys heteroscedastic regression. The U-Net model predicts the conditional expected val-ues of the elevation corrections, aiming to reduce the impact of vegetation on determined ground surface elevations. Concurrently, it estimates the logarithm of the elevation cor-rection variance, allowing for direct quantification of the uncertainty associated with each elevation correction value. The algorithm was evaluated using three metrics: the root mean square error (RMSE) of vertical displacements, the percentage of nodes with deter-mined displacement values, and the percentage of outliers among those values. Perfor-mance was assessed using the technique for order of preference by similarity to ideal so-lution (TOPSIS) method and compared against several ground-filter-based algorithms across four datasets, each including at least two time intervals. In most cases, the U-Net-based approach demonstrated a slight performance advantage over traditional ground filtering techniques. For example, for the U-Net-based algorithm, for one of the test da-tasets, the RMSE of the determined subsidences was 6.1 cm, the percentage of nodes with determined subsidences was 80.5%, and the percentage of outliers was 0.2%. For the same case, the algorithm based on the next best model (SMRF) allowed an RMSE of 7.7 cm to be obtained; for 77.3% of nodes, the subsidences were determined; and the percentage of outliers was 0.3%.

</details>


### [152] [Seeing as Humans Do: Learning from Motion to Segment Anything Without Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39785)
*Weijian Jian,Xiaoyue Zhang,Bin Xiao,Chunyu Xie,Yixiao He,Yutao Liu,Dawei Leng,Yuhui Yin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MoSA是一个可扩展的无监督框架，通过从无标注视频中学习可迁移的物体性先验，实现类SAM的图像分割，零人工标注下性能接近全监督SAM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SAM依赖大量人工标注，构成模型扩展的根本瓶颈；现有无监督方法从运动中学物体概念，但常过拟合运动实体，缺乏多粒度理解与对静态物体的泛化能力。

Method: MoSA分三阶段：(1) 从大规模视频数据自动生成多粒度运动伪标签；(2) 通过对比学习训练感知分组模型(PGM)，内化泛化的、外观驱动的物体概念；(3) 将该先验迁移至提示引导架构，实现图像上的segment-anything式推理。

Result: 在七个挑战性基准（如COCO、ADE20K）上的广泛零样本评测显示，MoSA显著优于现有无监督方法；尽管零人工标注，其分割性能可与全监督SAM相媲美。

Conclusion: 利用大规模无标注运动是替代标注驱动segment-anything流程的可行且高度可扩展的方案。

Abstract: The Segment Anything Model (SAM) relies heavily on massive manual annotations, creating a fundamental bottleneck for model scaling. While unsupervised methods attempt to learn object concepts from motion, they typically overfit to moving entities, lacking both multi-granularity understanding and the ability to generalize to static objects. To overcome this, we introduce Motion-Grounded Segment Anything (MoSA), a highly scalable unsupervised framework that learns a transferable objectness prior from unlabeled videos. MoSA operates in three progressive stages: (1) automatically generating multi-granularity motion pseudo-labels from large-scale video data; (2) training a Perceptual Grouping Model (PGM) via contrastive learning to internalize a generalized, appearance-driven concept of objects; and (3) transferring this learned prior into a prompt-guided architecture for segment-anything-style inference on images. Extensive zero-shot evaluations across seven challenging benchmarks (e.g., COCO and ADE20K) demonstrate that MoSA significantly outperforms existing unsupervised methods. Notably, despite using zero manual annotations, MoSA achieves segmentation performance comparable to the fully supervised SAM. Our findings reveal that harnessing large-scale unlabeled motion is a feasible and highly scalable alternative to annotation-driven segment-anything pipelines.

</details>


### [153] [Inline Memory Meets Reusable Skills: Memory-centric Framework for Vision-Language-Action Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39794)
*Zaijing Li,Rui Shao,Bing Hu,Haoyu Zhang,Dongmei Jiang,Liqiang Nie*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Optimus-R，一种以记忆为中心的VLA框架，将机器人适配形式化为显式的查询-技能记忆调优，在域内、跨域及终身学习中实现数据高效技能学习并缓解灾难性遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA模型虽在通用机器人操作上有前景，但适配到新任务和域时效率低：依赖参数调优，成本高且易导致对已学任务的灾难性遗忘。

Method: 三大组件：(i) 内联记忆接口用于技能提取，将可学习记忆token插入VLA前缀流，使骨干在原生的动作条件路径中导出控制感知的查询与技能表示；(ii) 查询-技能记忆库用于技能学习，将技能外化为查询原型（决定检索什么）与技能值（指定如何行动），支持有限参数更新下的技能复用与扩展；(iii) 轻量级Bridge-and-Adapt机制用于技能更新，通过轻量适配器与残差记忆更新对齐目标域查询与技能。

Result: 在域内适配、跨域适配和终身学习实验上，Optimus-R实现了数据高效的技能学习，同时缓解了灾难性遗忘。

Conclusion: 以查询-技能记忆调优为核心的记忆中心VLA框架可有效替代昂贵参数调优，为机器人适配提供高效、抗遗忘的方案。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong promise for general-purpose robotic manipulation, yet adapting them to new tasks and domains remains inefficient: existing methods often rely on parameter tuning, incurring substantial costs and risking catastrophic forgetting of previously learned tasks. To address this, we propose \textbf{Optimus-R}, a memory-centric VLA framework that formulates robotic adaptation as explicit query-skill memory tuning. Optimus-R introduces: (i) An \textbf{Inline Memory Interface for skill extraction}. It inserts learnable memory tokens into the VLA prefix stream, allowing the backbone to derive control-aware query and skill representations within the native action-conditioning pathway. (ii) A \textbf{Query-Skill Memory Bank for skill learning}. It externalizes skills into query prototypes for deciding \emph{what} to retrieve and skill values for specifying \emph{how} to act, supporting skill reuse and expansion with limited parameter updates. (iii) A lightweight \textbf{Bridge-and-Adapt mechanism for skill updating}. It aligns target-domain queries and skills with the existing memory space through a lightweight adapter and residual memory updates. Experiments on in-domain adaptation, cross-domain adaptation, and lifelong learning show that Optimus-R enables data-efficient skill learning while mitigating catastrophic forgetting.

</details>


### [154] [P-SRM: Selective Recovery of Rejected Predictions in Visual Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39832)
*Youbin He,Siwei Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出P-SRM（后拒绝选择性恢复方法），通过空间响应、历史接受状态与原生决策边际重新评估被拒绝的候选，选择性地恢复可靠预测，在不改变原有接受输出与坐标的前提下提升跟踪性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉跟踪中的拒绝机制虽能抑制不可靠预测，但也会误拒定位正确的候选，导致有用信息被浪费。作者希望识别并恢复这些被误拒的候选，同时保留原生的接受输出与候选坐标。

Method: 提出P-SRM，融合三类信息——空间响应、历史接受状态、原生决策边际——对被拒绝候选进行重新评估与选择性恢复。

Result: 在六个跟踪器、四个数据集（涵盖类别特定、点和通用目标跟踪）共九种配置上，P-SRM均改善了被拒候选的排序质量与整体跟踪性能。

Conclusion: 后拒绝验证能够识别并恢复被原生拒绝机制丢弃的有用预测，证明复用被拒信息具有价值。项目代码：https://github.com/PalestyHR/P-SRM。

Abstract: Many visual tracking methods use rejection mechanisms to suppress unreliable predictions. However, these mechanisms can also reject correctly localized candidates, leaving useful information unused. We investigate how to identify and recover these candidates while preserving native accepted outputs and candidate coordinates. To this end, we propose P-SRM (Post-rejection Selective Recovery Method), which combines spatial responses, past accepted states, and native decision margins to reassess candidates and selectively restore reliable predictions. We evaluate P-SRM on six trackers and four datasets spanning category-specific, point, and generic object tracking. Across all nine configurations, P-SRM improves rejected-candidate ranking and overall tracking performance. These results show that post-rejection verification can identify and recover useful predictions discarded by native rejection, demonstrating the value of reusing rejected information. Project repository: https://github.com/PalestyHR/P-SRM.

</details>


### [155] [Spherical Interpolation for Backward-Compatible Multimodal Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39836)
*Simone Ricci,Niccolò Biondi,Federico Pernici*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究模型升级时新旧视觉-语言模型的表征空间不兼容问题，提出在正交对齐后的新旧查询表征之间的球面测地线上做插值（SLERP），以在不重建索引的情况下提升检索性能，并给出几何刻画与基于局部间隔的 Recall@K 认证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对比视觉-语言模型将图文映射到共享归一化嵌入空间，余弦相似度是跨模态检索的自然度量。但独立训练的模型表征空间不兼容，替换已部署模型通常需为整个图库重算嵌入，规模化代价高昂。正交后对齐虽可部分缓解，但因细粒度表征结构差异，仍存在残余角度偏差，故需探索更优的对齐后校正手段。

Method: 在旧模型查询与对齐后的新模型查询这两个归一化表征之间的球面测地线上进行插值（spherical interpolation，即 SLERP）；刻画何时该路径存在一个内部查询方向比两个端点更接近理想的检索最优方向，并通过局部间隔（margin-based）认证将这一刻画与 Recall@K 关联；在多个基准与模型族上验证。

Result: 实验表明，对齐后的球面插值相较单独的正交对齐有稳定提升，在多数评测设置中恢复了向后兼容性；与几何刻画一致，逐查询的 oracle 分析显示检索有利的内部点在实践中频繁出现。

Conclusion: 对齐后的球面插值是一种无需重建图库索引、即可改善模型升级向后兼容性的有效后处理方案，其有效性由球面几何刻画与间隔认证提供理论支持。

Abstract: Contrastive vision-language models map visual and textual representations into a shared normalized embedding space, making cosine similarity the natural metric for cross-modal retrieval. A practical challenge arises during model upgrades: independently trained models generally produce incompatible representation spaces, so replacing a deployed model typically requires recomputing embeddings for the entire gallery, which is prohibitively expensive at scale. Orthogonal post-hoc alignment can partially mitigate this problem by mapping new-model queries into the old-model gallery space. However, because independently trained models can differ in fine-grained representation structure, the orthogonal alignment remains approximate, leaving a residual angular discrepancy between the old-model query and the aligned new-model query. We study whether interpolation along the spherical geodesic between these two normalized query representations can improve retrieval without re-indexing the gallery. We characterize when this path contains an interior query direction closer to an idealized retrieval-optimal direction than either endpoint, and connect this characterization to Recall@$K$ through a local margin-based certification result. Experiments across multiple benchmarks and model families show that post-alignment spherical interpolation improves over orthogonal alignment alone, recovering backward-compatibility in most evaluated settings. Consistent with our geometric characterization, per-query oracle analysis shows that retrieval-favorable interior points occur frequently in practice. Code is available at https://github.com/miccunifi/SLERP_backward_compatibility .

</details>


### [156] [DyRAD: Radar Novel View Synthesis for Dynamic Driving Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39841)
*Merav Keidar,Tomer Borreda,Rajalakshmi Nandakumar,Or Litany*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DyRAD：用静态背景反射体+运动跟踪的动态点反射体渲染完整RAD张量，借助固定解析PSF分离传感器扩散与场景几何，实现动态行驶场景新视角合成与零样本雷达配置迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有雷达新视角合成未能利用多普勒直接测径向速度的能力：处理动态场景的方法仅重建距离-方位张量，而渲染多普勒的方法假设场景静态；同时雷达处理会把单次反射扩散到多个bin，现有表示将这种扩散错误地吸收进场景几何，导致视角移动时渲染错误。

Method: DyRAD将动态行驶场景建模为静态背景反射体与运动跟踪的动态点反射体，渲染完整的距离-方位-多普勒（RAD）张量；反射体速度由目标轨迹导出并投影到视线方向，使多普勒既是渲染输出也是轨迹监督信号；反射体通过源自雷达成像信号处理链的固定解析点扩散函数（PSF）渲染，避免传感器诱导扩散被固化为场景表示。

Result: 在RADIal、Boreas及合成基准上评估，覆盖原始路径位姿与先前工作未测试的偏移视角。在RADIal上，DyRAD在90.7%的参考检测目标中恢复出雷达检测，而最强基线仅为26.9%。

Conclusion: 分离PSF与场景几何不仅提升重建质量，还支持零样本传感器配置迁移——同一重建场景可在不同雷达规格下渲染而无需重新拟合。

Abstract: Reconstructing dynamic driving scenes from recorded sensor data supports closed-loop evaluation of autonomous driving systems by synthesizing observations beyond the original trajectory. Unlike cameras and LiDAR, radar measures radial velocity directly through Doppler. Yet existing radar novel-view synthesis fails to exploit this capability: methods addressing dynamic scenes reconstruct only range-azimuth tensors, while methods that render Doppler assume static scenes. Moreover, because radar processing spreads each reflection across multiple bins, existing representations absorb this spread into scene geometry, causing it to render incorrectly when the viewpoint moves. We present DyRAD, which models dynamic driving scenes using static background reflectors and motion-tracked dynamic point reflectors to render complete range-azimuth-Doppler (RAD) tensors. Reflector velocities are derived from object tracks and projected onto the line of sight, making Doppler both a rendered output and supervision for those tracks. Crucially, we render reflectors through a fixed analytic point-spread function (PSF) derived from the radar's signal-processing chain, preventing sensor-induced spread from being baked into the scene representation. Beyond improving scene reconstruction, this separation also enables zero-shot sensor-configuration transfer, allowing the same reconstructed scene to be rendered under different radar specifications without refitting. We evaluate DyRAD on RADIal, Boreas, and a synthetic benchmark across both on-path poses and displaced viewpoints untested by prior work. On RADIal, DyRAD recovers radar detections in 90.7% of reference-detected objects, compared with 26.9% for the strongest baseline.

</details>


### [157] [Hyperspectral Image Models: Technical Report](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39871)
*Tanishq Rachamalla,Aryan Das,Srishti Kaushik,Swalpa Kumar Roy*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文提出一个模块化高光谱图像模型框架，统一55个模型、6大范式与24个基准场景，并标准化评测流程；通过1320次模型-场景评估与6600次种子运行发现场景难度比架构更主导性能，无单一范式占优，小模型可媲美大模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高光谱遥感深度学习虽已涵盖谱-空CNN、ViT、Mamba、图神经网络、KAN及自监督掩码自编码等多范式，但仓库碎片化、张量约定不兼容、评测非标准化阻碍了进展。

Method: 构建统一注册表、自动4D/5D张量适配和标准化构造器的模块化框架，整合6范式55个代表模型；集成24个来自机载、星载、无人机和Mars CRISM传感器的基准场景，支持缓存、标签重映射、PCA、波段选择/原始光谱、空间最大池化和任意P×P块提取；采用类别均衡随机划分与带Chebyshev保护带的空间不交叠区域分块，消除训练-测试像素重叠；使用单一config.yaml、确定性种子和完整溯源，生成LaTeX基准表与分类图。

Result: 在1320次模型-场景评估和6600次种子运行中，场景难度主导架构表现：平均精度从Botswana的96.40%到Houston 2018的56.70%，而范式间均值差异约15个百分点；没有范式普遍占优，参数少于1M的模型可匹配大两个数量级的架构。

Conclusion: 标准化、可复现的高光谱图像模型框架有助于公平比较多范式方法；性能更多受场景难度影响而非架构范式，轻量模型具备强竞争力。代码已公开。

Abstract: Hyperspectral remote sensing has advanced across diverse deep learning paradigms, including spectral spatial CNNs, Vision Transformers, Mamba, graph neural networks, Kolmogorov Arnold networks, and self supervised masked autoencoding. Yet progress remains hindered by fragmented repositories, incompatible tensor conventions, and non standardized evaluation. Hyperspectral Image Models addresses these challenges through a modular framework unifying 55 representative models across six paradigms with a common registry, automatic 4D/5D tensor adaptation, and standardized constructors. It integrates 24 benchmark scenes from Airborne, Spaceborne, UAV, and Mars CRISM sensors, with caching, label remapping, PCA, explicit band selection or raw spectra, optional spatial max pooling, and arbitrary PxP patch extraction. To prevent inflated accuracy from overlapping windows, it supports class balanced random partitioning and spatially disjoint regional blocking with Chebyshev guard bands that eliminate train test pixel overlap. Experiments use a single config.yaml with deterministic seeds and complete provenance, generating LaTeX benchmark tables and classification maps. Across 1,320 model scene evaluations and 6,600 seeded runs, scene difficulty dominates architecture, with mean accuracy ranging from 96.40% on Botswana to 56.70% on Houston 2018, versus a 15 point spread across paradigm means. No paradigm universally dominates, while sub 1 M parameter models can match architectures two orders of magnitude larger. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/Tanishq251/Hyperspectral-Image-Models.

</details>


### [158] [Grounding with Confidence: Controllable Generative Video Temporal Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39883)
*Jinhao Chen,Benlei Cui,Ruijian Jia,Ziheng Wang,Tianyu Wo,Pengfei Sun,Longtao Huang,Hui Xue,Yitong Yang,Haiwen Hong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种为视频时序定位的生成式模型配备轻量级置信度头的方法，在原始解码过程中为每个候选区间输出显式置信分数，从而支持候选生成与接受的解耦，无需推理时调用外部验证器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成式视频时序定位模型通常只输出时间戳，缺乏区间级别的显式置信分数来指导候选选择，导致无法在推理时自主排序、筛选或拒绝候选。

Method: 将候选生成与接受分离，在原始解码过程中对单个区间打分；使用轻量级置信度头读取池化解码器状态；采用离线验证器分数在固定候选序列上监督该头，并利用时序重叠标签在强化学习过程中适配当前 rollout；通过锚定真值的候选池监督和集合级优化训练生成器。

Result: 在固定的 OMTG-Bench 候选池上，置信度使查询宏平均 Recall@0.5 在 10% 全局返回预算下从 9.95% 提升至 14.42%，在 25% 预算下从 26.48% 提升至 31.12%。

Conclusion: 连续置信分数支持排序、基于阈值的筛选和拒绝，使下游应用无需重新生成候选区间即可调整返回预算或接受阈值，以匹配其精确率—召回率偏好。

Abstract: Video temporal grounding supports applications such as video search, content review, and automated editing by localizing events described in natural language. Yet existing generative models typically output timestamps without explicit interval-level confidence scores to guide candidate selection. We separate candidate generation from acceptance by scoring individual intervals within the original decoding pass. A lightweight confidence head reads pooled decoder states, providing an explicit score trained for interval selection. Offline verifier scores supervise the head on fixed candidate sequences, and temporal-overlap labels adapt it to current rollouts during reinforcement learning. GT-anchored candidate-pool supervision and set-level optimization train the generator. The resulting scores support ranking, threshold-based selection, and rejection without invoking an external verifier at inference. On a fixed OMTG-Bench candidate pool, confidence raises query-macro Recall@0.5 from 9.95% to 14.42% over generation order at a 10% global return budget, and from 26.48% to 31.12% at a 25% budget. The continuous scores let downstream applications adjust return budgets or acceptance thresholds to match their precision-recall preferences, without regenerating candidate intervals.

</details>


### [159] [Spatial-Temporal Multi-scale Network for Screen Content Video Quality Enhancement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39894)
*Ziyin Huang,Sik-Ho Tsang,Xinyuan Qin,Yui-Lam Chan,Xueling Zhou,Feiyu Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出STM-Net，一个专为压缩屏幕内容视频增强设计的时空多尺度网络框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
