Motivation: 屏幕内容视频（SCV）具有突变运动、场景切换以及文字和图形等高频细节，与自然视频差异显著。传统视频增强方法高度依赖时间连续性，在处理SCV时因时间相关性被破坏而性能下降。

Method: STM-Net由三个互补组件构成：先验引导的时空分派器（PG-STD），将输入路由到三个并行流以避免特征污染；双向时间特征提取（BTFE）模块，无需显式检测即可自适应处理突变过渡；级联多尺度特征蒸馏（CMFD）模块，用于保留关键高频细节。

Result: 实验结果表明，STM-Net在客观指标和主观视觉质量上均优于现有最先进方法，为屏幕内容伪影提供了稳健的解决方案。代码已开源。

Conclusion: STM-Net针对压缩SCV的时间不连续与高频细节丢失问题，通过多流分派、双向时间建模和多尺度特征蒸馏实现了有效的增强效果。

Abstract: Different from natural videos, Screen Content Videos (SCVs) are characterized by abrupt motion, scene switches, and high-frequency details such as text and graphics. Conventional video enhancement methods, which rely heavily on temporal continuity, often suffer from performance degradation when processing SCVs due to the disruption of temporal correlations. To address these challenges, we propose the Spatial-Temporal Multi-scale Network (STM-Net), a novel framework specifically tailored for compressed SCV enhancement. Our approach integrates three complementary components: a Prior-Guided Spatio-Temporal Dispatcher (PG-STD) that routes input into three parallel streams to avoid feature contamination, a Bidirectional Temporal Feature Extraction (BTFE) module that adaptively handles abrupt transitions without explicit detection, and a Cascaded Multi-scale Feature Distillation (CMFD) module that preserves critical high-frequency details. Experimental results demonstrate that STM-Net outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both objective metrics and subjective visual quality, providing a robust solution for screen content artifacts. Code is available at https://github.com/HUANGZiyin1/STM-Net.

</details>


### [160] [Learning Where to Look: Anatomical Grounding and Guided Attention for Cardiac MRI Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39899)
*Bangwei Guo,Xiao Chen,Boris Mailhe,Jia Yao,Yiqing Wang,Ankush Mukherjee,Yikang Liu,Zheyuan Zhang,Hang Yu,Terrence Chen,Shanhui Sun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对CMR影像中的细粒度视觉问答，构建了大规模解剖定位与临床QA数据集，并提出心脏解剖路由注意力（CARA）机制，形成CARA-VL模型，在临床评估与区域定位上表现优异并具备跨队列泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CMR可评估心脏解剖、心室功能与心肌组织特征，临床医生需识别心脏结构并聚焦相关区域，因此需要解剖学引导的视觉语言模型（VLM）。但现有CMR专用的解剖定位与临床问答监督数据仍十分有限。

Method: 构建128,915条解剖定位与42,799条临床QA问答对，覆盖短轴电影、延迟钆增强和长轴电影序列，支持解剖识别、定位与临床评估且无需配对报告；提出心脏解剖路由注意力（CARA），根据问题选择预测的解剖先验，并以学习到的任务特定强度引导解码器注意力；结合解剖定位预训练与CARA得到CARA-VL模型。

Result: 实验表明CARA-VL在多种CMR成像设置下的临床评估与区域定位方面均具优势，并在外部临床队列中展现出良好的泛化能力。

Conclusion: 该数据与方法为研究和推进VLM的心脏视觉理解提供了实用框架，相关QA数据将在论文发表后基于公开数据集发布。

Abstract: Cardiac magnetic resonance imaging (CMR) enables assessment of cardiac anatomy, ventricular function, and myocardial tissue characteristics. Clinicians interpret these images by identifying cardiac structures and focusing on the regions relevant to each clinical question, motivating anatomically guided vision-language models (VLMs). Yet CMR-specific supervision for anatomical localisation and clinical question answering remains limited. To address this gap, we investigate fine-grained CMR visual question answering through anatomical grounding and guided attention. We construct 128,915 anatomical-grounding and 42,799 clinical QA pairs across short-axis cine, late gadolinium enhancement, and long-axis cine. These datasets support anatomical recognition, localisation, and clinical assessment without requiring paired reports for individual training images. To help the model learn where to look, we introduce Cardiac Anatomy-Routed Attention (CARA), which selects predicted anatomical priors according to the question and guides decoder attention with learned task-specific strengths. Combining anatomical grounding pretraining with CARA yields our model, CARA-VL. Experiments demonstrate CARA-VL's strengths in clinical assessment and regional localisation across CMR imaging settings, with promising generalization to an external clinical cohort. Together, our data and method provide a practical framework for studying and advancing cardiac visual understanding in VLMs. We will release the QA data derived from public datasets upon publication.

</details>


### [161] [NavHarness: Adaptive Goals for Agentic Vision-Language Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39915)
*Haoxiang Shi,Zaijing Li,Muhe Ding,Xiang Deng,Yaowei Wang,Liqiang Nie*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Agentic VLN 框架，用 Goal/Verify/Memory/Visuomotor 四个智能体实现自适应目标设定、动态验证与多模态历史压缩，在 R2R-CE、RxR-CE 及真实场景中提升长程导航一致性与效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用多模态智能体虽适合 VLN，但仅选择局部合理动作无法保证长程执行与既定路线一致；且交互历史累积导致后续决策输入膨胀、推理开销显著。

Method: 框架包含四个智能体：Goal Agent 依据指令、当前观测与执行历史设定自适应目标；Visuomotor Agent 执行导航动作以达成目标；Verify Agent 用目标专用验证问题动态判断观测结果是否满足完成条件；验证完成后 Memory Agent 以该边界压缩对应多模态交互历史并保留后续导航所需信息。

Result: 在 R2R-CE 与 RxR-CE 上评估，并在三种模型骨干上检验框架变体，研究执行过程中的上下文演化；真实世界八条挑战性路线各评测三次，达到 83.3% 成功率与 1.51 m 导航误差。

Conclusion: 通过目标设定、动态验证与历史压缩的智能体协同，可在保持长程导航一致性的同时降低推理开销，并在仿真与真实环境中均取得有效表现。

Abstract: Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) requires embodied agents to generate actions based on instructions and observations. General-purpose multimodal agents offer a promising basis for this task, but selecting plausible local actions does not ensure that execution remains consistent with the intended route, particularly in long-horizon tasks. Moreover, the accumulated interaction history increases the input required for subsequent decisions, resulting in a significant inference overhead. To this end, we introduce \method, an Agentic VLN framework that includes a Goal Agent that sets adaptive goals for local actions, a Verify Agent that dynamically verifies whether a goal has been completed, a Memory Agent for multimodal context compression, and a Visuomotor Agent to execute adaptive goals. Specifically, the Goal Agent formulates adaptive goals based on the instruction, current observation, and execution history. Then the Visuomotor Agent executes navigation actions to achieve each goal, while the Verify Agent uses a goal-specific verification question to dynamically assess whether the observed outcomes satisfy the intended completion condition. Verified goal completion then marks a boundary for the Memory Agent to compress the corresponding multimodal interaction history while preserving information needed for subsequent navigation. We evaluate navigation on R2R-CE and RxR-CE, examine framework variants across three model backbones, and study context evolution during execution. For Real-World evaluation, \method achieves 83.3\% success and 1.51\,m navigation error across eight challenging routes evaluated three times each.

</details>


### [162] [CoVisco: Codec-Native Vision Encoder with Native Token Compression for Unified Image-Video Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39924)
*Yulong Liu,Xiaotian Han,Junyuan Shang,Yuchen Ding,Zhenyu Zhang,Shuohuan Wang,Guibo Zhu,Sirui Han,Dianhai Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CoVisco 是一种编解码器原生的视觉编码器，通过原生 token 压缩实现统一的图像-视频理解，在长视频场景下大幅减少视觉 token 数量同时保持性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型存在根本性的扩展瓶颈：视觉 token 数量随时长和空间分辨率增长，使长视频理解对视觉编码器和语言模型都过于昂贵。现有方法通常在稠密编码后再压缩视觉 token，导致训练所用表示与部署所需紧凑接口之间产生不匹配。

Method: 提出 CoVisco，编解码器原生视觉编码器，具备原生 token 压缩。结合编解码器原生输入支持与分段注意力，可在单次前向传播中编码长视觉输入，无需在所有帧间形成稠密的 patch-to-patch 交互。每个时间片段配备可学习抽象 token，学习紧凑的片段级表示，同时细粒度 patch token 在整个编码器中保持可用。交替的片段内层与抽象通信层通过抽象 token 通道保留视频级上下文。轻量选择器可仅暴露抽象 token，或暴露抽象 token 加运行时选取的部分 patch token。预训练使用对比目标，覆盖 565M 图文对与 6.4M 视频。

Result: 在视频嵌入与多模态理解基准上表现具竞争力。在四段、64 帧设置下，仅抽象 token 推理仅用 400 个视觉 token，即可达到接近 OneVision-Encoder 的视频理解性能，部分基准上甚至超越。选取的 patch token 进一步提升细粒度视频推理能力。

Conclusion: CoVisco 通过编解码器原生 token 压缩，为下游 MLLM 提供紧凑视觉接口，减少视觉上下文与预填充负担，同时在需要时保留细粒度证据，实现高效的统一图像-视频理解。

Abstract: Vision-language models face a fundamental scaling bottleneck: the number of visual tokens grows with both temporal duration and spatial resolution, making long-video understanding expensive for the vision encoder and the language model. Existing methods often compress visual tokens after dense encoding, creating a mismatch between the representation used during training and the compact interface required at deployment. We present CoVisco, a codec-native vision encoder with native token compression for unified image-video understanding. By combining codec-native input support with segmented attention, CoVisco can encode long visual inputs in a single forward pass without forming dense patch-to-patch interactions across all frames. Each temporal segment is equipped with learnable abstract tokens that learn a compact segment-level representation, while fine-grained patch tokens remain available throughout the encoder. Alternating intra-segment and abstract-communication layers preserve video-level context through the abstract-token channel. A lightweight selector further exposes either abstract tokens alone or abstract tokens augmented with a runtime-selected subset of patch tokens, yielding a compact visual interface that reduces the visual context and prefill burden of downstream MLLMs while retaining fine-grained evidence when needed. Pretrained with contrastive objectives on 565M image--text pairs and 6.4M videos, CoVisco shows competitive performance on video-oriented embedding and multimodal understanding benchmarks. In the evaluated four-segment, 64-frame setting, abstract-only inference uses only 400 visual tokens while achieving video-understanding performance close to, and on some benchmarks exceeding, OneVision-Encoder. Selected patch tokens further improve fine-grained video reasoning. Project URL: https://github.com/ernie-research/CoVisco.git

</details>


### [163] [Super-Resolving Unseen Hyperspectral Sensors at Any Scale via Spatial Operators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39926)
*Ji-Xuan He,Guohang Zhuang,Bo Junge,Tingyi Li,Lingchen,Miaomiao Cai,Yanan Qiao,Xiujin Liu,Junfeng Fang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 OmniHSR，通过预测波段共享的空间算子而非光谱值，实现单模型跨传感器泛化与任意尺度高光谱超分辨。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高光谱超分辨中，单模型同时实现跨传感器泛化与任意尺度重建仍具挑战；现有任意尺度方法迁移到新传感器或超出训练范围的尺度时，往往需要额外数据与计算来维持重建质量。

Method: 核心是预测波段共享的空间算子而非光谱值。包含两个模块：跨光谱映射（CSM）将任意波段数的输入重采样到固定参考位置，并预测具有高斯支撑的局部算子；连续算子场重建（COFR）将这些算子组合成连续场，并作用于所有原始波段以完成任意尺度重建。

Result: 在全部七个数据集上，算子预测均优于直接光谱值预测。仅用 ARAD 训练、参数仅 0.538M 时，无需目标域训练数据或自适应，便在六个未见数据集上超越所有直接迁移基线。在 ×2 至 ×48 共十二个上采样倍率下，于 Pavia U 和 Chikusei 上平均 PSNR 较最强基线提升 0.55 dB，并超过在目标传感器上从头训练或自适应的基线，推理速度最高快 36×。

Conclusion: 算子预测范式在跨传感器泛化与任意尺度重建上优于光谱值预测，OmniHSR 以极少参数实现优异泛化与高效推理，代码将公开。

Abstract: Achieving cross-sensor generalization and arbitrary-scale reconstruction with a single model remains challenging in hyperspectral super-resolution (HSR). Although recent methods support arbitrary-scale reconstruction, applying them to new sensors or scales beyond the training range often requires additional data and computation to maintain reconstruction quality. To address these challenges, we propose OmniHSR, which predicts band-shared spatial operators rather than spectral values. Cross-Spectral Mapping (CSM) resamples inputs with any number of bands to fixed reference positions and predicts local operators with Gaussian supports. Continuous Operator-Field Reconstruction (COFR) composes these operators into a continuous field and applies them to all original bands for arbitrary-scale reconstruction. Experiments demonstrate that operator prediction outperforms direct spectral-value prediction on all seven datasets. Trained solely on ARAD with only 0.538M parameters, OmniHSR outperforms all directly transferred baselines on six unseen datasets without target-domain training data or adaptation. Across twelve upsampling factors from $\times2$ to $\times48$, it improves average PSNR on Pavia U and Chikusei by 0.55 dB over the strongest baseline. It also surpasses baselines trained from scratch or adapted on the target sensor and achieves up to $36\times$ faster inference. Our code will be publicly released soon.

</details>


### [164] [Learning to Reason with Compressed Context: Ground-Truth-Free Adaptation of OmniLLMs via Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39953)
*Jianghao Wang,Ke Meng,Jian Li,Chi Cheng,Longyu Qi,Liyin Liang,Yifeng Qian,Chunbo Lai,Yutian Lin,Zeyu Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CAFD，一种无需真值答案的自蒸馏框架，通过全上下文教师对压缩上下文学生进行软目标监督，提升OmniLLM在token压缩下的准确率-效率权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OmniLLM的长多模态token序列导致部署计算开销大，token压缩可降低成本但激进压缩会降低准确率。现有工作主要聚焦于设计更好的压缩机制，而如何让底层语言模型适应并在压缩后的上下文上有效推理仍未被充分探索。

Method: CAFD（Compressed-Context Adaptation via Full-Context Distillation）是一种无需真值的自蒸馏框架，无需参考答、推理依据或正确性奖励即可让OmniLLM适应固定压缩管线。其核心思想是利用同一多模态样本的全token视图作为特权信息：全上下文自教师沿学生的on-policy轨迹，向压缩上下文学生提供软目标监督。

Result: 在Qwen2.5-Omni-7B上跨五个音视频基准、五种压缩管线和五种部署预算进行评测，CAFD在125种条件中的120种取得一致增益，平均准确率提升1.44个点，平均恢复26.9%的准确率差距。

Conclusion: 所提出的无需真值适配方法为改善已部署OmniLLM的准确率-效率权衡提供了一条有效且实用的途径。

Abstract: Omni-modal large language models (OmniLLMs) enable unified audio-video understanding, but their long multimodal token sequences make deployment computationally expensive. Token compression reduces this cost, yet aggressive compression often lowers accuracy. Existing works predominantly focus on designing better compression mechanisms; however, adapting the underlying language model to reason effectively over the remaining compressed context remains under-explored. To address this, we propose CAFD (Compressed-Context Adaptation via Full-Context Distillation), a ground-truth-free self-distillation framework that adapts OmniLLMs to fixed compression pipelines without requiring reference answers, rationales, or correctness rewards. CAFD leverages the full-token view of the same multimodal sample as a source of privileged information: a full-context self-teacher provides soft target supervision to a compressed-context student along the student's on-policy trajectory. Evaluated on Qwen2.5-Omni-7B across five audio-video benchmarks, five compression pipelines, and five deployment budgets, CAFD demonstrates consistent gains, improving 120 out of 125 conditions with an average accuracy boost of 1.44 points and recovering 26.9% of the accuracy gap on average. These results demonstrate that the proposed ground-truth-free adaptation offers an effective and practical route to improving the accuracy-efficiency trade-off in deployed OmniLLMs.

</details>


### [165] [Reconstructing the Dynamic World: A Representation-Centric View of 4D Scene Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39960)
*Ziren Gong,Guo Chen,Yongjia Li,Yihua Shao,Fabio Tosi,Stefano Mattoccia,Matteo Poggi,Hao Tang,Fei Ma,Shuyan Li,Ziyang Yan,Nicu Sebe,Ling Shao,Jianfei Cai,Qi Tian,Ming-Hsuan Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文对4D场景重建进行统一综述，围绕场景表示、时序建模、重建流程与优化目标组织现有方法，并梳理数据集、评价指标及开放挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 4D场景重建需从视觉观测恢复动态环境的几何、外观与运动，但受非刚性运动、遮挡、时序不一致及保真度与计算效率权衡等影响，难度较大。NeRF与3DGS虽带来多种动态场景表示与重建方法，但其相互关系、设计选择与评测协议仍较为分散，缺乏统一视角。

Method: 本文提出面向4D场景重建的统一分析框架，按场景表示、时序建模策略、重建流程和优化目标对现有方法进行归类；基于该框架分析不同设计选择对几何保真度、外观一致性、运动表示与计算效率的影响；同时整合常用数据集与评价指标，并审视当前实验实践的局限。

Result: 通过统一框架，论文系统比较了不同设计选择在几何、外观、运动与效率方面的表现，汇总了常用数据集和评价指标，指出当前实验实践中存在的局限，并讨论了复杂动态真实环境重建中的开放挑战。

Conclusion: 该工作将方法发展与底层假设及评测证据相联系，为理解现有4D场景重建方法并识别未来研究方向提供了结构化基础，同时维护了持续更新的论文与资源集合。

Abstract: 4D scene reconstruction aims to recover the evolving geometry, appearance, and motion of dynamic environments from visual observations. Despite substantial progress in neural scene representations, reconstructing dynamic scenes remains challenging due to non-rigid motion, occlusions, temporal inconsistencies, and the trade-offs between reconstruction fidelity and computational efficiency. Recent advances in Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) have introduced diverse approaches to representing and reconstructing dynamic scenes, yet their relationships, underlying design choices, and evaluation protocols remain fragmented. In this paper, we present a unified perspective on 4D scene reconstruction, organizing existing methods around their scene representations, temporal modeling strategies, reconstruction pipelines, and optimization objectives. Through this framework, we examine how different design choices affect geometric fidelity, appearance consistency, motion representation, and computational efficiency. We further consolidate commonly used datasets and evaluation metrics, identify limitations in current experimental practices, and discuss open challenges in reconstructing complex, dynamic real-world environments. By connecting methodological developments with their underlying assumptions and evaluation evidence, this work provides a structured foundation for understanding existing approaches and identifying future research directions. An evolving collection of relevant papers and resources is available at https://github.com/ZiyangYan/Awesome-4D-Scene-Reconstruction.

</details>


### [166] [Can We Anticipate Violence? Multimodal Learning from Pre-Incident Behavioral Cues](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40014)
*Sindhuja Penchala,Mohammed Yusuf Mujawar,Noorbakhsh Amiri Golilarz,Sudip Mittal,Shahram Rahimi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该工作研究事件发生前短时风险识别，基于XD-Violence构建二分类Normal-vs-Risky数据集，融合面部外观、音频与骨骼运动多模态特征，DeiT-Tiny最佳配置在测试集达91.21%准确率与96.38% ROC-AUC。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 事件发生后的检测不如事前预警有价值；作者希望从事件发生前的即时行为线索（面部、声音、动作）中识别风险升高状态，实现短时域的事前风险预警，而非事后检测。

Method: 从带时间标注的XD-Violence片段构建Normal与Risky二分类任务，使用443个样本并按来源划分训练/验证/测试集；每个样本为变长的事件前片段，时长由可观测行为语境决定，且排除事件本身。评估三类信息源：面部区域外观、时间对齐音频、由跟踪关键点导出的身体运动特征。在相同划分下用Swin-Tiny、ViT-Tiny、DeiT-Tiny做受控消融，比较各模态贡献。

Result: 融合所有模态优于任一其他组合。最佳配置为DeiT-Tiny结合音频、面部外观与运动，在留出测试集上取得91.21%准确率、88.96%平衡准确率、93.65% F1、96.38% ROC-AUC。

Conclusion: 互补的外观、声学与运动学线索能为识别事件前风险升高提供有效证据，表明短时域事前风险识别在多模态融合下是可行的。

Abstract: Detecting violence after it begins is important from recognizing behavioral cues that appear immediately beforehand. This work studies short-horizon pre-incident risk recognition from multimodal video signals. We construct a binary Normal-versus-Risky setting from temporally annotated XD-Violence clips, using 443 samples with source-level separation across training, validation, and test sets. Each sample consists of a variable-length pre-incident clip, with its duration determined by the observable behavioral context preceding the incident. The inci- dent itself is excluded from all input clips. We evaluate three complementary information sources: facial-region appearance, temporally aligned audio, and body-motion features derived from tracked keypoints. Controlled ablations are performed with Swin-Tiny, ViT-Tiny, and DeiT-Tiny to measure the contribution of each modality under the same split. Results show that combining all modalities is more effective than using any other combination alone. The best configuration, Deit-Tiny with audio, facial appearance, and motion, achieves 91.21% accuracy, 88.96% balanced accuracy, 93.65% F1-score, and 96.38% ROC-AUC on the held-out test set. These results suggest that complementary appearance, acoustic, and kinematic cues provide useful evidence for recognizing elevated pre-incident risk.

</details>


### [167] [WARP: A Unified Benchmark for Invisible Image Watermarking -- Robustness and Protection Against Attacks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40031)
*Khaled Abud,Aleksey Yakushev,Aleksandr Akimenkov,Irina Serzhenko,Kirill Aistov,Egor Kovalev,Dmitry Obydenkov,Sergey Lavrushkin,Anastasia Antsiferova,Dmitriy Vatolin,Yury Markin,Kirill Lukianov*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 WARP，一个用于评估不可见水印鲁棒性的统一基准框架，集成32种水印方法与34种擦除攻击技术，并给出标准化、可扩展的评测协议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着法规与行业实践要求对AI生成内容进行标记并保证来源可追溯，数字图像水印愈发关键；而现有评测基准未能反映最新的水印技术与评估标准，亟需更新。

Method: WARP 涵盖32种近期经典、深度与生成式水印方法，以及34种擦除技术（从传统失真到对抗、净化与重嵌入攻击），提供标准化、可复现且易扩展的协议，用于评估感知质量、水印可读性与抗攻击能力。

Result: 基于 WARP 对现有不可见水印技术进行了大规模评估，构建了该领域规模最大的鲁棒性基准；识别出在失真与对抗条件下最鲁棒的方法，并揭示水印方法与最有效攻击策略之间的一致关系。

Conclusion: 部分水印方法即使对标准失真鲁棒，也对重嵌入攻击高度脆弱；代码已开源。

Abstract: Digital image watermarking is increasingly critical in media contexts, as emerging regulations and industry practices require marking AI-generated content and ensuring traceable sources to prevent manipulation or misuse. Recent advances in invisible watermarking methods highlight the need to update existing benchmarking practices to reflect current techniques and evaluation criteria.
  We address this by introducing WARP -- a unified framework and benchmark for evaluating the robustness of invisible watermarks. WARP incorporates 32 recent classical, deep, and generative watermarking methods, as well as 34 different erasing techniques, ranging from traditional distortions to more sophisticated adversarial, purification, and re-embedding attacks. It provides standardized, reproducible, and easily scalable protocols for evaluating perceptual quality, watermark readability, and attack resilience.
  Using WARP, we extensively evaluate current invisible watermarking techniques, collecting the largest robustness benchmark in the field. Results identify the most robust approaches under both distortion and adversarial conditions, and reveal consistent relationships between watermarking methods and the attack strategies most effective against them. Our experiments also highlight that some of the watermarking methods considered are highly vulnerable to reembedding, even if they are robust to standard distortions. The code is made available at https://github.com/ispras/wibe.

</details>


### [168] [Enhancing Autoregressive Video Generation via Representation Adversarial Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40037)
*Fangyu Lin,Xingtong Ge,Lunjie Zhu,Yi Zhang,Zhening Liu,Tianhang Wang,Mengfei Li,Yumeng Zhang,Guanglu Song,Yu Liu,Jun Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Radian：表征空间对抗蒸馏框架，用冻结视觉基础模型的表征空间对抗监督补充 DMD，实现少步自回归视频生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 少步自回归视频生成中，早期时间块的误差会作为上下文被复用并随 rollout 传播，导致细节退化、结构漂移和运动不稳定。现有 DMD 仅在扩散潜空间对齐师生分布，缺乏对解码视频感知质量的直接监督，且扩散内部特征提供的对抗信号不足。

Method: Radian 在冻结视觉基础模型（VFM）定义的特征空间中引入真实数据对抗监督，补充 on-policy DMD。训练时稀疏解码自回归学生 rollout 的帧，提取多层视觉表征，用轻量判别器头区分生成输出与真实视频帧。DMD 目标将学生锚定到预训练教师，表征空间对抗目标提供互补的感知与语义梯度以促进高质量模式。这些附加组件训练后丢弃，生成器架构与推理去噪预算不变。

Result: 在 Wan2.1-1.3B 上覆盖四步 chunk-wise、一步 frame-wise 及分钟级自回归生成。四步生成下 VBench Total 达 0.8444、VideoAlign Total 达 0.8033；相较 Rolling Forcing 将 VBench-Long 从 0.7805 提升至 0.8041，且去噪步数更少。图像、视频与扩散表征的受控对比表明，表征空间选择会产生不同的对抗信号，外部 VFM 梯度比扩散内部特征衍生的对抗监督更有效地补充 DMD。

Conclusion: 在表征空间引入外部 VFM 对抗监督可有效补充 DMD，缓解少步自回归视频生成的误差传播与质量退化，且不改变推理架构与去噪预算，具有即插即用的训练期增强特性。

Abstract: Few-step autoregressive video generation enables efficient streaming synthesis, but errors introduced in early temporal blocks are reused as context and can propagate through subsequent rollouts, leading to detail degradation, structural drift, and unstable motion. Existing distribution matching distillation (DMD) primarily aligns student and teacher distributions in diffusion latent space, but provides no direct supervision over the perceptual quality of decoded videos. We introduce Radian, a representation-space adversarial distillation framework that complements on-policy DMD with real-data adversarial supervision in the feature space defined by a frozen visual foundation model (VFM). During training, Radian sparsely decodes frames from autoregressive student rollouts, extracts multi-level visual representations, and applies lightweight discriminator heads to distinguish generated outputs from real video frames. The DMD objective anchors the student to the pretrained teacher, while the representation-space adversarial objective supplies complementary perceptual and semantic gradients that promote high-quality modes. These additional components are discarded after training, leaving the generator architecture and inference-time denoising budget unchanged. Experiments on Wan2.1-1.3B cover four-step chunk-wise, one-step frame-wise, and minute-long autoregressive generation. Our method achieves a VBench Total of 0.8444 and a VideoAlign Total of 0.8033 under four-step generation, and improves VBench-Long from 0.7805 to 0.8041 over Rolling Forcing while using fewer denoising steps. Controlled comparisons across image, video, and diffusion representations further indicate that the choice of representation spaces induces distinct adversarial signals, and external VFM gradients complement DMD more effectively than adversarial supervision derived from diffusion-internal features.

</details>


### [169] [CoEvoWhen: Policy-Tool Coevolution for Ultra-Long Video Temporal Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40048)
*Yiduo Jia,Muzhi Zhu,Jinchuan Shi,Hao Zhong,Yuling Xi,Ke Liu,Hao Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出策略-工具协同进化框架，通过VLM推理轨迹联合进化高层策略与媒体工具，无需更新模型参数即可实现超长视频时序定位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超长视频时序定位需在有限视觉预算下兼顾长程证据搜索与细粒度事件理解，但现有智能体方法仍主要依赖预定义的策略与工具能力。

Method: 训练外部的技能更新器，从VLM的推理轨迹中蒸馏可迁移的长视频时序定位经验，据此优化长程图像观测与细粒度视频观测的编排策略；同时利用其编码能力升级现有工具或创建新工具以适配长视频证据获取。进化后的VLM依策略自主编排工具进行智能体推理，无需依赖额外的更强规划模型。

Result: 在五个基准、三种VLM上的实验表明，策略-工具协同进化持续提升超长视频时序定位精度，同时降低推理时的视觉token开销；进化后的技能在无需额外任务特定进化的条件下，在通用长视频问答上也取得显著性能提升。

Conclusion: 策略-工具协同进化框架对长视频理解具有有效性与泛化性。

Abstract: Ultra-long video temporal grounding requires balancing long-range evidence search with fine-grained event understanding under a limited visual budget, yet existing agentic methods still rely largely on predefined policies and tool capabilities. Motivated by this, we propose a novel policy-tool coevolution framework that jointly evolves high-level policies and executable media tools from the agentic reasoning trajectories of a VLM, forming a reusable skill without updating model parameters. During evolution, an external skill updater distills transferable task experience in long-video temporal grounding, accordingly refining the orchestration of long-range image-based and fine-grained video-based observations. Alongside these policy updates, the updater employs its coding capabilities to upgrade existing tools or create new ones, adapting the tools to long-video evidence acquisition. Equipped with the evolved skill, the VLM autonomously orchestrates tools under the guidance of the evolved policy, coordinating image and video observations for agentic inference without relying on a separate, stronger planning model. Extensive experiments spanning five benchmarks and three VLMs show that policy-tool coevolution consistently improves temporal grounding accuracy in ultra-long videos while reducing visual token cost at inference, and that the evolved skill yields substantial performance gains on general long-video QA without additional task-specific evolution, demonstrating the effectiveness and generalizability of our framework for long-video understanding.

</details>


### [170] [Less Data, Better Timing: Student-Curriculum Coupling for VLM On-Policy Distillation in Temporal Video Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40055)
*Jiacheng Qiu,Yunsoo Kim,Ruichen Xu,Jian Luo,Petar M. Djurić,Sima Mofakham*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 Student-Curriculum Coupling (SCC) 闭环框架，解决 on-policy distillation 中固定课程假设失效的问题，通过让动态学生决定监督子集，实现数据与计算高效的时序视频定位后训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 on-policy distillation (OPD) 管线通常基于固定教师和初始学生状态构建训练课程，隐含假设所选样本在整个优化过程中始终具有正向监督价值。作者指出监督可信度（目标可信性）与监督必要性（随学生当前任务能力变化）是两个不同但耦合的概念，二者共同决定监督价值，而现有方法未能建模这种随能力演化的动态性。

Method: 提出 Student-Curriculum Coupling (SCC)：一个闭环框架，其中紧凑的 Anchor-Frontier 课程定义候选监督空间，而不断演化的学生动态决定其激活子集。监督可随能力变化被激活、暂停或重新激活，从而将教师计算与优化集中在当前任务级的能力缺陷上。

Result: 在三个 TVG 基准上，SCC 相较 Video-OPD 在其原始课程上平均召回率相对提升 5.1%，同时训练样本减少 60.0%、训练时间缩短 50.4%。消融实验证实能力结构化课程设计与学生依赖监督的互补作用。

Conclusion: SCC 是一个数据与计算高效的 TVG 后训练框架，通过将可信监督与学生的演化学习需求对齐，实现更强的时序定位性能。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) provides dense supervision directly on student-generated trajectories, making it an effective post-training strategy for vision-language models in temporal video grounding (TVG). However, existing pipelines typically construct the training curriculum from a fixed teacher and the initial student state, implicitly assuming that selected examples retain positive supervision value throughout optimization. We show that supervision trustworthiness and supervision necessity are distinct yet coupled: the former concerns target credibility, while the latter varies with the student's current task competence; together, they shape supervision value. Building on this coupled view, we introduce Student-Curriculum Coupling (SCC), a closed-loop framework in which a compact Anchor-Frontier curriculum defines the candidate supervision space and the evolving student dynamically determines its active subset. Supervision can therefore be activated, suspended, or reactivated as competence changes, concentrating teacher computation and optimization on current task-level deficits. Across three TVG benchmarks, SCC achieves a 5.1% relative improvement in mean recall over Video-OPD on its original curriculum, while using 60.0% fewer training examples and reducing training time by 50.4%. Ablations support the complementary roles of capability-structured curriculum design and student-dependent supervision in achieving these gains. Together, these results establish SCC as a data- and compute-efficient framework for TVG post-training, delivering stronger temporal grounding by aligning trustworthy supervision with the student's evolving learning needs.

</details>


### [171] [LongEmo: Towards Emotion Understanding and Reasoning in Long Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40079)
*Shuo Zhang,Yifan Zhou,Han Wang,Jinsong Zhang,Jingyu Li,Hongbing Li,Zhejun Zhang,Chengyi Zhao,Yuquan Hao,Yitong Liu,Jiyin Li,Ruiqi Tang,Zixuan Lin,Yi Luo,Xurui Zhang,Ronghao Chen,Huacan Wang,Lei Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出长视频情感理解与推理基准LongEmoBench及记忆增强智能体框架LongEmo，通过事件记忆图建模长程依赖，实现最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态大语言模型在情感计算中的推理能力局限于短视频片段和有限交互，而真实世界情感是由过往经历与持续事件塑造的动态累积过程，二者存在显著差距。

Method: 提出LongEmoBench基准，评估从连续场景交互到复杂情节发展的渐进式能力；并设计LongEmo记忆增强智能体框架，处理连续视频流构建事件记忆图，显式建模长程依赖并捕捉离散事件间的情感动态，进而检索与查询相关的事件流，迭代整合多模态记忆与关系依赖以推导答案。

Result: 对17种代表性方法的广泛评估表明，它们在长视频情感理解与推理上表现欠佳；LongEmo则取得最优性能。

Conclusion: 事件中心式记忆架构对长程情感推理具有有效性，LongEmo验证了该设计在长视频情感理解任务中的优越性。

Abstract: While recent Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown promise in affective computing, their reasoning capabilities are largely confined to short video clips with limited interactions. However, real-world emotions are not merely isolated instantaneous reactions but dynamic and cumulative processes deeply shaped by past experiences and ongoing events. To bridge this gap, we introduce LongEmoBench, a benchmark dedicated to emotion understanding and reasoning in long videos. It assesses progressive capabilities scaling from continuous scene interactions to complex episodic developments. Furthermore, we propose LongEmo, a novel memory-augmented agentic framework designed to tackle the immense challenges of long-range affective reasoning. LongEmo processes continuous video streams to construct an Event Memory Graph, explicitly modeling long-range dependencies and capturing emotional dynamics across discrete events. Given a question, the agent retrieves a query-relevant event stream from the graph, iteratively integrating multimodal memories and relational dependencies to deduce the final answer. Extensive evaluations of 17 representative methods reveal that they struggle significantly with emotion understanding and reasoning in long videos. In contrast, LongEmo achieves state-of-the-art performance, demonstrating the efficacy of its event-centric memory architecture.

</details>


### [172] [GateSPINE: Gated Cross-View Fusion for Lumbar Spine MRI Report Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40091)
*Hoang Nguyen Van,Cuong Vuong Tuan,Trang Mai Xuan,Bien Tran Van,Nam Tran Van,Thien Van Luong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出GateSPINE，一种视觉-语言框架，通过免训练算子融合矢状位T1/T2，并用并行3D编码器处理矢状位与轴位，借助门控跨视图融合解码放射报告，在三套腰椎MRI数据集上取得最高临床效能F1。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多序列MRI含多序列、多平面信息，现有方法将检查编码为单一体积并用固定规则组合多采集，导致仅在某平面可见的征象被稀释、常被漏检，降低对漏诊最敏感的临床效能指标召回。

Method: GateSPINE采用免训练算子融合矢状位T1与T2体积；用两个并行3D编码器分别编码融合后的矢状位与轴位体积；将联合表示解码为报告。核心为门控跨视图融合模块，按特征通道与token预测各视图的接纳程度，使信息量更大的视图在每一空间位置占主导。

Result: 在三套腰椎MRI数据集（两个公开基准及Phenikaa大学医院的私有队列）上，以NLG与临床效能指标评估。GateSPINE在三套数据集上均通过提升召回取得最高CE F1；在缺少轴位序列的SPIDER上体现的是矢状位融合组件而非门控跨视图机制，后者在两个同时含两种成像平面的队列上得到验证。同时在标准NLG指标上保持竞争力。

Conclusion: 门控跨视图融合可缓解多平面信息被稀释与漏检问题，提升临床效能召回与F1，且不牺牲自然语言生成质量；其收益在不同数据构成下可由不同组件贡献。

Abstract: Automated report generation can ease the burden radiolo gists face when interpreting multi-sequence MRI studies. Unlike CT, MRI examinations comprise multiple sequences and imaging planes, each con tributing complementary diagnostic information. Existing methods en code a study as a single volume and combine multiple acquisitions by fixed rules. Findings visible in only one plane are thus diluted and of ten missed, lowering recall on clinical efficacy metrics, where a missed abnormality is most costly. We propose GateSPINE, a vision-language framework that fuses sagittal T1 and T2 volumes with a training-free operator, encodes the fused sagittal and axial volumes with two parallel 3D encoders, and decodes their combined representation into a report. Its core mechanism is a gated cross view fusion module that predicts, per feature channel and token, how much of each view to admit, so the more informative view dominates at each spatial location. We evaluate GateSPINE on three lumbar MRI datasets, comprising two public bench marks and a private cohort collected from Phenikaa University Hospital, using both natural language generation (NLG) and clinical efficacy (CE) metrics. GateSPINE achieves the highest CE F1 through improved re call on all three datasets; on SPIDER, which lacks an axial sequence, this reflects the sagittal fusion component rather than the gated cross-view mechanism, which is validated on the two cohorts with both imaging planes. GateSPINE also remains competitive on standard NLG metrics.

</details>


### [173] [VR-JEPA: Learning Contrastive-State Latent Guidance for Generation-based Video Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40129)
*Zehua Ma,Kun Xiang,Yunshuang Nie,Quanlin Chen,Haoyuan Li,Xiuwei Chen,Jiang Ji,Haijun Wu,Zhenyu Xie,Michael Kampffmeyer,Hanhui Li,Xiaodan Liang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出VR-JEPA框架，通过局部对比状态学习和技能专家，将V-JEPA的时空先验对齐到任务推理逻辑，用预测潜轨迹引导视频生成，在VBVR-Pro-Bench上取得11.33%的相对提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前视频生成模型缺乏对潜在视觉状态如何演化的显式指导，导致生成轨迹出现物理与结构不一致，损害推理可靠性；而V-JEPA虽提供丰富时空先验，却无法自然适配复杂视觉任务所需的逻辑推理能力。

Method: VR-JEPA通过两项设计实现对齐：(i) 在同一输入条件下配对成功轨迹与生成备选轨迹，利用其V-JEPA表示差异识别有信息的state和token，进行局部对比监督；(ii) 为V-JEPA预测器配备在anchor-task数据上训练的skill-specific experts，使其共享时空先验能自适应地跨认知领域专门化。二者结合使预测器产生为视频生成提供任务特定逻辑指导的潜轨迹。

Result: 在大型VBVR-Pro-Bench数据集上，VR-JEPA相较前沿的生成式推理基线取得11.33%的相对提升，显著减轻物理伪影并增强逻辑一致性。

Conclusion: 将V-JEPA预测器与任务特定推理逻辑对齐并用其潜轨迹引导视频生成，是提升视觉推理可靠性的有效路径。

Abstract: Reasoning through video generation offers a promising path toward visual intelligence by modeling latent visual states and their dynamics. However, current video generation models often lack explicit guidance on how these states should evolve, leaving generated trajectories prone to physical and structural inconsistencies that undermine reasoning reliability. While the Video Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (V-JEPA) provides rich spatiotemporal priors learned through latent prediction, these general priors do not naturally adapt to the logical reasoning capabilities required for complex visual tasks. To bridge this gap, we propose VR-JEPA, a framework that aligns the V-JEPA predictor with task-specific reasoning logic through localized contrastive-state learning and uses its predicted latent trajectories to guide video generation for visual reasoning. Specifically, (i) we pair successful trajectories with generated alternatives under the same input conditions and use discrepancies in their V-JEPA representations to identify informative states and tokens for localized contrastive supervision. (ii) We further equip the V-JEPA predictor with skill-specific experts trained on anchor-task data, allowing the model to adaptively specialize its shared spatiotemporal priors across diverse cognitive domains. Together with skill-specific experts, this contrastive supervision enables VR-JEPA to predict latent trajectories that provide task-specific logical guidance for video generation. Comprehensive experiments on the large-scale VBVR-Pro-Bench dataset demonstrate that VR-JEPA achieves an $11.33\%$ relative improvement over the cutting-edge generation-based reasoning baseline, significantly mitigating physical artifacts and enhancing logical consistency.

</details>


### [174] [Recognition of Urbanized Areas in UAV-Derived Very-High-Resolution Visible-Light Imagery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40212)
*Edyta Puniach,Wojciech Gruszczyński,Paweł Ćwiąkała,Katarzyna Strząbała,Elżbieta Pastucha*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究比较了基于无人机RGB影像区分城市化与非城市化区域的分类方法，神经网络（约96%精度）优于最佳植被指数阈值法（Excess Blue，约87%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 比较多种植被指数阈值化与神经网络在无人机RGB影像中区分城市化/非城市化区域的效果，并考察季节、影像块尺寸等因素对分类精度的影响。

Method: 在两个研究区用不同无人机与相机采集RGB影像（地面采样距离分别为10 mm和15 mm）；测试多种植被指数阈值化与神经网络；人工目视解译作为参考分类（第一区约2400万像素，第二区约380万像素）；分析季节对植被指数阈值的影响以及影像块尺寸对神经网络精度的影响；因数据集高度不平衡，结合Matthews相关系数评估，并辅以定性分析。

Result: 神经网络分类精度更高（约96%），优于最佳植被指数Excess Blue（约87%）；数据集高度不平衡（非城市化区域约占87%），故采用Matthews相关系数评估；定性分析识别了植被指数阈值化与神经网络分类差异的主要来源。

Conclusion: 神经网络在无人机RGB影像的城市化/非城市化区域分类中优于植被指数阈值法，季节与影像块尺寸等因素会影响结果，需结合统计与定性分析综合评价。

Abstract: This study compared classifiers that differentiate between urbanized and non-urbanized areas based on unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV)-acquired RGB imagery. The tested solutions in-cluded numerous vegetation indices (VIs) thresholding and neural networks (NNs). The analysis was conducted for two study areas for which surveys were carried out using different UAVs and cameras. The ground sampling distances for the study areas were 10 mm and 15 mm, respectively. Reference classification was performed manually, obtaining approximately 24 million classified pix-els for the first area and approximately 3.8 million for the second. This research study included an analysis of the impact of the season on the threshold values for the tested VIs and the impact of image patch size provided as inputs for the NNs on classification accuracy. The results of the con-ducted research study indicate a higher classification accuracy using NNs (about 96%) compared with the best of the tested VIs, i.e., Excess Blue (about 87%). Due to the highly imbalanced nature of the used datasets (non-urbanized areas constitute approximately 87% of the total datasets), the Mat-thews correlation coefficient was also used to assess the correctness of the classification. The analysis based on statistical measures was supplemented with a qualitative assessment of the classification results, which allowed the identification of the most important sources of differences in classification between VIs thresholding and NNs.

</details>


### [175] [Learning Skills from Historical Action Trajectories: Action Experience Dictionary for World Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40219)
*Qi Lyu,Jiahua Dong,Hao Shen,Xudong Wang,Hongyuan Yu,Baichen Liu,Henghui Ding,Zhi Han,Nicu Sebe,Ivan Laptev,Fahad Shahbaz Khan,Salman Khan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Action Experience Dictionary (AED)，将历史动作轨迹编码为共享动作嵌入，以支持跨任务技能复用与关系建模，并通过运动感知转移损失减少背景干扰，提升动作预测效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有World Action Models虽能耦合视觉动态预测与动作生成，但无法显式复用跨操作任务的动作经验，且冗余背景元素干扰关键视觉信息提取，难以捕捉可指导目标动作预测的跨任务语义关系。

Method: 构建Action Experience Dictionary，将历史动作聚合以对齐视觉观测，并用预训练动作分词器检索动作嵌入；通过交叉注意力对池化嵌入进行视觉条件化，并将其前置到带噪动作token中，提供交互上下文与动作意图；引入运动感知转移损失，在随机时间区间上监督视觉特征变化预测。

Result: 在仿真基准和真实世界跨具身设置上的实验验证了AED的有效性。

Conclusion: AED通过动作经验字典与运动感知转移损失，实现了动作经验复用和跨任务语义关系建模，并降低对无关背景线索的依赖。

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) couple visual dynamics prediction with action generation, yet they do not explicitly support the reuse of action experience across manipulation tasks. Furthermore, existing WAMs struggle to capture underlying cross-task semantic relationships that could guide target action prediction, as redundant background elements interfere with the extraction of key visual information. To address these challenges, we develop a novel Action Experience Dictionary (AED) that encodes historical physical action trajectories into shared action embeddings to support skill reuse and model cross-task relationships. Specifically, we first aggregate historical actions to align with visual observations and retrieve action embeddings from the AED using a pretrained action tokenizer. Subsequently, we visually condition the pooled embeddings through cross-attention and prepend them to noisy action tokens, providing interaction context and action intent for prediction. To model action-related motion and reduce reliance on irrelevant background cues, we introduce a motion-aware transition loss that supervises visual feature change prediction over random temporal intervals. Experiments on simulation benchmarks and in real-world cross-embodiment settings verify the effectiveness of our AED. The anonymous project website is available at \href{https://github.com/JiahuaDong/AED}{AED}.

</details>


### [176] [LOCI: Spatial Linear Memory for Streaming World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40222)
*Ji Xia,Tingting Liao,Xuezhi Liang,Hao Li,Guangyi Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LOCI是一种混合空间记忆架构，在部分Transformer块保留键值缓存、其余块使用受相机几何条件约束的循环线性注意力记忆，从而在重访视角下更忠实地重建历史内容，并显著降低内存。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频世界模型在相机重访已观测区域时应重现此前的内容，这需要既记住过去的观测，又能为当前视角检索到正确的记忆。键值缓存虽能保留视觉细节，却随视频长度增长；循环记忆虽紧凑，却将历史压缩为固定大小状态，无法直接访问单个历史观测，因此需要同时保留两类表示。

Method: 提出LOCI混合空间记忆架构：在一半Transformer块中，主注意力保留过去观测的键值缓存；在另一半块中，主注意力限制在当前分块，并由循环线性注意力记忆补充，其读写在投影相机几何条件下进行，使视角同时参与记忆寻址和存储内容。循环读出的结果流入后续缓存支撑的块，为其查询提供累积的场景上下文。

Result: 在公开MIND记忆基准与留存的录制轨迹上，LOCI比代表性世界模型及同配方全softmax模型更忠实地重建重访内容；在完整历史下，等长度时峰值内存比全softmax降低约30%。在受限观测库下，它能以恒定内存流式处理长视频，并在相同预算下仍比全softmax更忠实。

Conclusion: 通过结合键值缓存与受几何条件约束的循环记忆，LOCI在保持对重访内容忠实重建的同时显著降低内存，并支持恒定内存下的长视频流式处理。

Abstract: When a camera revisits a previously observed region, a video world model should reproduce what was there before. This requires both remembering past observations and retrieving the right one for the current viewpoint. Key-value caches preserve visual detail but grow with video length; recurrent memory is compact but compresses history into a fixed-size state, so individual past observations are no longer directly accessible. We introduce LOCI, a hybrid spatial-memory architecture that keeps both representations. In half of the transformer blocks, main attention keeps a key-value cache of past observations; in the other half, it is restricted to the current chunk and complemented by a recurrent linear-attention memory whose reads and writes are conditioned on projective camera geometry, so viewpoint enters both memory addressing and stored content. Recurrent readouts flow into subsequent cache-backed blocks and supply their queries with accumulated scene context. On the public MIND memory benchmark and on held-out recorded trajectories, LOCI reproduces revisited content more faithfully than representative world models and a same-recipe full-softmax model; with full history, it lowers peak memory at equal length by about 30% relative to full softmax. With a bounded bank of retained observations, it streams long videos at constant memory and remains more faithful than full softmax under the same budget.

</details>


### [177] [EviRover: Reinforcing Agentic Perception Beyond a Glance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40230)
*Kaixuan Fan,Kaituo Feng,Tianshuo Peng,Yilei Jiang,Manyuan Zhang,Junke Wang,Xiangyu Yue*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出"证据不足下的感知"问题，将其形式化为可交互获取信息的智能体过程，并构建数据集、基准及首个显式训练感知智能体EviRover。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统视觉感知被表述为从单张图像一次性预测，假设图像内容与模型参数知识足以解答查询。但在依赖细粒度视觉细节或需要知识密集、最新信息的真实场景中，该假设常失效，作者称此类情况为"证据不足下的感知"。

Method: 设计两条专用数据生成流程，产出 EviRover-SFT-5K 与 EviRover-RL-12K 用于训练；构建人工校验的基准 EviLens（688 个实例，覆盖五类感知任务）；提出 EviRover，首个显式训练通过交互解决感知查询的感知智能体，采用监督微调后接智能体强化学习。

Result: 4B 规模的 EviRover 在 EviLens 上平均超越其骨干模型 30 分，性能与先进专有模型相当。增益可迁移至 WebEyes、传统感知基准及通用多模态基准，其中 BrowseComp-VL 提升 15 分。

Conclusion: 感知可被重新表述为主动获取证据的智能体过程，交互式训练能显著提升证据不足下的感知能力，且增益具有跨基准的泛化性；代码、模型与数据均已开源。

Abstract: Visual perception is conventionally formulated as a one-shot prediction from a single glance at the image, under the assumption that the image content and the model's parametric knowledge suffice to resolve the query. This assumption often fails in real-world scenarios that hinge on fine-grained visual details or require knowledge-intensive and up-to-date information. We term such cases \textit{perception under insufficient evidence} and formulate perception as an agentic process that can obtain information beyond a single glance. To address the absence of data for this setting, we design two dedicated data generation pipelines, yielding EviRover-SFT-5K and EviRover-RL-12K for training. We further construct EviLens, a human-verified benchmark comprising 688 instances across five perception categories. Building on these data, we present EviRover, to our knowledge the first perception agent explicitly trained to resolve perceptual queries through interaction, using supervised fine-tuning followed by agentic reinforcement learning. Experiments show that the 4B EviRover outperforms its backbone by 30 points on average on EviLens, reaching performance comparable to advanced proprietary models. The gains transfer beyond EviLens to WebEyes, conventional perception benchmarks, and general multimodal benchmarks, including a 15-point improvement on BrowseComp-VL. All code, models, and data are released.

</details>


### [178] [StreamRig: Exploiting Intra-Rig Geometry for Streaming Multi-Camera Odometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40244)
*Yufei Wei,Shuhao Ye,Qi Wang,Xin Zheng,Qing Huang,Rong Xiong,Yue Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: StreamRig：面向标定多相机平台的冻结-流式里程计框架，仅训练74.6M参数模块，实现低漂移、低推理成本的因果流式位姿估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 移动机器人与车辆普遍搭载同步多相机平台，但多数流式3D基础模型面向单目输入，如何高效利用相机平台几何信息仍是难题。

Method: 在冻结的多视角3D基础模型上构建因果流式里程计：冻结前端利用标定联合感知同步视图；Rig-Resampler压缩特征；CausalBridge以KV缓存做因果注意力；轻量头回归平台位姿；周期性重锚定协议保证长序列稳定。仅训练上述模块（共74.6M参数），以相对位姿为唯一监督；两阶段训练=群组重定位预训练+因果平台训练。

Result: 在NCLT、TartanGround、KITTI-360及自采人形机器人数据集ZJH上评测，训练仅用仿真、真实世界为零样本。四个数据集上平移与旋转漂移均低于所比较的非oracle单目流式模型和平台感知离线模型，且推理成本低；消融与受控相机数量实验揭示增益来源，并考察更长训练窗口对长时域推理的影响。

Conclusion: 通过冻结多视角基础模型并仅训练轻量流式模块，可有效利用多相机平台几何，实现跨数据集稳健、低成本、零样本泛化的流式里程计。

Abstract: Mobile robots and vehicles carry synchronized multi-camera rigs, yet many streaming 3D foundation models are designed for monocular input, leaving efficient use of rig geometry a challenge. We present StreamRig, a freeze-and-stream framework that builds causal streaming odometry for calibrated rigs on a frozen multi-view 3D foundation model. The frozen front-end jointly perceives the synchronized views using rig calibration. A Rig-Resampler compresses their features, a CausalBridge applies causal attention with a key-value cache, and a lightweight head regresses rig poses. A periodic re-anchoring protocol supports stable pose estimation over long sequences. Only these modules are trained, 74.6M parameters in total, with relative poses as the sole supervision. Our two-stage training strategy combines group relocalization pretraining with causal rig training to transfer the geometric priors of the frozen front-end and the alignment ability of the pretrained modules to streaming odometry. We evaluate on NCLT, TartanGround, KITTI-360, and our self-collected humanoid-robot dataset ZJH, where training uses only simulation and real-world evaluation is zero-shot. Across all four datasets, StreamRig achieves lower translation and rotation drift than the evaluated non-oracle monocular streaming and rig-aware offline models, while maintaining low inference cost. Ablations and controlled camera-count experiments identify the sources of these gains. We further examine how longer training windows affect inference over longer horizons. Code has been released at https://github.com/WeiYuFei0217/StreamRig.

</details>


### [179] [ComputerSD: Online Self-Distillation from Real-Time Feedback for Computer-Use Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40253)
*Yong Du,Tongbo Chen,Zhengxi Lu,Yizhou Liu,Bofan Chen,Tao Jiang,Wenhao Xu,Yongliang Shen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 ComputerSD，一种将 GUI 执行反馈转化为在线自蒸馏信号的 CUA 训练方法，联合优化 token 级 OPSD 与轨迹级 GRPO，在 OSWorld-Verified 上显著优于纯结果奖励 GRPO。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有计算机使用智能体（CUA）在线训练主要依赖稀疏的结果奖励，无法为中间动作提供监督。on-policy 自蒸馏（OPSD）虽能通过特权重打分提供 token 级信号，但直接用于 CUA 存在两问题：固定引导会与学生当前状态错位；引导引发的概率偏移可能与步骤级正确性相冲突。

Method: ComputerSD 将执行 GUI 转移的实时反馈转化为策略学习引导。每个动作后由微调的 GUI 分析器产出引导与步骤级价值分数：引导提供特权上下文，分数用于调节 OPSD 信号。方法在完全异步训练框架中联合优化 token 级 OPSD 与轨迹级 GRPO。

Result: 在 OSWorld-Verified 上，ComputerSD 相比仅用结果奖励的 GRPO，在通用骨干 Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking 与专用骨干 EvoCUA-8B 上分别提升 1.9 和 4.1 个百分点；分布外评测进一步支持其泛化性。

Conclusion: 结果证明了通过在线自蒸馏从实时反馈中学习对 CUA 的有效性。

Abstract: Online training enables computer-use agents (CUAs) to improve through interaction with executable environments. However, existing methods primarily rely on sparse outcome rewards, which provide no supervision for intermediate actions. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) offers token-level learning signals through privileged rescoring, but directly applying it to CUA online training presents two challenges: fixed guidance may become misaligned with the student's current state, and guidance-induced probability shifts may conflict with step-level correctness. We introduce ComputerSD, an online self-distillation method for CUAs that converts real-time feedback from executed GUI transitions into guidance for policy learning. A fine-tuned GUI analyzer produces guidance and a step-level value score after each action; the guidance provides privileged context, while the score regulates the resulting OPSD signals. ComputerSD jointly optimizes token-level OPSD and trajectory-level GRPO in a fully asynchronous training framework. On OSWorld-Verified, ComputerSD outperforms outcome-only GRPO by 1.9 and 4.1 percentage points on the general-purpose Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking and specialized EvoCUA-8B backbones, respectively. Evaluation in out-of-distribution settings further supports the generalizability of ComputerSD. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of learning from real-time feedback through online self-distillation for CUAs.

</details>


### [180] [Looped Diffusion Transformer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40305)
*Yong Xien Chng,Tianyi Chen,Wenwen Tong,Haiwen Diao,Zhongang Cai,Lei Yang,Ziwei Liu,Lewei Lu,Dahua Lin,Gao Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出Looped Diffusion Transformer（Looped-DiT），通过在单个去噪步骤内重复运行共享Transformer块来扩展计算深度而固定参数量，并结合中间循环深监督与自调制注意力，实现比非循环基线更优的文本到图像生成性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统提升文本到图像模型的方法依赖增大模型规模或增加去噪步数，计算成本高昂。作者希望探索一种替代的算力扩展方式：在参数量固定的前提下，通过循环共享Transformer块增加计算深度，实现内部表征的迭代精炼，而无需显式推理token。

Method: 论文提出Looped-DiT，核心包含两项设计：（1）对中间循环施加深监督，解决中间循环监督信号弱的问题；（2）自调制注意力（self-modulating attention），用以稳定循环特征更新，防止注意力更新逐步侵蚀局部信息。作者在匹配参数量和匹配计算量两种设定下进行对比实验。

Result: 在匹配参数和匹配计算设定下，Looped-DiT持续优于非循环基线。一个260M参数的循环模型在多个文本到图像基准上超越规模大6.5倍的模型，且推理计算量降低4.9倍。在固定推理预算下，增加循环深度带来的收益大于增加去噪步数；更深循环能逐步修正早期循环的错误，表现出潜在推理行为。

Conclusion: 循环计算为扩散模型提供了一种更有效的迭代计算形式，是扩展视觉生成模型的一种有前景的途径。

Abstract: Improving text-to-image models has traditionally relied on increasing model size or the number of denoising steps. In this work, we explore an alternative way to scale computation by repeatedly running shared Transformer blocks within each denoising step, effectively increasing computational depth while keeping the parameter count fixed. This looped computation enables iterative refinement of internal representations without explicit reasoning tokens. However, naive looping fails to consistently improve image quality. We trace this problem to weak supervision across intermediate loops and unregulated attention updates that progressively erode local information. To overcome these challenges, we propose Looped Diffusion Transformer (Looped-DiT), which combines deep supervision across intermediate loops with self-modulating attention to stabilize looped feature updates. Under matched-parameter and matched-compute settings, Looped-DiT consistently outperforms non-looped baselines. Notably, a 260M-parameter looped model can surpass a model 6.5x larger across multiple text-to-image benchmarks while requiring 4.9x lower inference compute. Beyond this performance gain, we find that looped computation can offer a more effective form of iterative computation for diffusion models, with increasing loop depth yielding larger gains than adding more denoising steps under a fixed inference budget. Furthermore, deeper loops can progressively correct mistakes made in earlier loops, exhibiting behaviors suggestive of latent reasoning. Together, these results show that looped computation offers a promising way to scale visual generation models.

</details>


### [181] [GLARE: Generating Listening Heads with Appropriate Reactions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40317)
*Zikai Liao,Yumin Suh,Yi Ouyang,Yi-Lun Lee,Yi-Hsuan Tsai,Zhaozheng Yin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文针对对话中倾听者行为生成的数据、模型与评估三大缺口，构建了含6类反应标注的倾听数据集，提出音频驱动的流匹配基线GLARE与反应导向评估协议，实验表明在视觉保真度与反应级指标上均优于先前方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 说话头生成进展迅速，但双人对话中倾听者的自然行为（何时反应、如何反应、反应类型）仍研究不足。现有双人数据集缺乏细粒度的倾听者反应标注，且沿用自说话头与视频生成的评估指标只衡量视觉真实感，无法判断倾听者的反应是否恰当。

Method: 从三方面切入：(1) 基于RealTalk与Seamless Interaction构建倾听头专用数据集，约147小时成对说话者-倾听者视频，含64,557条事件级反应标注，覆盖点头、摇头、微笑、大笑、皱眉、惊讶六类；(2) 提出音频驱动基线GLARE，基于流匹配transformer，采用Qwen2-Audio导出的韵律条件，并引入时间反应损失显式监督逐帧反应；(3) 提出反应导向评估协议，联合测量反应发生（R-F1）、时间对齐（R-tIoU）、非对称时间偏差（R-ATD）与反应区域视觉质量（R-FID）。

Result: 在视觉保真度与反应级指标上均一致优于先前的倾听头方法。

Conclusion: 反应感知的数据、建模与评估对生成自然的倾听行为至关重要。

Abstract: While talking head generation has advanced rapidly, generating natural listener behavior in dyadic conversations, which know when to react, how to react, and with what type of response, remains underexplored. Existing dyadic datasets lack fine-grained listener reaction annotations, and prevailing evaluation metrics inherited from talking-head and video generation measure visual realism rather than whether a listener reacted appropriately. We address these gaps along three aspects. First, we curate a listening-head-specific dataset built from RealTalk and Seamless Interaction, comprising approximately 147 hours of paired speaker-listener videos with 64,557 event-level reaction annotations across six categories: nodding, head shaking, smiling, laughing, frowning, and surprised. Second, we introduce an audio-driven baseline built on a flow-matching transformer, namely GLARE, with prosody conditioning derived from Qwen2-Audio and a temporal reaction loss that explicitly supervises frame-wise reactions. Third, we propose a reaction-oriented evaluation protocol that jointly measures reaction occurrence (R-F1), temporal alignment (R-tIoU), asymmetric temporal deviation (R-ATD), and reaction-region visual quality (R-FID), giving a more behaviorally grounded assessment than visual-quality-only metrics. Experiment results show consistent gains over prior listening-head methods in both visual fidelity and reaction-level metrics, suggesting that reaction-aware data, modeling, and evaluation are critical for natural listening behavior.

</details>


### [182] [Atomizer-IO: Beyond Pixels, Patches and Grids](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40320)
*Hugo Riffaud de Turckheim,Sylvain Lobry,Nicolas Houdré,Damien Robert,Roberto Interdonato,Diego Marcos*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Atomizer-IO 架构，将观测作为原子单元并利用其物理关系推导结构，摆脱对规则栅格假设的依赖，在遥感任务上具备竞争力并可无缝扩展至无序三维点云。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多数视觉架构假设观测位于规则栅格上，这一假设对自然图像有效，但难以适应通道、时间采样、空间分辨率与几何结构均可变的传感数据；通用集合式架构虽去除了栅格，却也丢失了有用的空间归纳偏置。

Method: 以数据的原子化表示为基座，每个观测由测量值及其获取元数据描述；采用局部交叉注意力将观测映射到可任意放置的锚点，从而由观测之间的物理关系推导结构。通过逐步放松栅格假设进行评测：改变输入栅格配置、不完整通道集合、灵活输出密度，直至无栅格输入。

Result: 在多数任务上与灵活的 EO 专用架构相当，同时支持训练后调节推理成本，并具备有竞争力的计算—性能权衡；同一公式无需架构重设计即可扩展至无序三维点云，表明原子接口可泛化到规则栅格输入之外。

Conclusion: 像素、图块与栅格无需成为传感架构的接口定义，观测优先的原子化设计是可行且更具通用性的方向。

Abstract: Most vision architectures assume that observations lie on a regular grid, an effective abstraction for natural images but a restrictive one for sensing data whose channels, temporal sampling, spatial resolution, and geometry can vary. Generic set-based architectures remove the grid, but also remove useful spatial inductive biases. We introduce Atomizer-IO, an architecture that places observations first and derives structure from their physical relationships. Building on top of an atomic representation of the data, each observation is described by its measurement and acquisition metadata, while local cross-attention maps observations to anchor points that can be arbitrarily placed. We evaluate this design by progressively relaxing the grid assumption, from varying input raster configurations and incomplete channel sets to flexible output density and, ultimately, inputs without a raster grid. Atomizer-IO is competitive with flexible EO-specific architectures on most tasks, while offering post-training control over inference cost and competitive compute--performance trade-offs. The same formulation extends without architectural redesign to unordered 3D point clouds, showing that the atomic interface generalizes beyond regular raster inputs. These results suggest that pixels, patches, and grids do not need to define the interface of a sensing architecture.

</details>


### [183] [I Have a Stream: Making Self-Supervised Learning Work on Continuous Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40333)
*Ivan Martinović,Lukas Knobel,Yuki M. Asano*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文研究连续视频流场景下的自监督预训练，构建WT++数据集（95小时城市步行视频）与评测套件，发现对比学习和蒸馏方法在此设定下表现不佳，MAE较稳健但仍逊于i.i.d.预训练；指出主要瓶颈是滑动窗口导致的批内高相似度，提出StreamMAE，通过流感知正则与运动偏置裁剪改进MAE，性能超越流式基线、追平i.i.d. MAE并随流时长正向扩展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准自监督学习虽受婴儿视觉发展启发，但训练管线与真实视觉发展差异悬殊：图像被独立采样并在各epoch间全局打乱。论文希望从连续视频流（按时间顺序消费帧、严格滑动窗口批次、无全局重打乱与多epoch重放）出发，探究自监督学习在该更接近真实视觉输入模式下的可行性、性能差距及其成因。

Method: 1）构建WT++：95小时城市步行游览视频数据集，用于流式预训练；2）设计全面评测套件；3）在严格滑动窗口批次、无全局重打乱、无多epoch重放的流式设定下，对比评估对比学习、蒸馏与MAE等方法；4）分析批间相似度与批内相似度两种假设；5）提出StreamMAE：保留MAE核心重建目标，在输入管线引入流感知正则化（stream-aware regularization）与运动偏置裁剪（motion-biased crop selection）。

Result: 对比学习与蒸馏方法在流式设定下表现吃力；MAE更稳健，但仍不及标准i.i.d.预训练。高批间相似度（源于滑动窗口在连续批次间的消费方式）并不能解释该性能差距；主要挑战是批内高相似度——每个批次内帧近乎重复。StreamMAE超越各流式基线，追平在同一视频数据上训练的i.i.d. MAE，与ImageNet预训练的MAE相比仍具竞争力，并随预训练流从12小时增至95小时呈现正向扩展。

Conclusion: 流式连续视频预训练的瓶颈在于批内帧近重复导致的高相似度，而非批间相似度；通过流感知正则化与运动偏置裁剪保留MAE重建目标即可有效缓解。StreamMAE在流式设定下达到i.i.d. MAE水平，且随数据流规模增长而稳定受益，表明连续视频流可作为可行的自监督预训练范式。

Abstract: Self-supervised learning draws inspiration from infant visual development, yet standard training pipelines bear little resemblance to it: images are independently sampled and globally shuffled across epochs. We study self-supervised learning from continuous video streams, where frames are consumed in temporal order using strict sliding-window batches, without global reshuffling or multi-epoch replay. To this end, we construct WT++, a 95-hour urban walking-tour video dataset for streaming pretraining. Combined with a comprehensive evaluation suite we find that contrastive and distillation-based methods struggle in this setting, while MAE is more robust but still falls short of standard i.i.d. pretraining. We find that high inter-batch similarity, caused by sliding-window consumption across consecutive batches, does not explain this gap. The main challenge is high intra-batch similarity, where frames within each batch are near-duplicates. To mitigate this, we propose StreamMAE, which preserves the core MAE reconstruction objective while adapting the input pipeline with stream-aware regularization and motion-biased crop selection. StreamMAE outperforms streaming baselines, matches i.i.d. MAE trained on the same video data, remains competitive with ImageNet-pretrained MAE, and scales positively as the pretraining stream grows from 12 to 95 hours.

</details>


### [184] [Image Classifiers are Efficient Self-Supervised Video Representation Learners](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40347)
*Owais Iqbal,Sudipta Sarkar,Shyam Marjit,Omprakash Chakraborty,Anirban Chakraborty,Abir Das*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VideoMSN 提出一种无解码器的掩码孪生网络框架，通过"超级图像"和双视图掩码策略，用图像 ViT 高效学习视频时空表示，在多个基准上达到 SOTA 且预训练轮数大幅减少。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频自监督方法依赖沉重的 3D 架构或基于重建的自编码器，计算成本高、效率低。作者希望复用标准图像 Vision Transformer 与图像基础模型，实现高效的视频时空表示学习。

Method: 将视频表示为"超级图像"（由采样帧构成的网格），从中构造两个视图：一个施加空间块掩码，另一个施加时间帧掩码，且保证帧间无信息泄露。共享的 ViT 编码器通过掩码孪生损失对齐两视图嵌入，捕获运动与外观线索，无需重建解码器。方法以预训练的 DINO-v3 和 DeiT-v3 图像编码器为起点。

Result: 在 Kinetics-400、UCF101 和 HMDB51 上达到 SOTA，视频预训练轮数比先前方法分别减少最多 32×和 160×；在低样本分类场景下也表现强劲，验证了学习表示的迁移能力。

Conclusion: VideoMSN 证明了无需 3D 架构或重建目标，仅借助图像基础模型和无解码器的掩码孪生范式即可实现高效且可迁移的视频自监督表示学习。

Abstract: We introduce VideoMSN, a Masked Siamese Network framework for efficient self-supervised spatio-temporal representation learning in videos. Instead of relying on heavy 3D architectures or reconstruction-based autoencoders for learning with unlabeled data, we repurpose standard image Vision Transformers by representing videos as super images which are grids composed of frames sampled from videos. From each super image, we construct two views: one with spatial patch masking and the other with temporal frame masking, ensuring no information leakage across frames. A shared Vision Transformer (ViT) encoder aligns their embeddings using a masked Siamese loss, capturing both motion and appearance cues without reconstruction. Our decoder-free formulation leverages an image foundation model towards efficient video representation learning. Starting from pretrained DINO-v3 and DeiT-v3 image encoders, VideoMSN achieves state-of-the-art performance on Kinetics-400, UCF101, and HMDB51 while requiring up to $32\times$ fewer and $160\times$ fewer video pretraining epochs compared to prior video self-supervised learning methods. Our proposed approach also shows strong performance in low-shot classification, confirming the transferability of the learned representations in a label-scarce scenario. Project Page: https://cvir.github.io/projects/videomsn.

</details>


### [185] [AssemblyWorld: Rethinking 3D Assembly with General-Purpose Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40353)
*Jiahao Zhang,Yeying Fan,Moitreya Chatterjee,Suhas Lohit,Bernhard Egger,Tim K. Marks,Anoop Cherian,Stephen Gould*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出交互式3D环境AssemblyWorld及评测基准AssemblyWorldBench，考察通用预训练智能体能否仅凭视觉交互、无需组装专用微调完成3D装配任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3D装配需要将部件理解与关系理解转化为精确的空间排布。作者希望回答一个核心问题：预训练的通用智能体能否通过视觉交互完成物体装配，而无需针对装配任务进行额外微调。同时，现有工作缺乏统一环境来评估此类交互式装配智能体的能力，也难以刻画"近似结构恢复"与"精确重建"之间的差距。

Method: 作者构建了AssemblyWorld交互式3D环境：智能体通过渲染的2D视图感知部件几何，而非直接访问网格顶点或面；在此基础上操作给定的刚体部件，并可在有图像或装配手册时作为参考。装配结果以几何方式进行评估。基于该环境构建AssemblyWorldBench基准，包含80个物体、100个装配任务，覆盖家具、工业装配与断裂重装三类场景，并评测了8个智能体系统。分析维度包括视觉参考、交互轨迹与失败案例。

Result: 八个被测系统能力差异显著。最强系统达到80.9%的部件准确率，但完整装配成功率仅为59.4%。开源系统在执行可靠性与装配精度两方面均明显落后于较强的闭源同级系统。对视觉参考、交互轨迹与失败的分析表明，智能体会在装配过程中修正装配结果，但仍残留定位误差。

Conclusion: AssemblyWorld为评估交互式装配智能体的能力、以及刻画近似结构恢复与精确重建之间的差距，提供了统一的实验平台。结果表明当前通用智能体在部件级精度与完整装配成功率之间存在显著落差。

Abstract: The task of 3D assembly requires translating an understanding of parts and their relationships into precise spatial arrangements. Can pretrained general-purpose agents assemble objects through visual interaction without additional assembly-specific fine-tuning? To investigate this question, we introduce AssemblyWorld, an interactive 3D environment in which agents inspect rendered views and manipulate supplied rigid parts, guided by images or assembly manuals when available. Agents perceive part geometry through 2D views rather than direct access to mesh vertices or faces, while their resulting assemblies are evaluated geometrically. Building on this environment, we construct AssemblyWorldBench, comprising 100 assembly tasks across 80 objects spanning furniture, industrial assembly, and fracture reassembly. Evaluating eight agent systems reveals substantial differences in their capabilities. The strongest system achieves 80.9% part accuracy but 59.4% complete-assembly success. The evaluated open-source systems lag substantially behind their stronger closed-source peers in both execution reliability and assembly accuracy. Analyses of visual references, interaction trajectories, and failures show how agents revise assemblies while leaving residual positioning errors. AssemblyWorld provides a common setting for both assessing the capabilities of interactive assembly agents and characterizing the gap between approximate structure recovery and precise reconstruction.

</details>


### [186] [ViTeX-Bench: Benchmarking High-Fidelity Video Scene Text Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40356)
*Xinghao Chen,Xiangbo Gao,Jiongze Yu,Yuheng Wu,Zhengzhong Tu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 ViTeX-Bench 视频场景文本编辑基准（ViTeX-Dataset + 三轴评测协议），并发布开源参考编辑器 ViTeX-Edit-14B，用于研究文本正确性、时空质量与编辑局部性之间的权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频生成在真实感与可控性上进展迅速，但视频编辑尤其是需保持原始场景动力学的精确局部编辑仍不成熟。视频场景文本编辑需替换店面招牌、白板、产品标签等表面文本并保持周边内容、运动与相机动态。图像场景文本编辑已有较成熟研究，但视频场景文本编辑在高视觉质量、时间一致性与编辑局部性方面仍缺乏探索；现有资源缺少配对的真实视频数据，通用视频编辑指标也无法直接衡量文本在时间上是否持续正确。

Method: 构建 ViTeX-Bench，包括 ViTeX-Dataset 与三轴评测协议。数据集含 387 个真实世界 720p 视频，配有文本区域掩码与编辑指令：其中 230 个提供经审核、由流水线生成的配对编辑用于训练，157 个构成冻结评测集。协议通过 13 项指标评估文本正确性、视觉与时间质量、编辑局部性，每个轴设一个主指标，并进行权衡的 Pareto 比较；同时用 OCR 校准、人工评估与标注敏感性分析支持分数解释。另发布 ViTeX-Edit-14B，在配对训练集上微调，采用运动对齐的字形-视频条件。

Result: 在四个编辑家族的八个基线上，准确文本、时间稳定性与场景保持难以同时达成。ViTeX-Edit-14B 取得 CharAcc 0.688，在被评估的视频原生编辑器中均值最高，并在原始编辑器输出中取得可比的最低文本裁剪区域 Warp。

Conclusion: ViTeX-Bench 为研究视频场景文本编辑中的上述权衡提供了可复现基础。

Abstract: Recent video generation is increasingly realistic and controllable, yet video editing remains less developed, particularly for precise local edits that must preserve the original scene dynamics. Video scene text editing replaces text on scene surfaces, such as storefront signs, whiteboards, and product labels, while preserving the surrounding content, motion, and camera dynamics. Although scene text editing is well studied for images, video scene text editing that achieves high visual quality, temporal consistency, and edit locality remains underexplored. Existing resources offer limited paired real-video data, and general video-editing metrics do not directly measure whether the requested text remains correct over time. We introduce ViTeX-Bench, a benchmark suite comprising ViTeX-Dataset and a three-axis evaluation protocol. The dataset contains 387 real-world 720p videos with text-region masks and editing instructions: 230 provide reviewed, pipeline-generated paired edits for training, and 157 form a frozen evaluation split. The protocol evaluates text correctness, visual and temporal quality, and edit locality through 13 metrics, with one primary metric per axis and a Pareto comparison of their trade-offs. OCR calibration, human evaluation, and annotation-sensitivity analyses support the interpretation of these scores. Across eight baselines from four editing families, accurate text, temporal stability, and scene preservation remain difficult to achieve together. We also release ViTeX-Edit-14B, an open-source reference editor fine-tuned on the paired training split with motion-aligned glyph-video conditioning. It achieves CharAcc 0.688, the highest mean among the evaluated video-native editors, and the lowest comparable text-crop Warp among raw editor outputs. ViTeX-Bench provides a reproducible foundation for studying these trade-offs in video scene text editing.

</details>


### [187] [Physis-Lang: Self-Evolving Language as a Physical Representation for Video World Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40358)
*Liming Lu,Xianzheng Ma,Wenkun He,Guanqi Zhan,Yilin Zhao,Junyu Chen,Mengyao Xu,Jiaojiao Fan,Wenhang Ge,Yuchao Gu,Yunze Liu,Boyi Li,Zhen Dong,Victor Prisacariu,Ming-Yu Liu,Song Han,Han Cai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Physis-Lang自进化框架，将"物理语言"作为数据构建、模型训练与视频生成的共享可优化表示，用语言描述物理过程（实体、因果、交互、规律、时序演化、效应）。通过PhysCapBench将物理过程分解为原子断言并按召回/精确率评估字幕，配合智能体循环迭代修正物理字幕生成指令；同时把模型缺陷转为文本描述，用语言引导检索补充缺失物理过程的视频。在四个物理视频基准、Wan与Cosmos骨干上物理合理性一致提升，基于Cosmos3-Nano的增强模型超过Veo 3.1。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频世界模型虽能生成视觉上逼真的视频，却常违背基本物理规律。现有方法普遍假设自然语言不足以表征可靠生成所需的物理知识，因而引入额外的视觉、潜变量、数值或规划信号。本文重新审视这一假设，主张物理语言可作为一种充分且可优化的表示。

Method: 提出Physis-Lang自进化框架：1）以语言描述物理过程的实体、原因、交互、支配规律、时序演化与效应；2）构建PhysCapBench，将物理过程分解为原子断言，用召回率与精确率评估物理字幕；3）智能体循环分析断言级错误并迭代优化生成物理字幕的指令；4）将模型缺陷转化为文本描述，用语言引导检索找到覆盖缺失物理过程的视觉多样视频，实现数据层面自进化。

Result: 在四个广泛使用的物理视频基准上，配合Wan与Cosmos骨干，物理合理性获得一致提升；以开源Cosmos3-Nano为起点，Physis-Lang增强后的模型超越了领先的闭源模型Veo 3.1。

Conclusion: 自然语言足以作为物理知识的可优化表示，语言可作为贯穿数据构建、训练与生成的共享表示，无需依赖大量额外模态信号；通过断言级评估与智能体式迭代，可系统性提升视频世界模型的物理合理性，并在开源骨干上达到超越先进闭源模型的水平。

Abstract: Video world models are expected to predict how the physical world evolves, yet they often produce visually plausible videos that violate basic physical principles. Existing approaches commonly assume that natural language is insufficient to represent the physical knowledge required for reliable generation, and therefore introduce additional visual, latent, numerical, or planning-based signals. We revisit this assumption and introduce Physis-Lang, a self-evolving framework that treats physical language as a shared and optimizable representation across data curation, model training, and video generation. Physis-Lang represents physical processes through language that describes their relevant entities, causes, interactions, governing principles, temporal evolution, and effects. To improve this representation, we construct PhysCapBench, which decomposes physical processes into atomic assertions and evaluates captions using recall and precision. An agentic loop iteratively analyzes assertion-level errors and refines the instruction used to produce physical captions. Physis-Lang further converts model deficiencies into textual descriptions and uses language-guided retrieval to identify visually diverse videos that cover missing physical processes. Experiments on four widely used physical video benchmarks with Wan and Cosmos backbones demonstrate consistent improvements in physical plausibility. Notably, starting from open-source Cosmos3-Nano backbones, our Physis-Lang-enhanced models surpass the leading proprietary Veo 3.1 model.

</details>


### [188] [Multimodal Flow: Unified Flow Modeling of Language and Vision in Embedding Spaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40362)
*Hongyuan Tao,Xinggang Wang,Lianghui Zhu,Yongkang Li,Yunchao Wei,Bin Feng,Shaoyu Chen,Qian Zhang,Chang Huang,Kai Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Multimodal Flow 提出一种全连续的统一多模态生成模型，用共享的 chunk-causal flow backbone 在连续超块上做 Flow Matching，避免量化瓶颈与模态依赖目标的权衡，并在多尺度预训练中超越代表性混合与离散模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态统一模型存在两条路线：一是将语言与量化图像都建模为离散 token，带来视觉量化瓶颈；二是将离散语言预测与连续图像生成结合，需要模态相关的目标函数与采样流程。全连续建模可规避上述权衡并实现共享生成过程，但在多模态预训练中尚未充分探索。

Method: 提出统一连续架构，将多模态连续表示与共享的 chunk-causal flow backbone 集成；把文本块与图像组织为有序连续 hyperchunks，保留文本 token 顺序与视觉空间结构；backbone 通过 Flow Matching 在 hyperchunks 上学习单一向量场。采用联合注意力实现跨模态交互，并用模态特定 FFN 处理各模态。训练时并行预测多个目标 chunk，推理时顺序生成 hyperchunks。实例化为 MF-1 并在多模态数据上预训练。

Result: 在 0.6B、1.2B、1.6B 规模上，持续预训练稳定提升多模态建模效果。仅用 150B 预训练 token，MF-1 在 GenEval 与 DPG-Bench 上平均得分 82.8，在 VQAv2、MMBench、POPE 上平均得分 75.3，与使用显著更多数据训练的统一模型相比仍具竞争力。在匹配数据、优化与参数预算下，Multimodal Flow 优于代表性混合模型与离散模型。

Conclusion: 结果确立了基于连续 chunk 的 embedding flow 建模可作为统一多模态建模的一种新的全连续范式。相关代码与模型已公开于 https://github.com/hustvl/Multimodal-Flow。

Abstract: We present Multimodal Flow, a fully continuous generative model of language and vision. Most unified multimodal models either model both language and quantized images as discrete tokens or combine discrete language prediction with continuous image generation. The former introduces a visual quantization bottleneck. The latter requires modality-dependent objectives and sampling procedures. Fully continuous modeling avoids these trade-offs and enables a shared generative process, but remains underexplored for multimodal pretraining. Multimodal Flow introduces a unified continuous architecture that integrates multimodal continuous representations with a shared chunk-causal flow backbone. It organizes text blocks and images as ordered continuous hyperchunks, preserving textual token order and visual spatial structure. The backbone learns a single vector field over these hyperchunks through Flow Matching. Joint attention enables cross-modal interaction, while modality-specific feed-forward networks process each modality. The model predicts multiple target chunks in parallel during training and generates hyperchunks sequentially at inference. We instantiate MF-1 and pretrain it on multimodal data. Across 0.6B, 1.2B, and 1.6B scales, continued pretraining consistently improves multimodal modeling. With only 150B pretraining tokens, MF-1 achieves an average score of 82.8 across GenEval and DPG-Bench and 75.3 across VQAv2, MMBench, and POPE, remaining competitive with unified models trained on substantially more data. Under matched data, optimization, and parameter budgets, Multimodal Flow further outperforms representative hybrid and discrete models. These results establish continuous chunk-based embedding flow modeling as a new fully continuous paradigm for unified multimodal modeling. The related code and model are publicly released at https://github.com/hustvl/Multimodal-Flow.

</details>


<div id='cs.CL'></div>

# cs.CL [[Back]](#toc)

### [189] [Large Language Models are Approximate Survival Estimators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38181)
*Juan M Zambrano Chaves,Peniel Argaw,Risa Ueno,Carlo Bifulco,Kristina Young,Rom Leidner,Tristan Naumann,Hoifung Poon*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 Survprompt 框架，将结构化患者协变量转为临床文本暗语，零样本提示 LLM 预测生存时间；在 MSK-CHORD 与 Providence 两个泛癌队列上与 RSF 等传统生存模型对比，LLM 预测误差意外接近甚至局部优于专用模型，但跨癌种、跨机构表现不稳定且风险分层（c-index）较差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生存分析用于从患者协变量估计事件发生时间，是医学风险评估的核心工具。患者确诊后可能借助消费级应用中易于获取的大语言模型获取预后信息，但 LLM 能否给出准确的生存预测尚缺乏严格评估。

Method: 提出 Survprompt 框架：将结构化患者协变量转换为自由文本临床暗语（vignette），以零样本方式提示预训练 LLM 预测生存。在两个多机构泛癌队列上基准测试：公开的 MSK-CHORD 队列，以及基于 LLM 医学信息抽取框架新构建的 Providence St. Joseph Health Network 队列。对照传统生存模型（含随机生存森林 RSF），报告删失平均绝对误差（cMAE）与一致性指数（c-index），并进行特征消融以识别影响 LLM 预测的变量。

Result: 前沿 LLM 在个体生存时间上取得意外有竞争力的 cMAE：如 GPT-5.6-Sol 在若干癌种上 cMAE 与专门训练的 SOTA RSF 相差在 10% 以内，在 MSK-CHORD 前列腺癌上 cMAE 低于 RSF。特征消融显示 LLM 对临床变量的优先级排序与专用生存模型相似。但 LLM 在不同癌种与机构间准确性不一致，且高风险与低风险患者区分能力差（c-index 较低）。

Conclusion: 零样本 LLM 无需专门训练即可生成意外准确的预后估计，但其跨癌种、跨机构的可变性能仍是临床应用中重要局限。

Abstract: Survival analysis estimates time-to-event outcomes from patient covariates and is widely used for medical risk assessment. Patients seeking prognostic information after a diagnosis may turn to large language models (LLMs), now readily accessible through consumer applications. However, whether LLMs can provide accurate survival predictions has not been rigorously evaluated. We introduce Survprompt, a framework that converts structured patient covariates into free-text clinical vignettes and prompts pre-trained LLMs to predict survival zero-shot. We benchmark Survprompt against conventional survival models, including random survival forests (RSF), across two multi-institutional pan-cancer cohorts: the publicly available MSK-CHORD cohort and a newly curated cohort from the Providence St. Joseph Health Network constructed using an LLM-based medical abstraction framework. We report censored mean absolute error (cMAE) and concordance index (c-index) and conduct feature ablations to identify variables influencing LLM predictions. Frontier LLMs achieved surprisingly competitive cMAE for individual survival times. For example, GPT-5.6-Sol achieved cMAE within 10% of state-of-the-art RSF models specifically trained for survival prediction for several cancer types and lower cMAE than RSF for prostate cancer in MSK-CHORD. Feature ablations revealed that LLMs prioritized clinical variables similarly to specialized survival models. However, LLMs showed inconsistent accuracy across cancer types and institutions and poorly discriminated between high- and low-risk patients (lower c-index). Zero-shot LLMs can generate surprisingly accurate prognostic estimates without specialized training, but their variable performance across cancer types and institutions remains an important limitation for clinical use.

</details>


### [190] [TomasuLLM: Out-of-Order Speculative Execution for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38201)
*Jiangnan Yu,Ceyu Xu,Mengming Li,Shiyu Huang,Yiran Xia,Jian Weng,Hui Xue,Haohui Mai,Yuan Xie*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: TomasuLLM 是一个将乱序执行与推测机制引入编码智能体的运行时，通过预测并提前执行未来的工具调用（在隔离的写时复制沙箱中），再按轨迹顺序验证并提交结果，从而在不破坏正确性的前提下显著降低工具调用延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长耗时工具（编译器、测试套件、仓库命令）需数秒至数分钟，而智能体在此期间处于空闲等待，造成严重延迟瓶颈。这一问题与乱序处理器面临的困境相同：顺序接口掩盖了本可预测并提前启动的工作，但推测结果需在自身及所有前序步骤验证后才能对外可见。

Method: TomasuLLM 运行时以非轨迹顺序执行智能体工具调用：先草拟未来动作，在隔离的写时复制（copy-on-write）沙箱中运行，追踪其依赖关系与副作用，仅在基于已提交状态完成验证后，按轨迹顺序提交结果。

Result: 在覆盖亚秒级到分钟级工具调用的三个基准上，TomasuLLM 提升了报告基准均值并随工具延迟扩展：SWE-bench Verified 100 项任务上 1.31 倍、Terminal-Bench 2.0 的 28 项任务上 1.35 倍、SWE-Marathon 18 个会话上匹配进度 1.27 倍；在 4,010 条经审计的提交验证记录中，零误接受。

Conclusion: 通过乱序推测执行与顺序验证提交相结合，TomasuLLM 能在保证任务执行正确性的前提下有效缓解长耗时工具带来的智能体延迟，且加速比随工具延迟增加而扩大，验证过程未出现误接受，证明了该方法的有效性与可靠性。

Abstract: Long-running tools can dominate coding-agent latency: compilers, test suites, and repository commands take seconds to minutes while the agent idles. This observation stall presents the same tension that drove out-of-order processors -- asequential interface hides work that can be predicted and started early, but a speculative result may become visible only after it and every earlier step have been validated.
  We present TomasuLLM, a runtime that executes agent tool calls out of trajectory order while preserving task-execution correctness. It drafts future actions, runs them in isolated copy-on-write sandboxes, traces their dependencies and effects, and commits results in trajectory order only after validation against committed state. Across three benchmarks spanning sub-second to minutes-long tool calls, TomasuLLM improves the reported benchmark means and scales with tool latency: 1.31x on 100 SWE-bench Verified tasks, 1.35x on 28 Terminal-Bench 2.0 tasks, and 1.27x matched progress on 18 SWE-Marathon sessions. Across 4,010 audited commit-validation records, it produces zero false accepts.

</details>


### [191] [Automatic estimation of verbal fluency index in people with Motor Neuron Disease using ASR alignment and pause modelling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38203)
*Bahman Mirheidari,Leslie Ing,Daniel Blackburn,Sharon Abrahams,Christopher McDermott,Heidi Christensen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究提出自动化言语系统估计运动神经元病（MND）患者的言语流畅性指数（VFI），结合WhisperX、Silero与精化时间戳，性能优于传统声学特征与自监督嵌入，最佳模型P-words达R² 0.9、NRMSE 0.05。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MND患者认知障碍（CI）监测对及时治疗与护理至关重要，但共病言语困难使其评估具有挑战性。ECAS是CI评估的稳健工具，其中VFI是核心成分，因此需要自动化的VFI估计方法。

Method: 基于独特MND数据集，结合ASR（WhisperX）与VAD（Silero）及精化时间戳，预测VFI并提取若干临床可解释的度量；采用多种回归算法，与基于传统声学特征和自监督嵌入的系统进行对比。

Result: 方法优于传统声学特征和自监督嵌入系统；临床启发特征持续优于其他特征集。最佳模型：P-words R² 0.9、NRMSE 0.05；S-words R² 0.8、NRMSE 0.08。

Conclusion: 证明了自动化VFI估计的可行性，临床启发特征在MND患者的言语流畅性评估中具有显著优势。

Abstract: Monitoring cognitive impairment (CI) in motor neuron disease (MND) is essential for timely treatment and care, yet challenging due to co-occurring speech difficulties. The Edinburgh Cognitive and Behavioural ALS Screen (ECAS) provides a robust metric for CI assessment, with the Verbal Fluency Index (VFI) a central element. Building on recent advances in automated speech analysis, this study proposes a system for estimating VFI.
