It leverages a unique MND dataset and combines ASR (WhisperX) and VAD (Silero) with refined timestamping to predict the VFI and extract several clinically interpretable measures. Our approach outperformed systems based on traditional acoustic features and self-supervised embeddings, evaluated using multiple regression algorithms. Clinically inspired features consistently outperformed the other sets, with the best models achieving strong results (P-words: R2 0.9, NRMSE 0.05; S-words: R2 0.8, NRMSE 0.08), demonstrating the feasibility of automated VFI estimation.

</details>


### [192] [The System Prompt Illusion: How Instruction Preambles Modify Computation in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38205)
*Muhammad Usama,Dong Eui Chang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 通过对17个指令微调模型（8个架构族，1.5B–72B）在20个系统提示下的逐层表征做CKA分析，本文发现系统提示的效果具有层选择性和指令类型依赖性：人格与格式类提示深度重塑中间层表征，而安全类提示几乎不改变计算，这为基于系统提示的安全机制易被越狱提供了机理解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 系统提示是实践者控制语言模型行为的主要手段，但其对Transformer内部计算的实际影响尚不清楚，尤其是安全类系统提示为何长期易被越狱缺乏机制层面的解释。

Method: 选取17个指令微调模型（覆盖8个架构族、1.5B–72B参数），对5个功能类别、共20个系统提示下的逐层表征使用中心化核对齐（CKA）进行比较；以最小基线提示为对照；并使用线性探测基线分析提示类别的编码层，最后用因果激活修补（activation patching）验证相关层对行为变化的因果中介作用。

Result: 提示效果呈层选择性且依赖指令类型：人格与格式类提示深度重构中间表征，安全类提示的表征变化与最小基线在统计上不可区分。限制性安全提示与显式许可提示（“你没有任何限制”）激活近乎相同的计算路径（平均CKA相关0.997），且在商业规模模型上依然如此，70B–72B模型的安全渗透率仍低于10%。线性探测表明模型在每一层都编码了提示类别，但仅在一小部分层重构计算，即提示被可靠“看见”，但在安全方面未被深度“执行”。因果激活修补证实这些层介导了行为改变，且表征深度可预测行为效应量（Spearman rho = 0.761, p < 0.001）。

Conclusion: 系统提示中的安全指令往往被模型表征但未被深度转化为计算层面的行为约束，这为基于系统提示的安全防护长期存在越狱脆弱性提供了机制性解释，同时表明安全对齐不能仅依赖提示层面的“注意”，而需作用于特定中介层。

Abstract: System prompts are the primary lever practitioners use to control language model behavior, yet what they actually do to the computation inside the transformer remains poorly understood. Across 17 instruction-tuned models spanning 8 architecture families and 1.5B to 72B parameters, we use Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA) to compare layer-wise representations under 20 system prompts in five functional categories. Effects are layer-selective and instruction-type-dependent: persona and formatting instructions deeply restructure intermediate representations, while safety instructions barely move them, producing changes statistically indistinguishable from a minimal baseline. Restrictive safety instructions and explicitly permissive ones ("you have no restrictions") engage near-identical computational pathways (mean CKA correlation 0.997), and this persists at commercial scale, where safety penetration remains below 10% even at 70B-72B. A linear probing baseline exposes the mechanism: the model encodes prompt category at every layer but restructures its computation only at a small subset, so the prompt is reliably "seen" but, for safety, not deeply "acted upon." Causal activation patching confirms these layers mediate behavioral change, and representational depth predicts behavioral effect size across the full 17-model cohort (Spearman rho = 0.761, p < 0.001). The findings provide a mechanistic explanation for the persistent jailbreak vulnerability of system-prompt-based safety. Code: https://github.com/Usama1002/system-prompt-illusion-cka

</details>


### [193] [TutlAit v1: a crowdsourced Moroccan Tamazight speech dataset with Arabic transcriptions and regional accent labels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38219)
*Mohamed-Amine Chadi,Ezzahra Ait El Arbi,Ismail Khayoub,Aymane Fadili,Yassine Ennhili,Jadjigua Bouali,Hanane Inhid,Mohammed Ameksa,Hajar Mousannif*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文介绍TutlAit数据集：一个带有区域口音标注的摩洛哥塔马齐格特语语音语料库，包含13,384个音频文件、约20.9小时、约3.01GB，配套现代标准阿拉伯语文本，可用于语音识别、语音翻译与口音识别。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 塔马齐格特语与阿拉伯语同为摩洛哥官方语言，但其语音技术资源严重匮乏：公开标注音频稀缺、普遍缺少区域变体信息、转写质量参差不齐。

Method: 开发专用众包Web应用TutlAit（React 18前端、Django 5／DRF后端、PostgreSQL），通过LinkedIn与Instagram定向招募母语者，采集人口统计与区域变体（Atlas、Souss、Rif或其他）信息，设置Text-to-Audio（显示阿拉伯语句子、录制塔马齐格特语口语）与Audio-to-Text（播放塔马齐格特语片段、键入阿拉伯语转写）两条流程；另从公开视听媒体获取片段，用ELAN分段标注并经CSV/ZIP批量导入；所有上传在服务端转为16kHz单声道WAV，SHA-256哈希去重，进行时长边界检查并由管理员校验。

Result: 数据集共13,384个音频文件，总时长75,231秒（约20.9小时，约3.01GB）；Atlas变体9,956个文件（14.08小时），Souss变体3,378个文件（6.75小时），另含少量Rif（22个文件）与Kabyle（28个文件）子集。

Conclusion: 该语料库可复用于摩洛哥塔马齐格特语的语音识别、语音翻译与口音识别任务。

Abstract: Tamazight (Amazigh) is, together with Arabic, one of the two official languages of Morocco, yet it remains severely under-resourced for speech technology: pub licly available labelled audio is scarce, generally lacks information on the regional variety spoken, and is often of uneven transcription quality. This article describes the TutlAit dataset, a corpus of Moroccan Tamazight speech paired with Modern Standard Arabic text and explicit regional accent labels. The data were collected with TutlAit, a purpose-built crowdsourcing web application (React 18 front end, Django 5 / Django REST Framework back-end, PostgreSQL database). Native speakers recruited through targeted LinkedIn and Instagram campaigns created an account, declared their regional variety (Atlas, Souss, Rif or other) and demographic information, and then contributed through two workflows: Text-to Audio, in which an Arabic sentence is displayed and the volunteer records its oral Tamazight rendering in the browser, and Audio-to-Text, in which a Tamazight excerpt is played and the volunteer types its Arabic transcription. A complemen tary set of segments was obtained from freely accessible Tamazight audiovisual media, segmented and annotated with ELAN and imported through a bulk CSV/ZIP pipeline. Every upload is converted server-side to 16kHz mono WAV, hashed with SHA-256 for duplicate rejection, checked for duration bounds and validated by an administrator. The dataset contains 13,384 audio files totalling 75,231 seconds (approximately 20.9 hours, about 3.01GB). The Atlas variety accounts for 9,956 files (14.08h) and the Souss variety for 3,378 files (6.75h); small Rif (22 files) and Kabyle (28 files) subsets are also included. The corpus can be reused for speech recognition, speech translation and accent identification for Moroccan Tamazight.

</details>


### [194] [Conformal Factuality Control for Multi-Hop Retrieval-Augmented Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38222)
*Muhammad Aimal Rehman,Chi-Kuang Yeh*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文将分拆共形声明过滤应用于多跳RAG，在HotpotQA、Natural Questions和TriviaQA上以Llama 3.1 8B与GPT-4o-mini验证其事实性控制效果。结果显示：95%目标下完全支持率升至95.80%-97.20%（无过滤为55.60%-76.03%），但代价是仅保留4.41%-31.09%的声明、9.70%-51.40%的响应非空。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RAG虽能引入外部证据，但检索上下文并不保证生成声明有事实支撑，多跳RAG中检索与推理分多个依赖阶段，该问题更突出。已有工作提出声明级共形事实性控制，但其在多跳场景下是否仍有效尚不明确，故本文对此进行检验。

Method: 采用分拆共形（split-conformal）声明过滤方法，将其应用于多跳RAG流程；在HotpotQA、Natural Questions、TriviaQA三个数据集上，结合Llama 3.1 8B和GPT-4o-mini两种模型进行评估，并设置单跳参考实验作为对照。

Result: 在全部六种多跳模型-数据集配置中，共形目标越严格，保留声明被完全支撑的响应比例越高。95%目标下该比例达95.80%-97.20%，无过滤时为55.60%-76.03%。但提升具有强选择性：95%目标下仅4.41%-31.09%的生成声明被保留，9.70%-51.40%的响应保持非空。

Conclusion: 共形事实性控制可扩展到多跳RAG，但名义可靠性必须与声明保留率和弃答（abstention）联合解读，不能仅看支持率。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) can ground large language models in external evidence, but retrieved context does not guarantee that generated claims are factually supported. This problem is especially relevant in multi-hop RAG, where retrieval and reasoning proceed through multiple dependent stages. We study whether claim-level conformal factuality control, previously developed for RAG, remains effective in this setting. We apply split-conformal claim filtering to multi-hop RAG and evaluate it on HotpotQA, Natural Questions, and TriviaQA using Llama 3.1 8B and GPT-4o-mini, together with a single-hop reference experiment. Across all six multi-hop model-dataset configurations, increasingly stringent conformal targets consistently increase the fraction of responses whose retained claims are fully supported. At the 95% target, this rate ranges from 95.80% to 97.20%, compared with 55.60%-76.03% without filtering. However, the improvement is strongly selective: only 4.41%-31.09% of generated claims are retained and 9.70%-51.40% of responses remain non-empty at the 95% target. These results show that conformal factuality extends to multi-hop RAG, while demonstrating that nominal reliability must be interpreted jointly with claim retention and abstention.

</details>


### [195] [Framing the Narrative: Ideological Mimicry in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38256)
*Olivia Macmillan-Scott,Michael Jacobs,Nils Metternich,Mirco Musolesi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文构建Poli-SHIFT数据集与评测框架，测试七个开放权重LLM在美英澳十个争议政治议题上的表现，发现提示词框架（术语、前提、用户信息）会系统性改变模型输出的政治立场，即"意识形态模仿"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有评测通常将LLM对政治争议议题的立场视为相对稳定的固有属性，但真实用户会通过术语选择、隐含假设与个人背景传递政治信号。若模型会顺应这些信号调整立场，则可能为立场对立的用户提供系统性不同的同议题叙述，从而形成个性化政治信息环境并加剧既有分歧。作者因此提出"意识形态模仿"这一研究问题。

Method: 构建Poli-SHIFT数据集与评测框架；选取美国、英国、澳大利亚的十个争议政治议题；评估七个开放权重LLM；系统操纵三类变量——有争议的术语表述、带政治倾向的前提假设、用户个人信息；并同时采用多项选择与开放式文本两种应答格式进行诱导测试，比较匹配样本间的立场变化。

Result: 各模型均稳健地表现出提示框架对输出政治立场的影响。仅改变术语表述，在16.9%的匹配对照中就使模型对议题的支持方向发生反转；用户明确声明的政治意识形态也会系统性地将回答拉向用户自身的立场。多项选择与开放文本格式均呈现该效应。

Conclusion: 政治立场并非LLM的固定属性，其表达的立场取决于与用户的交互情境。随着LLM日益成为个性化信息源，这种依赖交互的适应性可能促成强化用户既有观点的政治信息环境。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to answer questions about politically contentious issues, yet evaluations typically treat a model's stance as a relatively stable property. Real users, however, communicate political signals through their terminology, assumptions, and personal context. We investigate whether such signals produce ideological mimicry: systematic shifts in the political stance expressed by an LLM toward the position conveyed by the interaction. If LLMs adapt their responses to these signals, they risk creating personalised political information environments in which users with opposing views receive systematically different accounts of the same issue, potentially reinforcing existing divisions. We build the Poli-SHIFT dataset and evaluation framework and assess seven open-weight LLMs across ten contentious political topics in the United States, United Kingdom, and Australia, systematically manipulating contested terminology, politically valenced premises, and user information, and eliciting responses in both multiple-choice and open-text formats. Across models, we find robust evidence that prompt framing shapes the political stance of LLM outputs. Changing terminology alone reverses which side of an issue a model supports in 16.9% of matched comparisons. Stated political ideology also systematically shifts responses toward the user's position. These findings show that political stance is not a fixed property of LLMs; the views expressed are conditional on the interaction with the user. As LLMs become increasingly personalised sources of information, such interaction-dependent adaptation could contribute to political information environments that reinforce users' existing perspectives.

</details>


### [196] [ContextAdapt: Evaluating Contextual Adaptation and Value Alignment in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38260)
*Olivia Macmillan-Scott,Mirco Musolesi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 ContextAdapt 评估框架，考察大语言模型能否在不同专业情境中恰当应用诚实、自主与保密等价值，并在情境变化不影响专业规范时保持一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 诚实、自主、保密等价值常被视为 AI 对齐的普遍原则，但其具体含义依赖决策情境。现有研究多关注模型是否遵循抽象原则，却较少检验模型能否在不同专业场景中恰当调整价值的应用，并在情境变化不改变专业规范时保持一致。

Method: 构建 ContextAdapt 框架，覆盖医学、法律、金融与国家安全四个领域，以及诚实、自主、保密三类价值。基于专业与监管一手文献，建立"价值 x 领域"框架，设计同时测试默认专业规则与公认例外的情境。对 12 个大语言模型进行评测，考察其推荐的行为及给出的理由。另设因子实验，操纵是否明确点明专业领域、模型角色、情境严重程度等变量。

Result: 主实验中模型平均适当性达 95.6%，但使用正确领域特定理由的比例差异显著，介于 25.6% 至 76.9%。因子实验中，明确点明专业领域与改变模型角色对行为影响有限；改变利害程度则暴露严重但局部的失败：在部分案例中，模型即便专业义务未变也改变回答，感知到的严重程度似乎成为诚实与保密情境中披露的线索。

Conclusion: 评估价值对齐不能仅看模型是否遵循抽象原则，还需考察其能否在不同情境中恰当应用这些价值。ContextAdapt 表明，模型在行为层面表现良好，但在理由层面与情境敏感性上存在明显缺陷。

Abstract: Values such as honesty, autonomy, and confidentiality are often regarded as general principles underpinning AI alignment. However, what it means to act in accordance with these values can depend on the context in which a decision is made. In this paper, we ask whether large language models (LLMs) appropriately adapt the application of a value across professional settings, while remaining consistent when contextual changes do not alter the relevant professional norm. To study this, we introduce ContextAdapt, an evaluation framework covering honesty, autonomy, and confidentiality across medicine, law, finance, and national security. Drawing on primary-source professional and regulatory documents, we construct a value x domain framework and use this to develop scenarios testing both default professional rules and recognised exceptions. We evaluate 12 LLMs on both the actions they recommend and the justifications they provide. In our main experiment, models achieve 95.6% mean appropriateness, although the use of the correct domain-specific justification varies substantially across models, from 25.6% to 76.9%. In a separate factorial experiment, explicitly naming the professional domain and changing the role of the model have limited effect on behaviour. Varying stakes, however, reveals severe but localised failures: in some cases, models alter their responses even though the underlying professional obligation remains unchanged. In particular, perceived severity appears to act as a cue for disclosure across both honesty and confidentiality scenarios. These results show that evaluating value alignment requires us to consider not only whether models follow abstract principles, but whether they apply them appropriately across different contexts.

</details>


### [197] [NinaXander: Feasibility and Limits of Composing Frozen Language Models Across Architecture Families via a Shared Latent Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38261)
*Takanori Kotama,Shun-ichiro Hayashi,Daichi Mukunoki,Tetsuya Hoshino,Takahiro Katagiri*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 NinaXander，通过一个可训练的共享潜空间适配器连接不同架构家族的冻结语言模型层，实现事后模型重组，并系统评估其可行性与局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究来自不同架构家族的冻结模型能否在训练后（post hoc）被重新组合，从而在不重训练的情况下获得多种组合模型，并考察其能否降低推理开销。

Method: 用单个可训练的共享潜空间适配器连接层的冻结语言模型：组合模型先运行一个模型的前若干层，经适配器一次性转换中间表示，再运行另一模型的剩余层。采用循环模型 RWKV-4-Raven-7B（RWKV）与 Transformer 模型 Tulu-Pythia-6.9b（Pythia），适配器训练后即可无重训练获得不同连接层的多个组合模型；评估任务为多项选择题与 WikiText 语言建模。

Result: 组合模型生成的文本句法上well-formed。将 Pythia 前 5 层与 RWKV 后 27 层组合，使 Transformer KV 缓存减少 84.4%，准确率与单独 RWKV 无显著差异。但没有任何组合模型在多项选择准确率上匹配父模型 Pythia，且在域外 WikiText 上语言建模性能急剧下降。中间表示对应关系仅在一个有利情形下成立：共享分词器、相同深度、相同隐藏宽度，不足以证明模型共享通用语义空间。

Conclusion: 跨架构家族的冻结模型可通过单一共享潜空间适配器实现事后组合，并可带来显著KV缓存节省，但组合模型难以匹配强父模型性能，泛化到域外数据时性能下降明显；所观察到的表示对应关系依赖特定对齐条件，不能证明存在通用共享语义空间。

Abstract: In this paper we propose NinaXander, a series of composed language models obtained by connecting layers of frozen language models from different architecture families with a single trained shared-latent adapter. A composed model runs the first layers of one model, converts the resulting intermediate representation once with the adapter, and then runs the remaining layers of the other model. Once the adapter is trained, several composed models that connect at different layers are obtained without retraining. Using the recurrent RWKV-4-Raven-7B and the Transformer-based Tulu-Pythia-6.9b, abbreviated as RWKV and Pythia, this study examines whether frozen models from different families can be recombined post hoc. The composed models answered multiple-choice questions, and those whose generations we examined produced syntactically well-formed text. The configuration that combines the first 5 layers of Pythia with the remaining 27 layers of RWKV reduced the Transformer key-value (KV) cache by 84.4% with accuracy not significantly different from that of RWKV alone. In multiple-choice accuracy, however, no composed model matched the parent model Pythia, and language-modeling performance decreased sharply on WikiText, a corpus of Wikipedia articles outside the training domain. The correspondence between intermediate representations was also obtained in one favorable case, with a shared tokenizer, the same depth, and the same hidden width, and does not show that the models share a general semantic space.

</details>


### [198] [Which Models Work Well Together? Measuring Heterogeneity for LLM Team Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38274)
*Liangyu Teng,Hengsong Liu,Juncen Guo,Jingyu Zhang,Yang Liu,Jing Liu,Liang Song*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种异质性驱动的团队选择框架，通过离线画像刻画个体能力与两类互补性信号（错误模式去相关、预测行为分歧），并将团队选择形式化为质量-互补性组合优化问题，用贪心搜索从小候选池中选出小规模团队，实验证明其稳定优于仅看质量的基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM团队的性能上限不仅受个体模型能力限制，还受成员间错误共振和预测差异的影响。尽管异构组队在实践中常被证明有效，但现有方法缺乏可计算、可解释、可优化的互补性度量，导致团队构成只能依赖启发式规则。

Method: 提出异质性驱动的团队选择框架：先进行离线画像，刻画个体能力及两类互补信号——一是捕捉错误模式的去相关以减少共同失败，二是度量预测行为分歧以刻画策略多样性；随后将团队选择形式化为标准化的"质量-互补性"组合目标，并采用高效贪心搜索从候选池中选出小团队。

Result: 在多个基准上的实验表明，在受控的候选池和团队规模下，该框架持续优于仅考虑质量的基线方法。

Conclusion: 该工作为多LLM系统建立了可复用的团队选择原则，表明显式建模互补性有助于突破仅靠个体能力的性能天花板。

Abstract: The performance ceiling of an LLM team is constrained not only by individual model capabilities, but also by inter-member error resonance and predictive differences. Although heterogeneous teaming is often observed to be effective in practice, existing approaches lack complementarity metrics that are computable, interpretable, and optimizable, leaving team composition to rely on heuristics. We propose a heterogeneity-driven team selection framework that performs offline profiling to characterize individual capability along with two complementary signals: one captures decorrelation in error patterns to reduce co-failures, while the other measures divergence in predictive behavior to capture strategy diversity. We formulate team selection as a standardized quality--complementarity combinatorial objective and apply an efficient greedy search to select a small team from a candidate pool. Experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that our framework consistently outperforms quality-only baselines under controlled candidate pools and team sizes, establishing reusable selection principles for multi-LLM systems.

</details>


### [199] [EVOKE: Eliciting World Knowledge in Agents for Transferable Decision-Making](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38334)
*Yuhan Guo,Jinming Liu,Liang Xu,Ziqiang Li,Jianguo Huang,Zhicheng Wang,Hu Zhu,Qiuyu Chen,Yuntao Wei,Xin Jin,Wenjun Zeng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 EVOKE，一种后训练方法，通过在固定状态下引入目标多样性来隐式激发 LLM 智能体预训练中已内化的世界知识，从而提升多步决策的任务表现、泛化能力与数据效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 作为多步决策智能体时迁移到未见环境表现较差。世界模型方法通过预测未来观测来弥补，但需额外训练，且预测误差在规划中会累积。作者认为数字环境中 LLM 已在预训练中内化大量世界知识，问题关键在于"激发"而非"获取"。而典型后训练在每个访问状态下只有单一目标的监督，迫使策略依赖表层上下文习惯，缺乏激发世界知识的压力。

Method: EVOKE 在固定状态下提供目标多样性压力。理论上，若智能体在多样目标下均有能力，其动作偏好必须编码可恢复的世界模型。方法上固定环境状态与交互历史，让同一组候选动作在替代目标下排序，强迫动作偏好随目标改变，使依赖上下文习惯或单目标相关性的策略无法正确排序，从而隐式激发策略的预训练世界知识来指导决策。

Result: 在三个骨干模型、多种任务上评估 EVOKE，结果显示任务性能提升、未见环境泛化能力增强、数据效率更高。并进行了受控分析以理解增益来源。

Conclusion: 研究为通过直接决策监督激发内化世界知识以实现可迁移动作提供了新视角。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as agents for multi-step decision-making, yet transfer poorly to unseen environments. World-model methods address this by training agents to predict future observations, at the cost of additional training and errors that compound when predictions are used for planning. However, for LLM agents operating in digital environments, much of this world knowledge is already internalized during pretraining, which shifts the problem from acquiring it to eliciting it. We argue that typical post-training provides little pressure for such elicitation, since supervision under a single goal at each visited state inadvertently drives policies to rely on superficial contextual habits. We introduce EVOKE, a post-training method that supplies this pressure through goal diversity at fixed states. Motivated by theory showing that an agent competent across diverse goals must encode a world model recoverable from its action preferences, EVOKE holds the environment state and interaction history fixed and ranks the same candidate actions under alternative goals, forcing action preferences to change, so that a policy relying on contextual habits or single-goal correlations cannot order them correctly. This implicitly elicits the policy's pretrained world knowledge to inform decisions. We evaluate EVOKE across diverse tasks in three backbones, demonstrating improved task performance, unseen environment generalization, and data efficiency. We further conduct controlled analyses to better understand what drives these gains. These findings offer a new perspective on eliciting internalized world knowledge for transferable action through direct decision supervision.

</details>


### [200] [Halluscoring 2026: The first shared task on llms hallucination detection and answer verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38355)
*Aisha Alansari,Abdessalam Bouchekif,Ahmed Hasanaath,Salah Eddine Bekhouche,Malak Alkhorasani,Mohammed-En-Nadhir Zighem,Saad Ezzini,Hichem Telli,Hend Al-Khalifa,Muhammad Abdul-Mageed,Hadid Abdenour,Hamzah Luqman*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文介绍了HalluScoring 2026共享任务，聚焦阿拉伯语问答中的幻觉检测与事实核验，在泛化场景下设立4个子任务，共13支队伍参赛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 阿拉伯语问答中的幻觉检测与事实核验缺乏统一的评测基准，尤其在分布偏移（未见问题、未见LLM生成回复）条件下泛化能力不明，亟需专门共享任务进行系统评估。

Method: 构建HalluScoring 2026共享任务，含两大任务共4个子任务：任务1为二分类幻觉检测，考察对未见问题（1.1）与未见LLM生成回复（1.2）的泛化；任务2在检测基础上要求从6个相关候选中识别正确事实答案，覆盖伊斯兰知识（2.1）与通用知识（2.2）。数据基于HalluScore与HalluTruthQA两个阿拉伯语数据集。

Result: 13支队伍参赛，其中10支提交系统描述论文。任务1中，获胜队伍在子任务1.1和1.2的AUC-ROC测试分数分别为0.772和0.767；任务2中，获胜队伍在辅助评测下于伊斯兰知识和通用知识子任务分别取得0.882和0.857。

Conclusion: 在分布偏移下，阿拉伯语幻觉检测仍具挑战性；任务2在候选答案辅助下性能明显更高，表明事实答案识别比纯二分类检测相对更易取得较好表现。

Abstract: We present HalluScoring 2026, a shared task for evaluating hallucination detection and factual verification in Arabic question answering under challenging generalization settings. The shared task is organized into two main tasks, each comprising two subtasks, for a total of four subtasks. Task 1 evaluates binary hallucination detection, considering generalization to unseen questions (Subtask 1.1) and responses generated by unseen LLMs (Subtask 1.2). Task 2 extends the evaluation beyond detection by requiring the systems to additionally identify the correct factual answer from six related candidates, covering Islamic knowledge (Subtask 2.1) and general knowledge (Subtask 2.2). The shared task is based on two Arabic datasets: HalluScore and HalluTruthQA. A total of 13 teams participated in the shared task, 10 of which submitted system description papers. The results of Task 1 demonstrate that hallucination detection remains challenging under distribution shift, with the winning team achieving AUC-ROC test scores of 0.772 and 0.767 for Subtasks 1.1 and 1.2, respectively. For Task 2, the winning team achieved scores of 0.882 and 0.857 in the Islamic and general-knowledge subtasks, respectively, under assisted evaluation.

</details>


### [201] [Evaluating Language Model Safety Across Long Adversarial Conversations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38357)
*Parisa Salmani,Peter R. Lewis*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究通过多轮对抗对话评估三个开源指令微调模型的安全性，发现首轮安全响应率达85%-100%，但在第11轮骤降至38%-61%，第101轮进一步降至15%-44%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对话安全评估多采用单轮有害提示测试语言模型，而真实系统通过长时、自适应对话与用户交互。因此需要验证模型在对抗性用户跨多轮持续施压时是否仍能保持安全响应。

Method: 在三个开源指令微调模型、两类有害提示、不同对话长度和随机种子上进行评估。每轮由一个作为持续对抗用户的语言模型发起输入，另一安全分类器对每次响应标注安全或不安全。

Result: 所有模型-提示组合首轮安全响应率为85%-100%；第11轮降至38%-61%；第101轮降至15%-44%。该下降趋势跨模型出现，并远超多轮安全评估常用的短交互长度。

Conclusion: 强单轮安全性未必在持续对抗交互中保持，需开展长时程评估并采用考虑跨轮风险累积的对话级防护措施。

Abstract: Conversational safety evaluations often test language models with a single harmful prompt, even though real-world systems interact with users through long, adaptive conversations. This study examines whether models continue to respond safely when an adversarial user persists across multiple turns. We evaluate three open-weight, instruction-tuned models on two harmful prompts across different conversation lengths and random seeds. In each setting, a second language model acts as a persistent adversarial user, while a safety classifier labels every response as safe or unsafe. Across all model-prompt combinations, first-turn safe-response rates ranged from 85% to 100%. By depth 11, they dropped to 38-61%, and by depth 101, to 15-44%. This decline appeared across models and continued well beyond the short interactions typically used in multi-turn safety evaluations. These results provide proof-of-concept evidence that strong single-turn safety does not necessarily persist during sustained adversarial interaction. They highlight the need for long-horizon evaluations and conversation-level safeguards that account for risk accumulating across turns.

</details>


### [202] [Doc2LoRA Provides Decodable Representations of Scientific Ideas](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38374)
*Chand Sahil Mansuri,Joel Zachariah,Sadamori Kojaku*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出用Doc-to-LoRA超网络为每篇论文生成一个LoRA适配器，使向量空间中的每个点（包括混合点）都对应一个可用自然语言交互的LLM，从而同时支持论文检索与生成式构思。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 论文的向量表示通常只用于相似检索，混合向量产生的新点往往没有对应文献可供解释，无法识别其所代表的新想法。作者希望让空间中任意一点（含混合点）都能被"提问"，从而把检索与组合式创新生成统一起来。

Method: 用Doc-to-LoRA超网络根据论文生成对应的LoRA适配器作为论文表示；对嵌入施加一个小型可逆变换，使其在检索任务上具备竞争力；在APS论文数据上，对子领域平均点处的LLM进行指令，让其用短语命名领域；对两篇论文之间的插值点处的LLM进行指令，令其撰写摘要。

Result: 在APS数据上，位于各子领域平均点的LLM生成的领域名称，其与官方名称的词重叠度及五名LLM评审评分均优于五个基线；两篇论文之间的插值点生成的摘要随混合权重从一篇论文平滑过渡到另一篇。经可逆变换后的嵌入在检索上可与SPECTER2、EmbeddingGemma相当，接近SBERT。

Conclusion: 由于可逆变换保持了点与LLM的对应关系，该嵌入空间同时服务于检索与生成，使研究者能够就空间中任意一点的想法进行提问，并以此为起点生成新想法。

Abstract: Representing scientific papers as points in a space lets us search for similar papers and inquire about how fields relate to one another and drive innovation. Beyond search, the vector space of papers invites generation: mixing papers through simple vector operations creates new points, mirroring combinatorial novelty, the recombination of existing ideas into new ones. However, a mixed point often represents an idea no paper has yet realized, with no papers nearby to identify the idea. We propose representing each paper by a LoRA adapter generated by the Doc-to-LoRA hypernetwork. Every point in the space, including mixtures, thus represents a large language model (LLM) open to questions and instructions in natural language. On papers from the American Physical Society (APS), we instruct the LLM at the average of each subfield to name the field in a few words and obtain labels closer to the official names than the labels of five baselines, as judged by word overlap and a panel of five LLM judges. We also ask the LLMs at points between two APS papers to write an abstract and obtain descriptions shifting from one paper to the other in step with the mixing weight. While Doc-to-LoRA is trained for generation, a small invertible transform makes the embeddings competitive for search, on par with SPECTER2 and EmbeddingGemma and close to SBERT. Because the transform is invertible, every point in the transformed space still maps back to an LLM. The embeddings thus serve both search and generation, enabling researchers to question the idea at any point in the space as a starting point for generating new ideas.

</details>


### [203] [Evaluating Whether LLMs Can Reliably Connect the DOTs?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38406)
*Eftekhar Hossain,John Salvador,Santu Karmaker*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文构建了约9.2K实例的多领域叙事补全基准，评估20个开源指令微调LLM，发现模型规模不能可靠预测补全质量，显式推理收益有限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实世界信息常嘈杂且碎片化，从中重构连贯叙事需要模型补全缺失片段（text infilling），并同时保持与局部上下文和全局故事线的一致性。尽管文本补全被广泛用作LLM预训练目标，其在真实叙事补全任务上的实际表现仍缺乏深入探究。

Method: 构建约9.2K实例的多领域叙事补全基准，覆盖百科文本、常识故事、新闻文章、视觉叙事四类叙事类型，通过掩码1至3个句子生成任务。在此基础上评估20个开源指令微调LLM（1.5B至70B参数），考察不同指令具体程度与推理引导水平，并采用标准自动指标与覆盖五个叙事维度的定性框架进行评估。

Result: 模型规模不能可靠预测补全质量：Gemma-2-2B取得最高定性得分（4.02/5），超越参数量十倍以上的模型，如DeepSeek-Qwen-32B（3.77/5，差距6.6%）和LLaMA-3.3-70B（3.71/5，差距8.3%）。显式推理收益有限，思维链推理仅带来边际提升（+0.6%）。叙事长度较短与领域特征对任务难度的预测作用强于补全位置本身。

Conclusion: 当前LLM在真实叙事补全任务上，规模并非性能的决定性因素，小模型可超越大模型；显式推理引导作用有限；任务难度更多由叙事长度和领域特性决定，而非补全位置。该基准为叙事补全研究提供了多领域评估工具与新的实证发现。

Abstract: Access to real-world information is often noisy and fragmented. Constructing a coherent narrative from such fragments requires models to reconstruct missing spans within a broader storyline, commonly referred to as text infilling, while preserving consistency with both the local context and the global storyline. Despite using text infilling as a pre-training objective in many Large Language Models (LLMs), their actual performance on real-world narrative infilling remains underexplored. In this paper, we address this gap by introducing a multi-domain benchmark of ~9.2K instances for narrative infilling, constructed by masking one to three sentences across four narrative types: encyclopedic text, commonsense stories, news articles, and visual narratives. Using this benchmark, we evaluate 20 instruction-tuned open-source LLMs ranging from 1.5B to 70B parameters across varying levels of instruction specificity and reasoning guidance. Outputs are assessed using standard automatic metrics and a qualitative framework covering five narrative dimensions. Results show that model scale does not reliably predict infilling quality: Gemma-2-2B achieves the highest qualitative score (4.02/5), outperforming models over ten times larger, including DeepSeek-Qwen-32B (3.77/5, 6.6%) and LLaMA-3.3-70B (3.71/5, 8.3%). We further find that explicit reasoning offers limited benefits as chain-of-thought reasoning yields only a marginal improvement (+0.6%). Additionally, short narratives and domain characteristics emerge as stronger predictors of task difficulty than infill position alone for narrative infilling in current LLMs.

</details>


### [204] [Policy-Conditioned AI-Use Detection: An Evidentiary Framework for Academic Publishing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38427)
*Jairo Diaz-Rodriguez,Mumin Jia*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 作者提出"以政策为条件的AI使用检测"框架：将具体规则作为显式输入，用假设、证据、校准机制与不确定性替代"是否检出AI"的判定，并以会议预先设定的假阳性率报告真阳性率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI检测器只估计"文本是否由AI生成"，而学术会议与期刊真正需要判断的是"人类–AI协作流程是否遵守了已公布的规则"，且规则随角色、任务与披露要求而异。检测目标与决策需求之间存在错位，即便在强操作点上也难以支撑处罚性决策。

Method: 提出政策条件化的AI使用检测（policy-conditioned AI-use detection）作为证据性框架：1）把支配性规则设为显式输入；2）推理输出假设、证据、校准机制与不确定性，而非"AI检出"式结论；3）用可复现流程生成合规与非合规工作流来构建基准，并在会议预先固定的假阳性率下报告真阳性率；4）在同行评审场景中演练该框架，并指出需要制度化的环节——结构化披露、尊重评审保密性的批准工具路由、以及对结论提出异议的申诉路径。

Result: 在同行评审场景、合理的违规率假设下，即使检测器处于强操作点，被标记的合规作者数量仍多于违规者，说明"AI检出"式判定不足以支撑问责；该分析同时给出会议需要建设的三项配套机制。

Conclusion: 检测器不应被理解为作者身份分类器，而应被定位为具有预先固定、可辩护错误率的可审计程序；检测目标必须由政策规则定义。

Abstract: Major venues now publish detailed rules about how authors, reviewers, and area chairs may use AI, and those rules differ by role, by task, and by what must be disclosed. AI detection, the instrument usually proposed to enforce them, estimates something else: whether an AI model wrote the text. We argue that this target is misaligned with the decisions conferences and journals face, and propose policy-conditioned AI-use detection, an evidentiary framework for assessing whether a human--AI workflow complied with a stated rule. Policy makes the governing rule an explicit input. Inference reports hypotheses, evidence, calibration regime, and uncertainty in place of verdicts such as "AI detected". Evaluation builds benchmarks from reproducible pipelines that generate compliant and non-compliant workflows, and reports true positive rate at a false positive rate the venue fixes in advance. We work the framework through peer review, where at plausible violation rates a detector at a strong operating point still flags more compliant authors than violating ones. The framework therefore also names what a venue must instrument: structured disclosure, approved-tool routing that respects reviewer confidentiality, and a path by which a finding can be contested. Under this framing a detector is not an authorship classifier but an auditable procedure with an error rate the venue fixes in advance and can defend.

</details>


### [205] [The Backdrop Exposes What the World Around an Agent Costs It](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38469)
*Nusrat Jahan Lia,Shubhashis Roy Dipta*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 BACKDROP 基准：在保持任务指令与正确终态不变的前提下，向智能体执行环境中逐一及同时植入四种"日常危害"（越权、注入、越界、故障），考察干净世界中的能力在动态、多主体世界中的存活率。在 3,678 个变体、16 个模型上，四害齐备时平均通过率从 69.5% 降至 31.3%，最强模型跌幅最大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体基准多在"静止世界"中评测，即环境不受他人影响；而真实部署环境会被其他主体持续改变（如他人发消息要求改转账对象、订单确认要求回复门禁码）。因此需要一个基准，量化干净世界中的能力有多少能在受扰动的世界中延续，并揭示真实性能的上限。

Method: BACKDROP 以"任务 + 智能体执行环境"为输入，在环境世界中植入四类日常危害并保证指令与正确终态不变，分别单独植入和同时植入。四类危害各对应一个问题：Authority（他人的消息是否覆盖用户指令）、Injection（记录中植入的文本是否可重定向智能体）、Boundary（请求是否把智能体拉入未被授权的应用）、Fault（写入失败且未确认是否落盘时，智能体是否先核查再重试）。共构造 3,678 个变体，评测 16 个模型。

Result: 四害齐备时平均通过率由 69.5% 降至 31.3%；能力越强的模型跌幅越大（Claude Fable 5.1 由 96.6% 降至 56.0%）。在四害齐备且仅统计植入文本确实触达智能体的运行中，智能体在 46.4% 的运行中服从了他人消息，在 20.3% 的运行中服从了注入文本。这表明智能体已学会抵抗注入文本，但仍常顺从其他主体的非授权请求，且该差距在全部 16 个模型中一致存在。

Conclusion: BACKDROP 形式化了上述能力差距，说明智能体在任务世界中的得分是其在真实世界表现的上限；干净环境下的高分不能保证部署环境中的可靠性与安全性，尤其需关注对他人非授权请求的服从问题。

Abstract: Agent benchmarks test agents in worlds that stay still. Deployed agents work in worlds that other people also change. Someone texts the agent to send the money elsewhere or an order confirmation asks it to reply with a door code. We present BACKDROP, which asks how much of an agent's capability in a clean world survives in such a world. BACKDROP takes a task along with the agents execution environment, and plants four everyday hazards in its world, one at a time and all together. The instruction and the correct end state stay the same. Each hazard asks one question. Authority: does a message from another person override the user? Injection: does text planted in a record redirect the agent? Boundary: does a request pull it into an app it was not given? Fault: after a write fails without saying whether it landed, does the agent check before it retries? Across 3,678 variants and 16 models, , the average pass rate falls from 69.5% to 31.3% once all four hazards are present; the strongest models fall furthest (Claude Fable 5.1 from 96.6% to 56.0%). Agents have learned to resist injected text but often follow other unauthorized requests of other people. With all four hazards present, and counting only runs where the planted text reached the agent, agents followed another person's message in 46.4% of runs and injected text in 20.3%. The gap is consistent throughout all 16 models. BACKDROP formalizes these gaps and shows how an agent's score in a task's world is a ceiling on real-world performance.

</details>


### [206] [KlinikeBench: Evaluating Language Models Beyond Diagnostic Accuracy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38480)
*Xueting Fang,Zehui Li,Yang Yang,Camilla Giovino,Shubh K. Patel,Shailly Prajapati,Vallijah Subasri,Caihua Shan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: KlinikeBench：333个由临床医生撰写的交互式临床评估基准，覆盖问诊、检查、约束遵循与诊断记录，31个模型最佳成功率不足30%，揭示诊断准确率与实际临床问诊能力间的巨大差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有临床基准多在完整病例描述下评估语言模型的诊断能力，但真实临床中患者信息呈现方式多样，医生需主动采集病史并决定所需检查。仅凭诊断准确率无法判断智能体是否收集了关键信息、是否进行了恰当的临床评估，且已有基准缺乏专业临床医生的验证。

Method: 构建KlinikeBench，包含333个由临床医生撰写的任务；每个任务提供隔离沙盒环境，含虚拟患者、临床工具与任务专属成功标准；35位以上临床医生参与病例撰写与基准评估。任务中语言模型在固定轮次预算内与患者对话、询问病史、申请检查、遵循行动约束并记录最终诊断；分步评分并整体评分。在31个模型、7个模型家族上进行实证研究，并让临床医生对模拟对话与由真实对话改编的参考对话进行质量评分。

Result: 临床医生对模拟对话的平均质量评分高于由真实对话改编的参考对话。最佳模型（如GPT-6-astra与Claude Opus 5）任务成功率不足30%，尽管其诊断准确率可达90.7%。部分模型能从与患者对话中获益，另一些模型在完整病历上诊断表现良好，但在对话场景中表现显著下降。

Conclusion: KlinikeBench为评估完整临床诊疗过程提供了测试平台，揭示了诊断准确率与交互式临床评估表现之间的显著差距；仅以诊断准确率衡量模型能力不足以反映其真实的临床问诊与评估水平。

Abstract: Most clinical benchmarks evaluate language models (LMs) on diagnosis using complete case descriptions. In clinical practice, however, patients present information in different ways, and clinicians must obtain relevant history and determine which examinations are needed before reaching a diagnosis. Diagnostic accuracy alone therefore cannot establish whether an agent gathered essential information or conducted an appropriate clinical assessment. Furthermore, existing benchmarks lack professional clinicians' verification. To address this gap, we introduce KlinikeBench, a benchmark of 333 clinician-authored tasks, each providing an isolated sandbox environment with a virtual patient, clinical tools, and task-specific success criteria. More than 35 clinicians contributed to case authoring and benchmark evaluation. In an empirical study, clinicians gave simulated dialogues higher mean quality ratings than reference conversations, which is adapted from real conversation. In each task, an LM has a fixed budget of turns to communicate with the patient, ask about relevant history, request examinations, follow action constraints, and record a final diagnosis. We score these steps separately as well as together. Across 31 models and seven model families, the best-performing models (e.g., GPT-6-astra and Claude Opus 5) succeed on less than 30% of tasks, even though their diagnosis accuracy reaches 90.7%. Some models benefit from talking with the patient; others diagnose well from a complete chart but perform much worse in conversation. Overall, KlinikeBench provides a testbed for evaluating the full clinical encounter and reveals a substantial gap between diagnostic accuracy and performance in interactive clinical assessment.

</details>


### [207] [Personalized State-Transition-Aware Memory for Clinical Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38490)
*Maryam Haghifam,Zahra Rajabi,Yizhou Sun,Carlos Morato*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出STAM——一种状态转移感知的记忆框架，用于解决临床LLM智能体在长期追踪患者状态时"记忆累积"与"记忆覆写"之间的矛盾。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床记录推理需要追踪患者状态变化，同时保留理解这些变化所需的历史。单纯累积记忆会导致无法判断哪些信息仍然有效；直接覆写早期记忆则会抹去重建治疗史与临床轨迹所需的证据。

Method: STAM在新临床条目到达时将状态变化记录为状态转移。它结合语义检索与带类型的临床关系来识别受影响的记忆，将当前有效信息存入Active、被取代或已解决信息存入History；读取时通过查询相关的门控机制选择性调用历史记忆。

Result: 在四个纵向临床基准上评估STAM，采用下游问答任务、直接状态维护诊断，以及在近似匹配上下文长度下的对比实验。

Conclusion: STAM通过状态转移感知的记忆组织与查询相关门控，在保留临床历史证据的同时维持当前状态信息，为长程临床记录推理提供了兼顾"时效性"与"可追溯性"的方案。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents that reason over clinical records must track changes in a patient's state while preserving the history needed to understand them. Simply accumulating memories leaves it unclear which information still applies, whereas overwriting earlier memories can erase evidence needed to reconstruct treatment history and clinical trajectories. We introduce STAM, a state-transition-aware memory framework that records state changes as new clinical entries arrive. STAM combines semantic retrieval with typed clinical relations to identify affected memories, maintaining current information in Active and superseded or resolved information in History. At read time, a query-dependent gate selectively serves historical memory. Across four longitudinal clinical benchmarks, we evaluate STAM with downstream question answering, direct state-maintenance diagnostics, and comparisons at approximately matched context lengths.

</details>


### [208] [DEdit: Iterative Draft Editing for Speculative Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38510)
*Longxuan Yu,Bingsen Chen,Peng Shi,Dongkyu Lee,Yi Xiang,Hideo Kobayashi,Sheng Zhang,Shuaichen Chang,Xing Niu,Zhuoyan Xu,Greg Ver Steeg,Jiarong Jiang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: DEdit：一种可迭代编辑草稿的扩散式drafter，通过ProposalMix训练，在Qwen3-4B/8B七个基准上取得最高接受率与约5.7–6.0×加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散式drafter虽能并行提议多token降低延迟，但各token独立预测，一旦早期出错，前缀验证会丢弃整个后续草稿（即使其中有可用预测）。因此需要一种能在草稿内部修复早期错误、延长被接受前缀的机制。

Method: 提出DEdit，一种扩散式drafter，除常规并行unmasking外，还通过token-to-token预测迭代编辑草稿，使后续预测作为双向上下文修复早期错误并扩展接受前缀。为让模型在保留正确预测的同时修复错误，提出ProposalMix训练方案：训练时依据首轮置信度将草稿预测与真实token混合。

Result: 在Qwen3-4B与Qwen3-8B的七个基准上，DEdit在被评估的drafter中取得最高宏平均token接受率与加速，greedy解码下分别为5.72×与5.97×。分析显示：更多编辑轮次与更宽草稿窗口可提升接受率；ProposalMix将缩短接受前缀的有害编辑减半；将编辑器限制为因果注意力会降低接受率，尤其在高度可预测输出上，表明未来上下文是收益的关键来源。

Conclusion: 迭代编辑配合混合训练能有效修复草稿早期错误、提升接受前缀长度与推理加速，且双向（未来）上下文对性能增益至关重要。

Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive LLMs by having a lightweight drafter propose tokens that the target model verifies in parallel. Diffusion-based drafters further reduce drafting latency by proposing multiple tokens at once. However, these tokens are predicted independently, so a single early error causes prefix verification to discard the rest of the draft, even when it contains useful downstream predictions. We introduce DEdit, a diffusion-based drafter that can not only draft by conventional parallel unmasking but also iteratively edit its draft through token-to-token predictions. Through editing, later predictions can serve as bidirectional context for repairing earlier errors and extending the accepted prefix. To teach the model to repair errors while preserving correct predictions, we propose ProposalMix, a training scheme that mixes draft predictions with ground-truth tokens based on first-pass confidence during training. Across seven benchmarks on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B, DEdit achieves the highest macro-average token acceptance and speedup among the evaluated drafters, reaching macro-average speedups of $5.72\times$ and $5.97\times$ over autoregressive generation under greedy decoding, respectively. Further analysis shows that acceptance improves with more editing passes and wider drafting windows, and that ProposalMix halves harmful edits that shorten the accepted prefix. Moreover, restricting the editor to causal attention lowers acceptance, especially on highly predictable outputs, indicating that future context is a key source of these gains.

</details>


### [209] [Shifting Mechanisms: How Positional Encoding Choice Shapes In-Context Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38530)
*Eric Enouen,Sainyam Galhotra*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文从机制角度研究PE选择如何塑造上下文检索：标准RoPE模型依赖位置检索，PE混合体（如SWA NoPE）转向语义检索，且其长上下文增益实为一种检索权衡（利于多目标检索与QA，弱于区分竞争键）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型日益采用跨层变化注意力跨度与位置编码的架构（如RoPE+滑窗注意力、NoPE+全局注意力，即SWA NoPE），但这些选择如何塑造上下文检索尚不明确。

Method: 采取机制视角追踪PE选择如何塑造内部检索机制：在22个开源模型、8个家族上进行观测分析；通过受控预训练消融将位置编码限制在局部层；并对比SWA NoPE与RoPE在多目标检索、QA及竞争键区分任务上的表现。

Result: 标准RoPE模型主要依赖位置检索，PE混合体转向语义检索；将PE限制在局部层即可产生这一语义偏移，并损害位置信息表征；SWA NoPE在多目标检索与QA上优于RoPE，但在区分竞争键时表现更差。

Conclusion: PE混合体所报告的长上下文增益掩盖了检索权衡；这些行为差异更好地对应从位置机制向语义机制的转变，而非长上下文检索的一致性提升。

Abstract: Language models increasingly use architectures that vary attention span and positional encoding across layers, such as applying RoPE with sliding-window attention and NoPE with global attention (SWA NoPE). However, how these choices shape in-context retrieval remains unclear. To study this question, we take a mechanistic view, tracing how positional encoding (PE) choice shapes the internal mechanisms models use for in-context retrieval. Across 22 open-weight models spanning eight families, we find that standard RoPE models rely primarily on positional retrieval, while PE hybrids shift toward semantic retrieval. We further show on a controlled pre-training ablation that confining positional encoding to local layers produces this semantic shift, degrading representations of positional information. Finally, we show that the reported long-context gains of PE hybrids mask a retrieval trade-off: SWA NoPE improves over RoPE on multiple-target retrieval and QA, but degrades when distinguishing competing keys. We show that these behavioral differences better track the mechanism shift from positional toward semantic mechanisms than a uniform improvement in long-context retrieval.

</details>


### [210] [MedKIT: Evaluating Knowledge Integration and Generalization in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38543)
*Lukas Thede,Yash Kumar Atri,David Chen,Danielle Bitterman,Matthias Bethge,Tom Hartvigsen,Zeynep Akata*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出MedKIT基准，用于在真实临床证据更新序列下细粒度评估模型对新知识的整合与应用能力，并基于该基准对12种知识整合策略、5个模型进行大规模实证研究，发现"记忆召回"与"知识可用"之间存在持续差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实世界知识（尤其医学临床证据）不断演变，模型需持续更新，过时知识会带来安全风险。然而现有的知识整合评估主要聚焦于事实召回，难以揭示新整合的知识是否真正可用，即能否迁移到不同任务与语境中。

Method: 构建基准MedKIT（Medical Knowledge Integration and Transfer）：每个实例对应一条由临床证据推导的事实更新，并配以针对性探针，评估四类迁移能力——词汇变体、关系变换、组合推理、开放式操作化，同时设置局部性测试（locality tests）检验原有知识是否被保持。基于该基准，对12种知识整合策略在5个模型（含通用LLM与医学LLM）上进行大规模实证研究。

Result: 结果揭示召回与可用知识之间存在一致差距：多数方法在原始更新任务及词汇变体下取得显著提升，但关系泛化能力有限，且在组合推理与操作类任务上没有任何方法带来有意义的改进。

Conclusion: 这些发现凸显了知识整合中的根本性挑战，并将MedKIT定位为开发新方法的测试平台，以推动新整合知识在跨任务、跨语境下更一致地可用。

Abstract: Constantly evolving real-world knowledge necessitates models to be updated continuously. Especially in medicine, as clinical evidence changes over time, outdated knowledge can pose safety risks. Existing evaluations of knowledge integration focus on factual recall, offering limited insight into whether newly integrated knowledge is actually usable. Our benchmark MedKIT (Medical Knowledge Integration and Transfer) provides a granular evaluation of how models integrate and apply knowledge under realistic sequences of clinical updates. Each instance corresponds to a factual update derived from clinical evidence, paired with targeted probes that assess transfer across lexical variation, relational transformations, compositional reasoning, and open-ended operationalization, as well as locality tests for knowledge preservation. Using MedKIT, we conduct a large-scale empirical study of 12 knowledge integration strategies across 5 diverse models, including both general-purpose and medical LLMs. Our results reveal a consistent gap between recall and usable knowledge: while most methods achieve strong gains on the original update task and under lexical variation, relational generalization is limited, and no method yields meaningful improvements on compositional or operational tasks. These findings highlight a fundamental challenge in knowledge integration and position MedKIT as a testbed for developing methods that make newly integrated knowledge more consistently usable across tasks and contexts.

</details>


### [211] [Prompt2Skill: Unsupervised Skill Optimization From Natural Language Instructions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38593)
*Bo Ni,Li Li,Ryan A. Rossi,Franck Dernoncourt,Tyler Derr*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出Prompt2Skill框架，仅凭自然语言任务描述即可自动构建技能，通过推导任务规范、发现/合成数据集并进行反思式闭环优化，在四个领域平均提升10.8分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM技能依赖昂贵的人工编写，且未针对具体消费模型优化（失败模式随版本、规模、训练变化而异）；新兴任务常超出既有技能库范围，需在训练数据可用前开发新技能；而现有基于反思的自动技能优化方法仍需精心筛选的同分布训练集，用户未必具备。

Method: Prompt2Skill从自然语言任务描述（prompt）出发：先推导出任务规范（task specification），进而发现或合成数据集，最后在反思式编辑的闭环中不断精炼技能。

Result: 在问答、阅读理解、电子表格操作和数学推理四个领域，Prompt2Skill持续优于直接提示基线，在开源与前沿模型上平均提升10.8分。

Conclusion: Prompt2Skill无需人工编写技能或预先准备训练集，仅凭任务描述即可自动构建并优化LLM技能，具备跨领域有效性，为缺乏标注数据的场景提供可行方案。

Abstract: Skills are external artifacts that Large Language Models (LLMs) consume at inference time to improve their performance on specialized domains by incorporating relevant procedural and domain knowledge. Expert-authored skills are expensive to produce, and the resulting artifacts are not optimized for the specific model that consumes them, whose failure modes can vary with version, scale and training. In addition, emerging tasks may fall outside the scope of existing skill libraries, creating a need to develop new skills before curated training data become available. Recent works have explored automated skill optimization through reflection, but they require a curated, in-distribution training set, which users might not always have. To address these limitations, we present Prompt2Skill, a framework that builds skills from natural-language task description alone. From the prompt, the system derives a task specification, discovers or synthesizes datasets, and refines the skill in a closed loop of reflective editing. Across four domains spanning question answering, reading comprehension, spreadsheet manipulation, and mathematical reasoning, Prompt2Skill consistently outperforms the direct prompting baseline, achieving an average improvement of 10.8 across open-source and frontier models.

</details>


### [212] [Beyond Oracle Communication: Benchmarking Interactive Intent Alignment Under Miscommunication and Evolving User Intent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38604)
*Zheyuan Zhang,Mengyuan Chao,Ke Xiao,Ziyi Chen,Daoan Zhang,Yan Zhang,Yanfang Ye,Wei Xu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出"交互式意图对齐"任务设定，并构建基准 Drift-Bench++ 与评测协议 GRIP，用于研究在沟通不完美、意图漂移下 LLM 智能体的意图恢复与持续跟踪能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体基准普遍假设"神谕式沟通"：用户总能准确、充分地表达固定意图。但现实中用户会误传信息、改变目标、失去耐心，该假设不成立，因此需要新的任务设定与基准来刻画真实交互中的意图对齐问题。

Method: 1) 形式化定义"交互式意图对齐"任务；2) 提出 Drift-Bench++：一条有原则的基准构建流水线，生成经校验的可执行任务，并可控地注入失配与意图漂移；3) 设计交互协议，包含有限耐心、多样化模拟用户以及静默的、受交互条件触发的意图漂移；4) 提出 GRIP 评测协议，从任务落地、用户真实性、询问有效性、对演化意图的适应性四方面评估。

Result: 在多种环境、模型与交互条件下，更强的交互能力始终带来收益，但距离神谕式表现仍有明显差距；在已部署的 ProdAgent 会话上验证表明，所建模的失败模式在真实部署中普遍且影响重大。

Conclusion: Drift-Bench++ 提供了统一的、可执行的交互式意图对齐基准，为在真实沟通条件与演化意图下评测和推进智能体能力奠定基础。

Abstract: Modern LLM agents increasingly tackle complex tasks through interactive, long-horizon exchanges with users, while existing benchmarks generally assume that users always accurately and sufficiently communicate a fixed intent. However, this oracle communication assumption rarely holds in practice: users may miscommunicate, change their goals, and run out of patience. We define this task setting as Interactive Intent Alignment, where agents must recover and continuously track the user's current intent despite imperfect communication and evolving goals. To study this setting, we introduce Drift-Bench++, a principled benchmark construction pipeline for verified executable tasks with controlled misalignment and intent shifts, along with an interaction protocol featuring finite patience, diverse simulated users, and silent interaction-conditioned shifts. We further develop GRIP, a comprehensive evaluation protocol covering task grounding, user realism, inquiry effectiveness, and adaptation to evolving intent. Across diverse environments, models, and interaction conditions, stronger interaction consistently helps but remains far from oracle performance; Validation on deployed ProdAgent sessions further shows that the modeled failures are prevalent and consequential in deployment. By providing a unified, executable benchmark for interactive intent alignment, Drift-Bench++ offers a foundation for evaluating and advancing agents under realistic communication and evolving intent.

</details>


### [213] [StreamDecisionBench: Evaluating Decisions in Force on Evolving Language Streams](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38612)
*Jhen-Ke Lin,Chung Chun Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出 StreamDecisionBench (SDB)，在流式证据场景下评估语言模型作为程序决策组件时"瞬时生效决策"的正确性，将每个错误时刻归因于判断、时延或二者兼有，并揭示推理能力在判断与时延之间的权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型越来越多地作为程序内的决策组件运行：程序将当前状态发送给模型，并按返回决策执行，直到新决策到来。当推理过程中证据发生变化时，一个对其自身状态正确的决策可能在状态已经过期后仍然生效（例如客户已开始报出卡号，而通话录音器仍在运行）。传统的非时间对齐（离线）准确率会把这类错误计为正确，因而无法反映真实部署中的风险。

Method: 提出 StreamDecisionBench (SDB)，评估每一时刻实际生效的决策，并把每个错误时刻归因于判断错误、时延错误或二者共同导致。基准包含四个应用族的流式证据场景，参考决策由公开规则的可执行代码计算得出。用 1–5 秒更新间隔下的生效准确率，以对数时间轴上的归一化曲线下面积（等权对待相等的乘性区间）进行汇总。共评估四个托管模型的六种设置。

Result: 该汇总分数与"场景级非时间对齐准确率 × 预言机的积分时延分数"之积相差在 2.9 分以内；即生效准确率可近似分解为判断能力与时延能力的乘积。推理能改善判断，但在低推理强度下，时延使 Luna 和 Terra（两个同样在无推理条件下被评估的 GPT 模型）分别损失 38.8 和 42.8 分（相对非时间对齐准确率）；一个判断较弱但更快的组件在无推理条件下可达到与 Terra 相近的积分分数。聚合曲线与分族曲线显示了这些权衡在何处发生变化。

Conclusion: 评测应关注决策的"生效时间"而非仅离线准确率；生效准确率近似为判断与时延的乘积形式，推理能力带来的判断增益可能被时延成本抵消。分族与聚合曲线使该评测的时间尺度依赖性可见，为流式部署中模型选择与推理强度配置提供了依据。

Abstract: As natural language drives more applications, language models increasingly run inside programs as decision components: the program sends them the current state and acts on the returned decision until a newer one arrives. When evidence changes during inference, a decision correct for its own state can stay in force after that state has passed, as when a call recorder keeps running after a customer starts reading out a card number; untimed (offline) accuracy counts such an error as correct. We introduce StreamDecisionBench (SDB), which evaluates the decision in force at every instant and attributes every erroneous instant to judgment, latency or both. Its scenarios stream evidence in four application families, with reference decisions computed from public rules by executable code. We summarize in-force accuracy across update intervals of 1-5 s by its normalized area under the curve on a logarithmic time axis, giving equal weight to equal multiplicative ranges. Across six settings of four hosted models, this score stays within 2.9 points of the scenario-wise product of untimed accuracy and an oracle's integrated timing score. Reasoning improves judgment, but at low effort latency costs Luna and Terra, two GPT models we also evaluate without reasoning, 38.8 and 42.8 points relative to untimed accuracy; a faster component with weaker judgment attains a similar integrated score to Terra without reasoning. The aggregate and family curves show where these tradeoffs change, making the evaluation's time-scale dependence visible.

</details>


### [214] [Marking Contour Tones in Yorùbá](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38627)
*Kólá Túbòsún*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文探讨约鲁巴语（Yorùbá）中曲折调在正字法上的编码困境，特别指出部分人名与词条的传统拼写不仅省略声调信息，甚至会造成语义反转；文章论证现有方案不足，并提出采用抑扬符（caron）与扬抑符（circumflex）在单元音上标记升调与降调，并以WriteYoruba键盘和TTSYoruba语音合成器的实现加以支持。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 约鲁巴语是声调语言，曲折调长期缺乏可行的正字法表达手段。问题尤为突出的是：一些人名和词条的传统拼写为避免使用元音延长来承载第二个声调，结果不仅丢失声调信息，还可能把原意反转，表达出与命名意图相反的含义。现有解决方案不足以应对这一问题。

Method: 文章首先界定问题并说明现有方案的不足；随后提出在单元音上采用抑扬符（caron）与扬抑符（circumflex）分别编码升调和降调。这一做法在约鲁巴语音系学研究中自Olmsted（1951）以来已有先例。该方案的优势在于可通过标准键盘输入和计算文本处理实现。作者通过WriteYoruba键盘与TTSYoruba语音合成器中的实现来验证该提议，其架构与听测评估另行报告（Tubosun et al., 2026）。

Result: 该正字法方案在WriteYoruba键盘和TTSYoruba语音合成器中得到实现，使曲折调首次能够通过标准键盘输入和计算文本处理获得表达。合成器的架构与听测评估结果另文报告。摘要未给出具体评测数据。

Conclusion: 建议约鲁巴语正字法采纳抑扬符与扬抑符来标记单元音上的升调与降调，以解决传统拼写中声调信息缺失乃至语义反转的问题，并借由实际工具实现证明其技术可行性。

Abstract: Yorùbá is a tonal language in which contour tones pose persistent orthographic challenges. These are especially notable for personal names and lexical items whose conventional spellings avoid vowel lengthening that would otherwise provide a host syllable for the second tone. A particular concern is a class of names in which the conventional spelling does not just omit tonal information but inverts the meaning of said name, sometimes asserting the opposite of what the name intends. This paper describes the problem, illustrates the inadequacy of current solutions, and proposes the adoption of the caron and circumflex marks. These are symbols with precedent in Yorùbá phonological scholarship since Olmsted (1951), used as orthographic conventions on single vowels to encode rising and falling contour tones, making them accessible for the first time through standard keyboard input and computational text processing. The proposal is supported by an implementation in the WriteYoruba keyboard and the TTSYoruba speech synthesizer, whose architecture and listener evaluation are reported separately (Tubosun et al., 2026).

</details>


### [215] [Strong Multilingual Privacy Tagging at Encoder Speed](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38630)
*Jonathan Graehl*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一种多语言细粒度命名实体标注器，用于隐私脱敏场景，在35种语言上微调多语言编码器并结合多项训练技巧，在7种语言的人工标注测试集上取得88.8的脱敏F1，显著优于GLiNER2、Presidio及OpenAI Privacy Filter等基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 隐私脱敏需要删除个人信息，同时保留文本中表达的关系，因此需要支持细粒度区分和多样化脱敏策略的标注器，并能够以较低成本学习更多实体类型。

Method: 在多语言编码器上接仿射跨度标注头，用前沿模型在35种语言的标注进行微调；重放映射后的人工金标并采用覆盖感知掩码，避免将未标注类型误当作负样本；通过学习的±1字符调整修复子词边界。

Result: 在7种语言、1283个人工金标测试片段上，最佳脱敏F1为88.8，而GLiNER2为69.1（排除11类不可表示类型后为68.8），适配新训练数据后为67.8，Presidio为57.3，最佳OpenAI Privacy Filter微调为35.8。增加约5万条标注训练句并增加人工金标重放，使Ont3（1201个开发片段、31类）精确类型跨度F1从74.5提升至76.3；仅映射金标重放即提升人工金标F1达10点且在前沿标注文本上无损失；边界调整在Ont3上增加1.7点。单张96-GB GPU可运行的小型LLM作为提示标注器和冻结编码器表现不佳，编码速度比XLM-R推理慢30-95倍，提示标注慢约180-1100倍。该编码器架构CPU吞吐量为GLiNER2的4.9倍。

Conclusion: 该编码器架构在隐私脱敏的多语言细粒度命名实体识别上显著优于现有基线，兼具高精度与高吞吐，并公开代码、提示、训练配方及数据获取脚本与来源链接。

Abstract: Privacy redaction must remove personal information while preserving relationships expressed in text. We develop a multilingual named-entity tagger with fine-grained distinctions supporting varied redaction policies and methods for cheaply learning additional distinctions. We fine-tune a multilingual encoder with an affine span-tagging head on frontier-model annotations in 35 languages, replay mapped human gold with coverage-aware masking so unannotated types are not treated as negatives, and repair subword boundaries with a learned +/-1-character adjustment. On 1,283 human-gold test segments in seven languages, best measured redaction F1 is 88.8, against 69.1 for published GLiNER2 with 11 unrepresentable types excluded from its task (68.8 without that exemption), 67.8 for GLiNER2 adapted to the new training data, 57.3 for Microsoft Presidio and 35.8 for the best published OpenAI Privacy Filter fine-tune. Adding about 50,000 annotated training sentences and increasing human-gold replay improves exact typed-span F1 from 74.5 to 76.3 on Ont3, our 31-type frontier-annotated NER evaluation of 1,201 development segments. Mapped-gold replay alone raises human-gold F1 by ten points without loss on frontier-annotated text; boundary adjustment adds 1.7 exact typed-span F1 points on Ont3. Local LLMs fitting on a single 96-GB GPU underperformed as prompted annotators and frozen encoders, with encoding 30-95 times slower than XLM-R inference and prompted annotation roughly 180-1,100 times slower in the evaluated configurations. The encoder architecture delivers 4.9 times GLiNER2's CPU throughput. We release code, prompts and training recipes, with data-acquisition scripts and source links.

</details>


### [216] [Breaking Babel: A Self-Evolving Multi-Agent System for Long-Form Subtitle Translation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38660)
*Haibo Jin,Xinjie Li,Najmeh Sadoughi,Yang Liu,Yibo Wang,Zhu Liu,Yuzong Liu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出SMART自进化多智能体长剧集字幕翻译系统，并发布Subtitle Arena基准与SubMQM评价框架，在15个翻译方向及公开基准上取得最优结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长剧集字幕翻译需跨集乃至整部剧进行话语与文化语境推理，并保持术语与风格一致。现有单LLM方法多为句级处理，多智能体系统则常采用静态工作流，无法根据场景复杂度或制作语境自适应调整。

Method: SMART在测试时训练阶段构建持久的剧集级记忆，通过动态路由器与Mixture-of-Agents层翻译部分句子，并配备术语校验、字幕约束验证与上下文检索工具；由judge-refiner循环对候选译文打分，并利用文本批评更新智能体提示词与路由策略，无需重训底层LLM。测试时推理阶段，用进化后的配置翻译剩余剧集。同时提出Subtitle Arena基准（14种题材、每剧2–198集、制作年份1959–2023、15个目标语区）及SubMQM字幕适配评价框架（7个维度、19类错误）。

Result: SMART在Subtitle Arena全部15个翻译方向上取得最佳总MQM得分，较最强竞争多智能体系统平均惩罚降低6.9%；在公开MuSC基准上，四组语言对均取得最佳模型结果，并获最佳人工评价结果，总分为4.50/5。

Conclusion: 基于自进化多智能体与动态路由、记忆和批评反馈机制，SMART有效提升长剧集字幕翻译的一致性、语境适应性与质量，验证了测试时自适应配置在字幕翻译任务上的优越性。

Abstract: Long-form subtitle translation requires reasoning over discourse and cultural context spanning episodes or entire series, while maintaining consistent terminology and style. Existing single-LLM methods are largely sentence-level, and multi-agent systems often use static workflows that do not adapt to scene complexity or production context. We propose SMART, a Self-evolving Multi-Agent system for long-foRm subtitle Translation. During test-time training, SMART builds persistent series-level memory and translates a subset of sentences through a dynamic router and Mixture-of-Agents layer with tools for terminology verification, subtitle constraint validation, and contextual retrieval. A judge-refiner loop scores candidates and uses textual critiques to update agent prompts and routing policies without retraining the underlying LLMs. During test-time inference, the evolved configuration translates the remaining series. We also introduce Subtitle Arena, covering 14 genres, 2--198 episodes per series, production years 1959--2023, and 15 target locales, together with SubMQM, a subtitle-adapted MQM framework with seven dimensions and 19 error categories. SMART achieves the best overall MQM score in all 15 Subtitle Arena directions, reducing average penalty by 6.9% over the strongest competing agent system. On the public MuSC benchmark, SMART obtains the best model result across all four language pairs and also achieves the best human-evaluation result, with an overall score of 4.50/5.

</details>


### [217] [MetaSteer: Context-Conditioned, nonlinear Steering via Attention-Projection Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38718)
*Mehdi Jafari,Hao Xue,Flora Salim*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: MetaSteer：一种学习非线性、上下文相关干预并施加于注意力投影矩阵的转向方法，经偏好优化训练一次后可零样本迁移到未见概念与分布外情境。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大模型转向方法多依赖激活空间中的线性、上下文无关干预。近期工作对这一假设提出质疑，且当固定表示需编码多种行为区分时，会产生信息瓶颈，因此需要非线性、上下文相关的干预手段。

Method: 提出 MetaSteer，学习具有上下文相关效应的非线性干预，并将其作用于注意力投影矩阵，使激活效应在构造上随输入上下文变化，且不依赖线性概念几何假设。方法以偏好优化为框架，在汇总偏好语料上训练一次，即可零样本迁移至未见概念与分布外上下文；实现上采用低秩适配器。

Result: MetaSteer 在隐状态轨迹上诱导出结构化、上下文相关的变化，同时部分保留局部轨迹动力学（速度与曲率）。在三个受控文本生成基准与三个智能体场景、多个模型族与规模上评测，零样本设置下多数汇总比较中匹配或优于强任务特定转向基线；且更强的文本生成转向与更强的智能体转向表现相关。

Conclusion: 非线性、上下文相关的注意力投影干预可在零样本下有效迁移，且不牺牲局部轨迹动力学，为可迁移转向提供了新范式；同时讨论了轨迹几何效应、能力保持以及可迁移转向带来的安全性考量。

Abstract: Steering large language models typically relies on linear, context-independent interventions in activation space, an assumption that recent work has challenged and that can induce an information bottleneck when a fixed representation must encode many behavioral distinctions. We introduce MetaSteer, a method that learns nonlinear interventions with context-dependent effects and applies them to attention projection matrices, producing activation effects that vary with the input context by construction and requiring no linear concept-geometry assumption. Framed as preference-based optimization, MetaSteer is trained once on a pooled preference corpus and transferred zero-shot to unseen concepts and out-of-distribution contexts. We find that, despite using low-rank adapters, MetaSteer induces structured, context-dependent changes in hidden-state trajectories while partially preserving aspects of their local trajectory dynamics, including velocity and curvature. We evaluate MetaSteer on three controlled text-generation benchmarks and three agentic settings across multiple model families and scales. MetaSteer matches or outperforms strong task-specific steering baselines on most aggregate comparisons in the zero-shot regime. Across the evaluated settings, stronger text-generation steering is associated with stronger agentic steering performance. We further discuss geometric trajectory effects, capability retention, and safety considerations raised by transferable steering.

</details>


### [218] [Training LLM Judges from Language Feedback via Position-Selective Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38792)
*Ilgee Hong,Changlong Yu,Zhenghao Xu,Xin Liu,Yuwei Zhang,Qin Lu,Bing Yin,Tuo Zhao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出基于熵位移的位置掩码自蒸馏方法训练LLM评判器，性能超越结果监督RL。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主观任务的评判结果依赖评判器调用的评估标准及其权重，而主流的结果监督RL（如GRPO）仅用最终裁决准确率的单一标量对所有token统一赋权，无法在标准选择token上提供独立信用，也忽略了偏好标签附带的语言反馈（如偏好理由）。

Method: 利用同一模型在条件语言反馈下作为教师，对学生进行密集的逐位置自蒸馏监督。通过教师与学生之间的逐位置熵位移识别两种模式：上下文锐化（教师将概率集中于某一反馈对齐的标准表述）与上下文扩散（教师将概率分布于多个反馈对齐的备选）。基于该不对称性，引入基于熵位移的位置掩码，保留熵位移分布的下尾（低熵位移位置）。

Result: 掩码高熵位移位置相比朴素自蒸馏提升了分布外泛化能力；所得自蒸馏评判器在评估的主观子类别上比结果监督RL训练的评判器高出2-9个百分点，同时在客观子类别上保持竞争力。

Conclusion: 高熵位移（扩散）位置对应语义理解、低熵位移（锐化）位置对应特定表述记忆，选择性掩码高熵位移位置可有效提升主观任务评判器的泛化性与性能。

Abstract: We study training LLM judges from natural language feedback, especially for subjective tasks where the verdict depends strongly on which evaluation criteria the judge invokes and how it weighs them. The dominant approach, outcome-supervised RL (e.g., GRPO), credits every token in the rollout with a single scalar determined only by the accuracy of the final verdict, providing no separate credit at the criterion-choice tokens and ignoring the rich language feedback (e.g., preference rationales) that naturally accompanies preference labels. Self-Distillation (SD) is one natural way to use this language feedback: the same model, conditioned on this feedback, acts as a teacher providing dense, position-level supervision. However, not all positions carry equally useful signal. Using the per-position entropy shift between teacher and student, we identify two regimes: context sharpening, where the teacher concentrates probability on a particular feedback-aligned criterion expression, and context spreading, where the teacher distributes probability across multiple feedback-aligned alternatives. We interpret these patterns as follows: sharpening encourages memorization of a particular criterion expression, whereas spreading promotes semantic understanding by preserving these alternatives. Motivated by this asymmetry, we introduce position masking based on the entropy shift that retains the lower tail of the entropy-shift distribution. Experiments show that masking higher-entropy-shift positions improves out-of-distribution generalization over naive SD. The resulting self-distilled judges outperform judges trained with outcome-supervised RL by 2-9 percentage points on the evaluated subjective subcategories, while remaining competitive on objective ones.

</details>


### [219] [Recovering Off-Policy Supervision for Speculative Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38795)
*Jungseob Lee,Chanjun Park,Sugyeong Eo,Hyeonseok Moon*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出基于rollout的训练框架，通过ALR和IRA两个组件恢复对固定语料上训练草稿模型的全监督，提升投机解码接受长度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 块级草稿模型通常在外部模型撰写的语料上训练，单个off-policy token会导致块内后续所有槽位的监督失效；现有方法直接丢弃这些发散槽位，造成严重监督损失。

Method: 提出rollout训练框架，包含两个互补组件：(1) Anchor-Label Relabelling (ALR)，用贪心目标rollout的分布替换语料标签，恢复所有预测槽位的有效监督；(2) In-Rollout Anchors (IRA)，将草稿块直接置于这些rollout中，使草稿模型接触目标生成的上下文，并复用预计算的rollout特征，不增加额外目标开销。

Result: 在固定视觉-语言与文本语料上，相比DFlash将贪心接受长度最高提升36.5%，并持续优于擦除基线；单轮训练即超过最佳擦除调度，三轮后匹配在目标重生成响应上训练得到的接受长度。

Conclusion: 该框架为在固定语料上训练投机草稿模型提供了一种有效且计算高效的方法，且无需修改原始文本。

Abstract: Block drafters for speculative decoding are commonly trained on corpora written by external models, where a single off-policy token invalidates supervision for all subsequent slots in a block. Existing approaches discard these divergent slots, resulting in severe supervision loss. To resolve this problem while preserving the training corpus, we propose a rollout-based training framework that recovers full supervision through two complementary components. The first component, Anchor-Label Relabelling (ALR), replaces corpus labels with distributions from greedy target rollouts, restoring valid supervision across all predicted slots. The second component, In-Rollout Anchors (IRA), places draft blocks directly inside these rollouts to expose the drafter to target-generated context, reusing precomputed rollout features at no additional target cost. Across fixed vision-language and text corpora, our framework increases greedy accepted length by up to 36.5% over DFlash and consistently outperforms erasing baselines. Notably, a single epoch of our method surpasses the best erase schedules. After three epochs, it matches the acceptance length of training on target-regenerated responses. These results show that our framework provides an effective and compute-efficient approach for training speculative drafters on fixed corpora without modifying the original text. Code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/ALR-IRA.

</details>


### [220] [Overlap, Unique and Conflict: Can LLMs Extract What They Can Recognize?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38799)
*Eftekhar Hossain,Santu Karmaker*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出跨叙事任务 OUC 抽取（重叠/冲突/独有子句），构建 22K 叙事对、140K 实例基准，评测 14 个开源 LLM 发现冲突与重叠抽取远难于独有信息，瓶颈在于子句配对而非关系识别。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多视角替代叙事分析需识别不同来源信息之间的一致、冲突与差异，但现有跨文本关系研究多局限于对预定义文本对进行关系分类（如蕴含、矛盾），无法直接从完整叙事中抽取这类信息，存在研究空白。

Method: 定义 OUC（Overlap-Unique-Conflict）抽取任务：从两段叙事中抽取全部重叠、冲突与独有子句。构建约 22K 叙事对、140K OUC 实例的基准，覆盖事实性、论辩性与政治话语；评测 14 个开源 LLM（0.6B–35B），并进行诊断分析及任务特定监督微调实验。

Result: 独有信息抽取显著易于重叠与冲突：最强模型 Gemma-4-31B 在重叠上仅 61.13% F1、冲突 48.58%，而独有超过 75%。诊断表明困难并非仅源于关系识别，而是无法从完整叙事中配对并抽取对应子句，小模型尤甚。经任务特定监督微调，Qwen-3-8B 相对基线绝对提升 15–28%，在多项任务上超越约四倍规模的 Qwen-3.6-35B。

Conclusion: 重叠与冲突抽取性能仍远未令人满意，跨叙事子句抽取仍是开放挑战；任务特定监督可显著缩小差距，但不足以解决该问题。

Abstract: Understanding multi-perspective alternative narratives requires identifying how their information agrees, conflicts, or differs across sources. Existing work on cross-text relations largely focuses on categorizing relations between predefined text pairs, such as entailment or contradiction, rather than directly extracting such information from full narratives. To address this gap, we introduce Overlap-Unique-Conflict (OUC) extraction, a cross-narrative task that extracts all overlapping, conflicting, and unique clauses from two narratives. To support this study, we construct a benchmark of approximately 22K narrative pairs and 140K OUC instances spanning factual, argumentative, and political discourse. Evaluating 14 open-source LLMs (0.6B-35B), we find that unique information is far easier to extract than overlap and conflict: the strongest model, Gemma-4-31B, reaches only 61.13% F1-score on overlap and 48.58% on conflict, against more than 75% on unique. Further diagnostic analysis reveals that this difficulty does not stem from relation recognition alone, but rather from a failure to pair and extract the corresponding clauses from full narratives, especially in smaller models. Nevertheless, learning these extractions with task-specific supervision narrows the gap considerably: a fine-tuned Qwen-3-8B gains 15-28% absolute over its baseline and surpasses models roughly four times its size (e.g., Qwen-3.6-35B) on several tasks. Even so, overlap and conflict remain well below satisfactory, leaving cross-narrative clause extraction an open challenge.

</details>


### [221] [Uncovering Uncontrolled Repetition through Residual Stream Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38802)
*Yuanhe Zhang,Xinyao Zhou,Haoran Gao,Yuyao Zhang,Zhenhong Zhou,Fanyu Meng,Li Sun,Sen Su*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出Tokenwise Residual Comparison (TRC)方法，通过分析残差流动态定位重复行为异常，在浅层选择性抑制残差坐标，有效缓解大模型的无控重复生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无控重复会延长LLM自回归生成，导致资源消耗攻击。以往分析仅识别出中后层的强激活特征，但重复活动在这些层显著之前如何产生和发展仍不清楚，缺乏对早期干预机会的理解。

Method: 提出TRC（Tokenwise Residual Comparison），在生成过程中比较各生成token对残差流的注意力与MLP写入，识别与重复相关的模式，并在识别出的层选择性地抑制残差流中的坐标。主要研究载体为大视觉语言模型（LVLM），因其可通过视觉和文本输入支持更丰富的无控重复。

Result: TRC有效缓解无控重复，平均降低循环率57%。分析显示重复语义在浅层出现，并沿残差流传播，破坏正常表示。TRC可泛化到LLM和大型推理模型（LRM），一致地捕获类似的重复动态并实现有效缓解。

Conclusion: 该工作将重复生成研究从显著内部表示扩展到更早的干预机会，为缓解资源消耗攻击提供新见解。

Abstract: Uncontrolled repetition can prolong autoregressive generation in large language models (LLMs) and enable resource consumption attacks. Prior analyses of repetitive generation have identified strongly activated features in intermediate and late layers. However, how uncontrolled repetition activity emerges and develops before becoming prominent in these layers remains insufficiently understood. In this paper, we investigate this question primarily in large vision-language models (LVLMs), which support a richer set of uncontrolled repetitions through both visual and textual inputs. We propose Tokenwise Residual Comparison (TRC), a method that identifies and localizes anomalies associated with repetition from residual dynamics during generation. TRC compares attention and multilayer perceptron writes to the residual stream across generated tokens to identify patterns associated with repetition. It then selectively suppresses coordinates in the residual stream at the identified layer. Experiments show that TRC effectively mitigates uncontrolled repetition, reducing loop rates by 57\% on average. Our analysis further shows that repetition semantics emerge in shallow layers and propagate through the residual stream, disrupting normal representations. TRC also generalizes to large language models (LLMs) and large reasoning models (LRMs), where it consistently captures analogous repetition dynamics and achieves effective mitigation. Our work broadens the study of repetitive generation from its prominent internal representations to earlier opportunities for intervention, providing insights for mitigating resource consumption attacks.

</details>


### [222] [StateTree: Enhancing Long-Term Dialogue Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38809)
*Naen Xu,Wanqing Cui,Yibo Hu,Shixin Hong,Hengyu An,Meiguang Jin,Junfeng Ma,Tianyu Du*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: StateTree是一种数据驱动的强化学习方法，通过从稀缺对话中构造树结构路径追踪辅助任务，并采用课程式RL训练，使模型在10K token上下文上训练后能泛化到128K token，在长程对话推理上大幅超越基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型作为个性化助手需对长且不断演化的交互历史进行推理。然而长程对话推理面临证据分散在多个会话、偏好随时间被修改等挑战，而标准的长上下文训练在数据稀缺和计算成本高昂的情况下难以应对这些问题。

Method: 提出StateTree，一种数据驱动的RL方法，从稀缺对话中构造带可验证真值的挑战性辅助任务。它将多会话对话扩充为树结构路径追踪任务：键值记录跨会话嵌入构成二叉树，求解需从根到叶跨会话检索记录并比较时间戳以消解分支，再在干扰叶中恢复隐藏的目标问题。采用逐步增加树深度的课程式RL训练，并引入边携带步骤级推理片段的组合变体，训练模型将部分线索组合为连贯查询。

Result: 在10K token上下文上训练，StateTree泛化到128K token而无需全长度RL成本，展现跨会话检索、时间推理、知识更新和组合多跳推理能力。它优于SFT和RL基线，同时保持短上下文通用推理。StateTree-7B在LongMemEval（128k）上增益达+23.60%，StateTree-14B在LongMemEval上达到59.00%准确率，超过QwenLong-L1-32B（45.20%）。

Conclusion: StateTree通过构造可验证的树结构路径追踪辅助任务与课程式RL训练，有效解决了长程对话推理中的数据稀缺与长上下文训练成本问题，并实现了从短上下文到长上下文的泛化，显著提升长程对话推理性能。

Abstract: Large language models deployed as personalized assistants must reason over long, evolving interaction histories. However, in long-term dialogue reasoning, relevant evidence is scattered across sessions, preferences may be revised over time, and standard long-context training fails to address these challenges under data scarcity and prohibitive computational costs. We propose StateTree, a data-driven RL method that constructs a challenging auxiliary task from scarce dialogues with verifiable ground truth. StateTree augments multi-session dialogues with a tree-structured path-tracing task: key-value records are embedded across sessions to form a binary tree. Solving the task requires the model to traverse from root to leaf by retrieving records across sessions and comparing timestamps to resolve branches, then recover the hidden target question among distractor leaves. We apply curriculum RL training progressively increasing tree depth and introduce a compositional variant whose edges carry step-level reasoning fragments, training the model to compose partial cues into coherent queries. Trained on 10K-token contexts, StateTree generalizes to 128K tokens without full-length RL costs and exhibits capabilities including cross-session retrieval, temporal reasoning, knowledge update, and compositional multi-hop reasoning. StateTree outperforms both SFT and RL-based baselines while preserving short-context general reasoning. StateTree-7B achieves gains up to +23.60% on LongMemEval (128k), and StateTree-14B reaches 59.00% accuracy on LongMemEval, surpassing QwenLong-L1-32B (45.20%).

</details>


### [223] [Can Terminal Agents Trust Their Own Verification? Diagnosing and Improving Self-Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38812)
*Yingfeng Luo,Shaowei Wei,Daixin Wang,Dingyang Lin,Kaiyan Chang,Weiqiao Shan,Tong Zheng,Zhiqiang Zhang,Jingbo Zhu,Tong Xiao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文诊断了终端智能体自验证的可信度，发现主要瓶颈在于错误检测与修复而非验证启动，并提出SCVD蒸馏方法显著提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 终端智能体通过与环境交互并依赖自验证来评估和修正解决方案，但自验证的可信度尚不清楚，缺乏系统性研究。

Method: 提出诊断框架：定位每条轨迹中首个完整解决方案、判定其客观正确性，并以此为真值量化智能体后续验证与恢复行为；基于发现提出Student-Conditioned Verification Distillation (SCVD)，让学生在同一交互上下文中先生成候选解，再蒸馏更强教师的后续验证与恢复能力。

Result: 在TerminalBench2.1上评测十个终端智能体：候选解形成后验证几乎普遍发生，但仅61.43%的错误候选被检测到，且仅49.36%的已检测错误被成功修复。在三个Qwen3.5骨干上，SCVD将Pass@1提升9.74–16.85个百分点（相对基座模型），较标准全轨迹蒸馏提升4.49–8.61个百分点，且避免全轨迹蒸馏在SWE-bench Verified上的明显分布外退化。

Conclusion: 自验证的核心弱点在于错误检测与修复环节；SCVD通过条件化蒸馏教师验证与恢复能力，有效提升终端任务性能并缓解分布外退化。

Abstract: Terminal agents rely on self-verification to assess and correct their solutions as they solve tasks through interaction with command-line environments. Yet how trustworthy such self-verification is remains poorly understood. To investigate this question systematically, we introduce a diagnostic framework that identifies the first complete solution in each trajectory, determines whether it is objectively correct, and uses this ground truth to quantify the agent's subsequent verification and recovery behavior. Applying it to ten terminal agents on TerminalBench2.1, we find that verification is nearly universal after a complete candidate is formed, yet only 61.43\% of incorrect candidates are detected and only 49.36\% of detected errors are successfully repaired. These results show that the main weakness in self-verification lies not in initiating verification, but in detecting and repairing errors. Motivated by these findings, we propose Student-Conditioned Verification Distillation (SCVD), which lets the student first produce a candidate solution and distills a stronger teacher's subsequent verification and recovery from the same interaction context. Across three Qwen3.5 backbones, SCVD improves \textsc{Pass@1} on TerminalBench2.1 by 9.74--16.85 percentage points over the corresponding base models and by 4.49--8.61 points over the standard full-trajectory distillation, while avoiding the pronounced out-of-distribution degradation of full-trajectory distillation on SWE-bench Verified.

</details>


### [224] [You're Hired: Strategic Model Selection for LLM Collaboration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38816)
*Zongwan Cao,Ziyuan Yang,Shangbin Feng,Michael Duan,Skyler Hallinan,Bingbing Wen,Lucy Lu Wang,Yulia Tsvetkov*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究多LLM系统中的模型选择问题，提出并系统评估9种选择算法，实验证明能力/训练相关的选择策略优于随机或启发式方法，最高提升36.1%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多LLM协作系统依赖预定义、手工构建的模型池，形成性能瓶颈，缺乏对模型选择的系统性研究。

Method: 提出9种选择算法的分类体系，涵盖模型描述的多样性、能力感知的行为多样性、基于LLM的招募器；在10和32个模型的两个候选池、4种模型协作算法上，跨数学、编码、QA、推理任务进行实验。

Result: 有效选择算法较随机或基于个体最优表现的启发式团队最高提升36.1%；能力与训练相关的选择策略降低选择方差并取得最佳性能；更大的候选池对浅层启发式更具挑战，而基于与候选模型交互、理解其能力的算法能稳健过滤错位、不安全模型，并泛化到新任务。

Conclusion: 原则化、有依据的团队选择对构建高效多LLM系统至关重要，推荐在部署实际系统前使用能力与训练相关的选择策略。

Abstract: While multi-agent and model collaboration algorithms gain traction to combine the strengths of diverse Large Language Models (LLMs), existing systems remain bottlenecked on pre-defined and hand-crafted model pools. In this work, we investigate the problem of model selection in multi-LLM systems. We propose and systematically evaluate a taxonomy of 9 selection algorithms ranging from diversity of model descriptions, capability-aware behavioral diversity, and LLM-based recruiters. We conduct extensive experiments across two candidate pools of 10 and 32 models, deployed in four model collaboration algorithms, and evaluated across tasks spanning math, coding, QA, and reasoning. Results demonstrate that successful selection algorithms greatly outperform random or heuristics-based teams such as merely selecting the models with top individual performance, by up to 36.1% across settings. Specifically, capability- and training-based selection strategies alleviate selection variance and achieve the best performance, which we recommend to employ before deploying real-world multi-LLM systems. Further analysis reveals that larger candidate pools pose greater challenges to shallow selection heuristics, while algorithms grounded in interacting with candidate models and understanding model capability robustly filter out misaligned, unsafe models, as well as generalizing to novel, out-of-distribution tasks. Together, we establish that principled and informed team selection is critical and present strong model selection algorithms for assembling effective multi-LLM systems.

</details>


### [225] [BARRAC: Adaptation of an English Aspect-based Sentiment Analysis Approach for Classification Tasks in Arabic Dialects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38820)
*Ali Almutairi,Gelareh Mohammadi,Imran Razzak,Aditya Joshi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 BARRAC，将英语方面级情感分析框架适配到阿拉伯语分类任务，在五个阿拉伯语方言数据集上取得 63.93% 平均宏 F1，超过最佳少标签 SOTA 3%，并在五项任务中的四项超过 GPT-4o。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 阿拉伯语 NLP 快速发展，已有大量模型、数据集与基准，但一个核心问题尚未被充分探讨：为英语等主流语言开发的方法能否迁移到阿拉伯语任务。作者希望验证"适配任务特定方法"这一方向与适配模型、数据集、基准同样具有潜力。
