Method: 作者将英语方面级情感分析框架迁移到阿拉伯语分类任务，命名为 BARRAC（Brainstorming Alignment and Replaced Representation learning for ArabiC tasks）。该方法做两项替换：（1）用阿拉伯语语言手段与标记替换消费者评论属性池，用于方言情感、讽刺与方言识别；（2）用两阶段训练替换带噪自训练。

Result: 在五个阿拉伯语方言数据集上评估，BARRAC 取得 63.93% 的平均宏 F1，较最佳少标签 SOTA 提升 3%，并在五个任务中的四个上优于 GPT-4o。误差分析进一步揭示了仍存在的挑战。

Conclusion: 结果表明，在适配模型、数据集与基准之外，适配任务特定方法（task-specific approaches）是阿拉伯语 NLP 的又一有前景的研究方向。

Abstract: With the rapid growth of Arabic NLP, several models, datasets and benchmarks have been reported. This paper asks whether approaches developed for majority languages like English can be adapted to Arabic tasks. We adapt an English aspect-based sentiment analysis framework to Arabic classification tasks and present the adaptation as BARRAC: Brainstorming Alignment and Replaced Representation learning for ArabiC tasks. BARRAC replaces consumer-review attribute pools with Arabic linguistic devices and markers for dialectal sentiment, sarcasm, and dialect identification, and replaces noisy self-training with two-stage training. Evaluated on five Arabic dialect datasets, BARRAC achieves a mean macro-F1 of 63.93\%, outperforming the best few-label SOTA by 3\%, and outperforming GPT-4o on four out of five tasks. Error analysis provides insights into remaining challenges. These results demonstrate that adapting task-specific approaches is a promising direction for Arabic NLP alongside adapting models, datasets and benchmarks.

</details>


### [226] [Forging LLM Authorship Fingerprints with Targeted Rewriting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38831)
*Haohan Yuan,Simin Chen,Xi Niu,Hanqing Guo,Depeng Xu,Haopeng Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出"定向指纹迁移"问题，并给出 ForgePrint 框架，将某模型的输出改写为归因分类器认定的目标模型指纹；在 CNN/DM 上学生模型达到 70.2% 目标成功率，远超教师模型与六个已发表改写基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模型归因分类器虽能在未修改文本上准确识别文本的生成模型，但这种准确性并不能说明文本被有意改写后是否仍指向原始来源；论文旨在揭示"指纹可检测性"与"来源真实性"不可混为一谈，文本归因在定向改写下可能提供误导性的模型身份证据。

Method: 将问题形式化为"定向指纹迁移"：改写某模型输出，使归因分类器将其判为选定的目标模型。任务选择摘要生成，因为不同模型接收同一文档、表达相同底层内容，构成受控的条件生成场景。提出 ForgePrint 的"先搜索后蒸馏"框架：先搜索能把归因推向目标指纹的改写，再将筛选出的改写蒸馏进一次前向的 4B 学生模型。

Result: 在 CNN/DM 上，学生模型取得 70.2% 的目标成功率，优于其教师模型（54.1%）以及六个已发表改写基线中最强者的 39.3%，且对抗的是攻击过程中从未被查询过的留出分类器。从开放模型向选定商业模型迁移摘要时，目标成功率仍达 68.3%。

Conclusion: 指纹可检测性不应等同于来源真实性；即便归因在未修改文本上准确，在定向改写下仅凭文本的归因也可能给出误导性的模型身份证据。

Abstract: Model-attribution classifiers can often identify which language model produced a text, making model-specific writing patterns a signal of provenance. Accurate attribution on unmodified text, however, does not show whether the prediction still identifies the original source after deliberate rewriting. We formulate this problem as targeted fingerprint transfer: rewriting one model's output so that attribution classifiers assign it to a chosen target model. We study summarization, where different models receive the same document and express the same underlying content, providing a controlled setting for conditional generation. We introduce ForgePrint, a search-then-distil framework that first searches for rewrites that move attribution toward a target fingerprint, then distils the selected rewrites into a one-pass 4B Student model. On CNN/DM, the Student reaches 70.2% target success rate, outperforming both its Teacher (54.1%) and the strongest of six published rewriting baselines (39.3%), against held-out classifiers that are never queried by the attack. It also reaches 68.3% target success when transferring summaries from an open model toward chosen commercial models. These results show that fingerprint detectability should not be conflated with source authenticity, and that text-only attribution can provide misleading evidence of model identity under targeted rewriting, even when it is accurate on unmodified text.

</details>


### [227] [Scaling Parameter and Context in Attention: Native Sparse Attention from Mixture-of-Head](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38832)
*Zizhuo Fu,Runsheng Wang,Meng Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出NAMOH，一种架构原生的稀疏注意力机制，通过每token激活H个注意力头中的K个，使注意力参数扩展直接支撑上下文扩展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩展注意力参数可提升语言模型质量，但保留完整token历史会使多头在长上下文中开销高昂；同时注意力需检索并融合上下文信息，因此参数扩展也应支持更长上下文。作者由此探究：注意力参数扩展能否直接实现高效且有效的上下文扩展。

Method: NAMOH每token激活H个头中的K个；每个头只保留其被分配到的token，并在这条子序列内做因果注意力。头选择同时决定激活参数与可用上下文，无需扫描完整历史。在均衡分配下，固定K增大H会缩短各头历史、减少每token的KV访问且不增加总KV存储。还引入头相对旋转位置编码以缩短路由子序列内的位置跨度，缓解位置引起的注意力噪声。

Result: 实验表明，NAMOH在相同总参数量下可优于全激活模型，并在匹配激活参数量时比更小的稠密模型实现更高效的长上下文推理；且与GQA及现有稀疏注意力机制兼容。

Conclusion: 该工作为注意力扩展提供了新路径：参数扩展可直接促成上下文扩展。

Abstract: Scaling attention parameters can improve language model quality, but retaining full token histories makes additional heads costly at long contexts. Furthermore, since attention retrieves and combines contextual information, parameter scaling should also support longer contexts. We therefore ask whether attention parameter scaling can directly enable efficient and effective context scaling. We introduce NAMOH, an architecture-native sparse attention mechanism that activates $K$ of $H$ heads per token. Each head retains only its assigned tokens and performs causal attention within this subsequence. Head selection thus jointly determines active parameters and available context without scanning the full history. Under balanced assignments, increasing $H$ at fixed $K$ shortens head histories and reduces per-token key-value (KV) access without increasing total KV storage. We further support head-relative rotary position embeddings to shorten positional spans within routed subsequences, aiming to mitigate position-induced attention noise. Experiments show that NAMOH can outperform fully activated models with the same total parameters, while enabling more efficient long-context inference than smaller dense models with matched active parameter counts. It remains compatible with GQA and existing sparse attention mechanisms. We hope this work offers a new path for scaling attention, with parameter scaling directly enabling context scaling.

</details>


### [228] [Where MLLMs Fail and Why: Causal Task Decomposition for Capability Failure Diagnosis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38851)
*Xia Hu,Brian Potetz,Chun-Ta Lu,Huanfen Yao,Leonidas Guibas,Zhicheng Wang,Howard Zhou,Pengfei Xing,Andrew Gallagher*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出因果分解框架，通过干预前置依赖，将多模态大模型在组合任务上的失败拆分为"目标能力固有缺陷"与"上游前置能力级联错误"两类，并构建诊断基准 CADET 验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端到端准确率只能记录多模态大模型在组合任务上是否失败，无法区分失败究竟源于目标能力本身的内在缺陷，还是上游前置能力的级联错误，因而难以定位真正的能力短板。

Method: 提出因果分解框架，对每个任务的前置依赖做受控干预：能力指标（NC、IC、RC）分别在无辅助、前置正确、前置错误三种条件下打分，以诊断失败来源；贡献指标（N-Score、S-Score）借鉴因果概率，量化每个前置条件的必要性与充分性以解释失败原因。实例化为 CADET 基准，含10个组合任务、分解为46个单位任务、逾33,000个人工标注问题，覆盖感知、空间、时间、认知四类。

Result: 在前沿多模态大模型上，框架揭示出端到端准确率掩盖的系统性规律：能力层面，提供正确前置可消除认知任务54%的错误，使其由最弱类别跃升至优于空间与时间类别；前置层面，因果贡献集中于少数关键前置，仅补充最重要的单个前置即可获得补充全部前置所带来收益的84%。

Conclusion: 因果分解框架可有效区分固有缺陷与级联错误，比端到端准确率提供更细粒度的诊断信息，并指明提升组合能力的关键前置条件。

Abstract: End-to-end accuracy on compositional tasks records how often MLLMs fail, but cannot distinguish whether a failure reflects an intrinsic deficit in the targeted capability or a cascading error from an upstream prerequisite. We propose a causal decomposition framework that isolates these two failure modes through controlled interventions on the prerequisite dependencies of each task. Our capability metrics (NC, IC, RC) score each task under unassisted, correct, or incorrect prerequisites to diagnose where failures arise; contribution metrics (N-Score, S-Score), adapted from probabilities of causation, quantify each prerequisite's necessity and sufficiency to determine why. We instantiate the framework in CADET, a diagnostic benchmark of 10 composite tasks decomposed into 46 unit tasks with over 33,000 human-annotated questions spanning perception, spatial, temporal, and cognitive categories. Diagnosing frontier MLLMs with our framework uncovers systematic patterns that end-to-end accuracy obscures. Capability-wise, supplying correct prerequisites eliminates 54\% of errors on cognitive tasks, lifting them from weakest to above spatial and temporal. Prerequisite-wise, causal contributions are concentrated in a few critical prerequisites, and supplying the single most important one alone captures 84\% of the gain from supplying all prerequisites.

</details>


### [229] [TRACE: Target-Aware Retrieval, Attributed Evidence, and Contract-Constrained Extraction for LitTraceQA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38861)
*Sachin Gupta,Divya Godara*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出LitTraceQA任务及其"grounding contract gap"问题，并给出TRACE系统以目标感知检索、证据定位、多模态表格抽取和契约约束验证实现可验证问答，在官方71题测试集上取得0.760613分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 检索到相关论文不等于能产生可验证答案：评测要求规范论文标识符、页面/对象级精确证据以及与评分器匹配的类型化答案，而现有流程中源访问与评分可见正确性之间存在断层，即grounding contract gap。

Method: TRACE包含五个组件：目标分组检索（target-grouped retrieval）、独立的类型化证据定位、多模态表格抽取、模式驱动的表格构建以及fail-closed验证。系统通过段落、对象、别名、引文和稠密表示索引27,487篇论文，并在各信号中保留问题目标。表格方面先预测观测单元再抽取数值，并以评测器兼容的键归一化组装行。

Result: 经审计的clean-track结果在官方71题测试集上得分0.760613，其中论文F1为0.9728，证据F1为0.6847，多选准确率0.9800，表格行F1为0.5423，宏平均单元格准确率0.3508。在11条公开开发表格记录上，clean基线与坐标感知视觉填充的row F1分别为0.291和0.411；该诊断对比含回退输出，非官方测试结论。

Conclusion: TRACE通过显式契约约束与目标保留缓解了grounding contract gap，但残余错误主要集中于locator、观测单元、行键与源值身份识别。

Abstract: Finding a relevant paper is not the same as producing a verifiable answer from it. LitTraceQA requires canonical paper identifiers, exact evidence at the page or object level, and typed answers that match the evaluator. We call the separation between source access and scorer-visible correctness the grounding contract gap. TRACE - Target-Aware Retrieval, Attributed Evidence, and Contract-Constrained Extraction - addresses this gap with target-grouped retrieval, independent typed evidence localization, multimodal table extraction, schema-driven table construction, and fail-closed validation. It indexes 27,487 papers through passage, object, alias, citation, and dense representations while retaining the question target behind each signal. For tables, TRACE predicts the observation unit before extracting values and assembles rows with evaluator-compatible key normalization. Our audited selected clean-track artifact scores 0.760613 on the official 71-question test set, including 0.9728 paper F1, 0.6847 evidence F1, 0.9800 multiple-choice accuracy, 0.5423 table-row F1, and 0.3508 macro cell accuracy. On 11 public-development table records, a clean baseline and coordinate-aware visual fill obtain row F1 of 0.291 and 0.411, respectively; this diagnostic comparison includes fallback outputs and is not an official-test claim. Remaining errors chiefly concern locator, observation-unit, row-key, and source-value identity.

</details>


### [230] [GraphForge: Training Working Agents with Graph-Anchored Workspace Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38923)
*Qisheng Su,Hanchen Wang,Guanru Zhu,Huicheng Jiang,Qiuyinzhe Zhang,Kou Shi,Zhen Fang,Ziao Zhang,Qingnan Ren,Zehui Chen,Tao Gui,Feng Zhao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: GraphForge 是一个基于证据图的框架，用真实文件同时支撑任务构建与验证，合成 2,169 条轨迹微调 Qwen3.6-27B，在 GDPVal、Workspace-Bench-Lite 与 SpreadsheetBench II 上均取得提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 训练文件处理型智能体需要基于大量真实文件、且结果可验证的任务数据，但现有合成流程存在两类缺陷：一类用模型生成文件，缺乏真实性与多样性；另一类基于真实文件构建任务却缺少任务特定的验证器，导致结果质量无法核查。

Method: 以职业相关的种子保证多样性，为每个种子组装真实文件工作区，并在文件关系上构建证据图；任务描述与评分标准（rubrics）均从该图派生，使任务要求有工作区文件支撑、每条评分标准锚定到验证所需的文件。随后通过初始 rollout 检验可执行性，并由修订智能体对照原始文件修复任务与评分标准，之后才收集轨迹。此外采用拒绝式微调，用证据锚定的评分标准筛选模型自身 rollout 的候选。

Result: 用 2,169 条 GraphForge 轨迹微调 Qwen3.6-27B：在 OpenHands 下 GDPVal 达 1445.7（+65.7）；在 Claude Code 下 Workspace-Bench-Lite 达 63.7（+7.7），SpreadsheetBench II 达 24.0（+13.7）。对 SFT 模型自身 rollout 做拒绝式微调（候选由证据锚定评分标准筛选），三个基准进一步提升，表明评分标准可作为有效的选择信号。

Conclusion: GraphForge 通过将任务与验证同时锚定在真实文件的证据图上，解决了合成数据真实性与可验证性的双重问题，能有效提升文件处理型智能体的能力，且其评分标准可用作拒绝式微调的选择信号；数据与模型已公开。

Abstract: Working agents need to read diverse files, coordinate tools, and produce deliverables. Training such agents requires tasks built on many real files with verifiable results, but few pipelines exist to synthesize this kind of data. Existing pipelines either generate files with models, which lack realism and diversity, or build tasks on real files without task-specific verifiers, leaving result quality unchecked. We introduce GraphForge, an evidence-graph based framework that grounds both the task and its verification in real files. Starting from occupation-grounded seeds for controlled diversity, GraphForge assembles a workspace of real files for each seed and builds an evidence graph over their relations. Since the task statement and rubrics are both derived from this graph, task requirements are backed by the workspace files and each criterion is anchored to the files needed to verify it. An initial rollout further tests executability, and a revision agent repairs the task and rubrics against the original files before trajectories are collected. Fine-tuning Qwen3.6-27B on 2,169 GraphForge trajectories brings GDPVal to 1445.7 (+65.7) under OpenHands, and Workspace-Bench-Lite and SpreadsheetBench II to 63.7 (+7.7) and 24.0 (+13.7) under Claude Code. Rejection fine-tuning on the SFT model's own rollouts, with candidates selected by the evidence-anchored rubrics, yields further improvements on all three benchmarks, suggesting that the rubrics provide a useful selection signal. The data and models are available.

</details>


### [231] [Making LLMs Say What They Think: Measuring and Improving CoT-Interpretability Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38972)
*Yihuai Hong,Shauli Ravfogel,Chen Zhao,Eunsol Choi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出CIA指标衡量CoT与内部计算的一致性，发现LLM一致性有限（44.8-75.9%），并通过后训练以准确率和参数化忠实度为奖励信号显著提升忠实度且保持或提升准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Chain-of-thought（CoT）常被视为LLM推理过程的代理，但越来越多证据表明CoT往往无法反映模型内部实际计算，且可在不影响最终答案的情况下被改变，因此需要度量并提升CoT与内部计算之间的一致性。

Method: 提出CoT-Interpretability Alignment（CIA）指标，用于衡量模型CoT轨迹与由可解释性工具检测到的内部推理策略之间的一致程度；在三个任务（两跳问答、提示干预、整数乘法）与三个LLM上评估CIA；随后通过后训练改进CIA，将任务准确率与参数化忠实度信号同时作为奖励。

Result: LLM在所有任务上的一致性有限，CIA为44.8-75.9%；后训练实验表明可显著提升CoT参数化忠实度，同时保持或提升任务准确率，并提供了泛化模式等分析。

Conclusion: 该工作既提供了审计CoT参数化忠实度的框架，也给出了使模型显式推理更可信的路径。

Abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) traces often serve as a proxy for how Large Language Models (LLMs) arrive at their answers. However, growing evidence shows that models' CoT often fails to reflect their internal computations and can be changed without affecting their final answers. In this work, we measure and improve the alignment between the reasoning described in an LLM's CoT and what it computes internally. We propose CoT-Interpretability Alignment (CIA), a metric that measures the agreement between a model's CoT traces and its internal reasoning strategies as detected by interpretability tools. We evaluate CIA on three tasks (two-hop question answering, hint intervention, and integer multiplication) across three LLMs, finding that LLMs exhibit limited alignment across all tasks (44.8-75.9%). We then experiment with improving CIA via post-training, setting both the task accuracy and parametric faithfulness signals as a reward. Experiments show that we can substantially improve CoT parametric faithfulness while maintaining or improving the task accuracy. We provide rich analysis, such as their generalization patterns. Our work provides both a framework for auditing CoT parametric faithfulness and a pathway toward making models' explicit reasoning more trustworthy. Code and data are available at https://github.com/yihuaihong/CIA-minimal-repro.

</details>


### [232] [Fairness Beyond a Single Run: Training-Seed Variability in Speech LLM Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38976)
*Srishti Ginjala,Eric Fosler-Lussier,Srinivasan Parthasarathy*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 语音LLM微调中,随机种子对人口统计学公平性指标的影响通常大于音频压缩率;在Fair-Speech族裔归一化差距上种子贡献85.3%方差,压缩率仅8.3%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动语音识别的人口统计学公平性差距几乎总是基于单次训练运行来报告,忽略了随机种子等训练噪声可能带来的方差,导致结论的可靠性存疑。

Method: 固定编码器、基础解码器、数据与解码策略,仅微调语音LLM的Q-former投影器与LoRA适配器;在5种音频压缩因子与6个随机种子上进行训练,并在Common Voice与Fair-Speech上评估;采用平衡3×3分解进行方差归因,并控制准确率与dropout;扩展到960小时适配数据以检验效应稳健性。

Result: 在460小时干净LibriSpeech上,多数人口统计学轴上种子对公平性指标的影响大于压缩率;Fair-Speech族裔归一化差距方差85.3%归因于种子,8.3%归因于压缩率(p=0.009),但压缩率在年龄与性别上解释更多。不同种子间LibriSpeech留出WER差异仅0.04,而Common Voice达8.57,说明并非训练失败。扩大并多样化适配集至960小时后,效应减弱但未消失。Fair-Speech族裔上,单次运行系统需归一化差距差异超过0.30才能超出种子变异性。

Conclusion: 单次运行报告的公平性差距不可靠,种子变异性可超过压缩率等受控因素;比较系统时应以种子可靠性阈值(如0.30)为判据,并报告多种子方差。

Abstract: Demographic fairness gaps in automatic speech recognition are almost always reported from a single training run. We fine-tune the Q-former projector and LoRA adapters of a speech LLM at five audio compression factors and six random seeds, holding the encoder, base decoder, data and decoding fixed, and evaluate every run on Common Voice and Fair-Speech. At 460 h of clean LibriSpeech, the seed moves fairness metrics more than compression does on most demographic axes. A balanced 3x3 decomposition attributes 85.3% of the variation in Fair-Speech ethnicity normalized gap to the seed against 8.3% to compression (p = 0.009), though compression explains more on age and gender. Held-out LibriSpeech word error rate spreads by 0.04 points across those seeds while Common Voice spreads by 8.57, so these are not failed runs, and the effect survives controlling for accuracy and dropout. Scaling and diversifying the adaptation set to 960 h damps the effect but does not remove it. On Fair-Speech ethnicity, two single-run systems must differ by more than 0.30 in normalized gap to exceed seed variability.

</details>


### [233] [When Clipping Reverses Correction: Failure Dynamics of Pointwise Forward-KL On-Policy Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38995)
*Di Huang,Hao Li,Yixin Chen,Fuhai Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文直接检验 on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) 中前向 KL 目标的逐点裁剪（pointwise clipping）对训练的影响，发现裁剪会导致更严重的持续性重复，并从理论上证明裁剪目标可能无法将学生推向教师。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OPSD 原研究提出用逐点裁剪（将每个词表维度上的前向 KL 项以固定阈值封顶）来稳定训练，后续工作沿用该做法，但其对训练的实际效果从未被直接考察。

Method: 在仅裁剪与否不同的匹配训练中进行对照实验；并从理论上分析裁剪目标相对于未裁剪前向 KL 的优化方向。

Result: 裁剪版本产生明显更多、且持续到回答结束的重复（repetition）；理论证明裁剪目标可能无法将学生纠正向教师，反而把被裁剪与未裁剪的词元概率推离教师。训练结果与之吻合：在重复片段内，裁剪后的学生在“退出重复”的词元上概率低于教师、在“继续重复”的词元上概率高于教师，而未裁剪版本则贴近教师。

Conclusion: 逐点裁剪会破坏 OPSD 的蒸馏信号，诱发持续重复；它的稳定作用以牺牲对齐教师为代价，因此沿用该裁剪需谨慎。

Abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) trains a student on its own generated responses using feedback from the same model conditioned on privileged information. On mathematical reasoning, the original OPSD study finds that stylistic tokens can dominate the training signal over math-related tokens, and that pointwise clipping of the forward KL objective stabilizes training. Pointwise clipping caps each vocabulary-wise forward KL term at a fixed threshold before summing over the vocabulary. Follow-up studies have adopted this clipping, but its effect on training has not been directly examined. In matched training runs differing only in whether clipping is applied, we observe that clipped runs produce substantially more repetitions that persist to the end of the response than their unclipped counterparts. We trace this failure to the clipped objective. We prove that the clipped objective can fail to correct the student toward the teacher and can instead push clipped and unclipped token probabilities away from its teacher. Our training runs agree with this analysis: inside repetitions, the clipped student places less probability than its teacher on leaving the repetition, and more on continuing it, whereas the unclipped runs stay close to their teachers.

</details>


### [234] [Settle: Learning When to Stop Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38997)
*Ryan Brown,Zihao Fu,Chris Russell*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Settle 通过已完成的推理轨迹中的答案稳定性来学习何时停止生成，在推理时仅需普通解码，可在几乎不损精度的情况下大幅减少 token 消耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推理模型在答案已经确定后往往仍继续生成冗余内容，导致算力与 token 浪费，因此需要一种能判断何时停止的方法。

Method: Settle 利用完整轨迹中答案的稳定性来确定停止时机；训练模型已有的推理结束 token，同时使其他预测保持接近基础模型；推理阶段仅需普通解码。

Result: 在 Qwen3-4B 与 MATH-500 上，Settle 使 token 数减少 40%，精度仅下降 0.5 个百分点；相比在同一轨迹首次稳定答案处截断后进行监督微调的方法，精度提升 6.16 个百分点，且 token 数基本相当；其停止分数能够预测正确答案是否会保持正确。

Conclusion: Settle 扩展了所评估停止方法的精度—token 数 Pareto 前沿，是一种高效且低开销的推理停止策略。

Abstract: Reasoning models often continue generating after their answers have settled. Settle learns when to stop from answer stability in completed traces. It trains the existing end-of-reasoning token while keeping other predictions close to the base model, and requires only ordinary decoding at inference. On MATH-500 with Qwen3-4B, Settle reduces token count by 40% with a 0.5-percentage-point decrease in accuracy. It gains 6.16 percentage points over supervised fine-tuning on the same traces shortened at their first stable answer, at nearly identical token counts. Its stopping score predicts whether a correct answer will remain correct. Settle extends the accuracy-token-count Pareto frontier of the evaluated stopping methods.

</details>


### [235] [The Invisible Language Tax: Token Premiums of French and Regional Languages in 2026 LLM Tokenizers, and a French-Optimized Prototype](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39001)
*Thomas Serval*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文测量了主流2026年模型分词器的"token溢价"：同一内容在非英语语言（尤其法语）下需要更多token，并探讨其对定价、上下文窗口的影响，同时提出一个降低法语token数的BPE原型Baracoda FR v1.2。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM服务按token计费、上下文窗口也以token计量，但相同内容在不同语言下的token数并不相同，这种跨语言差异会造成成本与可用上下文的不公平，尤其在智能体（agentic）场景下放大差距，因此需要量化并尝试缓解该"token溢价"。

Method: 在七个主流分词器（OpenAI o200k、Llama 3、Qwen3、DeepSeek V3/V4、Gemma 3、Mistral Tekken，以及通过Anthropic计数API访问的Claude第5代分词器）上，使用NTREX-128（124种非英语参考译文）和区域性语言的《世界人权宣言》测量token溢价；并进行受控实验（BPE、Europarl语料、50k词表）研究将法语加入分词器训练数据对溢价的影响。

Result: 法语比英语多需31%–58%的token；简体中文相对英语从少5%到多40%不等，且在七个分词器中六个上比法语更便宜。法国区域及海外语言的token数约为英语的1.6–3.3倍。受控实验中，向训练数据加入法语可快速降低溢价，但存在收益递减且英语成本上升。Baracoda FR v1.2原型在六个从未参与设计、协议事先固定的最终测试语料上，法语token数比Tekken少11.5%，英语少3.7%；剔除与训练数据重叠的测试句及在普通token预算相同条件下结果依然成立。但该原型在其他语言上更差，且在相同词表规模下不优于CroissantLLM。

Conclusion: 跨语言token溢价显著且系统性地存在，会影响成本与上下文使用；通过调整分词器训练数据可部分缓解，原型Baracoda FR v1.2在法语（及英语）上取得改进，但泛化到其他语言较差。需注意这些仅为分词（分割）结果，对模型质量和任务成本的实际影响尚待验证。

Abstract: LLM services are billed per token and context windows are measured in tokens, yet the number of tokens needed for the same content varies across languages. We measure this token premium on seven tokenizers of widely used 2026 models (OpenAI o200k, Llama 3, Qwen3, DeepSeek V3/V4, Gemma 3, Mistral Tekken, and the Claude generation-5 tokenizer via Anthropic's counting API) on NTREX-128 (124 non-English reference translations) and on the Universal Declaration of Human Rights for regional languages. French requires 31% to 58% more tokens than English, whereas Simplified Chinese ranges from 5% fewer to 40% more and is cheaper than French on six of the seven tokenizers. Regional and overseas languages of France pay roughly 1.6 to 3.3 times the English count. We discuss how history re-sending, tiered pricing and fixed context windows amplify the absolute gap in agentic use. In a controlled experiment (BPE, Europarl, 50k vocabulary), adding French to tokenizer training data quickly reduces the premium, with diminishing returns and a growing cost for English. Finally, we present Baracoda FR v1.2, a byte-level BPE prototype with Tekken's vocabulary size. On a final test of six corpora never consulted during design, with a protocol declared fixed beforehand, it uses 11.5% fewer tokens than Tekken on French and 3.7% fewer on English; results hold after removing test sentences overlapping the training data and with an equal ordinary-token budget. It is worse on other languages and, at comparable vocabulary size, does not outperform CroissantLLM. These are segmentation results only; effects on model quality and task cost remain to be shown.

</details>


### [236] [Evidence First, Arithmetic Second: A System Report and Failure Analysis for DocSem](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39013)
*Divya Godara,Sachin Gupta*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: EVICALC系统在DocSem共享任务官方测试中取得8.61%联合准确率，公开验证集上答案为92.17%、证据F1为1.00，但两者配置与指标不同，不可作受控比较；初步个案分析提示OCR与区块合并问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对DocSem共享任务的文档语义/证据定位需求，构建一个能读取PDF、选取段落、生成并执行算术表达式以回答问题的系统，并通过中间结果支持失败诊断。

Method: EVICALC流程为：读取PDF、选择相关段落(passage)、调用语言模型生成算术表达式、在本地代码中求值该表达式；保存中间结果以便检查失败原因。另开展两项探索性分析：对个案进行人工事后描述性分析，以及在100份文档上尝试直接阅读页面图像的探索性研究。

Result: 官方最终测试共1,730个任务，联合准确率为8.61%；单独的公开验证运行中答案准确率为92.17%、证据F1为1.00。探索性阅读页面图像研究在100份文档中仅对22份返回了证据标识符。个案检查中发现OCR与区块(block)分组将相关段落并入其他区块，导致系统依据无关文本作答。

Conclusion: 两组分数因配置与指标不同不构成受控比较；描述性发现仅作失败模式提示，不能据此推断总体得分的成因，需进一步评估以确定原因。

Abstract: EVICALC, our system for the DocSem shared task, achieved 8.61% joint accuracy on 1,730 tasks in the official final test evaluation. It reads a PDF, selects a passage, asks a language model to write an arithmetic expression, and evaluates that expression in local code. Saved intermediate results support inspection of failures. A separate public-validation run achieved 92.17% answer accuracy and 1.00 evidence F1. The configurations and metrics differ, so these scores are not a controlled comparison. Our manual, post-hoc analysis is descriptive: in one inspected case, optical character recognition (OCR) and block grouping merged the relevant passage into another block, and the system answered from unrelated text. An exploratory study of reading page images on 100 documents returned evidence identifiers for only 22 documents. These descriptive findings motivate further evaluation; they do not establish the causes of the overall score.

</details>


### [237] [A Missing Piece for Trustworthy AI Reviewers: From Benchmarking Rhetorical Robustness to SciCore Review](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39027)
*Chenguang Wang,Ming Li,Chengrui Fan,Jianpeng Chen,Han Chen,Tianyi Zhou,Dawei Zhou*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出"修辞鲁棒性"这一评测目标，构建了全稿基准RobustReview，揭示AI审稿人存在"虚假鲁棒性"，并提出双分支审稿方法SciCore以提升稳定性与区分度的联合表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI审稿人可能对表述同一科学内容但措辞不同的稿件给出不同评判，从而导致奖励修辞优化而非科学改进。因此需要将"内容保持改写下的稳定性"与"跨稿件的区分度"作为联合要求，正式定义为修辞鲁棒性。

Method: 构建受控全稿基准RobustReview（含1,260个稿件版本），评测30种审稿人配置；基于发现提出SciCore——一种双分支审稿器，将全稿判断与从稿件中抽取的结构化"科学内核"判断进行平均，融合稿件级评估与内容归一化视角。

Result: 基准揭示"虚假鲁棒性"现象：改写敏感度低的同时伴随跨稿件评分崩塌；人类对齐度与修辞鲁棒性对审稿人的排序不一致；内容聚焦提示协议在不同基座上未能持续提升鲁棒性。在主要GPT-5.5对比中，SciCore在所评测审稿人中取得领先的稳定性-区分度联合表现，同时保持有竞争力的人类对齐度。

Conclusion: 修辞鲁棒性是一个独立的评测目标，基于科学内核的审稿方法具有提升该指标的潜力。

Abstract: AI reviewers can assign different judgments to manuscripts that report the same science in different wording, potentially rewarding rhetorical optimization over scientific improvement. We formulate Rhetorical Robustness as the joint requirement of stability across content-preserving rewrites and discrimination across papers. We introduce RobustReview, a controlled full-manuscript benchmark with 1,260 manuscript versions, and evaluate 30 reviewer configurations. The benchmark reveals false robustness, where low rewrite sensitivity coincides with score collapse across papers, and shows that human alignment and rhetorical robustness rank reviewers differently. Moreover, the evaluated content-focused prompting protocol does not consistently improve robustness across backbones. Motivated by these findings, we introduce SciCore, a dual-branch reviewer that averages a full-manuscript judgment with a judgment based on an extracted, structured science core. This design combines manuscript-level assessment with a content-normalized view intended to reduce rhetorical sensitivity. In our primary GPT-5.5 comparison, SciCore achieves a leading joint stability-discrimination profile among the benchmarked reviewers while maintaining competitive human alignment. These results identify rhetorical robustness as a distinct evaluation target and demonstrate the potential of science-core review to improve it.

</details>


### [238] [RSIGame: Autonomous Agentic Game Development with Recursive Self-improvement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39045)
*Wenyi Wu,Minghao Fu,Jieyu You,Kun Zhou,Siqi Liu,Aayush Salvi,Yiheng Lin,Ce Zhang,Xiaohan Lan,Jiahui Zhu,Yujie Zhong,Qi She,Biwei Huang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: RSIGame 是一个具备递归自我改进能力的自主智能体游戏开发框架，通过局部与全局双循环实现游戏质量的持续提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型使自动游戏生成日益可行，但如何在可玩版本基础上可靠地进一步提升质量仍具挑战。朴素迭代精修容易过拟合小规模测试用例，导致游戏脆弱、遗留缺陷、行为缺失，且难以泛化到更广泛的玩家交互。

Method: RSIGame 将开发过程组织为互补的局部与全局循环。局部循环为"探索—诊断—改进"：广泛探索可执行游戏、诊断并排序发现的问题、基于证据进行修订，并用不断演化的检查清单持续积累新的测试与改进指引。全局循环追踪整体质量、保留最佳检查点，并检测长程开发中的饱和或退化。此外，RSIGame 通过训练将成功的开发经验内化到生成器中。

Result: 在 140 个 GameCraft-Bench 任务、两种游戏引擎和五种生成器上，RSIGame 在相同开发预算下持续提升游戏质量。经验内化使 Qwen3.8-27B 在 Godot 上达到 61.38、在 Phaser 上达到 58.53，超过 GPT-5.5 的一次性生成分数，同时将 Qwen 的生成 token 数减少 11 倍。

Conclusion: RSIGame 通过局部—全局双循环与经验内化机制，在受限开发预算下稳定提升自动生成的游戏质量，并显著降低生成成本。

Abstract: Recent advances in large language models have made automatic game generation increasingly feasible, yet reliably improving generated games beyond a playable version remains challenging. Naive iterative refinement can easily overfit a small set of test cases, producing fragile games with unresolved bugs, missing behaviors, and poor generalization to broader player interactions. We introduce RSIGame, an autonomous agentic game development framework with recursive self-improvement. RSIGame organizes development into complementary local and global loops. Concretely, a local explore-diagnose-improve loop broadly explores the executable game, diagnoses and prioritizes discovered issues, and performs evidence-grounded revision, where an evolving checklist continually accumulates new testing and improvement guidance. A global loop tracks overall quality, preserves the best checkpoint, and detects saturation or regression over long-horizon development. Beyond test-time improvement, RSIGame further internalizes successful development experience into the generator through training. Across 140 GameCraft-Bench tasks, two game engines, and five generators, RSIGame consistently improves game quality under matched development budgets. Notably, experience internalization enables Qwen3.8-27B to reach 61.38 on Godot and 58.53 on Phaser, exceeding GPT-5.5 one-shot scores while reducing Qwen's generation tokens by 11 times.

</details>


### [239] [Structure vs. Chain-of-Thought: Evaluating LLM Criteria Extraction for Depression Severity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39049)
*Xinkai Chen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究系统比较了三种抑郁症严重度评估路径（直接评分、思维链、临床标准抽取）在三个规模LLM、两个Reddit语料和两份问卷上的表现，发现标准抽取的优势高度依赖阈值拟合与校准，且序数一致性提升并不等同于重症检出能力提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准抽取因可逐条审计而理论上优于直接评分或思维链，但其真实增益来源不明：究竟是方法本身更优，还是仅来自阈值调优与标签校准，需要控制变量进行验证。

Method: 在Reddit抑郁相关语料（含一个重标注的压力数据集）上，用三种规模LLM（9B至前沿模型）与两份问卷PHQ-9、BDI-II，比较直接提示、思维链、临床标准抽取三种方法；以二次加权kappa衡量与标签的一致性，并区分阈值由标注数据拟合、由PHQ-9先验固定、以及对思维链重新校准等条件。

Result: 前沿模型仅在决策阈值由标注数据拟合时，标准抽取才在某一语料上超过思维链，且增益不显著，对思维链做同等校准后差异消失；阈值先验固定时抽取无增益。9B模型在抑郁社区语料上倾向把多数帖子判为重症，先验规则反而优于它。更高序数一致性不代表重症检出更好：标准抽取漏掉多数重症帖子，从直接提示到思维链再到抽取，漏检率几乎在所有比较中上升。一个使用压力数据集自身特征（含词数）的模型，在先验规则下与前沿抽取表现无显著差异。

Conclusion: 标准抽取的可审计性优势并未转化为稳健的评估增益，其表面提升多来自阈值拟合与标签校准；序数一致性指标无法反映重症检出，提示临床评估任务应关注召回与重症识别，而非仅依赖kappa类一致性度量。

Abstract: A large language model (LLM) can rate depression severity directly from a social media post or mark which clinical criteria the post shows and let code turn the count into a label. The latter is easier to audit because a clinician can check each marked criterion. We compare these approaches on two Reddit corpora using three LLMs (from 9B to frontier scale) and two questionnaires (PHQ-9, BDI-II), and measure agreement with quadratic weighted kappa. For the two frontier models, criteria extraction scores above chain-of-thought on one corpus only when its decision thresholds are fitted on labeled data. Neither model's gain is significant, with or without recalibrating chain-of-thought on the same labels. With thresholds fixed a priori from PHQ-9's criteria, extraction shows no gain on either corpus, even where models mark over two criteria per post. The 9B model behaves differently on a corpus from depression communities. It labels most posts severe, whether prompted directly or with chain-of-thought, while the a priori rule beats both without labels. After chain-of-thought is recalibrated on the same labels, no significant gap remains, consistent with a calibration effect. Yet higher ordinal agreement does not ensure better detection of severe cases. PHQ-9 criteria extraction misses most severe posts, and moving from direct prompting to chain-of-thought and then to extraction increases misses in nearly all comparisons. On the primary corpus, a relabeled stress dataset, a model using that dataset's own features, including word counts from the text, is not significantly different from frontier criteria extraction under the a priori rule.

</details>


### [240] [CORE: Conflict-Oriented Reasoning Elimination for Verifiable Language-Model Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39069)
*Siyu Song,Rui Xu,Jia Lin,Kai Liu,Weifang Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: CORE是一种测试时推理搜索控制器，利用验证器提供的认证冲突核进行回跳与冲突缓存，避免重复错误。在可满足性条件下搜索完备且不剪枝有效解。图着色实验中，中位验证器调用比时序修复减少39.8%（30变量）和35.0%（36变量）；五个推理任务上平均成功率达75.9%（Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct）和84.2%（Qwen3-8B），优于Tree of Thoughts，且验证器调用与生成token更少。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有测试时推理系统在失败时通常重启或仅修改最后一步，即使错误实际源于更早的决策，导致低效且重复犯错。作者希望利用认证的失败解释来指导搜索方向。

Method: 提出CORE搜索控制器：(1)向验证器请求认证冲突核（certified conflict core）；(2)回跳至该核中最新决策（backjumping）；(3)缓存冲突以避免重复。在可靠验证、有限分支与深度、穷尽提议条件下分析搜索性质。

Result: 在2,000个种植图着色实例上（提议匹配、精确验证器），CORE相对时序修复将中位验证器调用减少39.8%（30变量）和35.0%（36变量），缓存进一步优于单独回跳。五个推理任务上平均成功率达75.9%（Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct）和84.2%（Qwen3-8B），高于Tree of Thoughts的72.5%和81.8%，且两个骨干模型上验证器调用和生成token均更少。

Conclusion: 结果表明，使用认证的失败解释来指导语言模型搜索具有显著价值，能够在保证完备性的同时提升效率与成功率。

Abstract: Test-time reasoning systems often respond to failure by restarting or revising the latest step, even when an earlier decision caused the error. We introduce CORE, a search controller that requests a certified conflict core from a verifier, backjumps to the latest decision in that core, and caches the conflict to avoid repeating it. Under sound verification, finite branching and depth, and exhaustive proposals, the uncapped search is complete and never prunes a valid solution. On 2,000 planted graph-coloring instances with matched proposals and an exact verifier, CORE reduces median verifier calls by 39.8% at 30 variables and 35.0% at 36 variables relative to chronological repair; caching further improves on backjumping alone. Across five reasoning tasks, CORE achieves 75.9% mean success with Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and 84.2% with Qwen3-8B, compared with 72.5% and 81.8% for Tree of Thoughts. It also uses fewer verifier calls and generated tokens on both backbones. These results show the value of using certified failure explanations to direct language-model search.

</details>


### [241] [LexReward: A Taxonomy-Driven Reward Framework for Legal Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39071)
*Yida Cai,Xin Dai,Bingxiang He,Huiyuan Xie,Yuxiao Ye,Zhenghao Liu,Yang Bai,Zhiyuan Liu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 LexReward，一个基于分类体系（taxonomy-driven）的法律奖励建模框架，从 Style、Element、Chain 三个维度刻画法律回复质量，并结合 DPO 与奖励模型训练提升法律语言模型表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有法律语言模型的奖励方法多依赖粗粒度的整体性判断，缺乏领域特异性与可解释性，难以刻画法律回复的多维质量。

Method: LexReward 沿三个互补维度定义法律回复质量：Style（词汇与句法质量）、Element（评估法律主体、事实、法条与判决）、Chain（评估法律推理的顺序、完整性、正确性与非冗余性）；为每个维度设计评分细则（rubrics），规定评价标准与质量等级；据此构造成对偏好数据，用于 DPO 与奖励模型（LexRM）训练。

Result: 实验表明，基于 rubric 的奖励能可靠区分不同质量的法律回复；在偏好数据上进行 DPO 训练可在三个维度上全面提升表现；各维度专属奖励模型可通过强化学习提升对应维度的策略性能，且奖励阶段无需参考答案；逐维度分析进一步验证了所提分类体系与奖励构造的有效性。

Conclusion: LexReward 通过 taxonomy 驱动的多维奖励建模，为法律语言模型提供了更具领域特异性与可解释性的奖励信号，并能有效支持 DPO 训练与下游强化学习优化。

Abstract: Legal language models require reward signals that capture not only answer correctness but also the multidimensional quality of legal responses. Existing reward methods, however, often rely on coarse-grained holistic judgments, providing limited domain specificity and interpretability. We introduce LexReward, a taxonomy-driven framework for legal reward modeling. LexReward characterizes legal response quality along three complementary dimensions: Style, covering lexical and syntactic quality; Element, assessing legal subjects, facts, statutes, and decisions; and Chain, evaluating the order, completeness, correctness, and non-redundancy of legal reasoning. For each dimension, we develop rubrics that specify evaluation criteria and quality levels. The resulting rewards are used to construct pairwise preference data for Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) and reward-model training. Experiments show that the rubric-based rewards reliably distinguish legal responses of different quality and that DPO training on the preference data improves performance across all three dimensions. The learned reward models, LexRM, also support effective downstream optimization: each dimension-specific reward model improves policy performance in its corresponding dimension through reinforcement learning, without requiring reference answers at reward time. Dimension-wise analyses further support the effectiveness of the proposed taxonomy and reward construction.

</details>


### [242] [Beyond Text: LLM-Based Dimensional Emotion Evaluation in Multimodal Dialogue](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39072)
*Yutong Hu,Jinho Choi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出基于LLM的框架，在IEMOCAP上同时进行离散情感识别与VAD维度评估，将声学线索以自然语言描述形式注入；LoRA微调的LLaMA显著优于提示工程的GPT，Valence CCC达0.7822，刷新IEMOCAP最优结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在对话情感识别中已有广泛研究，但在多模态对话的连续维度情感评估上仍鲜有探索；且大模型规模优势与领域适配孰更重要尚不明确。

Method: 在IEMOCAP上构建基于LLM的框架，参照SpeechCueLLM将声学线索转为自然语言描述；对LLaMA、GPT、Qwen三族共6个模型，在零样本提示、少样本提示和LoRA微调三种设定下评测离散情感识别与VAD维度评估，并开展消融实验。

Result: LoRA微调的LLaMA在两项任务上大幅超越提示工程的GPT（尽管GPT规模更大），差距归因于领域适配而非模型容量；最佳模型Valence CCC为0.7822，成为IEMOCAP新SOTA；音频文本描述对小模型提升明显（加权F1 +3.5~3.6），对最大模型增益甚微；VAD各维度性能差异与IEMOCAP标注者一致性层级高度吻合。

Conclusion: 领域适配比模型容量更能决定多模态连续情感评估的表现；声学线索在语言能力受限的小模型上价值最大；VAD维度间的性能不对称可部分由标注一致性解释。

Abstract: Emotion recognition in conversation has been widely studied, but applying Large Language Models (LLMs) to continuous dimensional emotion evaluation in multimodal dialogue remains largely unexplored. We propose an LLM-based framework that performs discrete emotion recognition and Valence-Arousal-Dominance (VAD) dimensional evaluation on IEMOCAP, incorporating acoustic cues as natural language descriptions following the SpeechCueLLM approach. We evaluate six models spanning the LLaMA, GPT, and Qwen families under zero-shot prompting, few-shot prompting, and LoRA fine-tuning. LoRA fine-tuned LLaMA models substantially outperform prompt-engineered GPT models on both tasks despite GPT's larger scale, a gap we attribute to domain adaptation rather than model capacity. Our best model achieves a Valence CCC of 0.7822, a new state-of-the-art on IEMOCAP. Ablation studies confirm that textual audio descriptions meaningfully improve smaller models (+3.5 to 3.6 weighted F1) while contributing little for the largest model, suggesting audio cues are most valuable when linguistic capacity is limited. The performance asymmetry across VAD dimensions closely mirrors the annotator agreement hierarchy in IEMOCAP's own annotations.

</details>


### [243] [False Frontiers: Diagnosing and Mitigating Co-Cheating in Self-Evolving Search Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39102)
*Meijia Chen,Hao Li,Zheng Lu,Hongshan Lin,Junbai Tian,Yichen Liu,Zijun Tian,Yufan Zou,Shuhan Sun,Hanxin Chen,Zeyu Zhang,Weizhi Du,Yueting Li,Tianyu Shi,Alaa Khamis*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 自演化搜索智能体存在“共同作弊”失效模式：提议者与求解器在共享错误上趋同，内部奖励上升但外部正确性不增。作者提出多样本验证（MSV）与跨拟合（CrossFit）方法，后者将源文档分为A/B两组交叉训练辅助求解器进行打分，显著降低假一致并通过七个下游基准验证性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自演化搜索智能体通过联合优化提议者（生成问题）与求解器（回答问题）来构建训练课程，但该闭环会产生“共同作弊”（co-cheating）失效模式：两者在共享错误上日益趋同，导致内部奖励提升而外部正确性并无相应增益。事后审计显示该问题随自演化轮次加剧，伪标签正确率停滞甚至下降，因此需要一种能阻断同源反馈的机制。

Method: 先提出多样本验证（MSV）：对同一模型分别在有源证据和无源证据下各查询三次，据此决定任务是否准入并替换不可靠伪标签。其残留缺陷促使提出主方法CrossFit：将提议者的源文档划分为A、B两组，来自A的问题由仅在B上训练的辅助求解器打分，反之亦然；交叉拟合一致性决定提议者奖励，使同源伪标签无法通过反馈求解器复现，而原求解器更新规则不变。

Result: 在Qwen3.5-4B与Qwen3.5-9B上重跑该循环，MSV将假一致质量从6.1%降至5.7%、从8.8%降至7.2%，而CrossFit分别降至3.0%和3.7%。在排除源证据的反馈下重放相同提议，假一致进一步降至0.4%和0.1%，从而将反馈来源与课程变化分离。在七个下游搜索基准上，CrossFit相对标准耦合自演化平均提升8.8和8.4分，相对Search-R1提升8.7和7.8分。

Conclusion: 同源反馈是自演化搜索智能体中共同作弊的关键成因，CrossFit通过交叉拟合的反馈归因机制有效缓解该问题，在多个模型规模与下游基准上均优于耦合自演化与Search-R1基线。

Abstract: Self-evolving search agents build their own training curricula by jointly optimizing a proposer that generates questions and a solver that answers them. This closed loop introduces a failure mode we call co-cheating: the proposer and solver increasingly agree on shared errors, so internal reward improves without a matching gain in external correctness. A post-hoc audit against source evidence shows co-cheating growing more severe over successive rounds of self-evolution, with pseudo-label correctness stagnating or declining even as the in-loop training signal improves. The most direct mitigation is to verify proposals before training: we introduce multi-sample verification (MSV), which queries the same model three times with the source and three times without it to decide task admission and replace unreliable pseudo-labels. MSV partially reduces false agreement but leaves substantial residual co-cheating and costs six extra labeler generations per candidate. These limitations motivate CrossFit, our main method: it partitions the proposer's source documents into groups A and B; questions generated from A are scored by an auxiliary solver trained only on B, and vice versa. The cross-fitted agreement determines proposer reward, so a same-source pseudo-label cannot be reproduced through the feedback solver, while the original solver's update rule is unchanged. Rerunning the loop with Qwen3.5-4B and Qwen3.5-9B, MSV reduces false-agreement mass from 6.1% to 5.7% and from 8.8% to 7.2%, whereas CrossFit reduces it to 3.0% and 3.7%. Replaying identical proposals with source-excluded feedback further reduces false agreement to 0.4% and 0.1%, isolating feedback ancestry from curriculum changes. Across seven downstream search benchmarks, CrossFit improves average performance over standard coupled self-evolution by 8.8 and 8.4 points and over Search-R1 by 8.7 and 7.8 points at 4B and 9B.

</details>


### [244] [Bongard: Training Machine Intuition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39111)
*Li Ding,Haidi Jin,Chen Ji*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Bongard是一个开权重"System One"直觉模型：基于T5Gemma 2 4B-4B编解码器，通过三阶段训练与结果反馈学习机器直觉，在DecisionBench上达78.05%准确率（61个系统第4名），并具低延迟高吞吐特性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类智能高度依赖习得的直觉（模式识别与情境判断，无需显式展开每个中间步骤），作者希望把"机器直觉"作为一种可独立设计、独立训练的能力来构建，并提供开放、高效、面向高吞吐决策负载的替代方案。

Method: 提出Bongard模型，采用T5Gemma 2 4B-4B编解码分离"读证据"与"做判断"：编码器将状态与问题指令双向编码，多个解码分支共享同一编码，使同一状态的多次判断只需一次读取；训练好的分类头直接在候选上输出概率而不生成文本。训练分三阶段（监督判断→语义关系→动作结果），每阶段在单张Blackwell GPU上更新全部70.9亿可训练参数；随后进行联合嵌入后训练与沙箱阶段，从动作rollout及精确oracle中学习结果分布。

Result: 联合嵌入后训练使留出改写集准确率由75.7%升至85.9%；沙箱阶段使冻结沙箱面板准确率由50.6%升至64.8%；在DecisionBench上对23,900个决策达78.05%准确率，公开对比中位列61个系统第4名。单张RTX PRO 6000上短请求中位延迟36 ms，同一状态的32个问题耗时221 ms。

Conclusion: Bongard表明机器直觉可通过表征学习与结果反馈被系统性训练，为高吞吐决策工作负载提供了开放、高效的方案。

Abstract: Human intelligence relies heavily on learned intuition: recognising patterns and judging situations without explicitly unfolding every intermediate step. We introduce Bongard, an open-weight System One model that treats machine intuition as an independent capability to design and train. A T5Gemma 2 4B-4B encoder-decoder separates reading the evidence from making judgments. The encoder reads the state bidirectionally together with the question instructions, and separate decoder branches share this encoding, so many judgments about the same situation require only one reading of the state. A trained head returns probabilities over the supplied candidates without generating text. Training proceeds in three stages, from supervised judgments to semantic relationships to action outcomes, and each stage updates all 7.09 billion trainable parameters on one Blackwell GPU. Joint-embedding post-training raises accuracy on held-out rephrasings from 75.7% to 85.9%. A sandbox stage then learns outcome distributions from action rollouts and exact oracles, raising accuracy on a frozen sandbox panel from 50.6% to 64.8%. On DecisionBench, the final model reaches 78.05% accuracy over 23,900 decisions and ranks fourth of 61 systems in the public comparison. On one RTX PRO 6000, its median latency is 36 ms for short requests, and 32 questions about one state take 221 ms. Bongard demonstrates that machine intuition can be systematically trained via representation learning and outcome feedback, providing an open, efficient alternative for high-throughput decision workloads.

</details>


### [245] [Diagnosing On-Policy Self-Distillation for Reasoning Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39118)
*Yang Li,Gongle Xue,Yuheng Yuan,Yijia Guo,Shizhe Zhang,Liwen Hu,Lei Ma*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文系统诊断了语言模型数学推理中的 on-policy self-distillation（OPSD），发现其教师信号依赖推理模式对齐与完整教师前缀而非特权语义本身，仅在狭窄的兼容区间内有效，否则会导致无效长度增长、稳定退化或行为崩溃，因此 OPSD 是一种敏感而非通用的推理提升后训练方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OPSD 作为无需外部奖励和独立强教师的推理能力提升方法受到关注，其自教师可借助特权信息在学生轨迹上提供密集信号；但其在语言推理中的行为尚不明确，已有结果从适度增益到行为崩溃不一，亟需系统性诊断。

Method: 在 0.6B--8B 参数规模的模型上进行数学推理的 OPSD 诊断，采用控制实验与 token 级分析，考察教师信号的来源、有效条件及其与下游性能的关系。

Result: 教师信号由推理模式对齐和完整教师前缀塑造，而非仅由特权语义决定；OPSD 仅在狭窄的兼容区间内提升推理，否则表现为无效长度增长、稳定退化或行为崩溃；token 级分析显示教师信号不稳定且无法预测下游性能。

Conclusion: OPSD 是一种敏感算法，而非普遍可靠的推理提升后训练方法。

Abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) has attracted growing interest as a promising approach to improve the reasoning ability of language models. Without external rewards nor a separate stronger teacher, the self-teacher with privileged information could provide dense signals on student's trajectories. However, its behavior in language reasoning remains unclear, with reported outcomes ranging from modest gains to behavioral collapse. In this work, we diagnose OPSD for mathematical reasoning across models spanning 0.6B--8B parameters. We conduct controlled experiments and token-level analyses to fully delve into OPSD. We point out that teacher's signal is shaped by reasoning-mode alignment and the complete teacher prefix, rather than by privileged semantics alone. OPSD improves reasoning only in narrow compatibility regimes. Otherwise, it produces ineffective length growth, stable degradation, or behavioral collapse. Token-level analysis shows that teacher's signal is not stable and does not predict downstream performance. Based on these results, we argue that OPSD is a sensitive algorithm rather than a generally reliable reasoning-improvement post-training method.

</details>


### [246] [DAGent: Evaluate-then-Grow Planning for Deep Research Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39154)
*Hanwen Liu,Yuanfu Sun,Qiaoyu Tan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: DAGent：面向深度研究任务的DAG多智能体框架，用"评估后生长"（Evaluate-then-Grow）的增量规划替代传统"先规划后修补"（Plan-then-Patch），并引入DAGRPO进行结构感知强化学习，在多基准上超越最强开源基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度研究任务需要在庞大知识空间中导航、跨多源综合证据，并随发现动态调整规划。现有基于DAG的多智能体系统虽支持并行执行和子任务依赖隔离，但采用Plan-then-Patch策略：在执行前即实例化任务级规划，仅在失败或证据缺失后才修补图。这种策略在证据最薄弱时承诺最强，后续修订浪费计算在不应规划的支路上，因而脆弱。

Method: 提出DAGent框架：1）Orchestrator采用Evaluate-then-Grow增量规划，一次扩展一批任务图，扩展条件由已完成节点的置信度与不确定性信号决定；2）分层上下文层默认传播紧凑的QueryDocs，同时保留完整执行轨迹以供按需召回；3）记录DAG拓扑，定义结构性RL信号，将GRPO改造为DAGRPO，在Executor rollout注入拓扑条件信用分配，并对Orchestrator规划施加结构合规正则。

Result: 在BrowseComp-Plus、GAIA、xbench-DeepSearch上，Qwen3-235B-A22B规模下分别超过最强开源基线5.3/5.8/2.0分；该优势在四个开源主干上复现，并扩展到327K上下文的GPT-5。Qwen3-8B规模下，DAGRPO相比同预算的仅结果GRPO基线平均Pass@1提升3.0分。同架构对比显示，证据条件规划以更低的单任务token、工具调用与步数达到更高准确率。

Conclusion: 证据条件化的增量规划优于Plan-then-Patch，能以更低计算开销获得更高准确率；DAG拓扑为强化学习提供了结果信号无法定义的结构性信用分配，验证了DAGent与DAGRPO的有效性与可扩展性。

Abstract: Deep research tasks require agents to navigate large knowledge spaces, synthesize evidence across many sources, and adapt their plans as findings emerge. Directed acyclic graph (DAG)-based multi-agent systems suit this setting because they support parallel execution and isolate each sub-task within a focused dependency context. Yet existing DAG-based agents instantiate a task-level plan before execution and repair the graph only after failures or missing evidence are observed. This Plan-then-Patch strategy is brittle for deep research: the system commits most strongly when its evidence is weakest, and later revisions waste computation on branches that should not have been planned. We propose DAGent, a DAG-based multi-agent framework with Evaluate-then-Grow incremental planning: an Orchestrator grows the task graph one batch at a time, conditioning each expansion on confidence and uncertainty signals from completed nodes. A hierarchical context layer propagates compact QueryDocs by default while preserving full execution traces for on-demand recall. The recorded DAG topology admits structural RL signals that outcome-only recipes cannot define; DAGRPO, a GRPO adaptation, injects topology-conditioned credit on Executor rollouts and a structural compliance regularization on Orchestrator plans. Across BrowseComp-Plus, GAIA, and xbench-DeepSearch, DAGent surpasses the strongest open-source baseline by 5.3 / 5.8 / 2.0 points at the Qwen3-235B-A22B scale, and the lead replicates across four open-source backbones and extends to GPT-5 at 327K context. At the Qwen3-8B scale, DAGRPO improves over a same-budget outcome-only GRPO baseline by 3.0 average Pass@1 points. A same-architecture comparison shows that evidence-conditioned planning reaches higher accuracy at lower per-task token, tool-call, and step footprints than its Plan-then-Patch counterpart. Code: https://github.com/hanwenliu6825/DAGent

</details>


### [247] [ViLegalExpert: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Vietnamese Legal Retrieval and Question Answering from Real-World Consultations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39189)
*Dat Tien Nguyen,Nghia Hieu Nguyen,Anh Thi-Hoang Nguyen,Dung Ha Nguyen,Kiet Van Nguyen,Ngan Luu-Thuy Nguyen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: ViLegalExpert：基于真实公民—律师咨询构建的大规模越南法律基准，含172K+问题、34个法律领域、专业答案与专家核验证据，支持检索、抽取式与生成式问答；实验表明证据检索与有据生成难度显著，混合检索表现最佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可信法律AI需在回答法律问题时以权威来源为依据（grounding）。然而现有越南法律基准对真实世界法律咨询的覆盖有限，难以支撑面向实际咨询场景的可靠法律AI评估。

Method: 从真实公民—律师咨询中构建大规模基准ViLegalExpert：包含超过17.2万条问题，覆盖34个法律领域，并配有专业答案与专家核验的法律证据。该基准支持三类任务：法律信息检索、抽取式问答、生成式（摘要式）问答。以代表性检索方法与语言模型进行实验评估。

Result: 实验显示在证据检索与有据答案生成方面存在显著挑战；预训练模型在问答任务上表现较强，而混合检索（hybrid retrieval）取得最佳检索性能。

Conclusion: 将自然表达的法律问题映射到权威法条仍然困难，ViLegalExpert可作为越南可信法律AI的具有挑战性的基准。

Abstract: Trustworthy Legal AI requires systems that can answer legal questions while grounding their responses in authoritative sources. However, existing Vietnamese legal benchmarks provide limited coverage of real-world legal consultations. We introduce \textbf{ViLegalExpert}, a large-scale benchmark constructed from authentic citizen--lawyer consultations, containing over \textbf{172K} questions across \textbf{34 legal domains}, together with professional answers and expert-verified legal evidence. ViLegalExpert supports legal information retrieval, extractive QA, and abstractive QA. Experiments with representative retrieval methods and language models reveal substantial challenges in evidence retrieval and grounded answer generation. While pretrained models perform strongly on QA, hybrid retrieval achieves the best retrieval performance. These results demonstrate the difficulty of mapping naturally expressed legal questions to authoritative provisions and establish ViLegalExpert as a challenging benchmark for reliable Vietnamese Legal AI.

</details>


### [248] [Argument Structure Prediction in Online Conversations: A Comparative Study of Modeling Paradigms and Task Architectures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39225)
*Siddharth Bhargava,Sara Tonelli,Patricia Martín-Rodilla,Javier Parapar*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究系统评估了对话场景下论证结构预测（ASP）的不同方法，发现识别论证关系是主要瓶颈，并公开了数据处理流水线与端到端建模框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期ASP研究虽探索了统一神经模型、多步流水线及基于提示的LLM等多样方法，但其相对权衡（尤其在对话场景下）仍缺乏系统探索。

Method: 在严格schema约束下系统评估ASP，比较监督微调与基于提示的LLM在单步和多步任务架构下的表现，从对话输入端到端生成完整论证结构；在三个由推理锚定理论改编为双极论证结构的对话语料库上进行基准测试，并在统一评测框架下评估预测性能、跨域泛化、schema合规性与计算效率。

Result: ASP仍是具有挑战性的任务，识别论证关系是主要瓶颈，这主要源于对话式论证的隐含性与上下文依赖性。

Conclusion: 为促进未来研究，作者公开了面向对话语料库计算ASP的数据处理流水线与端到端建模框架。

Abstract: Argument structure prediction (ASP) constructs complete argument structures from discourse by identifying argumentative units and their relations. While recent work has explored diverse approaches---including unified neural models, multi-step pipelines, and prompt-based large language models (LLMs)---their relative trade-offs remain under-explored, particularly in dialogical settings.
  We present a systematic evaluation of ASP under strict schema constraints, comparing supervised fine-tuning and prompt-based LLMs across single- and multi-step task architectures, generating complete argument structures from dialogical input end-to-end. We benchmark them on three diverse dialogical corpora adapted from Inference Anchoring Theory into bipolar argument structures. Under a shared evaluation framework, we assess predictive performance, cross-domain generalization, schema compliance, and computational efficiency. Our results show that ASP remains a challenging task, with identifying argumentative relations emerging as the primary bottleneck, largely due to the implicit and context-dependent nature of dialogical argumentation. To facilitate future research, we release our data processing pipeline and end-to-end modeling framework for computational ASP on dialogical corpora.

</details>


### [249] [RAIM: Robust Aggregation of Inexpensive Models for Hallucination Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39229)
*Elia Onofri,Roberto Di Pietro*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出RAIM，一种对成员相关性误差鲁棒的廉价开源评审团聚合方案，用交叉拟合堆叠逻辑回归与可容许性检验，在8个忠实性基准上以1/64成本保留前沿模型93%的中位Cohen's κ和约97%的平衡准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 忠实性自动评估日益依赖LLM作为评判者，但最可靠的评判者是专有前沿模型，成本高昂且不适合高吞吐监测。作者试图探究：一组廉价开源权重评判者（4–9B）能否通过聚合替代前沿评判者、这种替代牺牲了什么、以及何时值得进行这种替代。

Method: 提出RAIM聚合方案：针对成员间相关误差具有鲁棒性，将交叉拟合的堆叠逻辑回归（cross-fitted stacked logistic regression）与可容许性检验（admissibility test）相结合，该检验直接从成员自身输出读取，用以判定聚合是否优于最佳单成员且仍在前沿评判者的可及范围内。实例化使用来自不相交家族的10个评判者，覆盖8个忠实性基准。

Result: 相对于Claude Sonnet，评审团保留其中位93%的Cohen's κ，平均仅损失2.9个百分点的平衡准确率；作为配对差异看，在一个基准上明确改善、三个上明确变差（仅两个差异不可忽略），四个基准结论未定。推理价格为前沿的1/64，主要开销是50–100条标注记录的一次性域内校准。评审团在专用检测器的主场基准上也具竞争力（与GPT-4o相差1.3个准确率点，与LLM-AggreFact榜首相差1.9）；在自建grounded集合上比复跑的最强检测器高出6个点。

Conclusion: 聚合是否划算取决于成员本身：当多个有能力的成员在不同样例上出错时，评审团优于最佳单评判者并接近前沿；当某一成员占主导时，堆叠器退化为该领先者，此时只有前沿模型明显领先。这两种条件都可从校准集零额外成本读出，因此只要该审计允许，廉价评审团即可替代前沿评判者。

Abstract: Automatic evaluation of faithfulness increasingly relies on a large language model acting as a judge, yet the most reliable judges are proprietary frontier models, costly and ill-suited to high-throughput monitoring. We investigate whether a panel of cheap open-weight judges (4--9B) can be aggregated to stand in for a frontier one, what the substitution sacrifices, and when it is worth making. We propose RAIM, an aggregation scheme robust to the members' correlated errors, coupling a cross-fitted stacked logistic regression with an admissibility test that, read from the members' own outputs, identifies when aggregating them improves on their best member and stays within reach of the frontier judge. We instantiate RAIM with ten judges from disjoint families across eight faithfulness benchmarks. Against Claude Sonnet, the panel retains a median 93% of its Cohen's $κ$ and gives up only 2.9 points of balanced accuracy on average; read as paired differences, it clearly improves on one benchmark and clearly worsens on three (only two by a non-negligible margin), leaving four unresolved. At a sixty-fourth of the frontier's inference price, the operative expense is a one-time in-domain calibration on 50--100 labelled records. The panel is also competitive with purpose-trained detectors on their home benchmarks (within 1.3 accuracy points of GPT-4o and 1.9 of the LLM-AggreFact leader), and beats the strongest one we reran by 6 points on our grounded sets. Whether aggregation pays depends on the members themselves: where several capable members err on different items, the panel improves on its best judge and approaches the frontier; where one dominates, the stacker recovers the leader, and only there does the frontier remain materially ahead. Both conditions are read off the calibration set at no further cost, so a cheap panel can stand in for a frontier one wherever this audit admits it.

</details>


### [250] [4MT-VLM: How Coarse Is a VLMs Cognitive Map?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39238)
*Markus Frey*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出4MT-VLM基准数据集，通过程序生成景观并在五种刺激模式下测试16个视觉语言模型的地点识别能力，发现模型在视角旋转后性能骤降至随机水平以下，空间分辨率远逊于人类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体移动时必须能从陌生视角识别地点，这要求具备稳定的三维空间认知。然而现有视觉语言模型（VLM）是否拥有可用的认知地图、其空间表征的精细程度如何尚不清楚，且缺乏与人类可直接对比的评测工具。

Method: 构建4MT-VLM数据集，程序化生成景观，每个场景以五种刺激模式渲染，逐步剥离外观线索而保持布局不变：形状+颜色、仅形状、仅颜色、无物体的裸地形山峰、以及将山峰置于地平线的山谷视角（临床常用于探测人类海马功能）。在16个开源与闭源模型上评测，采用4AFC（四选一）指标，与人类被试的评分方式一致。

Result: 模型能从所学的视角识别地点，但相机移动后即失效：在旋转135°处准确率跌破25%的随机水平，而人类被试为85%。前沿模型（Gemini 3.8 Flash、GPT-5.6）在旋转试次中仅答对39%和31%，只有当干扰物间距超过30米时才回升至85%和55%。

Conclusion: 当前VLM已具备初步的认知地图，但其空间分辨率在根本上过于粗糙，视角一旦改变便无法维持稳定、三维的世界理解，与人类存在显著差距。

Abstract: An agent that moves must recognise a place from a viewpoint it has never seen. We introduce 4MT-VLM, a dataset of procedurally generated landscapes, each rendered across five stimulus modes that remove appearance cues while holding layout fixed: shape and colour, shape only, colour only, bare terrain peaks with no objects, and a valley viewpoint that puts the peaks on the horizon. The last condition is commonly used in clinics to probe hippocampal function in human patients. We test this benchmark across sixteen different open and closed-source models and report 4AFC performance, a measure which is also used to grade human participants. We observe that models identify a place from the studied viewpoint but lose it once the camera moves, dropping below the 25% chance level at 135° where a human observer scores 85%. Frontier models (Gemini 3.8 Flash, GPT-5.6) answer only 39% and 31% of rotated trials correctly, recovering to 85% and 55% only when distractors are moved more than 30 meters apart. Our benchmark demonstrates that while current VLMs possess rudimentary cognitive maps, their spatial resolution remains fundamentally too coarse to maintain a stable, 3D understanding of the world once the viewpoint changes.

</details>


### [251] [Concept Subspaces Compute Beyond the Logit Lens: A Weights-Only Test for Locating Representations Upstream of Readout](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39263)
*Aojie Yuan,Zhiyuan Julian Su,Haiyue Zhang,Zijian Su*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一种双侧几何诊断方法，通过测量提取子空间与去嵌入矩阵主导右奇异方向的重叠度，并结合输出导向的正对照，区分"概念结构"与"主导输出读出方向"，从而限制对概念子空间因果充分性的主张。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 概念子空间对模型行为的影响，并不能说明它与输出读出（readout）之间的关系。"概念子空间有效"常被等同于"该子空间即模型用于输出的表征"，但缺乏对二者几何关系的直接刻画。作者希望建立一个诊断，判断提取出的概念基是否真的对齐模型的输出读出方向，还是仅捕捉了与读出无关的中间结构。

Method: 提出双侧几何诊断：测量提取子空间与去嵌入矩阵（unembedding matrix）主导右奇异方向的重叠度，并以输出导向的正对照进行校准。给定提取基，原始诊断只需模型权重。测试对象为FARS（Format-Agnostic Reasoning Subspace）——从18个推理概念、6种表面形式中提取的10维基。比较9种秩匹配估计器、26个模型；设置同层下一token预测对照（用拟合线性翻译器进行深度匹配）；并在10个互斥概念上重提FARS，验证流程迁移性；另做4模型、3种子干预研究。

Result: 四种来自激活的概念估计器在top-10读出跨度中平均仅携带0.38–0.80%能量；末层PCA为3.56%，在26个模型中有25个超过FARS。同层下一token对照的能量约为FARS的13倍，在全部25个测试模型中均可分离。在10个互斥概念上重提FARS，于24个生成模型中实现62–100%的跨格式检索。干预实验发现依赖模型、面向源方向的效应，但远低于全向量替换的效果。

Conclusion: 几何诊断与干预对照共同表明：概念子空间结构与主导输出读出方向是分离的，FARS并非去嵌入主导方向的对齐物；同时干预效应弱于全向量替换，故应限制"概念子空间具有因果充分性"的论断。所提取的是可迁移的提取流程，而非固定基。

Abstract: A concept subspace's effect on model behavior does not establish how it relates to the output readout. We introduce a two-sided geometric diagnostic that measures an extracted subspace's overlap with the dominant right-singular directions of the unembedding matrix, evaluated against output-oriented positive controls. Given an extracted basis, the raw diagnostic requires only model weights. Our testbed is the Format-Agnostic Reasoning Subspace (FARS), a ten-dimensional basis extracted from eighteen reasoning concepts expressed in six surface forms. Across nine rank-matched estimators and twenty-six models, four activation-derived concept estimators carry only 0.38--0.80% mean energy in the top-ten readout span. Final-layer PCA carries 3.56%, exceeding FARS in 25 of 26 models. A same-layer next-token control, evaluated using a fitted linear translator for depth matching, carries approximately thirteen times more energy than FARS, with separation in all 25 tested models. Re-extracting FARS on ten disjoint concepts yields 62--100% cross-format retrieval across twenty-four generative models, demonstrating transfer of the extraction procedure rather than a fixed basis. A complementary four-model, three-seed intervention study finds model-dependent source-directed effects that remain well below full-vector replacement. Together, the geometry and intervention controls distinguish concept structure from dominant readout directions while limiting claims of causal sufficiency.

</details>


### [252] [Offline Guidance, Online Reasoning: Reusing LLM Feedback for Small Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39346)
*Bohan Zhang,Linan Yue,Weibo Gao,Pengyu Chen,Hong Guo,Yanqi Hao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出可复用潜在修正（RLC），在仅离线访问LLM、SLM参数固定且在线推理只用SLM的约束下，将LLM的一次性自然语言指导转化为SLM隐空间中的持久修正经验并存入外部经验库，按当前推理状态检索复用，从而在无需参数更新和在线LLM调用的情况下持续提升SLM推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM推理能力强但通过商业API访问成本高；SLM便于本地部署但推理能力弱。现有LLM-SLM协作主要有两类范式：一是知识蒸馏，用LLM生成的答案和推理轨迹离线训练SLM，但需要参数更新和额外训练；二是在线协作，在SLM遇到困难时将问题路由给LLM或利用LLM生成的指导与修正，但需要反复访问LLM，且针对特定问题产生的指导在推理后被丢弃，无法惠及后续涉及相似推理状态的问题。因此需要一个更受限但更高效的设定：LLM仅离线访问、SLM参数保持不变、在线推理完全由SLM完成。

Method: 提出可复用潜在修正（Reusable Latent Correction, RLC）。RLC将黑盒LLM给出的一次性自然语言指导转换为SLM隐藏空间中的持久修正经验，并将这些经验存储在外部经验库中；推理时根据SLM当前的推理状态检索相应经验，使SLM在推理过程中复用来源于LLM的修正，而无需任何在线LLM调用，也无需更新SLM参数。

Result: 在多个推理基准和不同规模SLM上的实验表明，RLC能够持续提升SLM的推理表现，且不需要参数更新，也不需要在线调用LLM。代码已开源：https://github.com/ZBH031/reusable-latent-correction。

Conclusion: RLC在LLM仅离线可用、SLM参数固定、在线仅由SLM推理的受限设定下，通过将LLM指导转化为可检索复用的隐空间修正经验，有效提升了SLM推理能力，同时保留SLM的部署优势并避免重复的在线LLM访问。该工作为LLM-SLM协作提供了一种无需训练、无需在线LLM调用的新思路。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) offer strong reasoning capabilities but are often costly to access through commercial APIs, while small language models (SLMs) are easier to deploy locally yet remain weaker in reasoning. This capability-deployment gap has motivated LLM-SLM collaboration, which aims to improve SLM reasoning using LLM capabilities while preserving the deployment advantages of SLMs. Existing approaches mainly follow two paradigms. Knowledge distillation uses LLM-generated answers and reasoning trajectories to train SLMs offline, but requires parameter updates and additional training. Alternatively, online collaboration routes difficult problems to an LLM or leverages LLM-generated guidance and corrections when an SLM encounters difficulties. Although effective, online collaboration requires repeated LLM access. Moreover, the guidance produced for a particular problem is discarded after inference and cannot benefit subsequent problems involving similar reasoning states. In the paper, we focus on a more constrained setting in which the LLM is accessed only offline, the SLM parameters remain fixed, and online inference is performed solely by the SLM. To this end, we propose Reusable Latent Correction (RLC), which converts one-off natural-language guidance from a black-box LLM into persistent corrective experiences in the hidden space of an SLM. RLC stores these experiences in an external bank and retrieves them according to the SLM's current reasoning state, enabling the SLM to reuse LLM-derived corrections during inference without any online LLM calls. Experiments across multiple reasoning benchmarks and SLM scales show that RLC consistently improves SLM reasoning without parameter updates or online LLM calls. Code is available at https://github.com/ZBH031/reusable-latent-correction.

</details>


### [253] [Working Around the Compute Ceiling: Byte-Exact Memory in Galahad Makes LLM Reading a One-Time Cost LLM Reading a One-Time Cost](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39358)
*Sietse Schelpe*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出 Galahad 内存层（含 Taliesin 与 Blaise 两个组件），为 vLLM、SGLang 和 llama.cpp 增加状态化推理能力，避免重复计算已读文本的 KV 状态，大幅降低时延与能耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer 每 token 计算量有界，而现有服务是无状态的：模型回答同一文档的第二个问题时，需从首个 token 重新计算文档注意力状态。实测七个真实数据集上 98.7% 的提示 token 是模型已读过的文本，存在巨大重复计算浪费。

Method: Galahad 是面向 vLLM、SGLang、llama.cpp 的内存层。Taliesin 保存文本块的 KV 状态，在后续含相同字节的请求中直接加载而非重算；Blaise 保留文档本身，仅把问题所需段落传给模型。加载不通过校验时回退重算（fail-closed）。

Result: 在 97,000 token 语料、100 条事实召回测试（Gemma 4 31B）中，仅 Taliesin 即让模型关注全语料，llama.cpp 上答对 98/100，每题 3.0 s、572 J；无 Galahad 的基线仅能保留最后 12,000 token，答对 10/100，9.3 s、2,754 J。加入 Blaise 后每题约读 668 token，三个运行时均答对 100/100，0.59-0.64 s、200-213 J；调优后的 RAGFlow 管线答对 77。存储语料为一次性成本约 100 s、28 kJ，13 个问题后即可收回能耗。恢复状态逐位一致：重启、再水化与热加载后 262,144 个输出 logits 全部匹配。在 vLLM 下测试的 30 个模型均适用。

Conclusion: Galahad 将 LLM 服务从无状态推向状态化推理：通过复用 KV 状态与按需文档加载，显著提升召回准确率并降低时延与能耗，且状态恢复逐位一致、具备安全回退机制，兼容多个运行时与大量模型。

Abstract: A transformer language model performs a bounded amount of computation per token, and recent work by Vishal Sikka, former CEO of Infosys, argues that this bound limits which tasks a model can carry out or verify (arXiv:2507.07505). We ask how much of the budget beneath that ceiling is spent on work the model has already done. Serving is stateless across requests: a model that answers a second question about a document recomputes the document's attention state from the first token. On seven real-world datasets, 98.7% of prompt tokens were text the model had already read. We present Galahad, a memory layer for vLLM, SGLang and llama.cpp that makes this reading a one-time cost. Taliesin saves the model's key-value (KV) state for a block of text and loads it on the next request that contains the same bytes, instead of recomputing it. Blaise keeps the documents themselves and passes the model only the section a question needs. On a recall test with 100 facts hidden in a 97,000-token corpus (Gemma 4 31B), Taliesin alone let the model attend to the whole corpus and answered 98 of 100 on llama.cpp at 3.0 s and 572 J per question, against 10 of 100, 9.3 s and 2,754 J for the same model without Galahad, which could hold only the last 12,000 tokens. With Blaise added, the model read about 668 tokens per question and answered 100 of 100 on all three runtimes at 0.59-0.64 s and 200-213 J; a tuned RAGFlow pipeline answered 77. Storing the corpus is a one-time cost of about 100 s and 28 kJ, whose energy is recovered after 13 questions. Restored state is bit-identical: all 262,144 output logits matched after restart, rehydration and hot-load. Galahad worked with all 30 models we tested under vLLM, and it fails closed: any load that does not pass its checks is recomputed. Together these results move LLM serving from stateless to stateful inference.

</details>


### [254] [Ready2Blend: From Natural-Language Instructions to Composable Alignment Prompts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39365)
*Jeesu Jung,Hwan Chang,Juseon Do,Jeonghwan Choi,Jinho Choo,Sungwoo Nam,S. K. Hong,Hwanjun Song*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Ready2Blend 通过 AlignFormer 将自然语言需求映射为模块化对齐提示，配合可组合性正则实现提示空间的加权融合，在冻结主干下达到后训练方法的对齐效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 持续对齐要求 LLM 适应新需求且不遗忘旧行为。自然语言指令灵活可组合但控制间接，后训练控制强但需反复更新参数。论文希望兼得两者优势。

Method: 提出 AlignFormer：将每条需求映射为定长对齐提示并存入模块化提示库，主干与既有提示保持冻结；引入可组合性正则，把文本需求的语义几何迁移到提示空间，以支持推理时提示的加权融合与重加权。

Result: 在两种持续对齐设定下，Ready2Blend 是唯一匹配后训练对齐方法的冻结主干方案，达到联合训练参考的 93.1–98.5%，保持性有竞争力，仅需少量提示 token，训练时间最多减少 4.3 倍。

Conclusion: 模块化设计进一步支持加权个性化与无顺序组合且无需重训练，说明冻结主干 + 提示库的持续对齐方案可行，代码将在录用后发布。

Abstract: Continual alignment requires LLMs to adapt to new requirements without forgetting previously acquired behaviors. Natural-language instructions are flexible and composable but offer only indirect control, whereas post-training provides stronger adaptation at the cost of repeated parameter updates. We introduce Ready2Blend, which combines the flexibility of natural language with learned alignment. AlignFormer maps each requirement to a fixed-length alignment prompt stored in a modular prompt bank, while the backbone and prior prompts remain frozen. Composability regularization transfers the semantic geometry of textual requirements into prompt space, enabling inference-time blending and reweighting. Across two practical continual alignment settings, Ready2Blend is the only frozen-backbone method that matches post-training-based alignment methods, reaching $93.1$-$98.5\%$ of a joint-training reference with competitive retention, while requiring only a few prompt tokens and up to $4.3\times$ less training time. Its modular design further enables weighted personalization and order-free composition without retraining. Code will be released upon acceptance.

</details>


### [255] [Making Grid Beam Search Less Greedy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39368)
*Sean Papay,Roman Klinger*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文指出 grid beam search 在满足词汇约束时存在偏向：优先纳入易满足的约束，将较难约束留到序列末尾。作者提出 fair grid beam search，在保持线性前向调用次数的同时消除该偏差，并能找到更高概率的生成串。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归文本生成的词汇约束解码中，DFA-constrained beam search 需指数级前向调用，成本高；grid beam search 只需线性前向调用，因而更受青睐。但 grid beam search 虽加速显著，却未平等对待所有约束，存在对约束满足顺序的隐性偏好，影响生成质量与公平性。

Method: 作者先对 grid beam search 的约束排序行为进行理论分析，证明其倾向于先纳入更易满足的约束，而将更难约束置于序列后部；DFA-constrained beam search 则无此偏差。为此提出 fair grid beam search：对 grid beam search 进行修改，以消除上述偏差，同时仍保持仅需线性数量的前向调用。

Result: 在两个受约束生成任务上验证了 grid beam search 的偏差：相较 DFA-constrained beam search 与 fair grid beam search，其约束词排序存在显著差异。fair grid beam search 不仅修正了该偏差，还在过程中找到概率更高的字符串。

Conclusion: grid beam search 的约束处理顺序存在系统性偏差，而 fair grid beam search 能在线性前向调用代价下消除偏差并提升生成串概率，为词汇约束解码提供了更公平且更优的替代方案。

Abstract: A common formalism for constraining the output of autoregressive text generation models involves lexical constraints, words or phrases which are required to occur in the generated text. DFA-constrained beam search and grid beam search are two widely used paradigms for decoding from autoregressive models while enforcing lexical constraints. As the former approach requires a number of forward passes exponential in the number of constraint tokens, it is often dispreferred to the latter, which requires only linearly many forward calls. However, while grid beam search achieves an exponential speedup, it does so in a manner which does not treat all of the constraints equally. In this paper, we demonstrate that grid beam search is biased to incorporate easier-to-satisfy constraints first, leaving harder constraints to the end of the sequence. This contrasts with DFA-constrained beam search, which exhibits no such bias. To address this shortcoming, we propose fair grid beam search, a modification to grid beam search which avoids this bias while still requiring only linearly many forward passes. Experimentally, we confirm grid beam search's bias on two constrained generation tasks, finding significant differences in how it orders constraint tokens as compared to DFA-constrained beam search and fair grid beam search. Furthermore, we find that fair grid beam search not only fixes grid beam search's bias, but finds higher-probability strings in the process.

</details>


### [256] [Exploring Heterogeneous Model Merging Approach for Complex Knowledge Transfer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39369)
*Jiahe Fan,Si Chen,Yinghao Hou,Wenbo Xia,Ke Xu,Hong Xie,Enhong Chen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文研究能否在参数层面将专家模型的能力直接迁移到通用语言模型，无需训练、蒸馏或表示对齐。作者将两种免训练异构合并方法（IM 和 APM）应用于"专家→通用"迁移，在嵌入、重排序、奖励建模与 MoE 代码专家四类任务上均提升了通用接收模型的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 专家模型擅长面向特定任务的行为，但把这类能力迁移到通用语言模型通常依赖训练、知识蒸馏或表示对齐等需要梯度或语义对齐的成本较高手段。作者希望探究这种能力迁移能否在参数层面直接完成，从而绕开上述依赖。

Method: 采用两种已有的免训练异构合并方法（此前用于通用语言模型间知识迁移），将其迁移到"专家→通用"场景。核心做法是把专家捐赠模型投影到接收模型的形状，并对主干参数进行插值，全程不进行梯度更新或语义对齐。其中 Intersection-Merge (IM) 注入与接收模型形状匹配的前缀对齐捐赠切片；Activate-Prune-Merge (APM) 则利用前向传播的激活统计量来选择应先保留哪些捐赠维度，再进行注入。

Result: 在嵌入、重排序、奖励建模以及 MoE 代码专家迁移等多类任务上，IM 与 APM 两种方法均提升了通用接收模型的表现，说明简单的异构合并即可把能力跨越多种专家角色进行迁移。

Conclusion: 免训练的参数级异构合并方法能够实现专家能力向通用语言模型的有效迁移，且无需训练、蒸馏与语义对齐。这表明简单的异构合并足以在多种专家角色间传递能力，为专家到通用模型的迁移提供了一条低成本路径。

Abstract: Specialized models encode task-oriented behavior, but transferring that behavior to a general language model usually requires training, distillation, or representation alignment. We study whether such ability can instead be transferred directly at the parameter level. We apply two existing training-free heterogeneous merging methods, previously shown to transfer knowledge between general language models, to specialist-to-general transfer, projecting a specialist donor into the recipient's shape and interpolating backbone parameters without gradient updates or semantic alignment. Intersection-Merge (IM) injects a prefix-aligned donor slice matching the recipient shape, while Activate-Prune-Merge (APM) uses forward-pass activation statistics to select which donor dimensions to retain before injection. Across embedding, reranking, reward modeling, and MoE code-specialist transfer, both methods improve the general recipient, showing that simple heterogeneous merging can move capabilities across diverse specialist roles.

</details>


### [257] [TTLab at Daleel 2026: STAR-Ar, Sequence Tagging for Argument Recognition in Arabic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39385)
*Bhuvanesh Verma,Ali Abusaleh,Alexander Mehler*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出STAR-Ar系统，采用BERT-BiLSTM-CRF架构联合建模阿拉伯语论证语篇单元（ADU）的检测与分类任务，验证集F1为72.69，测试集F1为73.7。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 阿拉伯语论证挖掘（AM）作为关键NLP任务严重缺乏资源。本文面向Daleel 2026——首个阿拉伯语论证挖掘共享任务，旨在填补该领域空白。

Method: 将ADU识别与分类两个目标联合建模为词级序列标注任务，采用BERT-BiLSTM-CRF架构，结合上下文Transformer嵌入与结构转移约束以支持精确的跨度检测。

Result: STAR-Ar在验证集上F1为72.69，测试集上F1为73.7。领域分析表明，仅在社论上训练的模型表现逊于在辩论文本上训练的模型，主要归因于社论数据集规模较小。

Conclusion: BERT-BiLSTM-CRF架构可有效处理阿拉伯语论证语篇的联合检测与分类；数据规模（而非领域本身）是导致社论与辩论性能差异的主要因素。代码已开源。

Abstract: Argument Mining (AM) is a critical NLP task that remains significantly under-resourced in Arabic. This paper presents $\testtt{STAR-Ar}$, a BERT-BiLSTM-CRF architecture for argument discourse detection and classification, as our system for Daleel 2026, the inaugural Arabic argument mining shared task. The task requires the identification and classification of argumentative discourse units (ADUs) in debate and editorial texts.We jointly model these two objectives as a token-level sequence labeling task using a BERT-BiLSTM-CRF architecture that combines contextual transformer embeddings with structural transition constraints to support accurate span detection. $\testtt{STAR-Ar}$ achieves an F1-score of 72.69 on validation and 73.7 on test data. Our domain-specific analysis shows that models trained exclusively on editorials underperform those trained on debates, a disparity we primarily attribute to the smaller size of the editorial dataset. The code for $\testtt{STAR-Ar}$ is available at ${\href{https://github.com/ENTAILab/daleel_2026_Arabic-Argumentative-Discourse-Mining}{\faGithub~TTLab at Daleel 2026}}$

</details>


### [258] [QuantCode Model: Specializing Language Models for Executable Algorithmic Trading Code](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39420)
*Alexey Chernysh,Orkhan Ekhtibarov,Dmitry Zmitrovich*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文研究如何将大语言模型专精于可执行的算法交易代码生成，比较了框架代码继续预训练与基于智能体验证数据的监督微调（SFT）两种机制，并揭示领域专精会损害结构化工具调用能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 算法交易是可执行代码生成中要求极高的专精场景：模型不仅要生成正确的程序逻辑，还需针对特定交易框架执行、在历史数据上回测并保持语义忠实。通用大模型难以直接胜任，因此需要研究专门化的机制，同时关注专精过程中可能出现的能力退化问题。

Method: 采用两种互补的专精机制：1）在算法交易框架代码上进行继续预训练；2）在经智能体验证的“请求-代码”配对数据上进行有监督微调。评估以 QuantCode-Bench（400个 Backtrader 策略生成任务）为核心，并辅以类似 SWE-bench 的仓库级评测轨道，同时考察智能体多轮修复能力与结构化工具调用的保留情况。

Result: 继续预训练将单轮 Judge Pass 从41.5%提升至47.5%（Qwen3.5-397B-A17B），从27.8%提升至33.0%（Qwen3.6-35B-A3B）。在继续预训练后施加 SFT，对 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 增益更大，达58.2% Judge Pass 与83.5%回测成功率；智能体评估中首轮成功率由22.3%升至58.3%，最多10轮后的最终成功率由47.5%升至79.5%。仅继续预训练虽提升首轮成功率，但修复后的最终成功率反而从47.5%降至32.5%，与指令遵循能力退化一致；SFT 则同时提升两者。另发现能力保留失败：领域专精损害了解析器兼容的结构化工具调用，针对性恢复 SFT 可修复工具调用格式，但无法恢复基座检查点的仓库级智能体性能。

Conclusion: 框架导向的继续预训练、经验证的 SFT 与显式的能力保留评估分别针对领域特定可执行代码生成中的不同失效模式。领域专精并非无代价，需在提升专精能力的同时显式监控并保留通用能力（如结构化工具调用与仓库级智能体表现）。

Abstract: Large language models are strong general-purpose code generators, but executable algorithmic trading remains a demanding specialization target: a model must translate a natural-language strategy specification into correct program logic for a specialized trading framework, execute on historical data, produce trades, and remain semantically faithful to the request. We study two complementary mechanisms for specializing language models for this setting: continued pretraining on algorithmic-trading framework code and supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on agent-validated request-to-code pairs. Evaluation is centered on QuantCode-Bench, our 400-task benchmark for Backtrader strategy generation, together with a repository-level SWE-bench-like track. Continued pretraining improves single-turn Judge Pass from 41.5% to 47.5% for Qwen3.5-397B-A17B and from 27.8% to 33.0% for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B. SFT applied after continued pretraining yields a larger gain for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, reaching 58.2% Judge Pass and 83.5% successful backtests; in agentic evaluation it raises first-turn success from 22.3% to 58.3% and final success after up to 10 turns from 47.5% to 79.5%. Continued pretraining alone improves first-turn agentic success but lowers final success after repair from 47.5% to 32.5%, consistent with degraded instruction following, whereas SFT improves both. We also identify a capability-retention failure: domain specialization degrades parser-conformant structured tool calling, and targeted recovery SFT restores tool-call formatting but not the base checkpoint's repository-level agent performance. The results show that framework-oriented pretraining, validated SFT, and explicit capability-retention evaluation address distinct failure modes in domain-specific executable code generation.

</details>


### [259] [DuplexAct-Bench: Broadening Full-Duplex Speech Evaluation toward Proactive Interaction across Diverse Behavioral Requirements](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39446)
*Keyue Xing,Wentao Ding,Mengmeng Wang,Wenming Tu,Zilong Zheng,Yipeng Kang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出 DuplexAct-Bench，一个覆盖六种互补交互行为的双语全双工语音基准，对12个系统在1290次流式试验中进行评测，发现现有系统在实时交互的时机与内容管理上仍不稳健。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有全双工语音基准仅覆盖真实交互行为的子集，且上下文条件有限，缺乏对交互行为、上下文条件进行系统性覆盖的评测手段，难以全面衡量系统在实时交互中的参与能力。

Method: 构建 DuplexAct-Bench 双语基准，系统覆盖六种互补交互行为（打断、让渡、主动发起、主动沉默、反馈应答等），并横跨 Pre-session、In-session 与 No-explicit 三类上下文条件；在1290次中英文流式试验中，从 Timing（时机）与 Content（内容）两个维度对12个全双工语音系统进行评测。

Result: 评测结果显示，系统表现在不同交互行为、上下文条件与系统之间存在显著差异，并且语义质量与行为时机之间频繁出现不匹配现象。

Conclusion: 当前全双工语音系统在实时交互过程中，对"何时参与、是否参与、如何参与"的管理仍远未达到稳健水平，DuplexAct-Bench 为这类能力的系统化评测提供了基准。

Abstract: Existing full-duplex speech benchmarks cover only subsets of real-time interaction behaviors, often under limited contextual conditions. We introduce DuplexAct-Bench, a bilingual benchmark that systematically covers six complementary behaviors, from interruption and yielding to proactive initiation, active silence, and backchanneling, across Pre-session, In-session, and No-explicit conditions. Across 1,290 English and Chinese streaming trials, we evaluate 12 full-duplex speech systems on both Timing and Content. Results reveal substantial variation across behaviors, conditions, and systems, as well as frequent mismatches between semantic quality and behavioral timing.
