These findings show that current systems remain far from robustly managing when, whether, and how to participate as real-time interaction unfolds. Project page: https://alitaxky.icu/DuplexAct-Bench/

</details>


### [260] [Synthetic Data Characterization via Training Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39447)
*Irene Lago,Ana Ezquerro,David Vilares*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文通过样本级可学习性刻画LLM生成数据，对比不同LLM家族与规模及人类数据，并评估基于可学习性的数据选择策略的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解LLM生成数据的性质对评估其在学习任务中的效用与局限至关重要，但现有工作对合成数据的样本级特性及跨模型变异的刻画不足。

Method: 生成覆盖单标签/多标签分类、标注和树预测任务的合成数据集；基于编码器训练动态推导机器数据与真实数据的经验数据分布；估计这些分布在多个编码器上的稳健性；评估基于可学习性信号的数据选择策略。

Result: 得到了LLM合成数据与人类数据在样本级可学习性上的经验分布，并量化了该分布在编码器间的稳健性；揭示了基于该信号的数据选择策略对两类数据源的不同影响。

Conclusion: 样本级可学习性可作为刻画合成数据特性的有效视角，且数据选择策略需针对合成数据与人类数据的差异进行差异化设计。

Abstract: Interpreting properties of LLM-generated data is important for understanding its utility and limitations across learning tasks. In this work, we characterize synthetic data through sample-level learnability, studying variation among LLM families and scales, alongside human-written data as a reference. We first generate synthetic datasets spanning single- and multi-label classification, labeling, and tree prediction tasks. We then derive empirical data distributions from encoder training dynamics for both machine and organic data, and estimate the robustness of these distributions across encoders. Finally, we evaluate how data selection strategies based on these learnability signals affect both data sources differently.

</details>


### [261] [Right-Wing Rock or Just Rock? A Computational Linguistic Analysis of Frei.Wild](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39460)
*Carlotta Schneeberger,Kevin Tang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文通过构建德国摇滚与右翼摇滚语料库，用词汇分析和分类器判定乐队Frei.Wild的政治倾向，发现其维持政治模糊性但整体偏向右翼，超半数歌曲被预测为右翼极端主义。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 右翼摇滚（Rechtsrock）传播右翼意识形态并常被用于招募青少年进入激进圈层。监管机构依靠人工审查乃至封禁极端内容，但存在逃避监管的边界案例。作者希望判断乐队Frei.Wild究竟应归为政治右倾还是普通德国摇滚，并探索计算方法在识别此类边界案例中的作用。

Method: 构建两个语料库：采样的德国摇滚数据集，以及为分析新建的右翼摇滚语料库作为参照。在此数据基础上进行词汇层面的叙事分析，并训练分类器（性能达最高97% ROC-AUC）对Frei.Wild歌曲进行右翼倾向判定。

Result: 证实了以往调查的直觉：Frei.Wild在政治归属上成功维持了模糊性，但倾向指向右翼谱系。词汇分析揭示其歌词中的民族主义叙事；两个高性能分类器将超过一半的歌曲标记为右翼极端主义。

Conclusion: 计算分析方法可提升在音乐中识别右翼极端主义倾向的流程，尤其适用于Frei.Wild这类边界模糊的案例；代码与数据已公开以供后续研究。

Abstract: Rechtsrock is a subgenre of rock music that spreads right-wing ideology, often instrumentalized to recruit adolescents into the radical scene. Monitoring institutions counteract this by manually examining and, in some cases, banning extremist content; however, there are border cases that evade regulation. We present a study aimed at determining whether such a case, the band Frei.Wild, should be classified as politically right-leaning or as part of the general German rock genre. We sampled a German rock dataset and created a corpus for right-wing rock to use as reference in this analysis and found that we can confirm the intuitions from previous investigations that Frei.Wild successfully maintains an ambiguity with regard to their political affiliation. However, the tendency is towards the right-wing spectrum. Lexical analyses reveal nationalistic narratives and two high-performing classifiers (up to 97% ROC-AUC score) label more than half of their songs as right-wing extremist. Our analysis provides insight into how computational methods can improve the process of identifying right-wing extremist tendencies in music, especially in borderline cases like Frei.Wild. The code and data are made available for future research.

</details>


### [262] [Spike-driven Vision-Language-Action Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39514)
*Shuai Wang,Malu Zhang,Mingquan Liu,Weihui Dai,Dehao Zhang,Jieyuan Zhang,Yimeng Shan,Zijian Zhou,Yang Yang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出首个脉冲驱动的VLA框架，支持机器人操作的端到端直接训练，在LIBERO与Meta-World上以更少参数和更低推理能耗取得有竞争力的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型多依赖大型Transformer，其延迟与能耗开销大，难以部署在资源受限平台上；脉冲神经网络通过稀疏事件驱动计算，为高能效计算提供了可行范式。

Method: 框架含三个核心组件：(1) 脉冲视觉与指令编码器，将视觉观测和语言指令编码为稀疏可靠的脉冲表示用于跨模态融合；(2) Multi-Winner Spike Fusion，采用双向top-k赢者通吃脉冲路由实现指令引导的场景理解，抑制背景干扰并生成融合记忆；(3) Spike Action Chunking Transformer，在融合记忆与当前机器人状态上引入脉冲交叉注意力，端到端生成连续动作块。

Result: 在LIBERO和Meta-World上的大量实验表明，Spike-driven VLA在参数更少、估计推理能耗更低的情况下，性能可与传统VLA模型相竞争。

Conclusion: 该工作为神经形态VLA建模建立了基础框架，为资源高效具身智能的后续发展开辟了道路。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models bridge multimodal understanding and robotic control, advancing the dominant paradigm for embodied intelligence. However, most existing models rely on large Transformers, whose latency and energy costs hinder deployment on resource-constrained platforms. Through sparse event-driven computation, spiking neural networks offer a promising paradigm for high-performance and energy-efficient computing. Here, we propose the first Spike-driven VLA framework enabling end-to-end direct training for robotic manipulation, which mainly comprises three core components. First, we develop spiking visual and instruction encoders for multimodal perception, encoding visual observations and language instructions into sparse, reliable spike representations for subsequent cross-modal fusion. Then, we introduce Multi-Winner Spike Fusion for instruction-guided scene understanding, using bidirectional top-$k$ winner-take-all spike routing to suppress background interference and yield fused memory. Finally, we propose a Spike Action Chunking Transformer that incorporates spiking cross-attention over the fused memory and the current robot state, enabling efficient end-to-end generation of continuous action chunks for robotic control. Extensive experiments on LIBERO and Meta-World demonstrate that Spike-driven VLA achieves competitive performance with fewer parameters and lower estimated inference energy than conventional VLA models. This work establishes a foundational framework for neuromorphic VLA modeling, paving the way for future advances in resource-efficient embodied intelligence.

</details>


### [263] [CATCH: A Controllable Analysis Testbed for Reward Hacking in Coding RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39533)
*Shouli Wang,Yanfeng Jia,Zhihao Ou,Zitao Su,Ruize He,Haotong Xie,Hao Peng,Juanzi Li,Xiaozhi Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出CATCH，一个用于研究代码强化学习（RL）中奖励黑客（reward hacking）的可控测试平台，通过环境漏洞与独立审计提供金标签，支持对黑客倾向与奖励难度进行系统调控，并揭示CoT监控的保护会随训练被"代码注释误导"侵蚀。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）中，大语言模型可能利用环境漏洞获取高奖励而不提升目标能力，即奖励黑客。该现象威胁训练效率与安全，但训练过程中的监控与缓解面临困难，根本瓶颈在于缺乏能复现黑客行为并可靠识别它的测试平台。

Method: 提出CATCH，面向代码RL的可控测试平台：有意暴露环境漏洞，并通过"脆弱评估器下的成功"与"独立审计下的任务正确性"对比，给出基于执行的金标签。同时通过监督微调数据混合调控模型初始黑客倾向，通过奖励设计调控获得奖励的难度，从而支持对黑客动态与干预措施的系统比较。

Result: 实验表明CATCH能产生带有明显奖励黑客行为的多样化RL训练轨迹；分析显示初始模型与奖励难度共同塑造奖励黑客的出现。进一步评估了多种检测与缓解方法，关键发现是链式思维（CoT）监控初期能抑制黑客，但随着策略模型学会用代码注释误导监控器，这种保护会逐渐失效。

Conclusion: CATCH可作为研究代码RL奖励黑客的可控测试平台，说明需要在训练全过程评估缓解方法而非仅早期；作者公开了源码与资源（https://github.com/THUAIS-Lab/CATCH）。

Abstract: During reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), large language models (LLMs) can exploit loopholes in their environments to obtain high rewards without improving the intended capabilities, i.e., reward hacking. Despite its risks to training efficiency and safety, monitoring and mitigating reward hacking during training remain challenging, which is limited by a lack of testbeds that reproduce hacking and reliably identify it. We introduce CATCH, a controllable testbed for studying reward hacking in coding RL. CATCH deliberately exposes environmental loopholes and provides execution-based gold labels by comparing success under a vulnerable evaluator with task correctness under an independent audit. It also can control the model's initial hacking tendency through supervised fine-tuning data mixtures and the difficulty of earning rewards through reward designing, enabling systematic comparisons of hacking dynamics and interventions. Experiments show that CATCH can produce diverse RL training trajectories with clear reward hacking, and analyses demonstrate that both initial models and reward difficulties shape the emergence of reward hacking. We further evaluate the effectiveness of different reward hacking detection and mitigation methods. A key finding is that a chain-of-thought monitor initially suppresses hacking, but this protection erodes as the policy model learn to mislead the monitor with code comments. This highlights the need to evaluate hacking mitigations throughout training with CATCH. The source code and resources are publicly released at https://github.com/THUAIS-Lab/CATCH.

</details>


### [264] [Compact Language, Complex Model Shifts: How and Where Ambiguity and Underspecification Affect LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39572)
*Michaela Regneri,Nina Scheller,Sören Laue*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文通过人工构造同音异义词（伪同音词）和上义词（伪上位词），研究词汇歧义与语义欠明确对语言模型训练的影响，并给出其内部表示机制的解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究词汇歧义（lexical ambiguity）与语义欠明确（underspecification）如何影响语言模型的训练过程，并理解模型是否及如何在内部表示和处理歧义与消歧现象。

Method: 构造人工同音异义词与人工上位词作为伪词（pseudowords），在训练语料中逐步增加这些歧义/欠明确伪词类型的数量，观察语言模型生成性能的变化；进一步分析模型是否对歧义或欠明确语句进行消歧，并给出歧义与消歧内部表示的首个机制性解释。

Result: 歧义与欠明确均能提升模型性能，且提升幅度与它们对语言类型-形符比（type-token ratio）的影响成比例；但包含歧义词或其同义词的序列生成准确率低于其他文本。伪词的内部表示反映出伪同音词被消歧，而伪上位词的欠明确性在生成过程中得以保持。

Conclusion: 词汇歧义与欠明确对语言模型训练具有双重作用：一方面通过影响类型-形符比提升整体性能，另一方面降低含歧义内容的生成准确率；模型内部能够对同音歧义进行消歧，但对上义关系的欠明确性予以保留。

Abstract: We analyze how lexical ambiguity and underspecification affect language model training. We create artificial homonyms and artificial hypernyms as pseudowords and analyze the generative performance of language models as they are trained with increasing amounts of these ambiguous or underspecified pseudoword types. We further analyze whether the models disambiguate ambiguous or underspecified statements and provide a first mechanistic account of how ambiguity and disambiguation are represented internally. Our main results show that both ambiguity and underspecification increase model performance in ways that scale with their influence on the language's type-token ratio. However, the accuracy of generating sequences containing ambiguous words or their synonyms decreases compared to other texts. We also show that internal representations of pseudowords reflect disambiguation of pseudo-homonyms, but underspecification of pseudo-hypernyms is maintained during the generative process.

</details>


### [265] [Thinking Outside the Box: Can Language Models Rely on External Guidance Selectively?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39578)
*Minghan Wang,Boyuan Wang,Jinhang Zuo,Yuxin Tao,Fang kong*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出Box²-Bench基准，在固定模型与任务的前提下改变工作流可靠性，以隔离并度量模型对指导信息的取舍能力（即"跳出框架思考"）。实验显示前沿模型受益于可靠指导但在误导性指导面前脆弱；通过反事实监督微调与基于结果的强化学习可部分习得该能力，且该行为可迁移到同伴纠错、损坏记忆等其他外部信息场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Agent harnesses依靠人工设计的工作流提升语言模型表现，但随模型能力增强，不可靠的指导反而会限制其执行能力。现有评估多关注任务表现，缺乏对"选择性依赖外部信息"这一可靠性维度的刻画与度量。

Method: 构建Box²-Bench基准：固定模型与任务，仅改变工作流的可靠性，从而隔离模型对指导依赖程度的调控能力。在此基础上训练两个开放权重模型，训练时仅使用"坏工作流"，保留"好工作流"用于评估。采用两种互补训练策略：反事实监督微调（counterfactual SFT）与基于结果的强化学习。并将结论外推检验至同伴纠错与损坏记忆等外部信息形式。

Result: 在Box²-Bench上，前沿模型在指导可靠时普遍受益，但当指导具有误导性或变得不可靠时仍表现脆弱。反事实监督微调提升了鲁棒性；基于结果的强化学习可将权衡向更多采用有帮助工作流的方向偏移。该行为可迁移至工作流之外的场景：改善同伴纠错表现，并提升对损坏记忆的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 对外部易错信息的选择性依赖是agent可靠性的一个独立维度，无法仅由任务表现来捕获。该能力可被学习（不同训练策略在鲁棒性与有用指导利用率上各有侧重），并具有跨场景泛化性。

Abstract: Agent harnesses often improve language models with human-designed workflows, but as models grow more capable, unreliable guidance can increasingly constrain their execution. We call the ability to benefit from useful guidance while overriding unreliable guidance thinking outside the box. We introduce Box$^2$-Bench, which holds the model and task fixed while varying workflow reliability to isolate how models regulate their reliance on guidance. On Box$^2$-Bench, frontier models often benefit from reliable guidance but remain vulnerable when it is misleading or becomes unreliable. To test whether this capability can be learned, we train two open-weight models using bad workflows, reserving good workflows for evaluation. We explore two complementary training strategies: counterfactual supervised fine-tuning improves robustness, while outcome-based reinforcement learning can shift the balance toward greater use of helpful workflows. We further find that this behavior extends beyond workflows to other forms of external information, improving peer correction and robustness to corrupted memory. Together, our results identify selective reliance on fallible external information as a dimension of agent reliability not captured by task performance alone.

</details>


### [266] [Is This Evidence Decision-Critical? Learning to Verify Rule-Governed Decisions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39608)
*Haoyang Zhang,Jianpeng Zhao,Qi Hao,Pengyang Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出InterPact框架，通过反事实证据干预与决策敏感度学习，训练语言模型判断规则决策中的关键证据，准确率达68.28%，优于六个基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 规则驱动推理（如资格审核、合同审查）中，模型需依据显式规则评估各条件的证据并组合判断。证据评估出错有时不改变决策，但对决策关键证据的误读或遗漏会逆转结果。识别关键证据可使更强模型聚焦于相应条件判断，从而支持准确且安全的决策。识别关键性需理解证据如何影响条件判断、以及条件判断如何影响决策。

Method: 提出InterPact（基于干预的影响学习框架），实现规则决策下证据关键性的反事实验证。其证据干预构造器利用冻结语言模型编辑案件事实，同时固定规则与非目标条件，生成传播验证器的训练对；人工审核标签记录由此产生的条件与决策变化，完整的状态—决策映射用于监督观测编辑之外的后果。训练时，验证器通过固定的组合操作，用基于证据的条件概率对所学条件决策预测加权，将决策变化监督传播至基础模型。推理时，训练好的基础模型直接从原始案件与目标证据判断关键性，无需人工或更强模型监督。

Result: 在改编的规则决策案例上的单案例证据关键性验证任务中，InterPact达到68.28%准确率，优于全部六个基线。

Conclusion: 结果表明，学习到的决策敏感度可作为优先安排证据核查的依据，为规则决策中关键证据的识别提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Rule-based reasoning, as in eligibility checks and contract reviews, requires language models to assess evidence against individual conditions and combine their judgments under explicit rules. Errors in evidence assessment can leave a decision unchanged, but misinterpreting or overlooking decision-critical evidence can reverse it. Identifying such evidence allows more capable models to focus on checking the corresponding condition judgments, supporting accurate and safe decisions. Recognizing the evidence's criticality requires understanding how evidence affects a condition judgment and how that judgment affects the decision. To achieve the goal, we propose a INTERvention-based imPACT learning framework (InterPact), which enables counterfactual verification of evidence criticality in rule-governed decisions. Specifically, its evidence intervention constructor generates training pairs for a propagation verifier by editing case facts with a frozen language model while holding rules and non-target conditions fixed. Human-reviewed labels record the resulting condition and decision changes, while complete state-to-decision mappings supervise consequences beyond the observed edit. During training, the verifier weights learned conditional decision predictions by evidence-based condition probabilities through a fixed composition operation, propagating decision-change supervision into the base model. At inference, the trained base model directly judges criticality from the original case and target evidence, without human or stronger-model supervision. On single-case evidence criticality verification over adapted rule-governed decision cases, InterPact achieves 68.28% accuracy, outperforming all six baselines. These results support learned decision sensitivity as a basis for prioritizing evidence checks.

</details>


### [267] [Marginal Response Surface Elicitation for Zero-Label Tabular Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39639)
*Liangyu Teng,Yicheng Ding,Jing Liu,Hengsong Liu,Juncen Guo,Hongru Li,Jingyu Zhang,Liang Song*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: MARS将LLM的特征级先验转化为可复用的零样本表格分类器，在八个基准任务上取得最高平均AUC/AP，并显著降低成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统表格学习依赖标注数据；虽可利用LLM依据任务描述与特征语义引出领域先验以实现无标注预测，但直接提示方式预测性能有限且端到端成本较高。

Method: MARS（Marginal Response Surface Elicitation）：从无标注数据中为每个特征选取代表性取值，提示LLM给出对应的类别支持分数与特征权重；对多个响应取中位数以构建特征响应函数，并通过其加权和进行预测，无需后续LLM查询。

Result: 在八个表格基准任务上，MARS取得最高平均AUC与AP，较直接提示分别提升1.97和6.21个百分点，同时大幅降低端到端成本；不同规模LLM的评测进一步验证其相对直接提示的预测优势。

Conclusion: 通过将LLM特征级先验转化为可复用的零样本分类器，MARS在无需标注数据的情况下实现了更优的表格预测性能与更低的推理成本，且优势在不同规模LLM上具有稳健性。

Abstract: Tabular learning uses structured data to predict target outcomes. Traditionally, this process has relied on labeled data. However, large language models (LLMs) can be used to elicit domain priors based on the task description and feature semantics, thereby enabling predictions without labeled data. We propose Marginal Response Surface Elicitation (MARS), a method that transforms feature-level LLM priors into a reusable, zero-shot tabular classifier. To construct this classifier, MARS selects representative values for each feature from unlabeled data and prompts the LLM to provide corresponding class support scores and feature weights. It then aggregates multiple responses using the median to construct feature response functions, and makes predictions through their weighted sum without further LLM queries. Across eight tabular benchmark tasks, MARS achieves the highest average AUC and AP, outperforming direct prompting by 1.97 and 6.21 percentage points respectively, while substantially reducing end-to-end costs. Evaluations with LLMs of different sizes further demonstrate its predictive advantage over direct prompting.

</details>


### [268] [Zero-Compute Cross-Lingual Transferability Estimation Using Typological Feature Proxies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39640)
*Dalton Raphael Harmsen,Swier Garst,Thomas van Osch,Zarè Palanciyan,Joaquin Vanschoren*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 类型学特征可低成本预测跨语言迁移效果，其信号不受文字系统与语系混杂影响，而高资源语言的优势主要源于资源与文字偏置而非类型学。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨语言迁移的量化测量通常依赖大规模多语言预训练与跨语言迁移矩阵，计算成本高昂。本文探究迁移效果能否由公开的类型学特征预测，并检验高资源源语言的优势究竟反映类型学相似性还是数据质量与数量的偏置。

Method: 在24语言的已有迁移矩阵上，仅使用类型学特征训练随机森林进行留一语言预测，并与非类型学对照模型比较；进一步采用留一文字系统（leave-one-script-out）和留一语系（leave-one-family-out）协议检验稳健性；最后将迁移分解为类型学项与资源-文字偏置项。

Result: 仅用类型学的随机森林取得留一语言出 ρ=0.705、R²=0.49，优于非类型学对照的 ρ=0.62；该信号在留一文字与留一语系协议下依然存在，说明文字与语系混杂不能解释该效应。将迁移分解后发现最佳源语言排序对资源-文字偏置敏感，而类型学不受该偏置影响。

Conclusion: 类型学数据库包含廉价且密集的跨语言迁移信号，可重构昂贵的实测迁移矩阵，并作为零计算的筛选工具，用一次模型拟合替代数百次训练运行。

Abstract: Cross-lingual transfer describes how knowledge in a source language benefits a target language. Measuring it quantitatively requires broad multilingual pre-training, as prior work has done with cross-lingual transfer matrices. We ask whether transfer is predictable from freely available typological features, and whether the prominence of high-resource source languages reflects typology or data quality and quantity. We show that typological databases contain cheap and dense signals about cross-lingual transfer. Our typology-only random forest on a 24-language prior-work transfer matrix scores leave-one-language-out $ρ{=}0.705$ and $R^2{=}0.49$, beating a non-typological control at $ρ{=}0.62$, which verifies the ability of typology-only predictions to reconstruct costly measured cross-lingual transfer. The signal survives leave-one-script-out and leave-one-family-out protocols, so script and family confounding do not explain the effect. By decomposing the transfer into a typology term and a resource-and-script bias term, we find the best-source ranking sensitive to this bias. In contrast, typology is not affected by this bias, which makes it a zero-compute screening tool that replaces hundreds of training runs with a model fit. Our code is available \href{https://github.com/dharmsen/typo-x-ling-transfer}{here}.

</details>


### [269] [SEPAL: Separated Expert Pairs with Answer-Level Fusion for Reliable LLM Collaboration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39645)
*Weijie Ren,Yanwen Zhang,Hao Li,Zhuolin Qi,Hengyi Zhang,Naibo Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出SEPAL方法，通过三个私有的Actor-Critic团队分别负责直接推理、证据定位和验证，角色专属训练赋予团队不同的推理目标，团队内部Critic指导修改以避免错误跨候选传播，最终仅对最终答案进行多数投票。在五个开源骨干模型和五个问答基准上，平均准确率较匹配的单Actor-Critic对提升1.81个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多智能体协作通过审议和反馈提升LLM问答能力，但共享讨论会将纠错与暴露于相同错误耦合在一起，可能侵蚀投票所需的多样性。自洽性方法无需反馈即可提供采样多样性，而单对Actor-Critic协作只能优化一个候选。因此需要一种既能保持候选多样性又能进行有效纠正的机制。

Method: SEPAL为直接推理、证据定位和验证分别分配三个私有的Actor-Critic团队。通过角色专属训练，使各团队除采样差异外还具有不同的推理目标。每个Critic仅在本团队内部指导修改，防止反馈将错误跨候选传播。修改结束后，仅对最终答案进行多数投票，推理历史在决策前保持相互独立。

Result: 在五个开源权重骨干模型和五个问答基准上，SEPAL相较匹配的单Actor-Critic对将平均准确率提升1.81个百分点，且在全部五个骨干模型上均有一致提升。代码已开源。

Conclusion: 通过将多智能体协作拆分为角色专属的私有Actor-Critic团队并延迟至最终答案才进行投票，SEPAL在保持候选多样性的同时实现有效纠错，显著且稳定地提升LLM问答准确率。

Abstract: Multi-agent collaboration lets large language models (LLMs) improve question answering through deliberation and feedback. Yet shared discussion couples correction with exposure to the same mistakes, which can erode the diversity needed for voting. Self-consistency offers sampling diversity without feedback, while single-pair Actor-Critic collaboration refines only one candidate. We introduce SEPAL, which assigns three private Actor-Critic teams to direct reasoning, evidence grounding, and verification. Role-specific training gives the teams different reasoning objectives beyond sampling variation. Each Critic guides revisions within its own team, preventing feedback from carrying errors across candidates. Once revision ends, majority voting combines only the final answers, keeping the reasoning histories separate until the decision. Across five open-weight backbones and five question-answering benchmarks, SEPAL improves mean accuracy by 1.81 percentage points over a matched single Actor-Critic pair, with improvements across all five backbones. Code is available at https://github.com/zhansan114514/SEPAL.

</details>


### [270] [The Evolution of Attention in Large Language Models: Mechanisms, Trade-offs, and Emerging Trends](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39661)
*Zhentao Tan,Jingyi Shen,Yanbo Li,Yao Liu,Yue Wu,Jieping Ye*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该综述将高效序列建模的各类机制统一重构为"模型内部上下文记忆"，提出五维分析视角（记忆表示、更新、访问、读出、整合），并基于59条发布级记录与14个模型谱系、11个开源端点，归纳出记忆功能趋同、跨深度协同以及有状态多维记忆路由假设三大结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自注意力虽为LLM提供细粒度、查询依赖的上下文访问，但稠密token交互带来二次预填充开销与随上下文增长的KV缓存代价。相关研究分散于显式记忆压缩、稀疏访问、循环状态构建、结构化状态动力学与异构机制组合等多条路线，缺乏统一框架进行比较，因此需要一种不依赖单一计算模型的分析视角来整合这些并行发展。

Method: 提出五维分析视角——Memory Representation（表示什么）、Memory Update（如何变化）、Access（何为查询可及）、Readout（如何读取）、Integration（读出如何形成输出），用于比较重叠的研究路线而不强加单一计算模型。以59条发布级记录，覆盖14个主要模型谱系与11个高性能开源权重端点，重建机制级发展与架构采纳轨迹。

Result: 第一，显式记忆与循环状态方法保留各自接口，但在记忆功能控制上日益重叠。第二，异构架构愈发在网络深度上协同：逐层组合在不同表示阶段分配互补的记忆处理，跨层复用则向前传递选定的记忆与路由产物，使深度成为构建与管理上下文记忆的维度。第三，由此提出有状态多维记忆路由假设：持久记忆按时间范围、网络深度、基底类型与表示粒度组织，并由协同的Sparse Write与Sparse Read决定维持什么、以及哪些内容对每次查询有贡献。

Conclusion: 高效序列架构设计正日益聚焦于上下文记忆的组织、生命周期与选择性使用，而非孤立的Attention算子；五维视角与多维记忆路由假设为跨路线的机制比较与未来架构设计提供了统一框架。

Abstract: Self-attention gives LLMs fine-grained, query-dependent access to context, but dense token interactions incur quadratic prefill cost and a key--value cache growing with context length. Research thus spans explicit-memory compression, sparse access, recurrent state construction, structured state dynamics, and heterogeneous mechanism composition. This survey analyzes these developments as model-internal contextual memory. We introduce a five-dimensional lens---Memory Representation, Memory Update, Access, Readout, and Integration---describing what is represented, how it changes, what is query-eligible, how it is read, and how readouts form outputs. This lens compares overlapping research lines without imposing one computational model.
  We reconstruct mechanism-level developments and architectural adoption using 59 release-level records from 14 major model lineages and 11 high-performing open-weight endpoints. First, explicit-memory and recurrent-state methods retain distinct interfaces but increasingly control overlapping memory functions. Second, heterogeneous architectures increasingly coordinate across network depth: layer-wise composition distributes complementary memory processing across representational stages, while cross-layer reuse carries selected memory and routing artifacts forward. Depth thus becomes a dimension along which contextual memory is constructed and managed. Third, these developments motivate a stateful multidimensional memory-routing hypothesis: persistent memory is organized across temporal scope, network depth, substrate type, and representation granularity, while coordinated Sparse Write and Sparse Read determine what is maintained and what contributes to each query. Overall, efficient sequence architecture design increasingly concerns the organization, lifecycle, and selective use of contextual memory rather than an isolated Attention operator.

</details>


### [271] [Better Supervision Is Nearby: Neighborhood On-Policy Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39687)
*Xincheng Wei,Yifan Ding,Yoshua Li,Yuquan Lu,Ziheng Li,Yi Lu,Dongsheng Ma,Rongxiang Weng,Xunliang Cai*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 Neighborhood OPSD（N-OPSD），利用局部参数扰动构建冻结专家池，将互补的参考对齐纠正转化为学生访问状态上的监督，在三个数学推理基准上稳定优于标准 on-policy 自蒸馏。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准 on-policy 自蒸馏（OPSD）在每个状态只使用一个固定参数的特权教师，监督信号有限；而邻近的参数设置可能在同一参考上下文下提供互补的、参考对齐的纠正，且不同专家在不同参考位置上给出这些纠正，其并集覆盖的位置比未扰动的特权教师更多。

Method: N-OPSD 分为离线与在线两步。离线：通过贪心选择构建紧凑的冻结专家池，奖励在每一位置上超出当前池最优的、经过过滤的参考 token 增益。在线：将锚方向与其支持程度分离，MaxPeak 选出锚 token，分位数选择在 top token 与锚一致的专家中挑选；学生通过继承自 OPSD 的截断前向 KL 目标，从所选专家的完整下一 token 分布中学习。

Result: 在 AIME 2024、AIME 2025、HMMT February 2025 上，每种方法三次独立运行，N-OPSD 相比 OPSD 在三基准 Average@12 上分别提升 2.75（Qwen3-1.7B）、1.67（4B）、1.94（8B）分；学生前缀续写支持将专家池用于参考轨迹之外；匹配消融支持以过滤参考 token 增益作为选择准则；计入池内重叠并按状态路由进一步提升准确率。

Conclusion: 局部参数扰动可提供互补监督，N-OPSD 通过离线专家池构建与在线锚-支持分离路由有效利用这些纠正，获得一致性提升；推理阶段仅需蒸馏后的学生模型。

Abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) trains mathematical reasoning models using a privileged teacher that sees a reference solution and supervises student-sampled prefixes. Standard OPSD uses one fixed parameter setting at every state, but nearby settings may offer additional supervision. We find that local parameter perturbations reveal complementary reference-aligned corrections under the same reference context. Different experts supply these corrections at different reference positions. Their pool covers more such positions than the unperturbed privileged teacher. We introduce Neighborhood OPSD (N-OPSD) to turn these corrections into supervision at student-visited states. Offline, greedy selection builds a compact pool of frozen experts by rewarding filtered reference-token gains beyond the pool's current best at each position. The highest-peak expert need not provide the best training target. Online routing therefore separates the anchor direction from its level of support. MaxPeak selects the anchor token, and quantile selection chooses among experts whose top token matches it. The student learns from the chosen expert's full next-token distribution through the clipped forward-KL objective inherited from OPSD. We evaluate on AIME 2024, AIME 2025, and HMMT February 2025. Across three independent runs per method, Neighborhood OPSD improves the three-benchmark Average@12 over OPSD by 2.75, 1.67, and 1.94 points on Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, and 8B, respectively. Student-prefix continuations support using the pool beyond the reference trajectories used for selection. Matched ablations support filtered reference-token gains as a selection criterion. Accounting for overlap within the pool and routing by state further improve student accuracy. Inference uses only the distilled student.

</details>


### [272] [Drift Inspector: Exploring and Measuring Scientific Drift with Atomic Contribution Claims](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39710)
*Vsevolod Karimov,Stepan Ostarkov,Anastasia Poroshina,Anatoly Frolov,Alexander Panchenko*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出 Drift Inspector 系统，将摘要分解为"原子贡献声明"(ACC)，通过跨年份聚类构建交互式演化地图，用于探测研究领域的历时变迁。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学摘要混合了贡献、背景、动机与元话语，直接读取难以区分"领域产出了什么"与"领域在讨论什么"，使得趋势分析被噪声干扰。

Method: 用 LLM 从每篇摘要中抽取去语境化、承载贡献的命题（ACC），再将声明按年份聚类为可交互地图，支持每条趋势回溯至其背后的声明与论文。抽取经人工验证，聚类与外部人工构建的分类体系进行对照校验。

Result: 在 EMNLP 六年数据上显示领域从经典 NLP 任务转向推理、多模态等 LLM 时代能力，这是关键词或整摘要计数难以辨识的。同一流程处理了完整 ACL Anthology：346k 条声明、80k 篇摘要、423 个会议/期刊。

Conclusion: ACC 级分析能揭示被传统词频/整篇计数模糊的领域演化信号；系统开源并发布了超越 EMNLP 的大规模数据，具备可追溯性与外部校验支撑。

Abstract: Scientific abstracts mix contributions with background, motivation, and meta-language, so tools that read them as-is cannot separate what a field produces from what it discusses. We present Drift Inspector, an open-source system for measuring and exploring how a research field changes over time at the level of Atomic Contribution Claims (ACCs): decontextualized, contribution-bearing propositions an LLM extracts from each abstract before analysis. The system clusters these claims across years into an interactive map where every trend traces back to the claims and papers behind it. Applied to six years of EMNLP, it shows the field shifting away from classic NLP tasks toward LLM-era capabilities such as reasoning and multimodality -- a movement that keyword or whole-abstract counts blur. The released data extend beyond EMNLP: the same pipeline has processed the full ACL Anthology (346k claims, 80k abstracts, 423 venues). Extraction is human-validated and clustering checked against an external manually constructed taxonomy.

</details>


### [273] [LatentHarness: Learning Latent Actions for Memory and Reasoning via Counterfactual Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39740)
*Xiaoqiang Wang,Suyuchen Wang,Bang Liu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: LatentHarness将记忆访问与隐式推理统一为序列化的隐式动作选择，通过反事实策略蒸馏训练，在长上下文推理基准上取得性能与速度双提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文推理存在两个互补瓶颈：跨长输入保留证据、跨多步推理维持计算。现有方法多分别解决：外部记忆扩展对远距离证据的访问，隐式推理压缩多步计算，缺乏统一框架。

Method: 提出LatentHarness，将记忆访问与隐式推理统一为序列化隐式动作选择。每一步模型可选：THINK（继续计算）、RECALL（从输入证据与中间推理状态的fast-weight记忆检索）、EXIT（输出下一个token）。采用反事实策略蒸馏训练：对每个动作单步分支并评估其对输出token的影响，从而学会何时记忆优于继续推理，并通过反事实召回梯度学习应保留哪些中间状态。

Result: 在六个通用与长上下文推理基准上，1.4B规模的LatentHarness相较最强基线分别相对提升2.8%与10.0%，且相比最强长上下文基线运行速度快5.9倍。

Conclusion: 将记忆访问与隐式推理统一为隐式动作选择并配以反事实策略蒸馏，能有效协调记忆与推理，兼顾性能与效率。

Abstract: Long-context reasoning faces two complementary bottlenecks: retaining evidence across long inputs and sustaining computation across many reasoning steps. Existing approaches largely address them separately, with external memory extending access to distant evidence and latent reasoning compressing multi-step computation. We introduce LatentHarness, which unifies memory access and latent reasoning as sequential latent action selection. At each internal step, the model chooses THINK for further computation, RECALL from a fast-weight memory of input evidence and intermediate reasoning states, or EXIT to emit the next token. We train this policy with counterfactual policy distillation, which branches every action for one step and scores its effect on the emitted token. These gains teach the policy when memory is more useful than further reasoning, while gradients through counterfactual recall teach which intermediate states should be retained in memory for future use. Across six general and long-context reasoning benchmarks, LatentHarness at 1.4B improves on the strongest baselines by 2.8% and 10.0% relative, respectively, and runs 5.9x faster than the strongest long-context baseline.

</details>


### [274] [MemCodex: Self-Programming Hierarchical Memory for Language Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39765)
*Xiaoqiang Wang,Bang Liu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出自演化分层记忆系统 MemCodex，将经验组织为可执行记忆程序，通过开放式程序演化搜索记忆设计空间，并构建统一运行时 MemArena 进行评测，任务成功率相对最强自适应记忆基线提升 10.1%，同时减少 3.4 倍上下文 token、推理加速 2.1 倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Agent 记忆面临异构访问需求：单跳问题只需一条证据，多跳问题需组合多源证据。预定义记忆工作流无法适应这种变化；现有自适应方法虽能搜索或学习记忆组件及其组合，但设计空间本身仍是预定义的，缺乏开放演化能力。

Method: 提出 MemCodex——自演化分层记忆系统，将经验组织为可执行记忆程序，涵盖摘要、关系知识、可复用技能与潜在记忆。通过开放式程序演化，重写各层程序的构建、索引、检索与路由方式，搜索开放设计空间，从而同时适配层内实现与跨层组合。查询时按粗到细遍历层级，证据充分即停止，必要时下探至原始历史。另构建 MemArena 统一运行时，将异构数据与记忆系统置于统一接口之后。

Result: 相对最强自适应记忆基线，MemCodex 平均任务成功率提升 10.1%，上下文 token 使用减少 3.4 倍，推理速度提升 2.1 倍。

Conclusion: 以开放式程序演化取代预定义设计空间，可实现层内与跨层协同自适应的分层记忆，在提升任务成功率的同时显著降低上下文开销并加快推理。

Abstract: Agent memory faces heterogeneous access needs: a single-hop question may require one piece of evidence, whereas a multi-hop question must combine evidence from multiple sources. Predefined memory workflows cannot adapt to these varying needs. Recent adaptive methods search or learn over memory components and their compositions, but the design space itself remains predefined. We introduce MemCodex, a self-evolving hierarchical memory system that organizes experience into executable memory programs for summaries, relational knowledge, reusable skills, and latent memory. Open-ended program evolution searches the open design space of layer programs by rewriting how each layer is constructed, indexed, retrieved, and routed, thereby adapting both within-layer implementations and cross-layer composition. At query time, reads traverse the hierarchy from coarse to fine and stop once sufficient evidence is found, descending to the original history when needed. We further develop MemArena, a unified runtime that places heterogeneous data and memory systems behind a common interface. MemCodex improves average task success by 10.1% relative to the strongest adaptive-memory baseline, while using 3.4x fewer context tokens and achieving 2.1x faster inference.

</details>


### [275] [Explore-on-Graph: Hybrid Embedding-LLM Reasoning for Knowledge Graph Question Answering under Incompleteness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39786)
*Ola El Khatib,Djellel Difallah*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出XoG框架，利用图结构学习恢复缺失推理路径，实现不完整知识图谱上的多跳问答。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多数基于LLM的KGQA方法依赖遍历已有图边，在缺失事实导致推理路径断裂时失效；而让LLM生成缺失知识又会引入幻觉证据。

Method: XoG结合类型级实体-关系统计识别候选关系，并用KG嵌入检索可能的缺失实体，将LLM作为语义选择器与推理器，整合进迭代的"规划-探索-推理"流程，从学习到的图结构而非LLM参数知识中恢复缺失路径。

Result: 在WebQSP、CWQ及基于Wikidata的BRINK基准上，XoG在完整KG上保持竞争力，在KG不完整时持续优于无任务特定KGQA训练的同类方法；该优势在多个LLM主干上均成立，且相比相近的规划类方法可减少最多33%的LLM token消耗。

Conclusion: 更强LLM本身无法解决缺失图证据问题，从图结构中恢复缺失推理路径是应对KG不完整的有效途径。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly combined with knowledge graphs (KGs) to ground reasoning in structured evidence. However, most LLM-based KGQA methods rely on traversing existing graph edges and become unreliable when reasoning paths are broken by missing facts. Alternatives that ask LLMs to generate missing knowledge risk introducing hallucinated evidence. We introduce XoG (eXplore-on-Graph), a framework for multi-hop question answering over incomplete KGs that recovers missing reasoning paths from learned graph structure rather than LLM parametric knowledge. XoG combines type-level entity-relation statistics to identify candidate relations with KG embeddings to retrieve plausible missing entities, using the LLM as a semantic selector and reasoner. These mechanisms are integrated into an iterative planning-exploration-reasoning process. Experiments on WebQSP, CWQ, and the Wikidata-based BRINK benchmark show that XoG remains competitive on complete KGs and consistently outperforms comparable methods without task-specific KGQA training under KG incompleteness. These gains persist across multiple LLM backbones, indicating that stronger LLMs alone do not resolve missing graph evidence. XoG also reduces LLM token consumption by up to 33% compared with a closely related planning-based approach.

</details>


### [276] [Stress-Testing LLM Lie Detectors: Role-Play Failures and Spurious Correlations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39807)
*Maximilian von Klinski,Sebastian Lapuschkin,Wojciech Samek,Lennart Bürger*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文构建了反事实人格设定下的大规模数据集与三个混杂因素数据集，发现现有谎言探测探针多依赖与真值伪相关的概念，并提出一个更稳健的简单线性探针。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 角色扮演使"真实"含义模糊：模型可采纳反事实人格（如阴谋论者），其信念与现实相悖。作者欲探究谎言探测探针在此情境下是仍标记错误陈述，还是转而追随人格信念。

Method: 构建含8,916条人工审核、on-policy响应的数据集（3个LLM采用反事实人格）；评估8个已有探针；构造3个新型混杂因素数据集，使真值与潜在混杂概念反相关；据此提出一个简单线性探针。

Result: 许多探针在人格压力测试中失效，尤其在同一人格提示下同时评估正确与错误答案时；实验表明现有探针强烈追踪训练数据中与真值伪相关的概念（如指令遵循、响应似然度）；新提出的线性探针在人格与混杂压力测试中均取得最佳整体表现。

Conclusion: 当前谎言探测探针远不可靠，亟需使用真值与混杂概念去相关的训练数据来提升探测器的稳健性。

Abstract: Lie detection probes aim to predict from a language model's internal states whether its output is truthful or dishonest. However, role-play complicates what "truth" means for an LLM: language models can adopt a wide range of personas that take very different claims to be true, including personas whose beliefs clearly contradict reality, such as a conspiracy theorist. In this work, we investigate whether lie detection probes reliably flag falsehoods generated under such an anti-factual persona or whether they instead follow the persona's beliefs. We introduce a dataset of 8,916 human-reviewed, on-policy responses from three LLMs adopting anti-factual personas. Evaluating eight probes from prior work, we find that many fail in this setting, particularly when correct and incorrect answers are evaluated under the same persona prompt. To investigate why, we construct three novel confounder datasets in which truth is anti-correlated with a potential confounding concept. Our experiments reveal that many existing probes strongly track concepts that are spuriously correlated with truth in their training data, such as instruction compliance or response likelihood. Based on these findings, we introduce a simple linear probe that achieves the strongest overall performance on both the persona and confounder stress tests. Our results suggest that current lie detection probes are far from reliable and highlight the need for training data in which truth is decorrelated from confounding concepts.

</details>


### [277] [Synthetic Pre-pretraining Survives Scale, but Not as a Grammatical Prior](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39827)
*Atsuki Yamaguchi,Tatsuro Inaba,Joel Niklaus,Michal Štefánik,Aline Villavicencio,Nikolaos Aletras*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了合成非自然语言数据上的预预训练（PPT）在更大规模与更真实数据混合下的效果，发现其token效率提升可扩展至7B参数与100B token，但增益并非源于语法先验，而是来自改善长程检索的PPT任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前工作认为PPT的增益来自语法先验（结构化归纳偏置），但PPT仅在≤1B参数、PT预算<2B token且以网页文本为主的条件下被验证；其在更大规模、更真实混合数据（如代码与数学）下的有效性未知，因此需要一项覆盖多任务、多数据混合、多参数规模与大预算的系统研究。

Method: 作者开展了一项综合性PPT研究，覆盖五种PPT任务、四种PT数据混合、四种参数规模（500M至7B）以及最高100B token的PT预算，并对比下游性能与语法可接受性，以考察增益来源。

Result: PPT带来的下游性能与token效率增益在规模上持续存在，例如在3B规模下至少节省21B PT token；但与先前工作不同，没有一致证据表明增益源于语法先验，下游性能与语法可接受性在各模型规模下并不一致对齐；增益实际来自改善长程检索的PPT任务；且增益对PT数据混合方式稳健，仅当缺少网页文本时减弱。

Conclusion: PPT是PT的低成本补充手段，其有效性具有规模鲁棒性与数据混合鲁棒性；未来PPT任务设计应针对长程检索，而非自然语言语法。

Abstract: Pre-pretraining (PPT) on synthetic non-natural language data improves token efficiency during language model pre-training (PT). Prior work attributes this gain to a grammatical prior, i.e., a structural inductive bias learned during PPT that transfers to natural language grammar. However, PPT has only been tested on models of at most 1B parameters and PT budgets below 2B tokens on predominantly web text. It is unknown whether PPT is effective at larger scales and under more realistic PT data mixtures that combine diverse sources (e.g., code and math). We therefore present a comprehensive study on PPT spanning five PPT tasks, four PT data mixtures, four parameter scales (500M to 7B), and PT budgets of up to 100B tokens. Our results demonstrate that the downstream performance and token efficiency gains of PPT persist at scale, e.g., saving at least 21B PT tokens at the 3B scale. However, in contrast to prior work, we find no consistent evidence that these gains stem from a grammatical prior. Downstream performance does not consistently align with grammatical acceptability across model sizes. Instead, we find that downstream gains arise from PPT tasks that improve long-range retrieval. Finally, PPT performance gains are robust to how PT data mixtures are composed and diminish only when web text is absent. Overall, PPT is a low-cost addition to PT, and future PPT task design should target long-range retrieval rather than natural language grammar.

</details>


### [278] [When a Kindergartener Solves Calculus: Measuring Capability Leakage in Role-Prompted Reasoning Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39846)
*Pakhapoom Sarapat,Saksorn Ruangtanusak,Kunat Pipatanakul,Pittawat Taveekitworachai*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出并研究"角色-能力泄漏(RCL)"现象：角色提示的推理模型能生成风格上符合角色的文本，但实际能力仍超出所扮演角色。作者构建RoleCapBench基准评测该问题，并提出Injection推理时干预方法以缓解泄漏。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 角色提示下模型只是表面扮演角色（风格一致），而底层能力并未随角色受限，导致"人设"与"能力"不匹配，例如扮演幼儿园学生却仍能解微积分。作者希望系统刻画并度量这一现象。

Method: 构建RoleCapBench基准：围绕六个教育角色、四个评测等级（覆盖小学至A-level）进行课程化设计，用于评测RCL；在三个开源权重推理模型上评估。提出Injection推理时干预，结合角色专属能力准则与引导性预填充回复前缀。

Result: 朴素角色提示获得较高角色语音分数1.218–1.389，但仍保持超角色准确率0.811–0.898；即使显式要求匹配角色能力水平，RCL依然存在。Injection提升角色-能力对齐，超角色准确率最多下降0.562，而角色内准确率在多数模型上仅小幅下降(<0.058)。

Conclusion: RCL是角色提示推理模型中的普遍且顽固问题，简单提示与显式能力约束均难以消除；Injection能有效降低超角色能力并较好保留角色内表现。所有脚本与评测数据将在录用后公开。

Abstract: We investigate the problem of role-capability leakage (RCL), in which a role-prompted reasoning model generates convincing in-role text while continuing to exhibit capabilities on benchmarks that exceed those implied by the assigned role. For example, when a model is prompted to assume the role of a kindergarten student, one might expect its performance on a mathematics benchmark to reflect kindergarten-level ability rather than expert-level proficiency in solving calculus problems. We introduce RoleCapBench, a curriculum-grounded benchmark for evaluating RCL across six educational roles and four assessment levels spanning elementary school through A-level, and use it to evaluate three open-weight reasoning models. We find that although the models can generate stylistically convincing in-role responses, they consistently fail to align their underlying capabilities with their assigned roles. Naive role prompting yields strong role-voice scores of 1.218--1.389 while retaining above-role accuracy of 0.811--0.898. RCL persists across a range of prompting conditions, including prompts that explicitly instruct the model to match the role's capability level. To mitigate this problem, we propose Injection, an inference-time intervention that combines explicit, role-specific capability guidelines with a guiding prefilled response prefix. Injection improves role-capability alignment across models, reducing above-role accuracy by up to 0.562 while preserving in-role accuracy with a marginal drop of less than 0.058 across most models. All artifacts, including scripts and evaluation data, will be released upon acceptance.

</details>


### [279] [Cognitive Enhancement: Rethinking the Necessity of Role-Playing for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39853)
*Xingjie Zhuang,Jialong Tang,Chulun Zhou,Buchao Zhan,Zhirui Li,Junhui Li,Yazheng Yang,Jinsong Su*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文系统验证了角色扮演提示（role-play prompting）在跨模型、跨领域、多语言场景下的效果不稳定性，提出"人格相关认知对齐假说"解释其生效条件，并提出免训练的多语言提示拼接策略 MLCP 以稳定提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 角色扮演提示虽被广泛使用且实现简单，但其能否在不同领域稳定提升 LLM 推理与输出质量缺乏系统验证；同时其生效机制尚不明确，存在"人格认知偏差"导致性能波动的问题。

Method: 在 MMLU 与 MMLU-Redux 上开展多模型、跨领域、多语言实验；基于元认知理论提出"人格相关认知对齐假说"，并通过三种手段验证：人格信息丰富度消融、逐层熵散度分析、潜在思维空间偏移观察；进而提出免训练的多语言提示拼接策略 MLCP（Mixed-Language Concatenate Prediction），聚合同语义的多语言角色提示以丰富互补表征线索。

Result: 角色扮演提示的收益高度依赖模型能力、知识领域与提示语言；消融与熵分析、思维空间偏移观察支持了所提假说；MLCP 在所有测试的 LLM 上均稳定优于原生角色扮演提示。

Conclusion: 角色扮演提示并非普适增益技术，其有效性取决于模型能否正确把握指定人格及其关联知识域；通过多语言提示拼接（MLCP）可缓解人格认知偏差、稳定并提升角色扮演性能，且无需训练、高效易用。

Abstract: Role-playing prompting has become a popular yet simple technique for improving LLM reasoning and output quality. However, whether it consistently boosts performance across diverse domains remains unclear, as systematic validation is lacking. To fill this gap, we run multi-model, cross-domain, and multilingual experiments on MMLU and MMLU-Redux. We find that gains from role-play prompting depend heavily on model capacity, knowledge domain, and prompt language. Drawing on metacognition theory, we propose the persona-related cognitive alignment hypothesis: role-play works only when the LLM correctly grasps the designated persona and its associated knowledge domain. We test this hypothesis through persona information richness ablation, layer-wise entropy divergence analysis, and latent thought-space deflection observation. To reduce persona cognitive bias and stabilize role-play performance, we propose \textbf{M}ixed-\textbf{L}anguage \textbf{C}oncatenate \textbf{P}rediction \textbf{(MLCP}), a simple, training-free, and efficient multilingual prompt concatenation strategy. It aggregates semantically equivalent role prompts to enrich complementary representational cues. Extensive experiments show that MLCP consistently outperforms vanilla role-play prompting across all tested LLMs.

</details>


### [280] [LLM Persona Unlearning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39882)
*Kemou Li,Zhuan Shi,Qizhou Wang,Fengpeng Li,Negar Rostamzadeh,Golnoosh Farnadi,Jiantao Zhou*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出"人格遗忘"（persona unlearning）任务，并发布 PersonaUnlearnBench 基准与 PaCE 方法，在权重层面抑制指定人格的激活。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练使 LLM 具备多角色、风格、价值观与目标的行为模式，后训练虽以"助手"为默认但未从权重中抹除其他模式，显式提示即可激活这些人格。在开放权重场景下运行时控制可被移除，因此需要一种权重级编辑手段，使指定人格在未见情境中也难以被诱发与执行。

Method: 提出 PersonaUnlearnBench：模型特定、配对的基准，覆盖 3 个家族共 6 个 LLM、5 种人格，包含对齐的遗忘/保留集、留出的指令改写以及四维评测。进一步提出 PaCE：对同一问题比较目标人格响应与理想响应，定位内部行为方向，再将目标提示下的状态推离目标模式、拉向匹配的理想响应。

Result: 基准显示标准遗忘方法无法在不为生成质量与通用效用带来明显损失的前提下可靠抹除目标人格。PaCE 能一致地抑制目标人格，同时保持较高响应质量与有用的对侧行为，仅付出中等效用代价。

Conclusion: 该工作将人格遗忘确立为一类独立的行为级编辑问题，并提供了对潜在 LLM 响应策略实现持久控制的可行路径。

Abstract: Pre-training equips large language models (LLMs) with a broad repertoire of behavioral patterns associated with roles, styles, values, and goals. Post-training teaches conditional enactment and makes a helpful Assistant the default, but it does not erase alternative modes from the weights; explicit prompts can therefore elicit personas that repeatedly shape judgment, language, and action. In open-weight settings, runtime controls can be removed, motivating persona unlearning: a weight-level edit that makes a designated persona difficult to elicit and enact on unseen contexts. We introduce PersonaUnlearnBench, a model-specific paired benchmark spanning six LLMs from three families and five personas, with aligned forget/retain sets, held-out instruction paraphrases, and four-axis evaluation. The benchmark shows that standard unlearning methods cannot reliably erase the target persona without sacrificing meaningful generation or general utility. We therefore propose PaCE, which compares target and desirable responses to the same questions to locate an internal behavior direction, then trains target-prompt states away from the target mode and toward the matched desirable response. Experiments show that PaCE consistently suppresses target personas with high response quality and useful counterpart behavior, at moderate utility cost. These results establish persona unlearning as a distinct behavior-level editing problem and a practical route toward persistent control of latent LLM response policies.

</details>


### [281] [OPSRD: On-Policy Self-Role Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39884)
*Weijie Ren,Yanwen Zhang,Hao Li,Zhuolin Qi,Hengyi Zhang,Naibo Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 OPSRD，用固定专家角色作为特权教学上下文，进行无需参考解的在线策略自蒸馏，将角色条件分布迁移到无角色学生模型上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 角色提示（role prompting）通过专家身份激发大模型的专门行为，是引导复杂任务推理的轻量手段；但完整评估或蒸馏角色提示下的答案，会在采样解仍错误时忽略有用的下一 token 偏好，且偏好迁移需要能触及学生极少预测的备选分布。

Method: OPSRD 以固定专家角色作为特权教学上下文，不做参考解答的在线策略自蒸馏：无角色学生生成轨迹，同一基座的冻结实例在其精确前缀上给出角色条件分布，暴露采样续写之外的备选；采用教师加权的正向 KL 针对学生低估的备选，并加裁剪限制单个词表项的贡献；监督仅限学生位置上熵最高的那一半，聚焦预测不确定处。

Result: 在 Qwen3-1.7B、4B、8B 三个规模、三个竞赛数学基准上，推理时不使用角色提示即优于基座模型；三种评估的散度中，正向 KL 在每个规模上取得最高的宏平均准确率。

Conclusion: OPSRD 无需参考解即可把角色提示的 token 级偏好有效迁移到无角色学生模型，正向 KL 是最优的散度选择，代码已开源。

Abstract: Role prompting elicits specialized behavior from large language models through an expert identity, offering a lightweight way to guide reasoning on demanding tasks. However, evaluating or distilling complete role-prompted answers can miss useful next-token preferences when the sampled solution remains incorrect. Transferring these preferences also requires an objective that reaches alternatives the student rarely predicts. We introduce OPSRD, which uses a fixed expert role as privileged teaching context for on-policy self-distillation without reference solutions. A role-free student generates a trajectory, and a frozen instance of the same base model supplies role-conditioned distributions on its exact prefixes, exposing alternatives beyond the sampled continuation. Teacher-weighted forward KL targets alternatives the student underestimates, with clipping to limit individual vocabulary contributions. Supervision is restricted to the highest-entropy half of student positions, concentrating learning where predictions are uncertain. Experiments on three competition-math benchmarks with Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, and 8B show improvements over the base models without role prompts at inference. Forward KL achieves the highest macro-averaged accuracy among the three evaluated divergences at every scale. Code is available at https://github.com/zhansan114514/OPSRD.

</details>


### [282] [The Concrete-Arbitrary Gap: Kinship Reasoning in LLMs Is Not Indifferent to Presentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39913)
*Thomas Pashby*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 在500组形式等同的亲属关系图上，LLM对熟悉词汇表述的准确率显著高于对非词谓词表述，差距随模型不同为5.4–35.6个百分点，且可通过推理预算与提示语言干预缩小。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 检验大语言模型在形式完全匹配的推理任务上，是否仅因关系被表述为熟悉词汇或显式定义的非词谓词而在表现上产生系统差异，即其关系能力是否对表述方式保持中立。

Method: 构建500组配对关系图，同一形式结构分别以熟悉亲属词汇和显式定义的非词谓词呈现；在四个模型（本地Qwen3.8-27B、Gemma 4 26B-A4B、Gemma 4 31B、Qwen3.8-Max）上比较"具体准确率"与"任意谓词准确率"的配对差距，并施加推理预算与提示语言干预。

Result: 具体表述的准确率分别高出35.6、26.6、12.0和5.4个百分点，四个配对差距均具统计显著性；推理预算与提示语言干预可大幅缩小差距，表明该差异是可调节的，而非固定能力缺陷。

Conclusion: 模型表现出的关系推理能力对表述方式并非中立：显式定义虽提供了形式关系，却不能使非词谓词像嵌入语言联想中的熟悉词汇那样易用。

Abstract: We test whether large language models solve formally matched kinship problems equally well when relations are expressed in familiar vocabulary or by explicitly defined nonce predicates. Across 500 paired graphs, concrete accuracy exceeds arbitrary accuracy by 35.6 percentage points in local Qwen3.8-27B, 26.6 in Gemma 4 26B-A4B, 12.0 in Gemma 4 31B, and 5.4 in Qwen3.8-Max. All four paired gaps are statistically resolved. Reasoning budgets and prompt-language interventions can substantially reduce the difference, showing that it is modifiable rather than a fixed incapacity. The minimal conclusion is behavioral: on these tasks, the models' manifested relational competence is not indifferent to presentation. Explicit definitions provide the formal relations but do not make nonce predicates as usable as familiar vocabulary embedded in learned linguistic associations.

</details>


### [283] [AdaGEPA: Adaptive Feedback Allocation for Reflective Prompt Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39927)
*Junyang Chen,Zecheng Wang,Jingbang Chen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出AdaGEPA自适应反馈分配方法，根据提示性能与任务结构选择样本进行提示修订，在六个下游基准上以相同rollout预算取得更高验证分数，并更快找到高性能提示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典反思式提示优化依赖任务样例的反馈来指导修订，但当反馈选择未考虑提示的弱点时，修订可能仅提升被选样例的表现，而无法带来更广泛的整体任务改进。

Method: AdaGEPA利用提示当前的性能表现与任务结构来选择下一轮修订所用的样例；在每个反馈小批次中最多替换一个样例，以针对已识别的弱点，同时保留其余反馈上下文。

Result: 在六个下游基准的主要实验中，AdaGEPA在匹配rollout预算下比非自适应反馈选择获得更高的平均验证分数，并在多个任务上更早找到高性能提示。在Schema-Guided Dialogue（SGD）初步研究中，其半预算提示在已见与未见服务的联合目标准确率上超过非自适应基线的全预算提示。

Conclusion: 研究结果表明，自适应反馈分配有潜力同时提升反思式提示优化的有效性与rollout预算效率。

Abstract: Prompt optimization improves the performance of language-model systems on downstream tasks by refining their prompts. Classical methods evaluate prompts on task examples and use the resulting feedback to guide prompt revisions through reflection. However, when feedback selection does not account for the prompt's weaknesses, these revisions may improve performance on selected examples without yielding broader task improvements. To address this issue, we propose AdaGEPA, an adaptive feedback-allocation method that uses the prompt's performance and task structure to select examples for the next prompt revision. Our method replaces at most one example in each feedback minibatch to target an identified weakness while preserving the remaining feedback context. Across our main experiments on six downstream benchmarks, AdaGEPA achieves higher mean validation scores than non-adaptive feedback selection under matched rollout budgets. AdaGEPA also finds high-performing prompts earlier across several tasks. In the initial Schema-Guided Dialogue (SGD) study, its half-budget prompts outperform the non-adaptive baseline's full-budget prompts in joint goal accuracy on new dialogues from services seen and unseen during search. Overall, our findings highlight the potential of adaptive feedback allocation to improve both the effectiveness and rollout-budget efficiency of reflective prompt optimization.

</details>


### [284] [LEAP: Learned Block-wise Evidence Retrieval for Long Audio-Video Perception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39938)
*Juyi Lin,Zhiqiang Lao,Jiali Cui,Lin Zhao,Pu Zhao,Dichang Zhang,Arman Akbari,Yu Qi,Xinru Jiang,Yanzhi Wang,Heather Yu,Liang Peng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: LEAP 是一个音视频问答框架，通过分块定位候选时间窗并将高排名窗口重新编码进单次有界回答，使回答输入与峰值上下文长度不随录制时长增长，在多个 AVQA 基准上显著优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小时级音视频问答面临上下文困境：对整段录制的密集编码会迅速耗尽上下文上限，而均匀时间压缩又会严重稀释细粒度的声学与视觉证据。因此需要一种不将整段录制放入单一上下文、又能保留细粒度证据的方法。

Method: LEAP 将录制切分为固定时长块，对每块执行轻量定位以给短候选窗口打分；将排名最高的窗口汇集并在单次有界回答过程中重新编码。该设计将证据定位与推理解耦：可在预计算文本上定位候选时间窗而无需解码媒体帧，同时通过在原始视听流上执行最终回答以保留细粒度视觉与非语音证据。训练两阶段：定位 LoRA 改进所选窗口，回答 LoRA 改进基于相同窗口读取的答案。块网格原生支持因果查询，因而无需流式专用训练即可支持流式推理。

Result: 在多个 AVQA 基准上，LEAP 相比 Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B 基线提升 4.5–16.8%；并迁移到第二个全模态骨干 MiniCPM-o 4.5，超出其已发表结果 3.1–13.0%。

Conclusion: 通过解耦证据定位与推理并将回答输入与峰值上下文同录制时长解耦，LEAP 在保持细粒度证据的可扩展性上有效，并能跨骨干迁移且支持流式推理。

Abstract: Hour-scale audio-visual question answering is constrained by a context dilemma: dense whole-recording encoding rapidly exhausts context limits, whereas uniform temporal compression severely dilutes fine-grained acoustic and visual evidence. We introduce LEAP, a framework where the model retrieves its own evidence without placing the whole recording in one context. LEAP divides a recording into fixed-duration blocks, applying a lightweight localization pass to each block to score short candidate windows. The highest-ranked windows are pooled and re-encoded in a single bounded answer pass. Consequently, the answer input and peak context remain independent of the recording duration. By decoupling evidence localization from reasoning, our framework can localize candidate temporal windows over pre-computed transcripts without decoding media frames, while preserving fine-grained visual and non-speech evidence by routing the final answering pass over raw audio-visual streams. LEAP trains both stages: a localization LoRA improves the selected windows, and an answer LoRA improves the answers read from the same windows. The block grid natively supports causal queries, enabling LEAP to support streaming inference without streaming-specific training. Across several AVQA benchmarks, LEAP improves over the Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B baseline by 4.5-16.8%, and transfers to a second omni-modal backbone, MiniCPM-o 4.5, surpassing its published results by 3.1-13.0%.

</details>


### [285] [UBTree: Parallel Tree Drafting via Unigram and Bigram Models for Speculative Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39972)
*Chumeng Liang,Linxuan Wang,Xinyu Peng,Huabin Liu,Yuxin Chen,Ge Liu,Guang Lin,Qifan Song,Jianguo Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出UBTree并行草稿器，用Unigram提议器+Bigram选择器构建草稿树，解决高熵目标分布下草稿多样性不足问题，在7个基准上实现5.84–6.94×加速并全面超越DARTree。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推测解码通过一次目标模型前向验证多个草稿token来加速推理。近期并行草稿器在前沿生产模型中取得突破，但随目标分布熵增大，其有效性因草稿多样性不足而下降。作者希望在保持并行性的前提下突破这一瓶颈。

Method: UBTree将Unigram提议器与Bigram选择器耦合以构建草稿树。Unigram提议器用标准交叉熵目标训练，为各位置独立生成候选token；轻量级Bigram选择器预测相邻候选对之间的转移分数，并在高温数据上用重归一化KL目标训练。这种"树原生"训练将监督扩展到贪心路径之外，鼓励生成合理的替代分支，提高树验证时额外token被接受的概率。

Result: 在Qwen3-4B与Qwen3-8B的7个标准化基准上，UBTree相较自回归解码取得平均5.84–6.94×加速，并在全部28项对比中超越DARTree。生产规模评估进一步显示UBTree优于DSpark等前沿基线。

Conclusion: 通过Unigram提议器与Bigram选择器的树原生训练组合，UBTree在保持并行性的同时提升了高熵场景下的草稿多样性与接受率，验证了其在标准基准与生产规模上相对DARTree、DSpark等基线的稳定优势。

Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates language model inference by verifying multiple draft tokens in a single target-model pass. Recent parallel drafters have achieved breakthrough performance in frontier production models, but their effectiveness deteriorates as the entropy of target distributions increases due to insufficient draft diversity. To overcome this bottleneck without sacrificing parallelism, we introduce UBTree, a parallel drafter that couples a Unigram proposer with a Bigram selector to construct drafting Trees. The unigram proposer is trained with the standard cross-entropy objective to generate candidate tokens independently for each position, while a lightweight bigram selector predicts transition scores between adjacent candidate pairs. Unlike the proposer, the selector is trained with a renormalized KL objective on high-temperature data. This tree-native training broadens the supervision beyond the greedy path, encouraging plausible alternative branches that improve the chance of accepting additional tokens during tree verification. Across seven standardized benchmarks with Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B, UBTree achieves an average speedup of $5.84$--$6.94\times$ over autoregressive decoding and outperforms DARTree in all 28 comparisons. Production-scale evaluation further demonstrates UBTree's advantage over frontier baselines such as DSpark.

</details>


### [286] [Overview of BioASQ 2026: The fourteenth BioASQ Challenge on Large-Scale Biomedical Semantic Indexing and Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39975)
*Anastasios Nentidis,Georgios Katsimpras,Anastasia Krithara,Martin Krallinger,Miguel Rodríguez-Ortega,Eduard Rodriguez-López,Natalia Loukachevitch,Igor Rozhkov,Elena Tutubalina,Dimitris Dimitriadis,Vasiliki Patsiou,Grigorios Tsoumakas,George Giannakoulas,Alexandra Bekiaridou,Athanasios Samaras,Giorgio Maria Di Nunzio,Nicola Ferro,Stefano Marchesin,Marco Martinelli,Gianmaria Silvello,Georgios Paliouras*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文概述了CLEF 2026框架下第十四届BioASQ挑战赛，涵盖六个共享任务，共87支队伍参与并提交超1000个run，多个提交达到竞争性性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: BioASQ作为国际性挑战赛系列，旨在推动生物医学语言处理领域的发展，涵盖语义索引、信息抽取、问答与摘要等任务，需要持续举办以促进该领域最新方法的进步。

Method: 组织第十四届BioASQ挑战赛（CLEF 2026），设置六个共享任务：Task 14b（生物医学语义问答）、Task Synergy14（生物医学主题开发问答）、Task MultiClinSum-2（多语言临床摘要）、Task BioNNE-R（俄语和英语嵌套命名实体关系抽取）、Task ELCardioCC（心脏病学临床编码）、Task GutBrainIE（肠-脑交互信息抽取）。

Result: 共有87支不同团队参与六个任务，总体提交超过1000个run；多个提交达到竞争性性能，反映出生物医学语言处理各任务上最先进方法的持续进步。

Conclusion: 第十四届BioASQ挑战赛成功举办，六个任务吸引了大量团队参与，参赛系统表现优异，体现了生物医学语言处理领域方法的不断进步。

Abstract: This paper presents an overview of the fourteenth edition of the BioASQ challenge, organized in the context of the Conference and Labs of the Evaluation Forum (CLEF) 2026. BioASQ is an international challenge series that supports progress in biomedical language processing tasks ranging from semantic indexing and information extraction to question answering and summarization. In 2026, BioASQ included six shared tasks: a) Task 14b on biomedical semantic question answering. b) Task Synergy14 on question answering for developing biomedical top- ics. c) Task MultiClinSum-2 on multilingual clinical summarization. d) Task BioNNE-R on extracting relations between nested named entities in Russian and English. e) Task ELCardioCC on clinical coding in cardiology. f) Task GutBrainIE on gut-brain interplay information extrac- tion. Across these six tasks, 87 distinct teams participated, submitting more than 1000 runs overall. As in previous editions, several submissions reached competitive performance, reflecting the continued progress of state-of-the-art methods across biomedical language processing tasks.

</details>


### [287] [Mid-Harness: Scaling Actions Between Model and Harness for Terminal Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39982)
*Minki Kang,Ryo Hachiuma,Shaokun Zhang,Subhashree Radhakrishnan,Yonggan Fu,Jindong Jiang,Mingjie Liu,Ehsan Hosseini-Asl,Yi Dong,Yu-Chiang Frank Wang,Byung-Kwan Lee*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文研究在模型-执行器（harness）边界分配测试时计算能否提升终端智能体的动作可靠性与轨迹成功率，提出 Mid-Harness：在动作执行前采样并验证候选动作。实验表明，在弱验证下增加动作采样收益有限，而强验证器可有效利用同一生成器产生的候选动作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 终端智能体通过随机模型生成动作，但能生成有用动作并不代表能可靠执行。一个糟糕的命令（如错误的软件包安装）会改变环境，阻碍后续进展，即使模型本可生成更好的替代方案。因此作者希望探究：在模型-执行器边界分配测试时计算是否能提升动作可靠性与轨迹成功率，以及这种分配为何有效。

Method: 提出 Mid-Harness，在不改变生成器和执行器的前提下，先采样并验证候选动作，再转发其中一个用于执行。方法聚焦于「动作缩放」（action scaling）：对生成器采样多条候选动作，由验证器进行筛选。作者进一步用更强的验证器对TMAX-9B进行响应蒸馏，并组合动作缩放与轨迹缩放。

Result: 使用TMAX-9B生成器时，弱验证下增加动作采样收益甚微，而强验证器能利用同一生成器的有用备选动作。在TerminalBench-Lite上，GPT-5.6 Sol验证器在采样8个动作时将Pass@1从基线智能体的50.00%提升至68.03%。当TMAX-9B自身作验证器时，成对验证（pairwise verification）在评测的机制中表现最佳。将强验证器响应蒸馏进TMAX-9B可进一步在不改生成器的情况下提升Pass@1。结合动作与轨迹缩放在更低估计token成本下达到更高成功率，优于仅增加轨迹生成。Mid-Harness在多个模型、基准与执行器上均带来提升。

Conclusion: 动作缩放是终端智能体测试时计算缩放的一个有前景的方向。验证质量是决定动作采样收益的关键，强验证器与蒸馏可显著提升执行可靠性，且动作与轨迹缩放的组合在成本效率上更优。

Abstract: Terminal agents act through stochastic model generations, yet the ability to generate a useful action does not ensure its reliable execution. A poor command (e.g., wrong package install) can change the environment in ways that hinder subsequent progress, even when the model could generate a better alternative. We investigate whether allocating test-time compute at the model-harness boundary can improve action reliability and trajectory success, and what makes this allocation effective. To study these questions, we introduce Mid-Harness, which samples and verifies candidate actions before forwarding one for execution, while keeping the generator and harness unchanged. With a TMAX-9B generator, more action sampling yields little benefit under weak verification, whereas a capable verifier can exploit useful alternatives from the same generator. On TerminalBench-Lite, a GPT-5.6 Sol verifier raises Pass@1 from 50.00% for the base agent to 68.03% with 8 sampled actions. When the same TMAX-9B model serves as the verifier, pairwise verification performs best among the evaluated verification mechanisms. Distilling responses from the stronger verifier into TMAX-9B further improves Pass@1, while leaving the action generator unchanged. With TMAX-9B on TerminalBench-Lite, combining action and trajectory scaling reaches higher success at lower estimated token cost than generating more trajectories alone. Mid-Harness also improves performance across additional models, benchmarks, and harnesses. These findings identify action scaling as a promising target for test-time compute scaling in terminal agents.

</details>


### [288] [OPTS-TTPO: Enhancing Finite-Sample Policy-Gradient Learning with Tree Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40035)
*Junyu Lu,Shichao Weng,Zhiqiang Wang,Haojie Luo,Jingfan Zhang,Yuhua Zhou,Cheng Du,Yuzhuo Zhang,Xi Li,Jinwei Du,Tiancheng Feng,Chuan Xiao,Shuyuan Zheng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出OPTS与TTPO(TTPG)，利用在策略树轨迹在不需动作分布修正的情况下提升样本覆盖并控制梯度偏差，理论上证明了分支聚合引理、单调改进与偏差界，实验显示其覆盖率、MuJoCo、Atari-57及Qwen3任务上均优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 策略梯度定理给出当前策略下的精确梯度，但有限的在策略样本可能遗漏罕见的高回报轨迹。作者研究在固定预算下，树搜索能否提升样本覆盖同时控制梯度偏差。

Method: 提出On-Policy Parallel Tree Search (OPTS)与Tree Trajectory Policy Optimization (TTPO/TTPG)，在访问状态处从当前策略采样新后缀构建在策略树轨迹，无需动作分布修正；通过Branch Aggregation Lemma证明分支加权树统计可在分支选择与权重预先固定时恢复链式期望；OPTS基于估计的性能差异选择扩展状态。

Result: 确定性动力学、精确值与max-backup优势下，搜索策略期望回报随预算单调提升；给出自适应扩展的梯度偏差界，max backup将前缀信用分配给导向更优后缀的动作。相对有限链参考，TTPG偏差接近无分支水平，NaivePG偏差从0.1251升至0.4884。匹配预算下OPTS提升正确率覆盖与多数投票准确率；匹配分支数下OPTS+TTPG以适度偏差增加换取覆盖提升；匹配预算下MuJoCo尾部回报较PPO提升至多28.6%，Atari-57对PPO取得34-22-1战绩，四个Qwen3模型上avg@32与pass@32均提升。

Conclusion: 在策略树搜索可在固定预算内提升覆盖并有效控制梯度偏差，OPTS与TTPO在连续控制、雅达利基准与大模型推理任务上一致优于PPO等基线。

Abstract: The policy-gradient theorem gives the exact gradient under the current policy, but finite on-policy samples may miss rare high-return trajectories. We study whether tree search improves their coverage within a fixed budget while controlling gradient bias. We introduce On-Policy Parallel Tree Search (OPTS) and Tree Trajectory Policy Optimization (TTPO) using on-policy tree trajectories, which sample new suffixes from the current policy at visited states. This needs no action-distribution correction, although branching changes state visitation. Our Branch Aggregation Lemma shows that branch-weighted tree statistics recover chain expectations when branch choices and weights are fixed before outgoing transitions are sampled. OPTS selects expansion states using estimated performance differences. Under deterministic dynamics, exact values, and max-backup advantages, the induced search policy's expected return improves monotonically with the budget. We bound the gradient bias from adaptive expansion and show that max backup assigns prefix credit to actions leading to better discovered suffixes. Against a finite chain reference, TTPG's measured bias stays near its no-branching level, while NaivePG's bias grows from 0.1251 to 0.4884. At matched budgets, reward- and value-guided OPTS improve correct-answer coverage and majority-vote accuracy over independent sampling. At matched branch counts, OPTS + TTPG gains coverage with a modest bias increase relative to Fixed-branch + TTPG. Under matched interaction or rollout budgets, OPTS-TTPO improves MuJoCo tail returns over PPO by up to 28.6%, achieves a 34-22-1 win-loss-tie record against PPO on Atari-57 under the last-100-log mean-return metric, and improves micro-averaged avg@32 and pass@32 over PPO across all four Qwen3 models.

</details>


### [289] [MGhana-ST: A Low-Resource Speech Translation Dataset for Ghanaian Languages and an Analysis of Multilingual Training Trade-offs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40041)
*Frank Lawrence Nii Adoquaye Acquaye,Eric George Parakal,Jesse Johnson,Kishankumar Bhimani,Jochebed Afua Basil*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 MGhana-ST，一个覆盖四种加纳低资源语言变体的语音翻译数据集（约16.1小时配对语音与英语译文），并在Whisper-small上比较单语与多语训练的跨语言迁移效果，发现平坦多语训练在数据极度稀缺下无一致收益，且早期单次运行的"正迁移"结论无法通过多种子复现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 加纳低资源语言变体（Ga、Twi、Ewe、Fante）缺乏语音翻译资源，现有资源缺少直接由音频产生的英语译文及事件标注；同时低资源场景下多语联合训练（跨语言迁移）是否有效尚无定论，且可能存在单次运行导致的统计假象。

Method: 构建MGhana-ST数据集：音频取自两个现有加纳语音资源，由37位母语标注者直接从音频产出英语译文，并包含言语与非言语事件标注；实验使用约16.1小时固定子集。以Whisper-small为骨干，在三种随机种子下比较单语与平坦多语训练，并以BLEU评估；同时对比经验跨语言迁移与基于类型学的URIEL相似度，并复现此前的单次运行分析。

Result: 平坦多语训练在该数据稀缺条件下对任何变体均无收益：Ga与Twi变化在种子方差内（+0.51、+0.06 BLEU，对应单语标准差1.63、2.20），Ewe下降6.99 BLEU，Fante下降5.11 BLEU；退化者为语言上独特且来自不同源语料的Ewe及资源最少的Fante。迁移BLEU比URIEL相似度更能识别紧密互动的语言对，但两者均无法预测哪些变体受益于联合训练。方法学层面：早期单次运行显示四变体中三个正迁移，但多种子复现后不成立；Ga与Twi在1.6–6.2小时音频上的单语基线种子标准差约为多语模型的5倍和30倍（0.35与0.07 BLEU），说明单语条件噪声更大时，仅由种子波动即可在单次比较中呈现类似规模的表观迁移。

Conclusion: 在数据极度稀缺的加纳低资源语音翻译中，平坦多语训练并不必然带来跨语言迁移收益，且此类结论必须通过多种子复现验证；类型学相似度与迁移BLEU均不足以预测联合训练的有效性。作者发布MGhana-ST以支持非洲语言语音技术及低资源语音翻译研究。

Abstract: We present MGhana-ST, a speech translation dataset for four low-resource Ghanaian language varieties: Ga, Twi (Akuapem and Asante), Ewe, and Fante. MGhana-ST is an ongoing annotation effort; the experiments here use a fixed subset of about 16.1 hours of paired speech and English translations. The audio is curated from two existing Ghanaian speech resources. Unlike in those resources, the English translations are produced directly from audio by 37 native-speaker annotators and include verbal and non-verbal event annotations.
  Using Whisper-small, we compare monolingual and multilingual training under severe data scarcity, reporting means over three seeds. Flat multilingual training benefits no variety in this regime. Ga and Twi are unchanged within seed variance (+0.51 and +0.06 BLEU against monolingual standard deviations of 1.63 and 2.20), while Ewe declines by 6.99 BLEU and Fante by 5.11. The degrading varieties are Ewe, which is linguistically distinct and drawn from a different source corpus, and Fante, the least-resourced. Comparing empirical cross-lingual transfer with typology-based similarity, we find that transfer BLEU identifies closely interacting language pairs better than URIEL similarity, though neither predicts which varieties benefit from joint training.
  We also report a methodological finding. An earlier single-run analysis found positive transfer for three of four varieties; this did not survive replication across seeds. For Ga and Twi, monolingual baselines trained on 1.6 to 6.2 hours of audio have seed standard deviations roughly five and thirty times those of the multilingual models (0.35 and 0.07 BLEU). When the monolingual condition is noisier, a single-run comparison can show apparent transfer of this size from seed variation alone. We release MGhana-ST to support research on African language speech technology and low-resource speech translation.

</details>


### [290] [From Tweets to Trades: Analyzing the Influence of Public Mood over Stock Market Performance in Turkiye](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40064)
*Ece Elif Adak,Bertaç Şakir Şahin,Şaziye Betül Özateş*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究基于2022–2023年176个X账号的610,422条帖子，用微调土耳其语Transformer进行领域分类并构建公共情绪指标，发现公共情绪与股市收益方向无关，但与价格波动幅度相关，且关系随聚合频率和市场状态变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有行为金融研究多将公共情绪与投资者情绪混同，且常把异质信息源合并处理，忽视了传播领域的异质性可能掩盖领域特定关系。本文旨在区分公共情绪与投资者情绪，并检验不同传播领域与市场动态的关系是否随领域和市场状态而变化。

Method: 采集2022年1月至2023年12月176个精选X账号的610,422条帖子，覆盖政治与政府、经济与金融、媒体与社会三个领域；使用三种领域特定及一种混合（pooled）机制的微调土耳其语Transformer模型进行文本分类；在日、周、月频率构建公共情绪指标，结合BIST100与BIST30市场指标，采用相关分析、Granger因果检验、向量自回归（VAR）和脉冲响应分析，在全样本期及特定市场状态下检验关系。

Result: 公共情绪与股市收益方向无显著关联，但与价格波动幅度相关，尤其在媒体与社会领域及混合传播中明显；该关系在更长聚合频率下更强。预测性关系集中于经济与金融领域传播，其强度和方向随市场状态变化，2023年选举期间尤为突出。混合指标在很大程度上反映了最活跃的传播领域。

Conclusion: 研究将传播领域异质性引入公共情绪与市场动态分析，丰富了行为金融研究；同时表明，将异质信息源聚合会掩盖公共传播与金融市场之间的领域特定关系。

Abstract: Purpose: This study examines whether domain-specific public mood is associated with stock-market dynamics and whether these relationships vary across communication domains and market conditions. It distinguishes public mood from investor sentiment and investigates whether heterogeneous sources of public communication exhibit different relationships with market behaviour.
  Design: The study analyses 610,422 posts published by 176 curated X accounts between January 2022 and December 2023, covering Politics and Government, Economy and Finance, and Media and Society. Posts are classified using fine-tuned Turkish transformer models under three domain-specific and one pooled regime. Public mood measures are constructed at daily, weekly, and monthly frequencies and examined alongside BIST100 and BIST30 market measures using correlation, Granger causality, vector autoregression, and impulse response analyses across the full period and selected market conditions.
  Findings: Public mood is not associated with the direction of stock-market returns but is associated with the magnitude of price movements, particularly for Media and Society and pooled communication. These relationships become stronger at longer aggregation frequencies. Predictive relationships are concentrated in Economy and Finance communication, while their magnitude and direction vary across market conditions, particularly during the 2023 election period. The pooled measure largely reflects the most active communication domain.
  Originality: The study contributes to behavioral-finance research by incorporating communication - domain heterogeneity into the analysis of public mood and market dynamics. It also demonstrates how aggregating heterogeneous sources can obscure domain-specific relationships between public communication and financial markets.

</details>


### [291] [AutoDataBench: A Data-centric Testbed for Accelerating Auto Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40097)
*Ruifeng Yuan,Yizhi Li,Yaxin Du,Fengyu Cai,Yiqi Liu,Hou Pong Chan,Chenghua Lin,Yun Chen,Jian Yang,Bryan Dai,Pinyan Lu,Chenghao Xiao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 AutoDataBench，一个隔离数据因素、系统评测大模型"数据智能"（理解、操作、改进训练数据）的受控基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动研究基准混杂了训练框架、超参数、算力预算与数据等多重改进来源，难以将不同前沿智能体之间的性能差异归因于具体的研究能力。

Method: 基于"数据诊断—数据组织—数据构建"的概念框架构建 AutoDataBench；设计三个精细策划的优化任务，固定非数据因素；在工具调用、检索、知识注入三类场景下，评测前沿大模型在任务特定资源预算内通过迭代实验改进训练数据的能力；并通过比较训练前的预测与实际结果，考察模型是否具备超越试错的数据效应推理能力，以及迭代反馈是否提升其理解。

Result: 在受控条件下评测了前沿大模型的数据智能表现，并检验了其对数据干预效果的预测与推理能力；复用 AutoDataBench 轨迹进行中期训练，可提升下游代码任务性能。

Conclusion: AutoDataBench 既能用于评测数据智能，也能生成高质量训练数据，具有双重价值；代码与资源已开源。

Abstract: Existing auto-research benchmarks often entangle multiple sources of improvement, including training frameworks, hyperparameters, compute budgets, and data, making it difficult to attribute why one frontier agent outperforms another to specific research capabilities. In this work, we isolate and systematically evaluate Data Intelligence: an agent's ability to understand, manipulate, and improve the data that shapes model capabilities. We introduce AutoDataBench, a controlled testbed built on a conceptual framework of data intelligence spanning data diagnosis, data organization, and data construction, instantiated through three highly curated optimization tasks while holding non-data factors fixed. Across tool use, retrieval, and knowledge injection, we evaluate frontier LLMs' ability to improve training data through iterative experimentation under task-specific resource budgets. Beyond optimization performance, we ask: do LLMs understand what their data interventions do? We compare predictions made before training with observed outcomes to seek evidence of data-effect reasoning beyond trial and error, and explore whether iterative feedback helps LLMs better understand how changes to training data affect model performance. Finally, we show that reusing AutoDataBench trajectories for mid-training improves downstream coding performance, highlighting its value in both evaluating data intelligence and generating high-quality training data. Code and resources are available at https://github.com/AutoDataBench/AutoDataBench.

</details>


### [292] [JuryFlow: Disagreement-Guided Human-in-the-Loop Multi-Agent Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40103)
*Mufeng Yang,Junwei Yu,Yepeng Ding*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出JuryFlow，一种以“评委分歧”为信号的人机协同多智能体评估框架：将回复拆解为原子主张，由异构评委逐主张裁决并构建分歧图，通过单次最小人工干预（结构引导）选定待解决的焦点分歧，随后将修正沿图传播并沉淀为可复用评分规则，实现评估器自我进化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM作为自动评委已广泛用于AI生成内容评估，但单一评委不可靠；即便采用评委团（panel），当评委出现分歧时，多数投票只是丢弃冲突而非解决冲突，留下难以消除的“分歧残余”。因此需要一种能把分歧当作精确信号来处理、而非当作噪声平均掉的评估范式。

Method: JuryFlow把候选回复分解为若干原子主张（atomic claims），由一组异构评委对每个主张给出判决；据此构建分歧图：节点由判决熵（verdict entropy）打分，边编码主张间的结构相似度。人类作为“结构引导者”，只做一次最小干预——选择要解决哪个分歧，而非重新标注整条回复。选定焦点主张后重新评估，修正沿图的边传播，并扩散到历史上相似的案例，同时固化为可复用评分规则（rubric entries），供所有评委继承，使评估器逐步自我精炼。为在无人工研究条件下实现大规模可复现基准测试，论文采用自动配置（由熵排序完成焦点选择）来评估JuryFlow。

Result: 在MT-Bench与LLMBar上，JuryFlow相对单评委基线和多数投票评委团基线均提升与金标签（gold labels）的一致性。消融实验分别验证了三部分贡献：面向分歧的重新评估、修正传播、以及评分规则归纳。

Conclusion: 论文贡献有三：(1) 一种人机回环范式，将人类角色从“标注者”转变为“结构引导者”；(2) JuryFlow框架，通过分歧图、焦点重评和闭环规则归纳将该范式落地；(3) 一套带消融的实验评估协议，用于定位性能增益来源。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as automated judges for AI-generated content, yet a single judge is unreliable and even a panel of judges leaves a hard residue: when judges disagree, majority voting discards the conflict instead of resolving it. We present JuryFlow, a disagreement-guided, human-in-the-loop multi-agent evaluation framework that treats inter-judge disagreement not as noise to be averaged away, but as a precise, claim-level signal indicating where an evaluation is uncertain. JuryFlow decomposes each candidate response into atomic claims, has a panel of heterogeneous judges assign per-claim verdicts, and builds a disagreement graph whose nodes are scored by verdict entropy and whose edges encode structural similarity between claims. A human acts as a structural guide, selecting which disagreement to resolve through a single, minimal intervention rather than re-labeling the response, after which the focal claim is re-evaluated, the correction propagates along graph edges and to historically similar cases, and is crystallized into reusable rubric entries that all judges inherit, making the evaluator progressively self-refining. To enable large-scale, reproducible benchmarking without human studies, we evaluate JuryFlow in an automatic configuration in which focal selection is made by entropy ranking. On MT-Bench and LLMBar, JuryFlow improves agreement with gold labels over single-judge and majority-vote panel baselines, and ablations isolate the contributions of disagreement-targeted re-evaluation, propagation, and rubric induction. We contribute (1) a human-in-the-loop paradigm that recasts the human from labeler to structural guide, (2) the JuryFlow framework operationalizing it through a disagreement graph, focal re-evaluation, and closed-loop rubric induction, and (3) an evaluation protocol with ablations that isolate where the gains originate.

</details>


### [293] [OverdoseMoE: A Multi-Expert Framework for Opioid Overdose Risk Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40108)
*Mingchen Li,Rohan Pandey,Junhui Qian,Feiyun Ouyang,Sunjae Kwon,Avijit Mitra,Zonghai Yao,Hong Yu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究基于患者既往一年纵向ICD诊断序列的180天阿片类药物过量风险预测，提出诊断特异性适配的OODMAMBA与OODQWEN，并在Qwen基础上构建多专家框架OVERDOSEMOE，显著提升预测性能与跨队列稳健性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 阿片类药物过量仍是重大临床与公共卫生负担，亟需可扩展的高危患者识别方法。通用语言模型缺乏对诊断序列的特异性建模，预测精度有限。

Method: 在纵向ICD诊断序列上进行持续预训练，再进行任务特定微调，得到OODMAMBA与OODQWEN；基于表现更优的Qwen预测器，进一步提出OVERDOSEMOE多专家框架，通过互补的专家加权策略整合不同规模模型。

Result: 诊断特异性适配一致优于通用语言模型基线，OODQWEN取得AUPRC 24.47、AUROC 68.56；OVERDOSEMOE进一步提升至AUPRC 25.17、AUROC 69.49。在预测风险排名前5%的患者中，PPV达25.38%并保持有意义的召回率。在独立MIMIC-IV队列上验证了跨队列稳健性，不同加权策略在各指标上各有优势。

Conclusion: 诊断特异性语言模型适配结合多专家集成可改善阿片类药物过量风险分层，并在异质电子健康记录人群中支持更稳健的预测。

Abstract: Opioid overdose remains a major clinical and public health burden, highlighting the need for scalable approaches to identify patients at high risk. Here, we investigate diagnosis-specific adaptation for 180-day opioid overdose risk prediction from patients' preceding one-year longitudinal ICD histories. We develop OODMAMBA and OODQWEN through continued pretraining on longitudinal diagnostic sequences followed by task-specific fine-tuning. Building on the stronger Qwen-based predictors, we further propose OVERDOSEMOE, a multi-expert framework that integrates models of different scales using complementary expert-weighting strategies. Diagnosis-specific adaptation consistently improved predictive performance over general-purpose language-model baselines, with OODQWEN achieving an AUPRC of 24.47 and an AUROC of 68.56. OVERDOSEMOE further improved discrimination and precision, achieving an AUPRC of 25.17 and an AUROC of 69.49 while outperforming the strongest single-model baselines. Among patients ranked in the top 5% of predicted risk, OVERDOSEMOE identified substantially enriched overdose risk, achieving a PPV of 25.38% while retaining meaningful recall. Evaluation on an independent MIMIC-IV cohort further demonstrated cross-cohort robustness, with complementary weighting strategies showing advantages across different performance measures. These findings demonstrate that diagnosis-specific language-model adaptation combined with multi-expert integration can improve opioid overdose risk stratification and support more robust prediction across heterogeneous electronic health record populations.

</details>


### [294] [Persistent Context Graphs for Efficient Memory Compaction in LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40118)
*Jingbo Yang,Kwei-Herng Lai,Xiaowen Wang,Zhaoxuan Tan,Pei Zhou,Mengting Wan,Yaar Harari,Evgeniy Gabrilovich,Shiyu Chang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: ReCAP：一种基于注意力派生重要性分数与依赖链接的轻量持久上下文图的记忆压缩方法，无需额外模型调用即可为新请求选择历史消息及支撑上下文，显著降低压缩与冷恢复延迟并提升代码任务准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体处理长时程复杂任务时交互历史不断增长，需记忆压缩以适应上下文窗口并降低预填充成本。现有方法（摘要或KV缓存压缩）常需额外模型计算来保留未来请求所需信息；且新请求会改变历史相关性，若KV缓存已过期则需重新编码，代价高昂。
