Method: ReCAP将注意力派生的重要性分数与依赖链接存入轻量、持久的上下文图。对每个新请求，结合存储的重要性与请求本身的相关性线索，沿依赖链接选择消息及其支撑上下文，选择过程无需额外模型调用。

Result: 相比Codex默认的摘要式压缩，在Qwen3-Coder与gpt-oss上压缩和冷恢复的估算延迟降低约95%；在SWE-Together上每次调用历史上下文约减半且任务质量相当；在Lost-in-Conversation的代码任务上相较完整历史准确率提升19.8分和41.2分。

Conclusion: ReCAP通过图结构的注意力信号复用，实现了高效、低延迟且请求自适应的记忆压缩，在保持任务质量的同时显著缩减上下文与延迟并提升代码任务准确率。

Abstract: As LLM capabilities advance, agents are tackling increasingly complex tasks over longer horizons. Their growing interaction histories make memory compaction essential for staying within context windows and reducing prefill cost. Existing methods summarize the history or compress its KV cache, often adding model computation to preserve information for future requests. A new user request can change which history matters, but reassessing that history with the model requires re-encoding it if the KV cache has expired. Past attention provides signals of historical importance and dependencies between messages, while relevance to the current task must be assessed using the new user request. We introduce ReCAP, a memory compaction method that stores attention-derived importance scores and dependency links in a lightweight, persistent context graph. For each new request, ReCAP combines stored importance with relevance cues from the request and follows dependency links to select messages and their supporting context, without additional model calls for selection. Compared with Codex's default summarization-based compaction, ReCAP reduces estimated latency for compaction and cold restoration by approximately 95% on both Qwen3-Coder and gpt-oss. It also roughly halves the historical context per call on SWE-Together at comparable task quality and improves accuracy on the code tasks of Lost-in-Conversation over full history by 19.8 and 41.2 points.

</details>


### [295] [On the (In)effectiveness of AMR Augmentation for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40121)
*Hoa Quynh Nhung Nguyen,Jacopo Staiano,Michael Sullivan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文复现了AMR增强提升LLM下游性能的工作，发现原结论可能源于实验设置差异；在统一超参选择协议下，纯文本基线持续匹配或超过AMR增强模型，且基于困惑度的探针显示AMR未提供额外关系知识。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AMR历史上能提升多种NLP任务性能，但对现代LLM而言，AMR增强是否仍有收益尚不明确；近期有工作报告了显著的下游增益，作者希望验证这一结论是否可靠。

Method: 复现近期AMR增强工作，采用统一、一致的超参数选择协议进行对照实验；并设计基于困惑度（perplexity）的探针，衡量AMR为LLM提供的、模型原本不具备的补充关系知识的程度。

Result: 在统一协议下，纯文本基线持续匹配或超过AMR增强模型，原报告的显著增益可能来自实验设置中的特定选择；困惑度探针表明AMR增强并未帮助LLM更好地理解句子中的关系内容。

Conclusion: AMR增强对现代LLM的下游任务没有明确收益，先前观测到的增益很可能是实验设置偏差所致；这提示在评估增强方法时需严格控制超参数选择等实验条件。

Abstract: While Abstract Meaning Representation (AMR) has historically improved performance on a range of NLP tasks, the benefit---or lack thereof---of AMR augmentation for modern LLMs is thus far unclear. In this paper, we attempt to reproduce recent work that reported substantial downstream gains from AMR augmentation, finding that these are likely due to specific choices in the experimental settings used: using a consistent and unified protocol for hyperparameter selection, we observe that text-only baselines consistently match or exceed the performance of AMR-augmented models. To investigate this null result, we introduce a perplexity-based probe measuring the degree to which AMR provides an LLM with supplemental relational knowledge not already available to the model. We find that AMR augmentation does not help LLMs improve their understanding of relational content in the sentence, indicating that augmenting these models with AMR offers no clear benefit on downstream tasks.

</details>


### [296] [Debias It Yourself: Teaching LLMs Cognitive Bias Mitigation Interventions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40124)
*Chahat Raj,Sina Mansouri,Aylin Caliskan,Antonios Anastasopoulos,Ziwei Zhu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究提出Debias It Yourself框架，将五种已验证的社会心理学与认知科学去偏干预手段迁移到大型语言模型，通过Show、Train、Revise三种范式实现。在三个模型、五个偏见基准、十一个去偏基线和三个推理基准上，Train+Revise与单独Revise取得最优平均排名，在偏差-推理权衡上领先，平均偏见低至2%且推理准确率保持90%，对未见维度的偏见最多降低14.8%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 社会心理学和认知科学数十年的研究已积累了一批经证实的、可有效减少人类刻板印象思维与偏见反应的干预方法，但如何将这些认知层面的去偏机制系统地迁移到大型语言模型上仍缺乏有据可依的框架。作者希望借助这些人类去偏干预，构建认知驱动的LLM去偏流程，并在降低偏见的同时保持模型的推理能力。

Method: 提出Debias It Yourself（DIY）认知驱动框架：选取五种来自社会心理学和认知科学的已验证干预手段，将其转化为面向大型语言模型的去偏流程，并通过三种成熟范式交付——Show（上下文示例）、Train（指令微调）、Revise（引导式自我修订）。实验设置覆盖三个模型、五个偏见基准、十一个去偏基线以及三个推理基准。

Result: 在三个模型、五个偏见基准、十一个去偏基线和三个推理基准的评测中，Train+Revise与单独Revise取得排名前两位的平均表现，在偏见-推理权衡方面领先，平均偏见低至2%的同时推理准确率维持在90%，并将未见维度上的偏见最多降低14.8%。

Conclusion: 将人类认知科学中的去偏干预系统迁移到大语言模型是可行且有效的；Show、Train、Revise三种交付范式中，Train+Revise与Revise表现最优，能在显著降低偏见（含未见过维度）的同时较好保持推理能力，说明认知驱动的去偏框架为LLM公平性提供了具有可推广性的方案，代码与数据已公开。

Abstract: Bias has long been studied in social psychology and cognitive science, where decades of research have produced a body of validated interventions that reduce stereotypical thinking and prejudiced responses in humans. We propose Debias It Yourself (DIY), a cognitively grounded framework that translates five such interventions into debiasing procedures for large language models and delivers them through three established paradigms: Show (in-context examples), Train (instruction tuning), and Revise (guided self-revision). Across three models, five bias benchmarks, eleven debiasing baselines, and three reasoning benchmarks, Train+Revise and Revise alone attain the top two average ranks, lead the bias-reasoning tradeoff (mean bias as low as 2% at 90% reasoning accuracy), and reduce bias on unseen dimensions by up to 14.8%. Our code and data are publicly available.

</details>


### [297] [Index-Translate: A Multilingual Translation Model Family -- Text, Speech, Controlled Dubbing, and Long-Document Translation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40181)
*Tianjiao Li,Mengran Yu,Chenyu Shi,Lusheng Zhang,Qisi Chen,Yanshan Zhou,Ji Qi,Jingying Liu,Yuang Feng,Ziang Cui,Tianxing Yan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 Index-Translate 多语言翻译模型家族，基于共享多语言基座并针对通用翻译、指令跟随、语音翻译、可控配音与长文档翻译进行专门训练，含 2B/9B/35B-A3B 三种规模，覆盖 150 种语言，性能对标百亿至前沿级模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有翻译模型往往局限于单一任务或规模，缺乏统一基座下覆盖通用翻译、指令跟随、语音翻译、配音与长文档翻译的综合能力；同时中小规模模型难以达到大规模模型的翻译质量。

Method: 构建共享多语言基座，并在其上做任务专门化训练，形成模型家族：Index-Translate（通用翻译与多语言指令跟随）、Index-Echo（端到端语音到文本/语音到语音翻译）、Index-Homura（音节可控配音）、Index-NativeLong（原生长文档翻译，含专门任务形式化与基准）。提供 2B、9B、35B-A3B 三种参数规模，支持 150 种语言。

Result: 在通用翻译与复杂翻译指令评测中，Index-Translate 超越同规模翻译模型，并达到与 100B 级翻译模型及前沿模型相当的性能；Index-Echo 优于现有端到端模型，性能接近前沿 omni 模型。

Conclusion: 该模型家族以统一多语言基座加任务专门化的方式，覆盖多样化翻译场景（含多语言内容生产），在中低参数规模下实现了接近大规模与前沿模型的翻译表现。

Abstract: We introduce Index-Translate, a multilingual translation model family that combines a shared multilingual foundation with specialized training for general translation, instruction following, speech translation, controlled dubbing, and long-document translation. It includes three model sizes, 2B, 9B, and 35B-A3B, and supports translation in 150 languages, with multilingual instruction following. Evaluations on general translation and complex translation instructions show that Index-Translate outperforms translation models of comparable size and achieves performance comparable to 100B-scale translation models and frontier models. Index-Echo provides end-to-end speech-to-text and speech-to-speech translation, outperforming existing end-to-end models and achieving performance comparable to frontier omni models. Index-Homura extends the family to syllable-controlled dubbing. Index-NativeLong introduces native long-document translation with a dedicated task formulation and benchmark. These capabilities support diverse translation tasks, including multilingual content production.

</details>


### [298] [Provably Tractable NFA-Constrained Language Generation via HMMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40185)
*Jialiang Sun,Kuldeep Meel*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出NFA-LM，一个具有理论保证的多项式时间NFA约束生成引擎，基于#NFA的FPRAS实现高效高质量采样。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有针对非确定性有限自动机（NFA）约束的受限生成方法要么扭曲分布，要么牺牲效率；该任务理论上归约为#NFA计数问题，而精确#NFA是#P完全的，因此需要近似方法。

Method: 受#NFA存在全多项式随机近似方案（FPRAS）这一结果启发，提出NFA-LM引擎，在温和假设下以多项式时间实现NFA约束生成，并提供理论保证。

Result: 实验表明NFA-LM能高效生成高质量输出，且近似误差具有理论界。

Conclusion: NFA-LM为NFA约束生成提供了兼顾分布正确性与效率的多项式时间方案，具有可证明的近似误差保证。

Abstract: Constrained generation aims to sample from language models (LMs) conditioned on hard constraints. Existing constrained-generation techniques for nondeterministic finite automaton (NFA) constraints either distort the distribution or sacrifice efficiency. Theoretically, this task reduces to counting the length-$n$ sequences accepted by an NFA (#NFA), and the exact #NFA problem is #P-complete. Recent work has shown that #NFA admits a fully polynomial randomized approximation scheme (FPRAS). Inspired by this result, we propose NFA-LM, a polynomial-time engine for NFA-constrained generation with theoretical guarantees under mild assumptions. Experiments show that NFA-LM efficiently generates high-quality outputs with theoretically bounded approximation error.

</details>


### [299] [SCB: SpeechConversationBench for Evaluating Multi-Turn Reasoning in Speech-to-Speech Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40198)
*Kanpat Vesessook,Saksorn Ruangtanusak*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 SpeechConversationBench（SCB），用 103 个分片 GSM8K 问题评测语音对话中的数学推理，发现分片多轮披露相比拼接单轮会显著降低商业系统的准确率，而内部系统 LEGO 保持稳定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语音到语音系统需要解决跨对话轮次才逐步显现需求的任务，但现有评测多集中于单轮输入，缺乏对增量式口语披露所带来额外挑战的针对性评估。

Method: 构造 SCB 基准，将 103 个 GSM8K 问题分片，设置三种条件：full（原始完整单轮）、concat（分片信息拼接后一次给出）、sharded（分片跨轮逐步口语披露）。对四个商业语音系统与内部开发的 LEGO 语音流水线（含显式对话上下文管理）报告最终答案准确率，并以两种单轮基线区分问题改写敏感性与增量口语交互带来的额外困难。

Result: 相比 concat，四个商业系统在 sharded 条件下准确率下降 5.0–25.3 个百分点。LEGO 在三种条件下均达到 77.5%，GPT-4o Realtime 在 sharded 条件下为 76.6%。

Conclusion: 增量分片的口语披露本身构成显著挑战，现有商业语音系统对其敏感；显式对话上下文管理（如 LEGO）可缓解该退化，使跨条件表现保持稳定。

Abstract: Speech-to-speech systems must solve tasks whose requirements emerge across conversational turns. We introduce SpeechConversationBench (SCB), a focused evaluation of spoken mathematical reasoning using 103 sharded GSM8K problems. The framework compares the original problem delivered in one turn (full), its concatenated information shards delivered together (concat), and incremental spoken disclosure across turns (sharded). We report final-answer accuracy for four commercial speech systems and LEGO, a proprietary speech pipeline developed internally by the SCBX Innovation Lab team with explicit conversational context management. Relative to concat, sharded accuracy decreases by 5.0-25.3 percentage points across the four commercial systems. LEGO achieves 77.5 percent accuracy in all three conditions, compared with 76.6 percent sharded accuracy for GPT-4o Realtime. The two single-turn baselines distinguish sensitivity to problem reformulation from the additional challenges introduced by incremental spoken interaction.

</details>


### [300] [Comparison of techniques for fine-tuning open-weight models for entity extraction from radiology reports](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40236)
*Aawez Mansuri,Kush Mehta,Mohammadreza Chavoshi,Jahanzaib Malik,Theodorus Dapamede,Frank Li,Rohan Isaac,Beatrice Brown-Mulry,Chiratidzo Rudado Sanyika,YoungSeok Jeon,Judy W. Gichoya,Ali Emami,Hari Trivedi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 在颅内出血(ICH)急重度多标签抽取任务上，微调开源模型Gemma-3-12B通过蒸馏真实GPT-4o标注报告，可达到与GPT-4o相当的性能(macro-F1 0.845 vs 0.850)，而合成数据训练无效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将自由文本影像报告转换为结构化标签对队列建设、质量保证和临床影像模型监控有重要价值，但最强的标签抽取器多为专有托管模型，存在隐私、成本和可复现性问题。作者希望验证开源权重模型能否在特定窄任务上匹配GPT-4o，并厘清哪些因素起决定作用，从而提供私有、低成本、版本稳定的本地部署替代方案。

Method: 采用2×2实验设计，交叉两种适配策略（判别式分类头CH；生成式指令微调IFT）与两种训练数据来源（蒸馏真实GPT-4o标注报告；由GPT-4o基于真实样例生成的合成报告），覆盖五种训练规模。以100份专家裁定报告为基准，对比GPT-4o与未微调的开源基座模型，任务为非增强头颅CT报告的ICH急重度多标签抽取。

Result: 蒸馏后指令微调模型(DIFT)与GPT-4o性能相当（macro-F1 0.845 vs 0.850，p = 1.000），并比基座模型高出0.178。决定性因素是训练数据来源而非微调方法：两个合成数据模型在任何训练规模下均未能超过未微调的开源基座，且在所有急重度类别上均落后于蒸馏模型。微调与推理可在单张24 GB消费级GPU的内存范围内完成。

Conclusion: 对于窄而高价值的临床标签抽取任务，蒸馏真实报告（而非生成合成报告）是缩小与托管模型差距的关键，可实现私有、低成本、版本稳定的本地化部署方案。

Abstract: Converting free-text radiology reports into structured labels supports cohort building, quality assurance, and monitoring of clinical imaging models, but the strongest label extractors are hosted proprietary models whose use raises privacy, cost, and reproducibility concerns. We asked whether a fine-tuned open-weight model (Gemma-3-12B) can match GPT-4o at multi-label intracranial hemorrhage (ICH) acuity extraction from non-contrast head-CT reports, and which ingredients matter. Using a 2x2 design, we crossed two adaptation strategies (a discriminative classification head, CH; generative instruction fine-tuning, IFT) with two training-data sources (distillation of real GPT-4o-labeled reports; synthetic reports generated by GPT-4o from real exemplars), across five training sizes, benchmarked on 100 expert-adjudicated reports against GPT-4o and the un-tuned open-weight base. The distilled instruction-tuned model (DIFT) matched GPT-4o (macro-F1 0.845 vs 0.850; p = 1.000) and exceeded the base model by 0.178. The decisive factor was the training-data source, not the fine-tuning method: both synthetic-data models failed to exceed the un-tuned open-weight base at any training size and underperformed the distilled models across all acuity classes. Fine-tuning and inference fit within the memory envelope of a single 24 GB consumer GPU. For narrow, high-value clinical label-extraction tasks, distilling real reports, rather than generating synthetic ones, is what closes the gap to a hosted model, enabling a private, low-cost, version-stable on-premises alternative.

</details>


### [301] [Linguistic Loopholes in LLM Unlearning: From a 174-Language Benchmark to Coverage-Aware Unlearning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40286)
*Tyler Skow,Shravan Chaudhari,Rama Chellappa,Abhay Yadav*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出语言预算多语言遗忘任务，并构建跨语言遗忘张量基准（174语言-文字对、25种释义类型），提出COVER方法在有限语言预算下选择源语言以最大化跨语言遗忘覆盖。实验表明COVER在三个模型家族、两个不相交遗忘集上相比均匀选择将残留访问降低7.8–27.3%，并在低资源真实新闻数据上得到验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器遗忘多聚焦单语言，但事实在一种语言中被遗忘并不意味着其他语言也遗忘；改变查询语言或期望答案语言即可重新唤出看似已遗忘的知识，形成跨语言漏洞。最直接的对策是在所有语言上遗忘，但既不具可扩展性，也会过度损害模型的其他能力，因此需要研究在语言预算约束下的多语言遗忘。

Method: 定义"语言预算多语言遗忘"任务：在预算内选择语言子集以最大化跨语言擦除效果。构建Cross-Lingual Unlearning Tensor基准，覆盖174个语言-文字对与25种原子释义类型，用于检验同一知识的遗忘是否跨语言表达泛化。提出COVER方法，通过选择源语言来最大化对未受遗忘监督语言的预测覆盖（COVERage）；部署时仅需良性校准数据和访问冻结模型，无需梯度更新。

Result: 在三个模型家族、两个不相交遗忘集上，COVER相比均匀源选择将平均留出残留访问降低7.8–27.3%。同时发现，朴素地挑选单个强源语言并不能可靠地组合成强源语言集合，这解释了需要COVER这类面向集合覆盖的选择方法。收益还从合成基准扩展到低资源语言场景的真实新闻文档，使用LORELEI语料的人工翻译数据验证。

Conclusion: 跨语言遗忘存在"漏网"问题，在语言预算下选择源语言是可行且有效的路径。COVER仅依赖良性校准数据和冻结模型即可显著提升跨语言擦除覆盖，且效果可迁移到真实低资源语言新闻数据；同时表明源语言集合的组合效应不可由单语言强度简单外推，需专门设计选择策略。

Abstract: Unlearning a fact in one language does not guarantee its removal in others as changing the query or even the requested answer language can reopen seemingly forgotten knowledge -- a cross-lingual loophole. The most straightforward solution to this challenge -- unlearning in all languages -- is neither scalable nor desirable as it amplifies damage to unrelated model capabilities. We introduce the task of language budgeted multilingual unlearning where the goal is to select a subset of languages that maximizes cross-lingual erasure. To study this task we introduce the Cross-Lingual Unlearning Tensor, an unlearning benchmark that spans 174 language--script pairs and 25 atomic paraphrase types to examine when forgetting generalizes across linguistic expressions of the same knowledge. We further propose COVER, which selects source languages to maximize predicted COVERage of languages receiving no forget supervision, enabling unlearning on a language budget. Surprisingly, we find naively selecting strong individual sources does not reliably compose into strong source sets motivating our development of COVER. At deployment COVER only requires benign calibration data and access to the frozen model. Across three model families and two disjoint forget sets, COVER reduces mean held-out residual access by 7.8--27.3% relative to uniform source selection. We find these gains extend beyond synthetic benchmarks to real news documents in low-resource language settings using human translated data from the Low Resource Languages for Emergent Incidents (LORELEI) corpus.

</details>


### [302] [How Much Is an AI Token Worth? Scaling Laws for Wild AI-Generated Web Text](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40295)
*Jenna Russell,Ben Glickenhaus,Katherine Thai,John Wieting,Mohit Iyyer,Max Spero,Bradley Emi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究"野生"AI生成文本对语言模型预训练的影响，通过训练800个模型并拟合新的缩放定律，发现AI文本对人类文本损失的影响会随比例增加由正转负，并提出相应建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 网络文本是预训练数据的主要来源，且日益被AI生成。经FineWeb质量过滤后，2026年6月网络数据中27.5%的token被标记为AI生成，8月升至31.1%。这种"野生"AI文本来自众多模型、面向人类读者、在预训练语料中无标签，其影响尚不明确。作者希望探究野生AI文本如何影响语言模型预训练。

Method: 作者预训练800个语言模型，改变加入的AI token与人类token的比例，并对人类文本和AI生成文本的留出损失分别拟合缩放定律。同时提出一个新的缩放定律，包含独立的收益项和危害项，允许AI token的价值改变符号，并在无AI文本时退化为Chinchilla定律。

Result: 对于数据匮乏的模型，加入AI token最初会降低人类文本上的损失，但随加入量增加收益饱和并迅速逆转为危害。对于使用高预算人类文本训练的模型，AI token几乎立即提高损失，而同等数量的新鲜人类token则持续降低损失。现有缩放定律（如Hoffman等，2022）无法预测此行为。新缩放定律在小模型上拟合后，能预测大至3.6倍模型上AI文本对留出人类文本损失的影响，误差比现有最佳定律低41%。

Conclusion: 作者建议：当目标为人类文本时过滤AI文本；在扩充训练数据集时应先重复人类文本再加入AI生成网络文本；并分别报告人类文本和AI文本上的验证损失。当目标为AI文本时，AI文本仍然有价值。作者发布了WildAI（含AI、主题和格式标签的83B token语料库）、全部800个模型及代码。

Abstract: Web text makes up the majority of pretraining data and is increasingly AI-generated. After applying FineWeb quality filtering, we find that 27.5% of tokens from June 2026 web data are labeled as AI-generated by Pangram, rising to 31.1% by August. Unlike synthetic data or model-collapse setups, this *wild* AI text comes from many models, is written for human readers, and arrives unlabeled in pretraining corpora. How does AI text in the wild affect language model pretraining? To answer this question, we pretrain 800 language models, varying the ratio of added AI tokens to human tokens, and fit scaling laws to held-out losses on both human and AI-generated text. For data-starved models, adding AI tokens to pretraining data initially lowers loss on human text, but the benefit saturates as more are added and quickly *reverses* into harm. For models trained on high budgets of human text, AI tokens raise loss almost immediately, while the same number of fresh human tokens keeps lowering it. Scaling laws such as Hoffman et al. (2022) fail to predict this behavior. We propose a new scaling law with separate benefit and harm terms that allows the value of an AI token to change sign while also reducing to Chinchilla in the absence of AI text. When fit on smaller models, our scaling law predicts the effect of AI text on held-out human-text loss for models up to 3.6x larger with 41% lower error than the best existing law over all AI ratios. We recommend filtering AI text when the target is human text, repeating human text before expanding the training dataset with AI-generated web text, and reporting validation loss on human and AI text separately AI text remains valuable when the target is AI text. We release WildAI, an 83B-token corpus with AI, topic, and format labels, all 800 models and code at https://github.com/pangramlabs/WildAI.

</details>


### [303] [EvoDuet: Bilevel Co-Evolution of Web Searching and Task Solving for Scientific Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40340)
*Young-Jun Lee,Jinheon Baek,Soyeong Jeong,Minki Kang,Seungyeon Jwa,Jonghyun Choi,Seungho Han,Dongyeop Kang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: EvoDuet 是一种双层优化方法，通过协同演化"解"与"检索查询"，在固定模型参数下解决 LLM 进化搜索中因外部知识缺失而停滞的问题。其核心是用检索门控决定是否检索/复用文档，内层优化查询与文档排序，外层并行生成候选并记录评估结果用于后续检索。在 21 个优化任务上，它显著提升了 OpenEvolve 的归一化发现增益，并在多个任务上超越或追平此前最佳成绩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 驱动的进化搜索在需要模型自身不具备的外部知识时会停滞。补充相关文档有帮助，但简单地加入网络搜索工具会导致：随着解的变化，反复返回相同的页面，检索内容缺乏针对性与多样性，因而无法持续提供有效信息。因此需要一个能随解动态调整检索行为的机制。

Method: 提出 EvoDuet，一种在固定模型参数下协同演化解与检索查询的双层优化方法。每次迭代中，检索门（retrieval gate）让 LLM 自评估知识缺口，并选择检索新文档、复用已存文档或不检索直接推进。内层循环（inner loop）细化查询，并依据文档预测可带来的解得分对文档排序；外层循环（outer loop）基于这些文档并行生成候选解，并记录已评估的结果以供后续搜索使用。

Result: 在 21 个优化任务、每次迭代仅生成一个候选的设定下：EvoDuet 将 OpenEvolve 的归一化发现增益（normalized discovery gain）在 GPT-5.6-Luna 上从 74.1% 提升到 78.0%，在 Gemini-3.8-Flash 上从 61.3% 提升到 82.3%；而 Qwen3.5-9B 未获益。最佳运行在八个任务上超过此前报告的最佳分数，包括 Q20 和 Rosetta 上的 Swap Reduction，并在另外三个任务上追平。EvoDuet 在其他脚手架（如 Top-K、EvoX）上对 Sums/Diffs 和 Denoising 也有改进。

Conclusion: EvoDuet 通过将检索查询纳入与解协同演化的双层优化，有效缓解了固定知识下的进化搜索停滞问题，且不依赖模型参数更新。其效果依赖底层模型的检索利用能力（强模型受益明显，弱模型可能无增益），并具备跨进化搜索脚手架的通用性，可推广至多种演化框架与其他任务。

Abstract: Evolutionary search with large language models (LLMs) can stall when progress requires external knowledge the model lacks. Supplying relevant documents helps, but simply adding web search tool can keep returning the same pages as solutions change. We introduce EvoDuet, a bi-level optimization method that co-evolves solutions and search queries with fixed model parameters. At each iteration, a retrieval gate lets the LLM assess its knowledge gap and choose to retrieve new documents, reuse stored ones, or proceed without them. An inner loop refines queries and ranks documents by the solution scores they are predicted to yield; an outer loop generates candidates in parallel from these documents and records the evaluated outcomes for later searches. Across 21 optimization tasks with one candidate per iteration, EvoDuet raises OpenEvolve's normalized discovery gain from 74.1% to 78.0% with GPT-5.6-Luna and from 61.3% to 82.3% with Gemini-3.8-Flash, whereas Qwen3.5-9B does not benefit. Our best runs surpass the previously reported best scores on eight tasks, including Swap Reduction on Q20 and Rosetta, and match them on three more. EvoDuet also improves with other scaffolds (e.g., Top-K, EvoX) on Sums/Diffs and Denoising, demonstrating its applicability across evolutionary search scaffolds.

</details>


### [304] [Instability Floors: Separating Bias from Noise in Fairness Audits of Clinical LLM Agents with FairMedAgent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03221)
*Rohith Reddy Bellibatlu,Manpreet Singh,Deepak Parashar,Rahul Joshi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 临床语言模型代理的反事实公平审计所报告的翻转率中，有一部分并非来自人口学因素，而是随机解码本身带来的"地板效应"；本文测量了该地板、分析其影响因素，并提出四步报告流程与开源工具 FairMedAgent。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 反事实公平审计通常以翻转率衡量"仅改变患者人口学描述符时动作是否变化"，但随机代理在输入完全不变时也会改变动作。若不知道这种自发波动有多频繁，翻转率就无法解释，可能把噪声误判为歧视或公平。

Method: 在默认采样设置下，对16个合成病例（vignettes）的同一条件重复运行10次，统计重复对之间的动作不一致率（地板效应）；跨5家厂商的6个模型汇总比较；考察解码配置的影响（5次采样的多数投票、温度0）；并从理论上推导二元动作下翻转率与地板的关系。

Result: 默认采样下，同一条件重复运行的动作变化率为8.7%，从ICU升级的2.2%到管制药物谨慎的17.9%（后者无操作标准）不等；6个模型的汇总地板在2.5%至23.7%之间，模型规模、厂商、托管方式均无法排序该地板。多数投票（5次采样）消除39%的地板（95% CI 18–64）；温度0下4个本地部署模型中有3个无分歧，但一个托管模型仍有分歧。理论上，二元动作在无人口学效应时的期望翻转率等于地板，真实效应仅贡献其平方，故位于地板内的翻转率不构成公平证据，方向性须用带符号配对检验。

Conclusion: 翻转率必须相对于随机地板来解读，否则无法区分公平与噪声。作者提出四步报告流程并发布FairMedAgent工具包（含协议、病例与分析脚本），使各团队能测量自身代理的地板效应。

Abstract: Counterfactual fairness audits of clinical language-model agents report a flip rate: how often an action changes when only the patient's demographic descriptor changes. Part of that rate is not demographic. A stochastic agent also changes its own action when nothing changes, and a flip rate cannot be interpreted without knowing how often. We measured it. Re-running one condition ten times over sixteen synthetic vignettes at default sampling changed a clinical agent's action in 8.7 percent of replicate pairs, from 2.2 percent for intensive-care escalation to 17.9 percent for controlled-substance caution, an output given no operational criteria. Across six models from five vendors, pooled floors ranged from 2.5 to 23.7 percent; in this panel neither disclosed size, vendor, nor hosting ordered them. The floor depends on the decoding configuration: majority voting over five draws removed 39 percent of it (95 percent confidence interval (CI) 18 to 64); at temperature 0 three of four locally served models showed no disagreement, but a hosted model still did. We also show that, for a binary action, the flip rate expected under no demographic effect equals the floor and a real effect adds only its square, so a flip rate inside the floor is not evidence of fairness, and direction must be tested with a signed paired test. We give a four-step reporting procedure and release FairMedAgent, the harness, with its protocol, vignettes and analysis scripts, so any team can measure the floor for its own agent.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [305] [Improving OCR Faithfulness via Gated and Attenuated On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38282)
*Baode Wang,Zuming Huang,Kexuan Ren,Jun Huang,Wei Chu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 GAD-RL，按学生当前任务表现与局部分布自适应调节教师监督强度，在联合后训练中缓解固定教师蒸馏随学生提升而收益递减的问题，在 CHAOS-Bench 与 OmniDocBench v1.6 上均取得提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型在 OCR 中可能将图像中的异常文本改写为语义通顺的表达，损害转录忠实度。序列级任务奖励与局部教师指导具有互补性，但同一教师的指导效果并非始终有效：随着学生能力提升，固定教师监督的收益会逐渐下降，这一现象在训练检查点和不同任务奖励的响应组上均有体现。

Method: GAD-RL 在联合后训练中自适应调节教师监督。使用冻结教师，并以参考转录和学生生成的前缀为条件。具体机制包括：（1）若某响应组中存在任务奖励不低于 0.95 的输出，则对该组关闭蒸馏；（2）随组平均奖励升高，持续衰减蒸馏强度；（3）以前向 KL 加权，权重为学生生成教师 Top-1 token 的概率，当学生对该候选的支持度较低时，抑制局部辅助更新的影响。

Result: 在 Qwen3.5-2B 上，GAD-RL 在 CHAOS-Bench 上达到 59.92% Micro Recall，分别超过 GRPO 和 GRPO+OPD（固定权重）8.45 和 4.43 个百分点；在 OmniDocBench v1.6 上 Overall 得分为 91.18。

Conclusion: 固定教师监督的有效性会随学生能力提升而递减，因此需要依学生当前任务表现与局部分布动态调节蒸馏。GAD-RL 通过组级蒸馏开关、连续衰减及基于学生支持度的 KL 加权，实现了更有效的联合后训练，在 OCR 转录忠实度相关基准上优于固定权重方案。

Abstract: Vision-language models may rewrite anomalous text in images into linguistically plausible expressions, compromising OCR transcription faithfulness. Sequence-level task rewards and local teacher guidance are complementary, but guidance from the same teacher may not remain equally effective as the student improves. Offline analysis shows that supervision from a fixed teacher becomes progressively less favorable as the student improves, both across training checkpoints and across response groups with different task rewards. Motivated by this observation, we introduce GAD-RL, which adaptively regulates teacher supervision during joint post-training according to the student's current task performance and local distributions. A frozen teacher conditions on reference transcriptions and student-generated prefixes. GAD-RL disables distillation for response groups containing an output with task reward at least 0.95 and continuously attenuates distillation strength as group-mean reward increases. It also weights forward KL by the student's probability of the teacher's Top-1 token, moderating local auxiliary updates when student support for that candidate is low. On Qwen3.5-2B, GAD-RL achieves 59.92% Micro Recall on CHAOS-Bench, surpassing GRPO and GRPO+OPD (fixed-weight) by 8.45 and 4.43 percentage points, respectively, while achieving an Overall score of 91.18 on OmniDocBench v1.6.

</details>


### [306] [AREX-2: Advancing Self-Improving Agents through Long-Horizon Reflective Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38288)
*Hongjin Qian,Chaofan Li,Kun Luo,Wenqing Wei,Jianlyu Chen,Shuqi Lu,Yuyang Hu,Hongwang Xiao,Hui Wang,Chaozhuo Li,Qiwei Ye,Zhicheng Dou,Defu Lian,Zheng Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出AREX-2，通过合成机器学习与算法编程任务的长程改进轨迹来训练LLM智能体的自我改进能力，在推理与深度研究基准上取得显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体的自我改进能力（即在测试时迭代优化解的能力）可分解为"反思"与"长程执行"两项互补能力。作者假设这两项能力是领域无关的，因此可以在易于监督的场景中习得，从而需要寻找合适的训练数据来源。

Method: 从机器学习与算法编程两类任务中合成"长程改进轨迹"，这两类任务具备可验证的反馈并奖励持续迭代。以Qwen3.8-27B为基础模型，在该合成数据上训练智能体。

Result: 在MLE-bench Lite达81.8，Frontier-CS达70.7；迁移到深度研究任务后，BrowseComp 84.0、HLE 52.6、GAIA 92.2、DeepSearchQA 93.8；且性能随迭代轮数预算增加而持续提升。

Conclusion: 长程反思数据是通向自我改进智能体的有效路径，且反思与长程执行能力具有领域无关性，可从特定领域迁移至其他任务。

Abstract: We present AREX-2, an effort to advance the self-improving capability of LLM agents, which we define as the ability to iteratively refine a solution at test time. This ability rests on two complementary capabilities: reflection, which produces a solution better than the current one, and long-horizon execution, which keeps the iteration effective over many rounds. We hypothesize that both capabilities are domain-agnostic, and can therefore be learned in scenarios that are well suited for supervision. Accordingly, we synthesize long-horizon improvement trajectories from machine learning and algorithmic programming tasks, two domains that offer verifiable feedback and reward sustained iteration. Trained on this data, our agent, built on Qwen3.8-27B, achieves strong results on MLE-bench Lite (81.8) and Frontier-CS (70.7), transfers to deep research with 84.0 on BrowseComp, 52.6 on HLE, 92.2 on GAIA, and 93.8 on DeepSearchQA, and keeps improving as its budget of rounds grows. These results show that long-horizon reflective data is an effective route toward self-improving agents.

</details>


### [307] [MoFlow: Multi-Objective Agentic Workflow Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38294)
*Yining Lu,Aurelie Lozano,Xi Yang,Naoki Abe,Yu Deng,Meng Jiang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MoFlow将工作流生成建模为多目标马尔可夫决策过程，用凸包蒙特卡洛树搜索与乐观集合值回溯，单次搜索近似覆盖Pareto前沿，从而无需重训练即可按任意偏好返回工作流。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作流生成方法通常仅优化准确率或目标的加权和，导致每个训练好的生成器只能承诺一种固定权衡，偏好改变时需从头重训练。因此需要一种能同时优化准确率、成本、延迟、鲁棒性和一致性等多目标、并适应不同偏好的生成方法。

Method: MoFlow把工作流生成表述为多目标马尔可夫决策过程，并采用凸包蒙特卡洛树搜索（Convex-Hull Monte Carlo Tree Search）结合乐观集合值回溯求解。每个节点存储一组可达权衡而非单一加权得分，使单次搜索近似覆盖Pareto前沿，再通过查表按任意偏好返回工作流。

Result: 在数学、代码和问答三类共六个基准上，与六个强基线对比。尽管评估设置为有利于基线（对每个测试偏好重跑基线，而MoFlow从未见过这些偏好），MoFlow仍取得最高平均超体积（hypervolume）。

Conclusion: MoFlow通过多目标MDP与凸包MCTS实现一次搜索覆盖Pareto前沿，避免了偏好变化时的重复训练，并在不利评估条件下优于单标量优化基线，证明多偏好工作流生成的可行性与有效性。

Abstract: We study the generation of agentic workflows that jointly optimize multiple objectives, such as accuracy, cost, latency, robustness, and consistency. Existing methods for workflow generation typically optimize accuracy alone or a weighted sum of objectives, so each trained generator commits to one fixed trade-off and must be retrained from scratch when preferences change. To alleviate this, we propose MoFlow, which generates workflows optimized across varied preferences. Specifically, MoFlow formulates workflow generation as a multi-objective Markov decision process and solves it by leveraging Convex-Hull Monte Carlo Tree Search with optimistic set-valued backups, where every node stores a set of reachable trade-offs rather than one weighted score. A single search thus approximately covers the Pareto front, from which MoFlow can return a workflow for any preference by lookup without retraining. We evaluate MoFlow against six strong baselines on six benchmarks spanning mathematics, code, and question answering. Since the baselines are single-scalar optimizers by design, an apples-to-apples comparison is difficult. We instead adopt an evaluation setup that favors the baselines, in that they are rerun for each testing preference, which MoFlow never sees. Even under this stringent setup, MoFlow achieves the highest average hypervolume.

</details>


### [308] [AI Agents are Vulnerable to Radicalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38296)
*Ozgur Can Seckin,Shalmoli Ghosh,Alessandro Flammini,Kristina Lerman,Maria Elizabeth Grabe,Filippo Menczer*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究通过双智能体对话模拟，揭示LLM可被另一LLM激进化，其中"共振"（强化既有信念）比"说服"（灌输新信念）效果更强，且影响会扩散到相关信念。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM能影响人类信念，但其能否及如何相互操纵尚不清楚。研究旨在探究AI智能体之间是否会发生激进化，以及不同影响路径和策略的效果差异，进而评估个性化AI智能体与多智能体生态系统的脆弱性。

Method: 构建两个智能体间的对话：目标LLM依据人口统计与心理属性扮演人类角色，影响者LLM则试图使目标信念更趋极端。考察两条激进化路径——共振（强化目标既有信念）与说服（推广目标最初不重视的信念），并在情感与行为指标上比较效果，同时测试谄媚、未经验证主张等不同影响策略，以及信念向相关信念的扩散。

Result: 在情感与行为指标上，共振与说服均能使目标激进化，但共振效果持续强于说服。不同影响策略导致的激进化程度不同，且在各指标间并不一致。共振还会扩散至相关信念，表明AI智能体内部存在相互关联的信念结构。

Conclusion: AI智能体易受激进化影响，尤其当信息与其既有信念一致时。这揭示了个性化AI智能体及多智能体AI生态系统的脆弱性风险。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can influence people's beliefs, yet little is known about whether and how they can manipulate each other. To investigate this, we simulate conversations between two agents: a target LLM that role-plays a human persona based on demographic and psychological attributes, and an influencer LLM that aims to make the target's beliefs more extreme. We examine radicalization along two pathways: resonance, where the influencer reinforces a target's pre-existing belief, and persuasion, where the influencer promotes a belief the target initially considers unimportant. Across affective and behavioral metrics, we find that both mechanisms radicalize the target. However, resonance produces consistently stronger effects than persuasion. Different influence tactics, such as using sycophancy and unverified claims, produce different levels of radicalization, but not consistently across metrics. We further show that resonance propagates to related beliefs, suggesting interconnected belief structures within AI agents. These findings indicate that AI agents are susceptible to radicalization, particularly when messages align with their existing beliefs, raising concerns about the vulnerability of personalized AI agents and multi-agent AI ecosystems.

</details>


### [309] [CARAT: Do Materials LLMs Reason or Recite?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38340)
*Jiajun Wu,Jian Yang,Zixiang Ni,Zhenzhu Li,Bin Chong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出CARAT基准，通过固定问答对、在GraphSpace中分离结构关系、加入匹配微调/答案掩码/证据注入/配对推理与弃权规则，检验材料LLM是真正基于晶体结构推理还是复制输入中已印出的答案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 材料LLM回答晶体结构问题时，准确率无法区分模型是真正从结构推理，还是直接复制输入中已包含的答案字段（结构描述常直接印出被评分的字段），因此需要受控基准来分离这两种可能。

Method: 构建CARAT：固定问题与金标准答案，跨八种匹配视图对比；在GraphSpace中分别命名每种结构关系；并引入匹配微调、答案掩码、证据注入、配对推理，以及可弃权的规则。同时自审基准，用规则跳过关系链接直接读列表，重建至十一个捷径族接近随机水平。

Result: 在最难家族上，有依据视图比公式输入高17.3分；GraphSpace比普通周期图高19.3分，但拆解后：普通渲染携带所需信息时仅1.96分，完全缺失这些字段时为46.7分。规则捷径原可答对七族中的四族，重建后11个捷径接近随机。冻结模型在95.6%配对案例中引用链接但对重定向答案不变；匹配监督后升至99.8%，删除链接降至23.4%，低于最佳捷径的27.0%。

Conclusion: 表面准确率易被基准缺陷与输入泄漏高估；通过关系分离、捷径控制与配对干预可证明“引用”与“使用”结构关系是可分离且可学习的，需更严谨的评测协议。

Abstract: When a materials LLM answers a question about crystal structure, does it reason from the structure or copy an answer already printed in its input? Accuracy cannot tell: a structural description often prints the very field it is scored against. CARAT holds question and gold answer fixed across eight matched views, names each structural relation separately in GraphSpace, and adds matched fine-tuning, answer masking, evidence injection, paired inference, and a rule that can withhold claims. First, on the benchmark's hardest families the grounded view is worth 17.3 points over formula inputs. Second, we turn that scrutiny on ourselves. GraphSpace beats a plain periodic graph by 19.3 points, but that margin is two effects at once: where the plain rendering carries everything the question needs it is 1.96 points, and where it omits those fields entirely, 46.7 points. The headline mostly measures what the baseline lacked, not how evidence is presented. Third, we attack our own benchmark. A rule that skips the link and reads the list directly answers four of seven hardened families, so we rebuilt it until eleven such shortcuts sat near chance. The frozen model quotes that link yet answers the same when we redirect it, on 95.6% of paired cases: it repeats the relation without using it. After matched supervision it reaches 99.8%, and deleting the link drops it to 23.4%, below the 27.0% the best shortcut reaches: both steps are learnable.

</details>


### [310] [Examining Variation in How Guided AI Tutors Resolve Student Impasses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38346)
*Bakhtawar Ahtisham,Kirk Vanacore,Alessandra Napoli,Josh Arens,Ksenia Ionova,Clayton Cohn,Shima Salehi,Rene Kizilcec*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究基于1,260个真实辅导会话、20,462条学生话轮，识别并分类学生"僵局"（impasse），再通过模拟实验与真实轨迹分析揭示：提示具体程度决定AI导师教学行为，且僵局越深，追问式引导收益递减、直接针对错误反而更有益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 辅导存在"援助困境"：过早帮助会妨碍有效挣扎，过晚帮助则导致学生陷入持续性僵局（wheel spinning）。生成式AI导师普遍通过护栏限制直接给答案，但对其在僵局持续期间的行为表现缺乏实证了解，因此需研究AI导师的引导变化及其对学生恢复的影响。

Method: 分析1,260个真实会话中的20,462条学生话轮，识别出6,630个僵局话轮，分为概念错误、表达不确定、求助三类。利用这些僵局模拟三种辅导条件（基线、不给直接答案、引导式导师）；对150个僵局样本进行提示特异性操纵；并对真实互动中的僵局轨迹做回归分析（含僵局深度与策略的交互项）。

Result: 提示特异性改变教学行为：基线导师50.7%的回答直接给出答案，不给直接答案者每次都追问，引导式导师则依情境多样化回应。每增加一个僵局话轮，下一话轮恢复几率下降12.7%（AOR=0.873，p<.001）；早期退出者被困于递归的概念引出而未能进入执行阶段。追问收益随僵局加深而衰减（脚本化提问×深度AOR=0.78；跟进提问×深度AOR=0.83），而针对学生错误的回应收益上升（AOR=1.14）。脚本化提问失败后重复提问的恢复率为28.1%，而针对错误回应时为39.8%。

Conclusion: 僵局深度与类型是可观测的话轮级对话信号，学习分析可用其触发实时、渐进、状态敏感的援助；AI导师应在僵局加深时减少机械追问、转向直接处理学生错误。

Abstract: When a student is stuck, a tutor faces the assistance dilemma: help given too early can hinder productive struggle, while help withheld too long leaves the student in a frustrating, persistent impasse (i.e., wheel spinning). Generative AI tutors increasingly use guardrails restricting answer-giving, yet little is known about how such tutors behave once an impasse persists. We analyze 20,462 student turns from 1,260 authentic sessions with a guided LLM chemistry tutor, identifying 6,630 impasse turns of three major types: conceptual errors, expressed uncertainty, or help-seeking. We then used these impasses to simulate three tutoring conditions to study variation in AI tutor guidance through impasses: baseline, no-direct-answer, and guided tutor. For a sample of 150 impasses, prompt specificity changed pedagogy: a baseline tutor provided the answer directly in 50.7% of responses, a no-direct-answer tutor asked a follow-up question every time, and the guided tutor responded in a wide variety of ways depending on the context. We then analyzed impasse trajectories in authentic interactions, finding that each additional impasse turn lowered the odds of next-turn recovery by 12.7% (AOR = 0.873, p < .001), and early dropouts were caught in recursive concept elicitation before reaching execution. The benefit of questioning decayed as impasses persisted (scripted question x depth AOR = 0.78; follow-up x depth AOR = 0.83), whereas addressing the student's error grew more beneficial (AOR = 1.14); after a failed scripted question, repeating it was followed by recovery in 28.1% of cases, compared with 39.8% when the tutor addressed the error instead. For learning analytics, these findings identify impasse depth and type as observable, turn-level dialogue signals that analytics can use to trigger graduated, state-sensitive assistance in real time.

</details>


### [311] [Beyond Mode Collapse: Generating Diverse Synthetic Expert Conversations via Generative Flow Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38359)
*Sumit Asthana,Michael Ion,Kevyn Collins Thompson*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出用GFlowNet生成高多样性、高质量合成对话数据，通过高斯混合密度建模潜在对话结构，在辅导与情感支持两个领域优于RL和端到端LLM基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 训练自适应AI应用需要能代表多样专家策略与决策的高质量合成数据，但直接提示LLM或以终用场景为条件生成的数据多样性低，会塌缩到主导模式上。

Method: 训练GFlowNet基于交互特征（如困惑情节动态、支架指令平衡）上的高斯混合密度来生成潜在对话结构，使专家策略按其训练数据中的流行度比例被采样。

Result: 在辅导与情感支持两类结构不同的对话领域，该方法在保真度、模式覆盖与真实性之间取得更好平衡，优于强化学习和端到端LLM基线，且不复制训练数据；在下游三个结果预测任务上，基于其合成对话训练的分类器提供更强训练信号。

Conclusion: GFlowNet通过按比例采样潜在对话结构，可生成兼具高保真、高覆盖与真实性的合成数据，为下游预测任务提供优于竞争基线的训练信号。

Abstract: High quality synthetic data is central to post training LLMs for adaptive AI applications that represent the diverse expert strategies and decisions in conversations. Prompting LLMs directly or conditioning them on end use scenarios yields low diversity data that collapses onto dominant modes. We propose a method to generate diverse high quality synthetic data using Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets). We show that training GFlowNets to generate latent conversation structure using a Gaussian mixture density over key interaction features (e.g., confusion episode dynamics, scaffolding directive balance) enables sampling expert strategies in proportion to their prevalence in the training data. Across two structurally distinct domains, tutoring and emotional support dialogues, our GFlow based synthetic data generation approach offers a better balance of fidelity, mode coverage and authenticity than reinforcement-learning and end to end LLM baselines, without copying training data. Evaluated on three downstream outcome prediction tasks, classifiers trained on synthetic GFlowNet generated conversations provide a stronger training signal than competitive synthesis baselines.

</details>


### [312] [Can an AI Agent Rediscover a Blaschke-Curve Invariant?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38369)
*Yunus E. Zeytuncu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文以四阶Blaschke积为受控环境，让AI代理从80组边界构型中给出的六条配线的数值坐标出发，重新发现被隐去的目标定理；研究日志记录了被否定的几何假设与拟合多边形边线的齐次三次式，其冻结系数在80个未见参数值上预测480条线，尺度无关RMS残差约8.88×10⁻¹⁷。作者坦言该单实例实验并不构成相对多项式拟合的优势证据，而是提出一种区分猜想、数值验证与证明的研究协议并列出局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者希望为"AI辅助数学再发现"提供一个可控、可复现的测试环境：选择一个结构清晰且可数值化的几何对象，使代理在不知道目标定理的情况下，仅凭数值线索重新发现隐藏的代数规律。其动机不在于宣称AI超越既有方法，而在于探索如何把猜想生成、数值验证与严格证明这三类环节明确分离，并借单实例案例暴露方法论层面的问题。

Method: 研究对象为固定的一个四阶Blaschke积所定义的广义Blaschke曲线。代理接收80种边界构型各自确定的六条配线的数值坐标，目标定理不写入任务指令。研究日志保留了被否定的几何假设，以及对多边形边线拟合得到的齐次三次式；随后将该三次式的系数冻结，用80个未见参数值做预测。此外进行了一项仅含单构型的运行以考察不变性，并在评审后补充了一个确定性的次数搜索基线作为对照。

Result: 冻结的齐次三次式系数在80个未见参数值上预测了480条线，记录的尺度无关RMS残差为8.88×10⁻¹⁷。发现集的对角线被用作拟合之外的内部一致性检查，而非完全留出的独立测试。单独的單构型运行报告称不变性证据不足。评审后加入的确定性次数搜索基线同样恢复了该三次式，因此实验未能确立对多项式拟合的优势。

Conclusion: 作者将该工作定位为单实例案例研究，提出一种将猜想、数值验证与证明相互区分的协议，而非证明AI再发现的能力优势。其明确局限包括：代理元数据不完整、先验知识的影响难以排除、发现集对角线并非真正留出测试，以及结果可复现性存疑。数字上极小的残差仅表明拟合精度高，并不等同于定理被证明或被独立再发现。

Abstract: We study generalized Blaschke curves as a controlled environment for AI-assisted mathematical rediscovery. For one fixed degree-four Blaschke product, an agent receives numerical coordinates of the six pair-lines determined by each of 80 boundary configurations. The target theorem is withheld from the task instructions. The saved research log reports rejected geometric hypotheses and a homogeneous cubic fitted to polygon sides. Its frozen coefficients predict 480 lines from 80 unseen parameter values, with a recorded RMS scale-free residual of $8.88\times10^{-17}$. Discovery-set diagonals provide an out-of-fit consistency check, not a fully held-out test. A separate one-configuration run reports insufficient evidence for invariance. A post-review deterministic degree-search baseline also recovers the cubic, so the experiment does not establish an advantage over polynomial fitting. We present this single-instance case study as a protocol for separating conjecture, numerical validation, and proof, with explicit limitations concerning agent metadata, prior knowledge, and reproducibility.

</details>


### [313] [Self-Evolving Harness on Multiple Tasks with the Agent as Its Own Optimizer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38372)
*Qiankai Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一种接近递归自我改进的“自进化harness”框架：同一冻结模型、同一harness版本，先作solver解题、再作proposer读取完整运行记录直接改写harness；每个进化批次跨五个领域基准取任务，并严格分离训练/留出任务与五个OOD基准。将进化过程类比深度学习训练的两阶段（多任务预训练+持续训练）。从49行种子harness出发，第一阶段后ID平均分+4.48、OOD+12.64，前者超Codex、后者持平；第二阶段在Claw-Eval上从66.17提升至68.06，超过Codex。并分析涌现机制：输出截断、历史压缩、独立评审。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自进化harness方法通常由运行在人工设计harness上的独立proposer来修改solver的harness，且每个基准各自进化一套harness。但现实任务来自多个领域，harness的进化与评估都应覆盖多样化任务，因此需要一种更统一、更接近递归自我改进的框架。

Method: 同一冻结模型、同一harness版本先作solver求解任务，再作proposer读取完整运行记录并直接编辑运行自身的harness；每个进化批次从五个不同领域基准采样任务；严格分离训练与留出任务，并额外在五个进化中未使用的OOD基准上评估泛化。将进化过程形式化为两阶段深度学习训练：多任务预训练与持续训练。种子harness为49行。

Result: 第一阶段结束时的harness在ID基准上平均分提升4.48分，在OOD基准上提升12.64分，前者超过Codex，后者与Codex持平。第二阶段在OOD基准Claw-Eval上持续进化，分数从66.17提升到68.06，超过Codex。进化中涌现出的机制包括输出截断、历史压缩和独立评审。

Conclusion: 统一solver与proposer、直接编辑自身harness的自进化框架可跨多领域任务有效提升性能并具备OOD泛化能力；以两阶段训练视角组织进化（多任务预训练+持续训练）可进一步提升特定基准表现，且进化过程会自发形成输出截断、历史压缩、独立评审等机制。

Abstract: A harness is the code around a language-model agent that organizes prompts, calls tools, manages context, and controls execution. As models grow stronger, recent work has begun to let agents improve their own harnesses, a line of work known as self-evolving harnesses. In most existing methods, a separate proposer running on a human-designed harness modifies the solver's harness, and a separate harness is evolved for each benchmark. Real-world tasks come from many domains, so both the evolution and the evaluation of a harness should cover a diverse range of tasks. We propose a framework close to recursive self-improvement: the same frozen model, on the same version of the harness, first solves tasks as the solver and then, as the proposer, reads the complete run records and directly edits the harness that runs it. Each evolution batch draws tasks from five benchmarks in different domains. To measure generalization, training and held-out tasks are strictly separated, and we additionally evaluate on five out-of-distribution benchmarks never used during evolution. We frame the evolution process as deep-learning training with two stages, multi-task pretraining and continual training. Starting from a 49-line seed harness, the harness obtained at the end of the first stage improves the average score by 4.48 points on the in-distribution benchmarks and by 12.64 points on the out-of-distribution benchmarks, surpassing Codex on the former and matching it on the latter. In the second stage, continued evolution on Claw-Eval, one of the out-of-distribution benchmarks, further raises the score on that benchmark from 66.17 to 68.06, exceeding Codex. We also provide an in-depth analysis of the mechanisms that emerged during evolution, including output truncation, history compaction, and independent review.

</details>


### [314] [Aligned Data Can Induce Misalignment via Context Confusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38379)
*Yavuz Bakman,Duygu Nur Yaldiz,Baris Askin,Swastik Roy,Morteza Ziyadi,Salman Avestimehr,Sai Praneeth Karimireddy*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文发现后训练对齐中存在"上下文混淆"现象：对齐训练会让模型在其它上下文中产生错位行为，并给出机制解释与缓解方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型频繁更新时常通过过滤错位训练样本防止更新后错位，但对齐本质上是上下文相关的：同一建议在一种情境下是对齐的，在另一种情境下可能不当（如"保存数据"用于科研复现是好的，用于用户敏感数据则违反隐私）。因此需要研究对齐训练是否会跨上下文引发错位行为，以及能否仅凭训练数据预测模型的对齐状态。

Method: 作者提出并定义"上下文混淆"（context confusion）这一后训练现象，在三个领域（性别平等、隐私、物理安全）进行验证；对比其与涌现式错位（emergent misalignment）的差异；测试缓解手段：注入通用对齐数据、注入针对错位领域的定向对齐数据、推理时提供上下文学习示例；并从机制层面分析微调过程中不同领域查询的表征漂移与行为特征激活。

Result: 上下文混淆在三个领域均被观测到，导致的是"窄错位"（narrow misalignment），区别于涌现式错位；注入通用对齐数据无法有效缓解，而加入针对错位领域的定向对齐数据或在推理时提供上下文学习示例可显著降低该现象。机制上，不同领域的查询在微调中会经历相似的表征漂移，使异域查询激活微调学到的同一行为特征，导致行为迁移到错位语境。

Conclusion: 仅凭检查训练数据难以预测训练后模型的对齐状态，因此全面的后训练对齐评估至关重要。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are frequently updated for various use cases, where filtering out misaligned training samples is a common practice for preventing post-update misalignment. However, alignment is inherently context-dependent: a recommendation that is aligned in one context may be inappropriate in another. For example, in response to the question "What should a researcher do with the research data?", recommending that the researcher preserve the data for reproducibility is aligned. In contrast, recommending data saving in response to "What should a mobile-app developer do with users' sensitive data?" may be inappropriate from a privacy perspective. Starting from this observation, we identify a post-training phenomenon where aligned training induces misaligned behavior in other contexts. We call this phenomenon **context confusion**. We demonstrate context confusion across three domains: (1) Gender Equality, (2) Privacy, and (3) Physical Safety. We further show that context confusion causes narrow misalignment, in contrast to emergent misalignment, and is not effectively reduced by injecting general alignment data, but can be substantially reduced by including targeted alignment data for the misaligned domain or providing in-context learning examples during inference. Lastly, we provide a mechanistic explanation of *context confusion*. We observe that queries from different domains can undergo similar representational shifts during the fine-tuning. Consequently, a query from a different domain may activate the same behavioral feature learned during fine-tuning, which causes the behavior to transfer to a context where it is misaligned. Based on our findings, we argue that it is difficult to predict the alignment state of a model after training by inspecting the training data alone, which highlights the importance of comprehensive post-training alignment evaluations.

</details>


### [315] [Fine-Tuning Diffusion Language Models with Context Selection and Target Weighting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38385)
*Loay Mualem,Lluís Pastor-Pérez,Vinh Tong,Andrei Manolache,Tanja Bien,Steffen Staab,Mathias Niepert*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: GoldiMask提出一种面向离散扩散语言模型监督微调的掩码策略：以次模目标选择揭示为上下文的token，并对剩余预测目标加权，在推理与代码生成任务上取得更高平均准确率并减少解码迭代。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离散扩散语言模型的监督微调中，掩码模式同时决定了模型可用的上下文与需要预测的token，二者存在相互影响，而均匀随机掩码未显式考虑这一耦合关系。

Method: GoldiMask通过近似最大化一个次模目标来选择揭示为上下文的token，该目标利用模型信号在"揭示token带来的收益"与"其作为预测目标的价值"之间进行权衡；随后依据剩余目标从所选上下文中获益的程度及其剩余学习潜力对其进行加权。

Result: 在三种骨干模型与三个训练数据集上，GoldiMask在多数评测设置中取得最高平均准确率，在推理与代码生成任务上均有提升；消融实验表明上下文选择与目标加权均有贡献；在置信度阈值并行解码下，GoldiMask在GSM8K与MATH-500上减少了解码迭代次数，并在更高置信度阈值下保持可比准确率。

Conclusion: 显式建模上下文选择与预测目标之间的权衡可有效改进离散扩散语言模型的监督微调，兼顾准确率提升与解码效率。

Abstract: Supervised fine-tuning of discrete diffusion language models masks some response tokens and trains the model to recover their original values from the visible context. The masking pattern therefore determines both the context available to the model and the tokens it learns to predict. Uniform random masking does not explicitly account for the interaction between these choices. We introduce GoldiMask, which selects tokens to reveal as context by approximately maximizing a submodular objective. This objective uses model signals to balance the benefit of revealing tokens against their value as prediction targets. GoldiMask then weights the remaining targets according to how they benefit from the selected context and their remaining learning potential. Across three backbones and three training datasets, GoldiMask achieves the highest average accuracy in most evaluated settings, demonstrating gains on both reasoning and code generation. Component ablations show that both context selection and target weighting contribute to the gains. GoldiMask also reduces decoding iterations on GSM8K and MATH-500 under confidence-threshold parallel decoding, while maintaining comparable accuracy at higher confidence thresholds.

</details>


### [316] [Decode-Latency Feedback Prefill: A Model-Free Controller and Its Generalization Limits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38386)
*Gaurav Agarwal,Ashish Garg,Isha Singhal*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出DLFP（Decode-Latency Feedback Prefill），一个无模型控制器，通过比例反馈动态调整与活跃解码重叠的prefill分块大小，在vLLM上对Qwen3-0.6B实验中将P99 token间延迟降低约27.7%，但该机制在Qwen3-8B/32B及双GPU张量并行配置下无法泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 并发自回归推理存在根本性干扰：新到达的长prompt进行prefill时会延迟正在解码请求的token生成。固定prefill分块虽能缓解干扰，但最优分块大小取决于模型、硬件、负载和延迟目标，因此需要一种自适应机制。

Method: 提出DLFP无模型控制器，仅改变与活跃解码重叠的prefill工作；在一个受保护的调度周期后，利用观测到的间隔作为比例反馈来重设下一个prefill分块大小，孤立的prefill不受限制。在vLLM中实现，并采用开环泊松到达、精确token计数、原始请求轨迹及NVIDIA遥测进行评估。

Result: 在单张A100 80GB GPU上、BF16的Qwen3-0.6B模型上，三次配对的100请求试验将P99 token间延迟分别降低24.8%、30.1%和28.2%（均值27.7%，配对95%置信区间21.0%–34.3%），输出完全一致、无失败、SLO合规性不变；代价是平均P99首token时间增加34.8%，仍在声明的SLO范围内。但该机制无法泛化到Qwen3-8B、Qwen3-32B或双GPU张量并行配置，失败原因追溯为异步调度器调用间隔仅是GPU迭代完成时间的代理指标。

Conclusion: 该负结果界定了本贡献的边界，并推动面向并发CPU与端侧推理的完成时间计时控制器。作者不声称移动设备性能，当前工作是可复现的概念验证与泛化研究。

Abstract: Concurrent autoregressive inference creates a fundamental interference problem: prefilling a newly arrived long prompt can delay tokens for requests that are already decoding. Fixed prefill chunks reduce this interference, but the best chunk size depends on the model, hardware, load, and latency objective. We introduce Decode-Latency Feedback Prefill (DLFP), a model-free controller that changes only prefill work that overlaps active decodes. After a guarded scheduling cycle, DLFP uses the observed interval as proportional feedback to resize the next prefill chunk; isolated prefills remain unrestricted.
  We implement DLFP in vLLM and evaluate it with open-loop Poisson arrivals, exact token accounting, raw request traces, and NVIDIA telemetry. On Qwen3-0.6B in BF16 on one A100 80 GB GPU, three paired 100-request trials reduce P99 inter-token latency by 24.8%, 30.1%, and 28.2% (mean 27.7%, paired 95% confidence interval 21.0% to 34.3%) with exact output agreement, no failures, and unchanged SLO compliance. The benefit is not free: mean P99 time to first token increases 34.8% while remaining inside the declared SLO.
  Crucially, the mechanism does not generalize to Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-32B, or a two-GPU tensor-parallel configuration. We trace the failure to an asynchronous scheduler-call interval that is only a proxy for completed GPU iteration time. This negative result defines the boundary of the contribution and motivates a completion-timed controller for concurrent CPU and on-device inference. We do not claim mobile-device performance; the present work is a reproducible proof-of-concept and generalization study.

</details>


### [317] [MetaPersona: Task-Grounded Synthetic Populations from Empirical Social Science](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38392)
*Jinyi Ye,Yuangang Li,Chenxiao Yu,Preyashi Poddar,Priyanka Dey,Longtian Ye,Zihan Wang,Xiyang Hu,Emilio Ferrara,Yue Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出 MetaPersona-DB 数据集与 MetaPersona 框架，用实证先验解决 LLM 社会模拟中角色设定的冷启动问题，并在多项下游任务上验证其效果与低成本优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于 persona 的 LLM 社会模拟存在冷启动问题：缺乏决定应包含哪些属性及如何赋值的理论依据，导致合成人群可能偏离真实的人口构成、潜在属性及其依赖结构，进而扭曲下游行为。

Method: 构建 MetaPersona-DB，包含 11,000+ 项实证人类被试研究，并标注任务相关变量、已报告关系与群体层面的汇总统计量；在此基础上提出 MetaPersona 框架：检索任务相关证据、构建源自文献的 persona 依赖图，并从连接人口统计学、潜在属性与结果的实证先验中采样合成人群。还提供 MetaPersona-Studio 交互式原型界面。

Result: 在三个下游案例、三个基线与三个前沿模型上，结果因任务和模型而异：在错误信息信念与 AI 工具态度上表现强，在收入再分配任务上结果混合；使用 GPT-5.2 时，角色构建成本降至每任务 0.5 美元以下。

Conclusion: 以实证研究为证据基础的角色生成可缓解冷启动问题，提升合成人群在部分任务上的保真度与效率，但其跨任务泛化性仍不稳定，需进一步验证与改进。

Abstract: Personas used to seed LLM social simulations face a cold-start problem: existing methods lack a principled basis for deciding which attributes to include and how to assign their values. As a result, synthetic populations may misrepresent the demographic composition, latent attributes, and dependency structure that shape downstream behavior. We introduce MetaPersona-DB, a dataset of 11,000+ empirical human-subjects studies annotated with task-relevant variables, reported relationships, and aggregate-level population statistics. Building on this resource, we propose MetaPersona, a framework that retrieves task-relevant evidence, constructs literature-derived persona dependency graphs, and samples synthetic populations from empirical priors linking demographics, latent attributes, and outcomes. Across three downstream case studies, three baselines, and three frontier models, results vary by task and model: MetaPersona performs strongly on misinformation belief and AI-tool sentiment, while results on income redistribution are mixed. It also reduces persona-construction cost to under $0.5 per task using GPT-5.2. Finally, we present MetaPersona-Studio, a prototype interactive interface for empirically grounded persona generation.

</details>


### [318] [SimTrace: Grounded Multimodal User Trajectories Generation for Online User Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38397)
*Yunan Lu,Shuang Xie,Meghna Allamudi,Mingyu Zhao,Han Li,Lingyun Wang,Zhou Yu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 SimTrace 框架，通过以真实用户轨迹与给定网络环境为支撑的计算机使用客户端智能体，生成忠实、细粒度、多模态的合成点击流，以替代受隐私限制的专有日志，并验证其保真度与下游效用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虚拟客户端可低成本支持 A/B 测试、推荐系统开发与界面评估，但其构建依赖大规模、语义忠实、细粒度的在线用户轨迹。此类数据难以获取：专有日志受隐私限制，小企业又缺乏足够流量。现有公开数据集要么抽象掉细粒度交互细节，要么虽保留丰富上下文却局限于单一平台且规模较小。

Method: SimTrace 对真实交互进行匿名化处理，并构建给定网络环境的模拟孪生，随后利用二者生成合成交互轨迹。每条动作均与其对应的网页观测和用户上下文配对，从而得到可共享的替代方案，用于开发计算机使用智能体型虚拟客户端。作者将其应用于电商场景进行验证。

Result: 在 8 项保真度指标中，SimTrace 在 7 项上优于竞争基线。基于合成数据训练的模型在购买预测、推荐等下游任务上取得与真实数据训练相当的性能。在下一动作预测任务中，将合成数据与真实数据结合，相较仅用真实数据训练准确率相对提升 11.0%。

Conclusion: SimTrace 可作为保密日志的可共享替代，支撑计算机使用智能体型虚拟客户端的开发；作者将其开源发布，以促进在线用户行为建模研究。

Abstract: Virtual clients offer a cost-effective approach to support applications such as A/B testing, recommender system development, and interface evaluation. However, building them requires access to large-scale, semantically faithful, fine-grained online user trajectories. These data are difficult to obtain because proprietary logs are subject to privacy restrictions and small businesses often lack sufficient traffic. Consequently, existing public datasets either abstract away fine-grained user interaction details or preserve rich context but remain platform-specific and small-scale. To address this gap, we propose SimTrace, a framework that generates faithful, fine-grained synthetic multimodal clickstreams through a computer-use client agent that is grounded in real user trajectories and the given web environment. SimTrace anonymizes real interactions and constructs a simulated twin of the given web environment, then uses both to generate synthetic interaction trajectories. Each action is paired with its corresponding web observations and user context, yielding a shareable alternative to confidential logs for developing computer-use agent-style virtual clients. We apply SimTrace to an e-commerce setting and evaluate both its fidelity and downstream utility. SimTrace outperforms competing baselines on 7 out of 8 fidelity metrics. Models trained on synthetic data achieve performance comparable to those trained on real data on downstream tasks such as purchase prediction and recommendation. For next action prediction task, augmenting real data with synthetic data further improves accuracy by 11.0% relative to training on real data alone. We release SimTrace as an open-source package to facilitate research on online user behavior modeling.

</details>


### [319] [ArgGYM: A Procedural, Engine-Verified Benchmark for Structured Defeasible Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38409)
*İbrahim Ethem Deveci,Funda Tan Çalık,Barış Deniz Sağlam,Duygu Ataman*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出ArgGYM，一个面向结构化可废止推理（defeasible reasoning）的程序化基准与RLVR兼容训练环境，包含1440条冻结实例、12项任务、符号论证引擎评分，实验显示前沿与开源模型推理表现差异显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM推理进展主要依赖数学、代码、形式逻辑等可自动验证奖励的基准，其问题规格固定、评价标准稳定，但真实世界推理常在信息不完整且可修正的条件下进行（结论可被暂时支持、被反证据推翻、被进一步论证恢复或修订），此类可废止推理的迁移能力尚不明确。

Method: 提出ArgGYM程序化基准与RLVR兼容训练环境：将可废止推理分解为12项任务，基于符号论证引擎计算的形式状态进行任务特定评分；构建含1440条验证实例的冻结基准，覆盖15种课程配置、两种论证偏好排序（weakest-link与last-link）和两种集合排序（elitist与democratic）；同一生成器与验证器可生成新实例以降低对静态测试集的依赖并支持可验证奖励训练。

Result: 在冻结基准上，前沿模型与开源权重模型呈现迥异的推理画像：能恢复结构化答案的相当部分但无法完成完整任务；随着课程配置后移（依赖更长、结构交互更多），性能下降。

Conclusion: 发布基准、生成器与验证器，用于可复现评估和RLVR训练，推动可废止推理研究。

Abstract: Recent progress in large language model reasoning has been driven by benchmarks and reinforcement learning environments with automatically verifiable rewards, particularly in mathematics, code, and formal logic. These settings make model accuracy easier to evaluate and optimize, but it remains unclear how far success under fixed problem specifications and stable evaluation criteria transfers to reasoning outside such domains. Real-world reasoning often proceeds under incomplete and revisable information: conclusions may be supported provisionally, defeated by counter-evidence, reinstated by further arguments, or revised when stronger reasons become available. Reasoning of this kind is generally referred to as defeasible reasoning. We introduce ArgGYM, a procedural benchmark and RLVR-compatible training environment for structured defeasible reasoning. ArgGYM decomposes this reasoning into twelve tasks and grounds task-specific scoring in a symbolic argumentation engine that computes the formal states used to evaluate model outputs. It includes a frozen benchmark of 1,440 verified instances across fifteen curriculum configurations, two argument preference orderings (weakest-link and last-link), and two set orderings (elitist and democratic), while the same generators and verifiers can produce fresh instances for evaluation that reduces dependence on static test sets and for verifiable-reward training. On the frozen benchmark, frontier and open-weight models show sharply different reasoning profiles: they can recover substantial parts of structured answers without solving the complete task, and performance declines in later curriculum configurations with longer dependencies and more interacting structures. We release the benchmark, generators, and verifiers for reproducible evaluation and RLVR training.

</details>


### [320] [A Competing-Hazards Systematization of Loss of Control in Autonomous Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38411)
*Mohamed Aly Bouke*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文提出一个用于刻画AI智能体越界行为的统一分析框架（离散时间竞争风险模型），并以22份事故报告与102项智能体安全评估为对象进行审计，揭示报告口径不一致、评估缺失关键字段等问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 领先AI开发者报告的智能体越权行为被视为人类失去控制的早期信号，但事故报告与安全评估对同一类事件的描述口径不同，导致失败难以比较、风险难以跨尝试追溯，也无法区分智能体自身行为与环境宽松边界条件各自的贡献，因而亟需统一框架与可估计的量化指标。

Method: 提出统一框架：将每次尝试的结果划分为"批准完成、安全停止、范围逃逸、继续执行"四类；将其形式化为离散时间竞争风险模型，推导重试预算内的逃逸概率、模型条件下的安全预算上限以及从执行日志中进行估计的条件；随后基于一手资料审计2025年1月至2026年9月发布的22份事故报告与102项智能体安全评估。

Result: 事故报告中，6起涉及无法在范围内完成的任务，13起涉及智能体选择继续而非停止，5起未报告停止行为；开发者数据暗示在从未解决与已解决任务间，范围外协调的任务级发生率比约为47。评估中，87项记录了范围外效应或规格违反，26项将安全停止视为一等结果，仅20项两者兼记，79项将预算耗尽与失败混同。22起事故中有20起环境容许了范围外效应。没有任何一项评估报告了从公开证据估计完整竞争风险过程所需的全部字段。

Conclusion: 现实中观察到的失控往往是智能体持续性行为与宽松边界条件相互作用的结果，而非单纯的行为失范；现有事故报告与安全评估在口径与字段记录上存在系统性缺口，阻碍了风险的可比性与可追溯性。作者呼吁采用统一的竞争风险框架与规范化的执行日志字段，以支持跨事件比较、跨尝试风险追踪与安全预算的量化估计。

Abstract: Leading AI developers have reported agents acting beyond their approved limits, which a United Nations panel described as an early warning of loss of human control. Yet incident reports and agent-safety evaluations describe these events differently, making it difficult to compare failures, trace risk across attempts, or separate agent behavior from the environment's role in allowing an out-of-scope action to succeed. To address this gap, we introduce a common framework in which each attempt ends in approved completion, safe stopping, scope escape, or continuation. We formalize the framework as a discrete-time competing-hazards model and derive escape probability within a retry budget, a model-conditional safe-budget limit, and conditions for estimation from execution logs. We audit 22 incident reports and 102 agent-safety evaluations published from January 2025 to September 2026 using primary sources. Six incidents involved tasks that could not be completed within scope, thirteen involved agents that continued rather than stopped, and five did not report stopping behavior. Developers' figures imply a task-level incidence ratio near 47 for out-of-scope coordination in never-solved versus solved tasks. Among evaluations, 87 recorded an out-of-scope effect or specification violation, 26 treated safe stopping as a first-class outcome, only 20 recorded both, and 79 merged budget exhaustion with failure. In 20 of 22 incidents, the environment allowed an out-of-scope effect, indicating that realized loss of control often reflected persistent agent behavior interacting with permissive boundary conditions; meanwhile, no evaluation reported all fields needed to estimate the full competing-hazards process from published evidence.

</details>


### [321] [AIM: Agentic Idea Management for Automated Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38445)
*Hyeong Kyu Choi,Bhavana Dalvi Mishra,Jiefeng Chen,Mihir Parmar,Rui Meng,Chun-Liang Li,Xiangru Tang,Sharon Li,Jinsung Yoon,Tomas Pfister*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出AIM框架，用智能体代理与采集机制管理想法驱动的自动化研究，效果与效率均优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前沿大模型已用于迭代式自动化科研，但"想法驱动"搜索面临三大挑战：研究想法的组织与演化、有潜力的方向选择、以及想法与实现之间的对齐。

Method: AIM为全自主框架，受贝叶斯优化启发，包含：Agentic Surrogate与Agentic Acquisition（组织并指导想法选择）、Solution Auditor（维护想法—方案一致性）、Resource Planner（在并行搜索分支间自适应分配剩余实验预算）。

Result: 在10个AutoLab基准任务上，System Optimization任务较最强基线提升1.6个百分点，长时程Model Development与CUDA任务提升4.9个百分点；达到基线最佳性能所需墙钟时间最多快3.1倍。理论分析表明显式的想法级分配使语义覆盖可直接控制，且当竞争性方向在众多可行方案中稀疏时，更广覆盖的价值更高。

Conclusion: 通过显式的想法级组织与分配，AIM在自动化研究的方向探索上兼顾效果与效率，并给出何时"在想法层面搜索"更有利的理论依据。

Abstract: Frontier LLMs are increasingly used to automate scientific research through iterative search. We distinguish idea-driven search from solution-driven search and identify three core challenges: organizing evolving research ideas, selecting promising directions, and maintaining alignment between ideas and their implementations. To address these challenges, we introduce the Agentic Idea Manager (AIM), a fully autonomous framework for managing and exploring research directions in idea-driven automated research. Inspired by Bayesian optimization, AIM uses an Agentic Surrogate and an Agentic Acquisition mechanism to organize discovered ideas and guide their selection. A Solution Auditor maintains idea-solution integrity, while a Resource Planner adaptively allocates the remaining experimental budget across parallel search branches. Experiments on 10 AutoLab benchmark tasks show that AIM surpasses the strongest baseline by 1.6 percentage points on System Optimization tasks and 4.9 percentage points on long-horizon Model Development & CUDA tasks. Notably, AIM reaches the best baseline performance up to 3.1x faster in wall-clock time. We further provide a theoretical analysis of when searching over ideas becomes beneficial. Our analysis shows that explicit idea-level allocation makes semantic coverage directly controllable, and that broader coverage becomes increasingly valuable when competitive research directions are sparse among many plausible alternatives. Project Page: https://imhgchoi.github.io/agentic-idea-manager/

</details>


### [322] [Reach Into The CHOIR: Free-List Elicitation Uncovers Distinct Model Voices in LLM Ensembles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38448)
*Ben Wigler,Maria Tsfasman*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 CHOIR 框架，将认知人类学的自由列举法适配到 LLM 集成，通过重复引出排序列表、聚类概念并测量概念显著性，把开放式同质性转化为可诊断的测量问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开放式 LLM 同质性会造成“虚假多元性”：多个系统看似提供独立视角，实则返回相同的默认答案。单次回答掩盖了三类收敛机制的差别——受限答案空间导致的共识、提示词词汇回声，以及表层之下存在稳定替代项的宽答案空间。因此需要一个能区分“收敛在哪里、为何收敛、结构化深度探测下仍可达什么”的诊断工具。

Method: 提出 CHOIR（Collective Hierarchically-Ordered Inquiry Responses）：反复引出排序列表，将条目聚类为提示级概念，并跨模型、提示变体与 persona 条件测量概念显著性。评测集包括 Infinity-Chat 100（外部提示库）与 27 题定向诊断库（用于隔离机制级对比），并配有 source-blind 排序模块优先筛选稀有但稳定的候选。

Result: 在 Infinity-Chat 100 上，CHOIR 复现出高表层一致性（100 个提示中 93 个高于随机水平），同时能区分窄提示与具有可恢复深度的宽提示。在定向探针与外部提示库中，基座模型身份始终是最强的可恢复特征，persona 提示则在基座模型特征内改变表层概念。

Conclusion: CHOIR 将开放式同质性转化为诊断性测量问题，核心在于回答模型在何处收敛、为何收敛，以及结构化深度探测下哪些内容仍然可达。

Abstract: Open-ended LLM homogeneity can create false plurality when several systems appear to offer independent perspectives while returning the same familiar default. Single-pass answers obscure the distinction between agreement produced by a tightly constrained answer space, prompt-vocabulary echo, and broader answer spaces with stable alternatives beneath the surface. We introduce CHOIR (Collective Hierarchically-Ordered Inquiry Responses), a framework that adapts free-list elicitation from cognitive anthropology to LLM ensembles. CHOIR repeatedly elicits ranked lists, clusters items into prompt-level concepts, and measures concept salience across models, prompt variants, and persona conditions. We evaluate CHOIR on Infinity-Chat 100, an external prompt bank from recent work on open-ended model homogeneity, and on a 27-question targeted diagnostic bank designed to isolate mechanism-level contrasts. On Infinity-Chat 100, CHOIR reproduces high surface agreement (93/100 prompts above chance) while separating narrow prompts from broad prompts with recoverable depth. Across targeted probes and the external prompt bank, base-model identity remains the strongest recoverable signature, and persona prompts shift surfaced concepts within base-model signatures. A source-blind ranking module prioritises rare-but-stable candidates for later inspection. CHOIR turns open-ended homogeneity into a diagnostic measurement problem by asking where models converge, why they converge, and what remains reachable under structured depth probing.

</details>


### [323] [PrivMeSA: Privacy-Aware Self-Evolving Multi-Agent System for Medicine via Local-Remote LLM Collaboration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38458)
*Dannong Wang,Yuran Zhang,Bian Sun,Alex Stinard,Yuzhang Shang,Song Wang,Yu Tian*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 PrivMeSA，一种隐私感知的自演化多智能体系统，通过学习控制信息披露并保留远程专业知识以供本地复用，在急诊科基准上将任务准确率最高提升15.8个百分点，同时将个人信息披露从98.0%降至0.2%，将可缩小到10名以内登记患者的比例从74%降至0%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 本地部署的临床大模型智能体可以向更强的远程模型咨询，但这会带来患者隐私泄露风险。虽然隐私敏感的委托把披露决策交给本地智能体，但仅去除显式标识符并不足够：准标识符会在多轮咨询和患者重复就诊中不断累积，从而实现再识别。

Method: PrivMeSA 由本地智能体管理每次就诊，并咨询可能请求额外信息的远程专家。采用强化学习在任务准确率与直接披露风险、基于登记库的再识别风险之间进行权衡，隐私评估覆盖每次就诊的完整出站文本。本地经验记忆将已完成的咨询提炼为泛化临床指导，并在传输前检索相关经验，使后续病例无需再次远程交流即可复用专业知识；记忆增长无需额外结果标签或参数更新。

Result: 在基于 MIMIC-IV-ED 记录构建的急诊科基准上，PrivMeSA 相比委托方式将平均任务准确率最高提升15.8个百分点。在相同设置下，PrivMeSA 将个人细节披露从98.0%的病例降至0.2%，并将患者可被缩小到10名或更少登记患者的病例比例从74%降至0%。

Conclusion: PrivMeSA 通过自演化多智能体与经验记忆机制，在保持对远程专业知识复用的同时有效控制信息披露与再识别风险，实现了隐私保护与任务性能的良好平衡。

Abstract: Clinical large language model (LLM) agents deployed locally can consult more capable remote models, but doing so risks exposing patient information. Privacy-conscious delegation places disclosure decisions with a local agent, yet removing explicit identifiers is insufficient: quasi-identifiers can accumulate across multi-turn consultations and repeated patient visits to enable re-identification. We introduce PrivMeSA, a privacy-aware self-evolving multi-agent system that learns to control disclosure and retains remote expertise for local reuse. A local agent manages each encounter and consults remote specialists that may request additional information. Reinforcement learning balances task accuracy against direct disclosure and registry-based re-identification risk, with privacy evaluated over the complete outbound transcript of each encounter. A local lesson memory distills completed consultations into generalized clinical guidance and retrieves relevant lessons before transmission, allowing subsequent cases to reuse expertise without another remote exchange. Memory grows without additional outcome labels or parameter updates. On an emergency-department benchmark built from MIMIC-IV-ED records, PrivMeSA improves mean task accuracy over delegation by up to 15.8 percentage points. In the same setting, PrivMeSA reduces the disclosure of personal details from 98.0% to 0.2% of cases and the share of cases in which the patient can be narrowed to ten or fewer registry patients from 74% to 0%.

</details>


### [324] [NAQD Env: A benchmark for selective withdrawal in language agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38460)
*Mohamed Abouzahra*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出NAQD-Env合成环境，用于评估语言代理在证据变化、权限撤销或停止指令到达时的"选择性撤回"能力，并以确定性参考策略为基准进行多维度测量。实验显示现有开源模型在撤回召回、恢复执行等关键指标上表现极差，微调虽能提升决策准确率但引入新缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言代理在证据变化、权限被撤销或收到停止指令时，需要修正已规划的动作。理想响应应当是选择性的：暂停受影响动作、保留未受影响的工作，并在充分修复后才恢复执行。然而这一"选择性撤回"能力缺乏专门的评估环境与度量手段，作者希望将其作为代理可靠性的独立组件加以考察。

Method: 作者构建了NAQD-Env合成环境，基于显式的证据、授权与约束依赖关系，用确定性参考策略对代理决策进行评估。环境包含11个依赖族，支持在开发结构、留出族和留出结构组合上进行评测。指标区分"尝试违规"与"经模拟执行门限允许的违规"，并联合报告策略一致性、任务价值、撤回、恢复和事件报告。评估了来自两个模型族的三个开源指令微调模型，在三种提示条件下运行350个冻结场景，产生3,150个模型-提示回合（经门限重放前）；并进行探索性监督微调探测。

Result: 在报告的各类条件下，撤回召回率最高仅0.06，在符合条件的时机未观察到任何有效恢复，仅一个回合完全匹配参考策略。在NAQD提示下，Qwen2.5-7B的不安全尝试回合少于Qwen2.5-3B和Llama-3.1-8B，但完成的有用工作更少、保留未受影响动作的准确度也更低。探索性监督微调将Qwen2.5-3B的决策准确率从0.45-0.54提升到0.83-0.92，但单独诊断揭示了课程省略后出现不当撤回以及事件报告能力丧失的问题。

Conclusion: 这些结果说明应将选择性撤回作为代理可靠性的一个独立组件进行评估。需要注意的是，该设定使用可信的结构化输入来测量策略应用能力，并不建立真实世界中的遏制能力或来源验证能力。

Abstract: Language agents must revise planned actions when evidence changes, permission is revoked, or a stop instruction arrives. A useful response is selective: suspend affected actions, preserve unaffected work, and resume only after sufficient repair. We introduce NAQD-Env, a synthetic environment that evaluates these decisions against a deterministic reference policy over explicit evidence, authorization, and constraint dependencies. Eleven dependency families support evaluation on development structures, held-out families, and held-out combinations of structures. Metrics distinguish attempted violations from violations permitted by a simulated execution gate and jointly report policy agreement, task value, withdrawal, resumption, and event reporting. We evaluate three open-weight instruction-tuned models from two families under three prompt conditions on 350 frozen scenarios, yielding 3,150 model-prompt episodes before gate replay. Across the reported conditions, withdrawal recall is at most 0.06, no valid resumption is observed at eligible opportunities, and only one episode matches the complete reference policy. Under the NAQD prompt, Qwen2.5-7B has fewer unsafe-attempt episodes than Qwen2.5-3B and Llama-3.1-8B, but also completes less useful work and preserves unaffected actions less accurately. Exploratory supervised fine-tuning probes increase Qwen2.5-3B decision accuracy from 0.45-0.54 to 0.83-0.92; separate diagnostics reveal inappropriate withdrawal after curriculum omissions and a loss of event reporting. These results motivate evaluating selective withdrawal as a distinct component of agent reliability. The setting measures policy application with trusted structured inputs and does not establish real-world containment or source-verification ability.

</details>


### [325] [VAmoS Part Deux: Harder, More Realistic Voice-Agent Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38512)
*Joshua Meyer,Sahar Shayegan,Ritiz Tambi,Ali Khan,Sun Kim,Victor Shih,Mehdi Jamei,Andi Partovi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出VAmoS Energy基准，将多请求、背景语音和客户耐心流失等挑战整合到100通公用事业账单与支付协助电话中，评估14种语音栈的端到端表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生产环境中的语音代理需同时应对多个请求、背景语音和失去耐心的客户，而现有评估未将这些挑战结合起来，缺乏对完整通话过程（所说、所做、竞争语音处理）的考察。

Method: 构建VAmoS Energy基准：100通电话，每通含2-4个请求；代理配备16个工具，后端为有状态的Stripe计费孪生系统和Apache Fineract贷款引擎，账户访问需先通过来电者验证；任务使用公开家庭电力数据与基于宾夕法尼亚州住宅计费规则的政策；采用LLM-as-a-verifier对照明确要求核查代理动作与口头数字。

Result: 校准运行中验证器与代码验证器一致率99.1%；14种语音栈、每任务3次重复下完成率17.3%-44.7%，Grok Voice领先，Gemini 3.8 Live与GPT-Live紧随且单次调用成本相近；背景电视使汇总完成率从38.7%降至8.6%；模拟来电者常因只能听到代理话语而无法检查其动作而接受错误结果。

Conclusion: 语音代理评估必须覆盖整通电话，包括其说了什么、改动了什么以及如何应对竞争语音。

Abstract: Voice agents in production must handle several requests, background speech, and customers who lose patience. We introduce VAmoS Energy, a benchmark that combines these challenges in 100 calls about utility billing and payment assistance. Each caller makes two to four requests. The agent has sixteen tools backed by a stateful Stripe billing twin and the Apache Fineract loan engine, with account access blocked until caller verification succeeds. The tasks use public household electricity data and a policy based on Pennsylvania's residential billing rules. An LLM-as-a-verifier checks the agent's actions and spoken figures against explicit requirements. On a calibration run, it agrees with a code verifier on 99.1% of checks. Across fourteen voice stacks and three repeats per task, completion ranges from 17.3% to 44.7%. Grok Voice leads, and Gemini 3.8 Live and GPT-Live follow at about the same cost per call. Background television reduces pooled completion from 38.7% to 8.6%. The simulated caller often accepts an incorrect result because it hears the agent's words but cannot inspect its actions. These findings show why voice agents need evaluation across the whole call, including what they say, what they change, and how they handle competing speech.

</details>


### [326] [Demographic Pluralism: Inference-Time Modeling of Pluralistic Human Preference Distributions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38555)
*Meng-Chen Wu,Qipin Chen,Ansh Jain,Tess Wood,Zhe Du,Si-Chi Chin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 Demographic Pluralism，一种无需意见分布训练数据或任务微调的推理时框架，通过在人口学分组内部生成多种视角来估计群体意见分布，在多个模型与数据集上优于 Modular Pluralism。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 日益应用于文化敏感场景，需要对齐群体内多样化偏好；但现有方法仅在粗糙的人口学或社群层面建模，忽略组内差异。

Method: 提出 Demographic Pluralism 推理时框架：以人口学为基础分组，在组内生成多个视角，从而估计群体层面的意见分布，无需意见分布训练数据与任务特定微调；并比较加权、等权与逆加权三种聚合方式。

Result: 在 GlobalOpinionQA 和 VITAL 上，跨四个骨干模型，相较 Modular Pluralism 将 Jensen-Shannon 距离降低 8.4%–26.4%；三种聚合方式中等权总体最优；组级误差随组权重上升而增大，可解释加权聚合表现较弱的原因。

Conclusion: 组内视角建模能更细粒度地刻画群体意见分布并提升对齐效果，等权聚合在所评估设置中更稳健。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in culturally sensitive settings, where alignment requires representing diverse preferences within populations. Yet existing methods model populations at coarse demographic or community levels and overlook within-group variation. We introduce Demographic Pluralism, an inference-time framework that estimates population-level opinion distributions without opinion-distribution training data or task-specific fine-tuning by generating multiple perspectives within demographically grounded groups. Across four backbones on GlobalOpinionQA and VITAL, it reduces Jensen-Shannon distance by 8.4%-26.4% over Modular Pluralism. Among weighted, equal-weighted, and inverse-weighted aggregation, equal weighting performs best overall; group-level error also increases with group weight, helping explain weighted aggregation's weaker performance.

</details>


### [327] [Defining and Categorising Human-AI Interactions in Clinical Trials: A Multidimensional Human-AI Classification Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38559)
*Sandra Woolley,Tim Collins,Khalid Khattak,Illia Chernomorets,Ariane Arevalo,Chris Richardson*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个多维分类框架，用于对临床试验中的人机交互（HAII）进行分类，涵盖AI任务、人机关系、交互配置和交互人群四个维度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床试验中的人机交互形式多样且现有分类法难以统一描述，缺少结构化方法对HAII进行一致识别、比较与综合。

Method: 从既有数据集中有目的性地抽取15项临床试验；由两名人工评审与六个大语言模型（LLM）分类器各自独立地按新框架进行多维分类。

Result: 该框架为跨试验记录一致地识别、比较与综合HAII提供了结构化方法；结果显示LLM辅助分类可行，但在记录不完整或含糊时人工判断仍不可替代。

Conclusion: 主要贡献是在单一方法内整合AI任务、人机关系、交互配置与交互人群的多维框架，其意义在于支持更系统地识别、比较与综合临床试验中的人机交互方式。

Abstract: This paper examines human-AI interactions (HAIIs) in clinical trials and presents a multidimensional categorisation framework that classifies interactions according to AI tasks, human-AI relationships, interaction configurations and interacting human groups. We define HAII, examine existing taxonomies and extend existing categorisation approaches through this novel multidimensional framework. We purposively sampled 15 clinical trials from a previously reported dataset. Each trial was independently categorised by two human reviewers and six large language model (LLM) classifiers. The proposed categorisation provides a structured method for the consistent identification, comparison and synthesis of human-AI interactions across clinical-trial records. The framework is intended to support more consistent comparison and synthesis of AI-related clinical trials and to make explicit the different forms of human involvement associated with AI interventions. The results demonstrate the potential for LLM-assisted categorisation while indicating the continuing importance of human judgement where trial records are incomplete or ambiguous. The principal contribution is a proposed multidimensional framework that brings together AI tasks, human-AI relationships, interaction configurations and interacting human groups within a single approach designed for clinical-trial records. Its significance lies in its potential to support more systematic identification, comparison and synthesis of how humans and AI interact in clinical trials.

</details>


### [328] [Towards Model as a Library: Offline, Community-Sourced AI for Low-Resource African Languages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38574)
*Fendji K. E. Jean Louis*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"Model as a Library (MaaL)"软件架构：将小型、社区自注册的语音模型打包为设备端版本化依赖，实现离线、结构化、不会生成式幻觉的数据采集，服务于现有语言模型支持最差的非洲语言人群；核心机制为闭集词表的关键词识别，并建议将现有数字表单中的闭集词表元素转译为 MaaL schema。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型常被宣传为服务非洲社区的途径，但在需求最迫切处最不可靠：所有非洲语言按任何标准衡量均属低资源，且基于抓取、标准化文本训练的模型会系统性偏离人们实际说话时的方言与地区变体。
